🎨 **个性化** — 8 种配色、本机界面缩放、终端模式，以及可调不透明度与可选磨砂模糊。 ## 内置插件 随桌面资源分发的一方插件： - [DSH Tauri](https://dshtauri.mintlify.site/zh-CN/built-in-plugins/dsh-tauri) — 核心插件，桌面端与 Harness 通信、版本适配器、插件依赖管理 - [DSH Tauri UI](https://dshtauri.mintlify.site/zh-CN/built-in-plugins/dsh-tauri-ui) — 桌面设置界面、原生核心组件、主题与配色 - [DSH Tauri Mobile UI](https://dshtauri.mintlify.site/zh-CN/built-in-plugins/dsh-tauri-mobile-ui) — 触屏布局与移动端偏好设置 - [DSH Tauri Worktree](https://dshtauri.mintlify.site/zh-CN/built-in-plugins/dsh-tauri-worktree) — 会话级 Git 工作树与检出 - [DSH Tauri Extension](https://dshtauri.mintlify.site/zh-CN/built-in-plugins/dsh-tauri-extension) — 官方插件管理、插件市场、Skills 与 MCP - [DSH Tauri Scheduler](https://dshtauri.mintlify.site/zh-CN/built-in-plugins/dsh-tauri-scheduler) — 定时任务与执行记录 - [DSH Tauri Archive](https://dshtauri.mintlify.site/zh-CN/built-in-plugins/dsh-tauri-archive) — 聊天归档与恢复 - [DSH Tauri Pet](https://dshtauri.mintlify.site/zh-CN/built-in-plugins/dsh-tauri-pet) — 桌宠与活动状态设置 - [DSH Tauri Rightclick Menu](https://dshtauri.mintlify.site/zh-CN/built-in-plugins/dsh-tauri-rightclick) — 会话、工作区与正文右键菜单 - [DSH Tauri Model](https://dshtauri.mintlify.site/zh-CN/built-in-plugins/dsh-tauri-model) — 模型选择与参数、自动配置模型 - [DSH Tauri Remote](https://dshtauri.mintlify.site/zh-CN/built-in-plugins/dsh-tauri-remote) — SSH 远端 Harness 连接与同步，并把本机 Harness 分享到局域网或公网隧道 - [DSH Tauri Notification](https://dshtauri.mintlify.site/zh-CN/built-in-plugins/dsh-tauri-notification) — 原生级会话通知与交互操作 ## 可选预设 启动引导提供以下社区插件，可按需安装； - [DSH Better Sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) — 按会话隔离的右编辑器侧栏 - [Billion Context](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context) — 上下文压缩与历史恢复 - [DSH Office Kit](https://github.com/hairyf/dsh-office-kit) — Office 文档、PDF、演示文稿与表格 - [DSH Market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) — 社区插件市场 - [DSH Rewind](https://github.com/SiriLee/dsh-rewind) — 对话回退与工作区备份 - [DSH IM](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im) — IM 渠道与机器人管理 - [DSH OPS](https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops) — 底层操作工具，减少 Token 消耗与任务耗时 新增或更新预设请提交 [Issue](https://github.com/dsh-tauri/deepseek-harness-desktop/issues)；可用版本由清单中的内核兼容规则决定。 ## 快速开始 从 [Releases](https://github.com/dsh-tauri/deepseek-harness-desktop/releases) 下载对应平台与架构的安装包： | 平台 | 要求 | 安装包 | | --- | --- | --- | | Windows | Windows 10+、WebView2 | x64 `.exe` / `.msi` | | macOS | macOS 12+；Web 界面需 Safari 17.4+ 能力 | Intel / Apple Silicon `.dmg` | | Linux | WebKit2GTK 4.1、GStreamer ≥ 1.24（AppImage 使用宿主的 GLib、WebKit 与媒体栈） | x64 `.AppImage` / `.deb` | macOS 也可通过 Homebrew 安装： ```bash brew install dsh-tauri/desktop/deepseek-harness ``` Fedora 43+（x64 / ARM64）可通过 Copr 仓库安装，升级随 `dnf upgrade` 进行，应用内更新已关闭；想跟进预发布版可改装 `dsh-tauri-beta`（与 `dsh-tauri` 互斥，用 `sudo dnf swap dsh-tauri dsh-tauri-beta` 切换）： ```bash sudo dnf copr enable fairyband/dsh-tauri sudo dnf install dsh-tauri # 正式版 ``` - 普通安装包首次启动需联网下载缺失的运行时与内核；Git 功能需要可用的 Git。 - 包含 `Bundle` 后缀为离线安装包（`_Bundle_*.exe`、`_Bundle_*.deb`、两种 `_Bundle_*.dmg`）。 - 本地运行不等于完全离线：模型服务、插件安装、更新与桌宠预设素材仍可能联网。 - Linux 显示、Wayland、AppImage 与权限问题的处理见[安装与故障排查文档](https://dshtauri.mintlify.site/zh-CN/help/troubleshooting)。 ### 桌面代理 - 在**配置 → 应用 → 代理地址**设置 HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS5 或 SOCKS5H 代理。 - 仅用于桌面端依赖/内核下载、更新检查及插件元数据，不修改模型请求或插件子进程的网络配置。 - 留空沿用系统/环境代理；保存后对新请求生效，可重试失败的下载。 - SOCKS5H 通过代理解析目标域名；本机回环连接始终直连。 ## 移动端支持 **DSH Mobile** 通过局域网或公网隧道访问电脑上的 Harness，不在手机运行内核。 - **Android**：从 [Releases](https://github.com/dsh-tauri/deepseek-harness-desktop/releases) 下载 APK。 - **iOS**：通过 [TestFlight 邀请](https://testflight.apple.com/join/kYXkpnp1)安装测试版，以审核与名额为准；Release 中的未签名 IPA 需自行签名。 在桌面顶部**远程**开启分享，手机扫码配对；电脑、Harness 与所用隧道须在线。远程访问并非只读，请勿公开二维码或访问码，详见[手机远程访问指南](https://dshtauri.mintlify.site/zh-CN/guides/mobile-remote-access)。 移动端仅在官方移动服务推出前维护；开发说明见[移动端规范](docs/specs/native.md)。 ## 运行方式 Windows 启动失败时会通过原生对话框显示具体错误。若出现 `STARTUP_LOW_INTEGRITY`： - 进程低于 Medium 完整性级别，无法写入正常用户数据；更新后的程序可能继承安装目录的 Low 标签。 - 用 `icacls` 检查目录与程序；将可信安装恢复为 Medium，或重新安装到正常目录。 - 以管理员身份运行不会移除 Low 标签限制；无需删除会话或修改 `DSH_HOME`。 | 当前基线 | 版本 | | --- | --- | | 推荐 Harness 内核 | `0.2.1-rc.4` | | 支持的内核最低版本 | `0.2.1-rc.4`，不保证所有插件兼容 | 更早内核不再支持；旧兼容记录仅保留历史事实，不代表当前支持范围。 - 内核与预设选择遵循[资源清单](<./src-tauri/resources/manifest.jsonc>)及插件声明的版本范围；不保证任意最新上游版本都兼容。 - 正式版默认启用 CLI 集成：Windows / macOS / Linux 自动更新 PATH。需重新打开终端，其他 shell 仍需要手动配置。 ## 交流

--- owner: @esengine backup: @SivanCola status: active reviewed: 2026-10-17 --- # dsh-plugin-reasonix English | [中文](#中文) [Website](https://reasonix.io) · [Documentation](../../docs/DSH.md) · [Source](../../README.md) Use [Reasonix](../../README.md) as a subagent in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`). The package is configuration only: one patch layer that points Harness's `subagent-acp` provider at `reasonix acp` and exposes it to the model as a `reasonix` tool. It contains no code. ## Before you install 1. Install Reasonix and run `reasonix setup` once on the same machine. Reasonix reads its provider key from its own home, not from environment variables, so Harness cannot pass one. 2. Make sure `reasonix` is on the `PATH` of the process that runs `dsh`. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix#path:/integrations/dsh-plugin ``` The package is not on npm; `pnpm` installs the `integrations/dsh-plugin` subdirectory of this repository (the `path:` selector, see [pnpm package sources](https://pnpm.io/package-sources)). ## After installing: switch it on An installed plugin starts **off**. Open its page in the DSH Web UI and turn the switch on. - The switch and both components must read Running. Turning it on in a running `dsh web` is enough: the next new session has the `reasonix` tool (observed on `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2). Restart `dsh` only if it is still missing. - While it is off the model may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell. - That looks like a delegation and is not one: there is no subagent, and the permission policy below does not apply. ## What it changes | Row | Effect | | --- | --- | | `subagent-acp-reasonix` | Spawns `reasonix acp` for each delegation; `permission: reject`. | | `tool-subagent-reasonix` | Adds the `reasonix` tool (`prompt`, `description`, optional `cwd`); `maxDepth: provider-managed`, which the provider requires. | ## Permissions - `permission: reject` is the default. Every approval card Reasonix raises is declined, so the child can read and research but cannot write files or run commands that need approval. - `permission: allow` makes Harness accept every card automatically. The delegated task can then do anything Reasonix's tools can do in that workspace. - Change the policy only in your own `cordis.patch.yml`, for a task and workspace you would approve wholesale. Details, what the parent receives, and limits: [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](../../docs/DSH.md). ## Versions The provider version must equal your `dsh` version. This release pins `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2. --- ## 中文 [官网](https://reasonix.io) · [文档](../../docs/DSH.md) · [源码](../../README.md) 把 [Reasonix](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix) 作为子智能体接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）。本包只有配置，没有代码：一层补丁，让 Harness 的 `subagent-acp` 提供方去启动 `reasonix acp`，并以 `reasonix` 工具的形式暴露给模型。 **安装前** 1. 在同一台机器上安装 Reasonix 并运行一次 `reasonix setup`。Reasonix 只从自己的主目录读取模型密钥，不读环境变量，所以 Harness 无法替它传密钥。 2. 保证运行 `dsh` 的进程的 `PATH` 里有 `reasonix`。 **安装** ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix#path:/integrations/dsh-plugin ``` 包不在 npm 上：`pnpm` 通过 `path:` 选择器安装本仓库的 `integrations/dsh-plugin` 子目录（见 [pnpm package sources](https://pnpm.io/package-sources)）。 **安装后：打开开关** 插件装好后默认是“关闭”的。到 DSH Web 界面的插件页打开它的开关。 - 开关和两个组件都显示 Running 才算生效。在运行中的 `dsh web` 里直接打开就够了，下一个新会话里就有 `reasonix` 工具（在 `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2 上实测）；仍然没有再重启 `dsh`。 - 没打开时，模型可能改在自己的 shell 里直接运行 `reasonix -p`。 - 这看起来像委派，其实不是：没有子智能体，下面的权限策略也不起作用。 **权限** - 默认 `permission: reject`：Reasonix 弹出的每个审批卡都会被拒绝，子智能体只能读和调研，不能写文件或执行需要批准的命令。 - `permission: allow` 会让 Harness 自动同意所有审批卡，被委派的任务可以在该工作区里做 Reasonix 工具能做的任何事。 - 只在你自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，为你愿意整体放行的任务和工作区才改成 `allow`。 详细说明见 [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](../../docs/DSH.md)。 **版本**：提供方版本必须与你的 `dsh` 版本一致，本版本固定为 `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2。

Open source · MIT · runs on your computer, model of your choice

An open-source coding agent for your terminal, desktop, browser and editor.

It reads your project, edits files and runs commands and tests. Have it ask before each step, or work on its own within limits you set. Files its edit tools changed can be rewound. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app.

Maintained by Huahui Yu.

> [!IMPORTANT] > **Community · 加入社区** — bilingual Discord for setup help (`#help` / `#求助`), workflow showcases, and feature ideas. → **** > > QQ group **DeepSeek-Reasonix官方群** (`1093562660`) → **** ([QR code](./docs/assets/qq-group.svg)) > Douyin: **做游戏的小鱼** (Douyin ID `22703872788`) · [QR code](./docs/assets/douyin.png)
## ❤️Sponsor

## What it is Reasonix is an open-source AI coding assistant. The program runs on your computer; the AI model is a service you configure, which receives what it reads. You describe a task in plain language; it reads code, edits files and runs commands and tests inside the project folder you choose, and shows you each step. You pick the model: a DeepSeek preset is built in, any OpenAI-compatible service is one config entry, and you pay the model provider directly. ## What you get - **Read, edit, run.** It reads code, edits files and runs tests and commands, all inside your project folder. - **Permission levels.** Have it ask every time, or let everyday actions run on their own; your forbid rules always hold. To see the approach first, use plan mode: it starts work only once you approve. - **Rewind.** A file is saved before it changes, so you can rewind by conversation turn without touching your git history. Only files its edit tools changed are covered, not what a shell command did. ## 30-second start Download, add a model key, open a project. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app. 1. Download and install the desktop app, Reasonix Studio, from the [releases page](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true). 2. Open it and enter your model provider and key when asked. 3. Open your project folder and write what you want, for example "add retry on failure to the http client". 4. At the level you chose, it stops and asks before anything that needs your say-so. Allow it to continue, or refuse. Prefer a terminal? Download the `reasonix` command-line tool, run `reasonix setup` to pick a model, then run `reasonix`. See [Install](#install) and [Quick start](#quick-start). ## Four ways to use it - **Desktop app (Studio).** A graphical app; the best place to start. - **Terminal.** A full-screen text interface; `reasonix run "task"` also works in scripts. - **Browser.** `reasonix web` opens a web interface on your own machine. - **Editor.** Install the extension in VS Code; other editors that support ACP (Agent Client Protocol, a common way for an editor to connect to an AI assistant) can connect to `reasonix acp`. All four are the same program underneath. What follows is for advanced users and contributors. ## Use it from DeepSeek Harness DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) can hand a task to Reasonix as a subagent over ACP. This repository publishes a plugin index for it: 1. Run `reasonix setup` on the machine that runs `dsh`. In the DSH Web UI turn on Custom plugin markets (Plugins, More) and add this index in the Discover tab: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/studio/integrations/dsh-plugin/market-index.json` 2. Install "Reasonix subagent" from it. 3. Open the plugin's page and turn its switch on. While it is off the model has no `reasonix` tool and may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell, which looks like a delegation and is not one. Setup details, the permission policy and limits are in [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](./docs/DSH.md). ## Versions Reasonix ships on two lines. See the [version roadmap announcement](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/discussions/10748) for the reasoning behind the split. | Line | Branch | Status | Get it | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Reasonix 2.x** | `studio` (this branch) | Active development | [Studio releases](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) | | **Reasonix 1.x** | [`main-v2`](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/tree/main-v2) | Maintenance / stable | `npm i -g reasonix` · [desktop download](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start) | - **Want something stable?** Stay on 1.x. It keeps receiving bug fixes, provider/API compatibility, updater and security fixes; its core architecture is no longer being extended. - **Want the new architecture?** Use 2.x Reasonix Studio. It is still moving quickly; reports are welcome. Valuable fixes, tests and behaviour from 1.x are reviewed one by one and ported or reimplemented on 2.x where they fit the new architecture. - [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md): what the two lines share, and how to run both on one machine without losing sessions. - [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md): what 2.x still has to deliver, how it ships, and the decisions still open. ## Features Technical highlights for advanced users. - **Config-driven.** Providers, the agent, enabled tools, and plugins are all declared in `reasonix.toml`. No hardcoded models. - **Multi-model & composable.** DeepSeek ships as a preset; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a config entry, not new code. Optionally run two models together (executor + planner) in separate, cache-stable sessions. - **Plugin-driven.** MCP servers contribute tools, prompts, and resources; Extension Protocol v1 sidecars can also intercept runtime events, contribute Providers and structured UI, and ship versioned plugin packages. - **Cache-aware context maintenance.** Startup injects a small stable environment summary, stale tool output is snipped/pruned before summary compaction, and the built-in tool schema contract is documented for regression review. - **Zero-friction distribution.** `CGO_ENABLED=0` single binary; cross-compile to six targets with one command. The result is a fully self-contained static binary — nothing to install on the target machine beyond the binary itself. ## Install This branch is **Reasonix 2.x**. Its desktop app is Reasonix Studio; the CLI, Studio, and editor integrations all run the same local Reasonix engine. ### Reasonix Studio (2.x) Download the package for your platform from the latest [Studio release](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) (tagged `studio-v2.*`; candidates such as `-rc.N` are marked as pre-releases): | Platform | Package | Architecture | | --- | --- | --- | | macOS | `.dmg` or `.zip` | Apple Silicon (`arm64`) / Intel (`amd64`) | | Windows | Installer `-installer.exe` or portable `.zip` | x64 | | Linux | `.deb`, `.rpm`, or `.AppImage` (download only) | x64 (`amd64`) / ARM64 (`arm64`, aarch64) | Every package ships with a `.minisig` signature, and the release carries `SHA256SUMS`. Once installed, Studio updates itself in place. The same release also carries the 2.x `reasonix` CLI as archives for `darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64`. The Android build ships on that release as `ReasonixMobile-.apk` (`arm64`, Android 8.0 or newer). The kernel and the page run on the phone, and the agent reaches your servers over SSH; pairing with a computer is done by scanning the code it shows. The APK is signed with the Android release key rather than minisign, so it carries a `.sha256` and no `.minisig`. When that key is absent the build is named `ReasonixMobile--unsigned.apk`. Android refuses to install an unsigned package, so those builds stay a workflow artifact for whoever wants to sign one, and the release carries no APK at all. ### Reasonix 1.x (stable) The 1.x CLI installs through npm on any supported platform, or Homebrew on macOS: ```sh npm i -g reasonix # any OS; pulls the prebuilt native binary brew install esengine/reasonix/reasonix # macOS ``` The 1.x desktop app is on the [official download page](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start). Windows installers are code-signed with a Certum code-signing certificate. ### VS Code extension The extension does not bundle the CLI; it starts your local `reasonix acp` backend and adds native chat, editor context, tool-call approvals, model selection, and workspace sessions. Install the 1.x CLI first. - **VS Code:** [install from Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=SivanLiu.reasonix-agent) - **VSCodium / Eclipse Theia:** [install from Open VSX Registry](https://open-vsx.org/extension/SivanLiu/reasonix-agent) - **Extension ID:** `SivanLiu.reasonix-agent` · [source and usage guide](https://github.com/SivanCola/reasonix-vscode) ### Build from source Clone the repository; `studio` builds 2.x and `main-v2` builds 1.x: ```sh git clone https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.git cd DeepSeek-Reasonix git switch studio ``` #### CLI The CLI build requires **Go 1.25+**. The module pins a `toolchain` directive; keep `GOTOOLCHAIN=auto` so Go downloads the pinned toolchain, or install it. ```sh make build # -> bin/reasonix(.exe) make cross # -> dist/ (darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64) ``` #### Studio Studio additionally requires **Node 24+ and pnpm 10** (`npm install -g pnpm@10`) for the frontend. ```sh make studio ``` See the [Studio build guide](desktop/README.md#prerequisites) for platform webview dependencies and Linux build tags. ## Quick start ### Reasonix Studio Install and launch Studio, then connect a provider and model in the app. No CLI setup is needed. ### CLI / TUI ```sh reasonix setup # configure a provider and model reasonix # start an interactive session reasonix run "implement the TODOs in main.go" ``` In an interactive session, run `/init` when you want Reasonix to create project instructions. For advanced CLI usage and configuration, see the **[CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md)**, **[Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md)**, and **[configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md)**. ## Documentation - **Getting started:** [Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md) · [CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md) · [Configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md) · [ACP editor integration](./docs/ACP.md) · [Use from DeepSeek Harness](./docs/DSH.md) - **Features & troubleshooting:** [Subagent profiles](./docs/SUBAGENT_PROFILES.md) · [Context Engine v2](./docs/SESSION_MEMORY_RETRIEVAL.md) · [Capability diagnostics](./docs/CAPABILITY_DIAGNOSTICS.md) · [Recovery and updates](./docs/RECOVERY.md) · [Checkpoints & rewind](./docs/CHECKPOINTS.md) - **Agent presets:** [Session Agent compositions](./docs/AGENT_COMPOSITIONS.md) - **Engineering & migration:** [Spec](./docs/SPEC.md) · [Task contracts & pause policy](./docs/TASK_CONTRACT.md) · [Tool contract](./docs/TOOL_CONTRACT.md) · [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md) · [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md) - **Extension development:** [Skills](./docs/SKILLS.md) · [Extensions](./docs/EXTENSIONS.md) · [Plugin packages and Manifest v1](./docs/PLUGIN_PACKAGES.md) · [Extension Protocol](./docs/EXTENSION_PROTOCOL.md) · [Go SDK and starter](./sdk/go/README.md) ## Star History
## Acknowledgments A small list of folks whose work has shaped Reasonix the most — the current top 20 contributors by commit count. The full contributor graph is on [GitHub](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/graphs/contributors?all=1). | Contributor | Contributor | Contributor | Contributor | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [**SivanCola**](https://github.com/SivanCola) | [**KHG420**](https://github.com/KHG420) | [**ttmouse**](https://github.com/ttmouse) | [**chuiwenwei**](https://github.com/chuiwenwei) | | [**lifu963**](https://github.com/lifu963) | [**XTLine**](https://github.com/XTLine) | [**HUQIANTAO**](https://github.com/HUQIANTAO) | [**xxoingr**](https://github.com/xxoingr) | | [**Harbor404**](https://github.com/Harbor404) | [**GTC2080**](https://github.com/GTC2080) | [**mchenziyi**](https://github.com/mchenziyi) | [**Li-Charles-One**](https://github.com/Li-Charles-One) | | [**light-front-theory**](https://github.com/light-front-theory) | [**imcreazy**](https://github.com/imcreazy) | [**eghrhegpe**](https://github.com/eghrhegpe) | [**noreply**](https://github.com/noreply) | | [**par73e**](https://github.com/par73e) | [**Bernardxu123**](https://github.com/Bernardxu123) | [**lancy69**](https://github.com/lancy69) | [**Guan0923**](https://github.com/Guan0923) | Special thanks to [**Bernardxu123**](https://github.com/Bernardxu123) for designing the project logo and intro video.

--- description: "A DSH bundle that turns an agent preset into a long-lived assistant with its own working folder: memory, research, skills, knowledge, and an operating ledger." kind: "package-bundle" --- # dsh-smart-assistant 一个 DSH **产品**：dedicated `assistant` profile 的组合；工作区绑定在 `assistant-product.workspaceDir`（profile Config），会话落在用户项目里；助手的大脑留在自己的 home，一次作业的交付包留在项目里。产品 home 是部署选项，不是安装要求。 - **四个房间**：`memory/`（已确立的事实/偏好/决定）、`research/`（未决线索，backlog 语义）、 `skills/`（学到的本事）、`knowledge/`（领域知识页，`[[互链]]`）。 - **自有工具**：`assistant_memory`、`assistant_recall`、`assistant_research`、`assistant_reflect`、`assistant_knowledge`、`assistant_operating` （动词清单以生成物 catalog 为准）。 - **一个机器能跑的养护检查**：`assistant_memory action=curate`。 - **一个 agent preset**：`assistant`（挂上它，这个会话就是"有 working folder 的助手"）。 - **一个只读部署自检 CLI**：`ov-doctor`（`bin/ov-doctor.mjs`；装好可选 OpenViking 层后在 profile 内运行，见安装手册的 OV 自检节）。 - **一个专家装配 CLI**：`expert-setup`（`bin/expert-setup.mjs`；把管理种子显式导入为 `draft`，不自动 stable）。 - **一个数据备份/诊断 CLI**：`assistant-data`（`bin/assistant-data.mjs`；导出/导入 `assistant` + `assistant-operating`，带 schema manifest；另有 `status`/`check`、`import --replace`/`--max-bytes`、`rotate` 与显式 `purge`）。 - **一个可选产品安装器（独立发布资产，不在包里）**：`bootstrap.mjs`（`--package` 指向解开的产品包；`--workspace` 建/复用 `assistant` profile、给首启一个 `ASSISTANT_WORKSPACE` 覆盖、起 Web；`--product` 从 profile Config 恢复；`--stop` 收；默认产品 home `~/.dsh-smart-assistant`，不碰日用 `~/.dsh`）。它**不写** profile patch，也不写工作区绑定文件。 - **一个产品工作区行**：`assistant-product`（web-only；`workspaceDir`/`onboarding` Config + `ASSISTANT_WORKSPACE` 一次性覆盖；boot 时登记工作区；GET/POST `api/assistant/product`，POST 经 `settings.update` 写 profile patch；headless profile patch 禁用）。 - **默认身份是管理岗**（P1）：`SOUL.md` 是数据，种子与回退一致；管理种子只在显式装配时进入知识室，安装不写 working folder。 ## Install **在 DSH 的 Plugins 页装**（`dsh web` 与 Desktop 同一句话；页面装的是**当前 profile**，不创建 profile）： 1. 启动一个 web profile（`dsh web`，或 dedicated profile：`dsh --profile assistant --from-default-profile web --dump-config`）。 2. 侧栏 **Plugins** → **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin** → 填包名 `dsh-smart-assistant`（或本地 tarball 的绝对路径）。 3. 启用、**重启 profile**（bundle membership 变化要重启）。 装完即产品：`--dump-config` 应看到 `preset-assistant`、`assistant-memory`、`assistant-product`，且 `agent-preset-registry` 的 `default:` 是 `assistant` —— **不需要改 profile patch**，默认 preset 随 bundle 发。 已选过预设的用户（`selectedDefault`）不受影响，卸载后回到 `standard`。 **CLI（自动化 / 无 Plugins 页的 surface）**： ```sh dsh plugin --profile add dsh-smart-assistant dsh --profile --dump-config # 找 preset-assistant 与 agent-preset-registry 的 default: assistant ``` CLI 面向 `dsh web` 自动化，**不能管理 `desktop`**（Desktop 用 Desktop 的 Plugins 页）。 **本 bundle 是 web 面的组合。** 它 override 的 vendor 行（`ui-chat` / `locale` / `ui-sidebar-terminal`）与必注 `connection`/`workspaceRegistry` 的产品行只在 web 组合里成立。装进 headless/SDK/ACP profile 时组合仍能起， 但会看到 `patch: entry "ui-sidebar-terminal" not found`，且这几行停在 pending —— 要在 headless 里用它，加一行： ```yaml - id: assistant-product disabled: true ``` **安装器不是包的一部分。** 自托管/一条命令部署用独立发布的 `bootstrap.mjs`（在发布资产里，与 tarball 同目录）： ```sh node bootstrap.mjs --package ./package --workspace /path/to/your-project node bootstrap.mjs --package ./package --product # 之后从 profile Config 恢复 node bootstrap.mjs --package ./package --stop --home ~/.dsh-smart-assistant --product ``` 它只建/复用 `assistant` profile、装包、校验组合、起 Web；`--workspace` 只设一次性 `ASSISTANT_WORKSPACE`。 产品 home 默认 `~/.dsh-smart-assistant`（不碰日用 `~/.dsh`；`--home ~/.dsh` 才是显式共享）。 需要 DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`、Node `^22.19.0 || >=24`，以及 PATH 上的 `pnpm >= 10.6.0` （10.4 及更低会报 `ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT`；Corepack 已启用也算）。首次安装需要访问 npm registry 或内网镜像，拉唯一依赖 `yaml`；之后运行不需要网络。 ## What it contributes `cordis.patch.yml` 是一层 bundle patch：host 面的 working-folder 服务（四房间、摘要、curate）、 经营账本/投影、产品工作区绑定/门、房间与 Viki 路由，以及 `assistant` preset（六个工具、四个常驻段落、策展技能、 学到的技能 provider 与遮蔽盾）。客户端贡献桌面与房间 tab；行、exports、工具动词的精确清单以 [生成物 catalog](../../docs/package-catalog.md) 为准。组合同时**禁用 vendor 的右栏终端行** `ui-sidebar-terminal`——管理岗用户不用开发工具；终端 API/工具仍留给 headless 或显式配置的开发组合。 ## Configuration 产品行 `assistant-product` 的 Config：`workspaceDir`（volatile；首启客户端或 profile patch 写）、`onboarding`（默认 true；部署可关）；`ASSISTANT_WORKSPACE` 是一次性启动覆盖。home 由 `--home`/`DSH_HOME` 决定；无绑定时 `not-configured`，首屏显示 onboarding。 `assistant-memory` 行可配 `dataDir`（默认 `/assistant`）、`digestMaxBytes`、`recallLimit`、 `staleResearchDays`；`assistant-operating-ledger` 行有独立的 `dataDir`（默认 `/assistant-operating`）与 `keepOperations`（默认 256）、`maxArchiveBytes`（默认 256 MiB 归档读取上限）；`assistant-desk-projection` 有 `maxProjectionBytes`（默认 8 MiB）与 `allowFixture`（默认 `false`：无账本时 404，不把 `desk-projection.json` 模拟资料当成真桌面）。patch 是整行 config 替换，不是深合并。 Viki 的 API key 从 `apiKeyEnv`（默认 `OPENVIKING_API_KEY`）读；内联 `apiKey` 只为旧 home 保留， 会以明文写进 profile patch，不推荐。 ## Data - **Working folder**：`/assistant`（产品模式 = `/assistant`，产品 home 可选），一棵用户可见的 home 树，由本插件拥有。**用户内容**：`SOUL.md`、 `MANUAL.md`（插件手册的渲染镜像）、`AGENTS.md`（用户笔记）、`memory/`、`research/`、`skills/`、`knowledge/`、 `skill-proposals/`；**机器账本**：`skill-usage.json`、`ui-mode.json`、`audit/*.jsonl`、`archive-maintenance/`、`*.bak-*`。 home 根下旧 `deliverables/` 是历史遗留；新交付包在会话 cwd 的 `deliverables/-/`。prompt 用手册的**当前渲染** + `AGENTS.md` 笔记； 升级永远最新，没有 generation。旧生成手册（带 marker）在 scaffold 时整体移到 `AGENTS.md.bak-*`（手改留在备份）。 笔记超预算报 `notes-over-budget`，身份报 `soul-over-budget`。学到的技能是本插件注册的 provider 根（`skills/`）， 不是 `$DSH_HOME/skills`；策展技能随包只读，位于 `presets/assistant/skills/`。 - **Workspace**：会话 cwd 是用户项目；一次作业一个 `deliverables/-/`（README 四段 + 交付物 + `present`）；项目 `AGENTS.md`/`.dsh/skills`/`.agents/skills` 只读/建议；不复制会话日志。 - **Ledger**：`/assistant-operating`，插件自有文件账本（不是 `ctx.storageDomain` 的 host KV）： 权威 `ledger.json`（最近 256 条操作 + 累计计数）+ `operations-archive.jsonl`（完整操作历史）+ 单 writer 锁； 可用 `assistant-data` 导出/导入。 - **Profile 不是租户**：同一 `DSH_HOME` 下的所有 profile 共用这两个目录；换 profile 名只隔离组合，不隔离数据。 真要隔离试用，用独立 `DSH_HOME`，或同时覆盖 memory/ledger/projection 的 `dataDir`。 - **Host-owned**：sessions、credentials、settings、storages 在 `$DSH_HOME` 下由宿主管理，插件备份不包含它们。 补丁启用的会话全文索引在 `/cache/assistant/session-search.db`（派生、可重建），卸载后仍留在盘上；要清就删该目录。 会话召回默认走已索引的 `session_search` 族（模型面 `tool-session-query` 是 N2 实验面），raw zstd 日志只是 手册声明的回退（跨项目/精确子串/索引缺席）。客户端 localStorage/sessionStorage 键属于设备，清站点数据即清， 卸载不自动清。working folder 或会话 cwd 下的 `deliverables/` 是用户数据。 - **备份/恢复**：`assistant-data` 只带这两个目录，排除 `writer.lock` / `*.tmp`，拒绝符号链接；import 要求实例已停止。 首次启动前目标为空即可直接 import；已经启动过的 home 先 `import --replace --dry-run` 看计划，再用 `--replace` 把现有目录移到 `.pre-import-*` 旁路。手动 `cp -R` 也要先删掉备份里的 `writer.lock`，并另备 sessions/credentials。 - **诊断/擦除**：`assistant-data status` 报路径/大小/手册 generation/账本健康/归档操作数，以及 memory/research/skills archive、提案收件箱、approvals 的 retention 读数（只读）；`check` 再报相对路径、 坏 ledger/归档行与符号链接，有问题以非零退出。`purge --kind ... --id ... --reason ... --yes` 是显式硬删除：删 active/archive/snapshot 副本，并向 `audit/purges.jsonl` 写审计；不删 sessions/账本历史。 `refresh-manual --yes` 先把 `MANUAL.md` 备份为 `.bak-*` 再写入当前渲染；它不碰 `AGENTS.md` 笔记。 `archive-proposals --yes` 把 `landed`/`rejected` 提案移进 `skill-proposals/archive/`，`proposed`/`approved` 留在收件箱。 `rotate --older-than [--apply]` 默认 dry-run；apply 才把旧 approvals/房间 archive/操作归档移进 `archive-maintenance/`。 `seal --in --out ` / `unseal --in --out ` 用环境变量口令做 AES-256/PBKDF2 传输加密。 `merge --in ` 默认 dry-run，只补缺失、冲突保留当前；`--prefer incoming` 才替换并备份；账本冲突不覆盖。 - **并发**：同一 home 只应有一个写入者；账本拒绝第二 writer，房间写是原子但 last-write-wins。 - **Package**：不写任何用户数据/secret；`handoff-scan` 拒绝数据、凭据、宿主路径与活密钥，`release-smoke` 断言安装不创建 working folder。Viki key 不落配置；bootstrap 的 `bootstrap.json` 0600、日志 token 已打码。 - **升级/卸载**：两个插件目录保留；房间格式只增可选字段，旧生成手册在 scaffold 时备份并转为笔记，账本 v1 旧字节可读； `assistant-data` 提供带 `schemaVersion` 的备份/恢复；不把 sessions/credentials 打进 bundle。 完整数据卡（每个面的归属/寿命/备份/卸载去向）= [`docs/delivery.md`](../../docs/delivery.md) §一。 | DSH 平面 | 本包 | |---|---| | D 定义 / C 代码 | bundle patch、preset、包内只读技能、`lib/bin`；只读，随版本替换 | | W workspace | 只写会话 cwd 的 `deliverables/-/`；目录与项目文件归用户 | | U home | `/assistant`：用户内容 + 插件账本共处一棵用户可见的树；跨项目，升级/卸载保留 | | S session / H host state / K cache / X credentials | S/X 宿主拥有；本包不用 `ctx.storageDomain`，账本是自有文件账本；K = 内存摘要缓存 + `cache/assistant/session-search.db` | 这个 home 根是**用户可见的 U 平面**（人能读、能 review、能导出），不是 `ctx.storageDomain` 的 host KV，也不是 随项目走的 workspace；因此使用文件格式 + `curate` 而不是 KV schema。转换边界的合同 = [`docs/delivery.md`](../../docs/delivery.md)。 ## Compatibility 机器可安装范围见 `engines.dsh`（当前 `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`）、`engines.node` 与 `engines.pnpm`（`>=10.6.0`）；当前 pin 是 `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2`。上界用 `<0.3.0-0` 而非 `<0.3.0`： 预发布参与匹配，`0.3.0-rc.1` 会被 `<0.3.0` 放进来，而它是下一个 breaking minor 的 RC。未来 0.2.x 自动放行；0.3.x 需要重新验证并发新版本。pnpm 下界来自 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 设置支持：10.4 及更低直接拒绝安装，10.5 会忽略 linker 设置。 历史 typecheck 台账在 repo-only `release-verification.json`，不随包发布，也不是当前支持承诺； 更老的 DSH 版本不在支持矩阵内。 ## Upgrade ```sh dsh plugin --profile add dsh-smart-assistant@ # 重启 profile（运行中的 Web 不会热替换代码） dsh --profile --dump-config # 仍应看到 preset-assistant 与 default: assistant ``` - **没有命令级回滚**（DSH 也没有）：回退 = 重装旧版本（`add dsh-smart-assistant@`）。 升级前记下当前版本；数据格式不兼容时先恢复备份（`assistant-data import`）。 - working folder、账本、`cache/assistant/` 跨升级保留；升级不写用户数据。 - 升级后如果默认 preset 变了，先看 `--dump-config` 里的 `agent-preset-registry`：用户级 `selectedDefault` 优先于 bundle 默认。 ## Uninstall ```sh dsh plugin --profile

remove dsh-smart-assistant ``` 卸载不删 `/assistant` 与 `/assistant-operating`；先 `assistant-data export` 备份。 产品模式的产品 home（`~/.dsh-smart-assistant`，可选）与工作区交付包都保留；产品 home 要清就手动删，工作区随项目备份。 卸载也不会删宿主数据：要清会话全文索引就删 `/cache/assistant/`，要清其余宿主数据按 [`docs/delivery.md`](../../docs/delivery.md) §一数据卡逐项处理；客户端 localStorage 键用“清除站点数据”。 OpenViking 是独立可选层，另停 server 并按其安装手册清理。 ## 它是什么形状 **当前声明了什么，以生成物为准**：[`docs/package-catalog.md`](../../docs/package-catalog.md) （由 `scripts/generate/gen-catalog.mjs` 从 exports、组合行、工具源码与技能目录抽取；`pnpm verify` 守 freshness）。 这里只留一句形状概括，不再手维护清单（手维护的清单必然漂移）： - plugin 子路径按 host / agent / client 三平面分布（host 含知识批准服务，agent 含自有工具、常驻段落、 learn、遮蔽盾与 dev 的 `./preset-runner`），另有非 plugin 导出（`./package.json`）。**计数与逐行清单以 [生成物 catalog](../../docs/package-catalog.md) 为准——本句不携带数字。** 装法、身份名、working folder 的契约分别在仓库的 `README.md`、`docs/identity.md`、`docs/home.md`。 Web 客户端贡献独立全局经营桌面（内部概念；UI 叫「今天」，账本投影）与右栏可按需添加的三个产品房间 tab（记忆 / 知识 / 技能）；Viki(调试) tab 只在 debug flag 下出现。默认主面板选择只在页面初始化时尝试，不随重挂覆盖用户导航；导航与数据读取的当前合同在 [浏览器动作链](../../docs/architecture.md#浏览器动作链一次点击--可见的桌面变化)。客户端不拥有经营权威数据。 Host 的 `./desk-projection` 是固定只读投影下载：有权威 `ledger.json` 时活渲染 v2 投影，无账本时回退固定 fixture；不是经营 writer 或通用文件读取。Config `dataDir` 与 agent working folder 独立；缺失、损坏和 I/O 错误分别返回错误，且 fiber 卸载撤销路由。目录/状态码/限额合同由上面的浏览器动作链拥有；此入口不向模型添加工具或提示词。 Client 内部下载对象处理连接代际、手动重读、陈旧缓存与迟到结果拒绝，使用平台 snapshot publisher；apply 承担 effect disposal，并通过 Slot inject hooks 供全局主区消费。它使用经营 v1/v2 双信封解析器验证身份、修订、事项状态及证据定位；解析失败保留最后有效内容。主面板显示完整集合和缺失/空/错误/陈旧状态；事项选择显示摘要、状态、证据 quote 与 Session/event 定位，宽区双栏、窄区单 pane 保留选择与列表位置；事项选择、处理路径与自动回桌已提供，业务写入仍由模型经账本动作完成（客户端不直接写经营账本）；`ready` 不等于业务成功。对象无持久缓存，组件不自行订阅或发起下载。 ## 依赖姿态 Host 运行期 `@deepseek-ai/*` 使用 **peerDependencies**；仅类型关系（例如 Connection 下载声明）使用开发依赖：DSH 的公开 API 仍是 pre-stable， 精确钉死会让每次上游同步都变成一次发版。**当前可安装范围由 `engines.dsh` 机器声明**；`release-verification.json`（repo-only，不进 tarball）是每个 pin 上跑过 typecheck 的历史验证台账，不当作当前支持承诺。`engines.node` 与 pin 住的 DSH 保持一致。`yaml` 是唯一的运行时 dependency。 ## 自包含 发布产物（`lib/`、`bin/`、`presets/`、`cordis.patch.yml`）不引用 repo 内任何其他目录，也不引用 `vendor/`； `pnpm verify` 机械检查这一点。唯一运行期 npm 依赖是 `yaml`（首次安装从 registry 拉取），其余全部由宿主 DSH 提供；因此“自包含”指 agent 物自包含，不是离线安装包。真实安装形状（`pnpm pack` → 干净 home → `dsh plugin --profile

add `）由 `pnpm release-smoke` 验证；`bin/ov-doctor.mjs` 随包安装，另一人不需要仓库。 # dsh-smart-assistant 一个 DSH **产品**：一个有自己的启动 profile、在启动时绑定用户项目、并把作业产物留在项目里的领域专家助手。 它有两块地：**助手自己的 home**（跨会话的记忆/技能/账本/身份）和**用户的工作区**（会话、文件工具、一次作业的交付包）。 核心命题借自 `Agent = Model + Harness` —— 模型决定上限，**那一圈**决定你能拿到多少；本 repo 做的就是那一圈。 ## 它为谁、怎样算干成（方向判据） **动机**（2026-09-25 拍板）：给中小企业管理者（CEO / VP）养一个**数字分身**——先有一个出厂可用的 **管理岗基座**（管理/销售/财务都懂一点、擅长拆复杂问题），再跟人配合做几件事就把他的判断标准学进去。 **立场 = 辅助本人**：帮他想、帮他做，对外内容由他过目，不代他出面；第一个真人 = 用户本人； 首批一起做的事 = 复杂经营问题的拆解与行动计划。产品定位 = **B 底座 + 专家包**（角色内容来源 = `ai_dsh_company`，本仓做基座与学习机制）。数据边界 = **严格本地**（反转属用户）；交互面只在 DSH 自己的 Web/Desktop，**不做 IM**（2026-09-27）。本仓 dev home 的内容 = 基座试车场数据，可随意处置； 产品要件 = 到用户手上能自己学习、自己养护（2026-09-28）。 | # | 意图 | 外部可观察行为 | |---|---|---| | P1 | **出厂可用的管理岗基座** | 未学过任何人时，给一个典型经营难题（如"下季度销售掉了 20%"），能从管理/销售/财务视角拆解并给出可执行的行动计划；由用户判"像样" | | P2 | **跟人做几件事就学得进去** | 一起完成 3 件同类拆解后，第 4 件不必再交代，按他的标准、口径与模板来做，并能指出"这条是哪次学来的" | | P3 | **学到的东西管得住** | 学到了什么，用户能看、能改、能删；学错了能被发现（人可读文件 + 机器检查） | | # | 结果意图 | 外部可观察行为 | |---|---|---| | O1 | **拆得对，且说得清出处** | 拆解按"现象 → 原因假设 → 取舍标准 → 行动"分层，与该用户的判断标准一致；每条事实性依据可指到原文定位 | | O2 | **办得成（不只是说）** | 从拆解走到可执行行动计划（负责人/时间/指标/风险与止损），落成交付物，被人采用 | | O3 | **知道自己不知道** | 超出知识、权限或立场时明确说"我不知道"并指路；不编造（错答即红线） | | O4 | **越用越像本人** | 👎 反馈 → 修正提案 → 评审 → 落地，且评测分不回退 | | O5 | **装得上（企业环境）** | 一条命令在企业机器装好并可用；管理员不写 YAML 就能配置与评审 | | O6 | **管得住（权限与数据）** | 知识变更可追溯；数据不出企业边界；对外内容需本人过目 | 本人的经营事实、判断标准与数据边界由本人提供或确认；原型可先用公开案例与标注模拟验证方法和机制，不等真人回访。 **当前边界**（本节是它的家）：方向已定案——一把手总助定位（19 轮推敲），已落地切片各有 implemented note； 阶段 4-5（信息积累与能力验证、检查与继续取舍）是**持续实践**，不是待交付物。未落地候选全部是**带触发条件的延后项**： ①C 分身（真用 30 天后触发验证）②OKF/VK 仪器（第一次需要证明「越用越好」时触发）③督办完整契约（真用出现状态歧义时触发） ④一句话定位 A/B/C 排序（用户真用后自然选择，不催）。方向与技术偏好已确认 ≠ 效果已验证 ≠ 整个路线获实施授权； 推敲结论不构成新增产品能力的授权。推敲史与用户原话在 [定位卡](_backlog/_archive/settled_issues/261005-open-value-deficit.md) 与 [自洽卡](_backlog/_archive/settled_issues/261005-turnaround-coherence.md)（冻结档案，作出处与史据引用）； [旧真用第一](notes/rejected/2026-10-01-real-use-first.md) 只作被取代方案的防错历史；研发姿态判据的常设指令在根 `AGENTS.md`。 ## working folder 有四个房间 | 房间 | 放什么 | |---|---| | `memory/` | 已确立的事实 / 偏好 / 决定 | | `research/` | 意图还不清晰的探索（backlog） | | `skills/` | 学到的本事（DSH 技能格式） | | `knowledge/` | 领域知识页（概念/实体/来源，`[[互链]]`） | （四房间的路径、生命周期、**出口与提案车道的合同** = [`docs/home.md`](docs/home.md) §一/§二；本表只做产品概览，不复制合同内容。） **桌面与抽屉**：常驻上下文 = 身份（SOUL.md）+ 手册 + 一份**有界摘要**（精选记忆 + 开放线索 + 知识签树）+ 经营账本段；完整记录、归档、技能正文都在抽屉里，用工具取。过程性知识（怎么写记忆、怎么养护、怎么复盘） 一律放技能，不占常驻上下文。 ## 工具 自有工具：`assistant_memory`（记忆）、`assistant_research`（线索）、`assistant_reflect`（复盘 / 技能 / 知识页写入）、 `assistant_knowledge`（只读检索）、`assistant_operating`（经营账本；独立 `assistant-operating` dataDir，契约 = [docs/operating.md](docs/operating.md)）、`assistant_recall`（按需只读记忆检索；find/search/read/tree，A2 已裁决并随 preset 挂载）。 各工具的**动词与完整清单以生成物 [`docs/package-catalog.md`](docs/package-catalog.md)「工具 × 动词」节为准**，此处不复制。 `curate`（`assistant_memory` 的一个动词，不是独立工具；另有一条 host 节拍器按轮自动插入养护 turn， 见 [`docs/home.md`](docs/home.md) §四）是**机器能跑的养护检查**（重复、悬空引用、摘要预算、过期线索、 技能遮蔽/退役/断链/凭据、知识页治理等——**非穷举**，完整检查面 = [`docs/home.md`](docs/home.md) §四）—— 能让代码查的，别让 AI 自己说。 这些是本插件的**自有**工具；同一组合里还有 DSH 现货工具在场——`session_query` 族（原始会话 检索）、`schedule_*` 定时四件、`skill`（技能加载）等，完整组合见 `docs/architecture.md` §二。 ## 产品怎么开始 产品 = **dedicated `assistant` profile 的组合**：插件内容随包；工作区绑定在 `assistant-product.workspaceDir`（profile Config）；会话落在你的项目里；一次作业的交付包落在 `<项目>/deliverables/-/`。合同 = [docs/product.md](docs/product.md)。 **DSH 推荐：应用内 Plugins 页安装。** 启动 profile（`dsh --profile <你的 profile>` 或 `dsh web`）→ 侧栏 **Plugins** → **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin** → 填 tarball 的绝对路径（或已发布包名 / Git 地址 / 本地目录）→ 启用 → 重启 profile。首启选项目目录。 要 dedicated `assistant` profile（产品 profile）： ```sh dsh --profile assistant --from-default-profile web # ① 一次性建 profile（已有 profile 不要用） dsh --profile assistant # ② 启动 # ③ Plugins 页装 tarball/包名（当前 profile = assistant）；启用并重启 ``` **本机/自动化**：页面不能用于自动化时，CLI 面向 `dsh web` 自动化：`dsh plugin --profile assistant add `，装完重启；headless/SDK/ACP 没有 Plugins 页，用 CLI 显式 profile；Desktop 用 Desktop 的 Plugins 页，普通 CLI 不能管理 `desktop`。装完 `--dump-config` 应看到 `assistant-product` 与 `preset-assistant`。 **可选：产品安装器（自托管 / 一条命令）**：没有 DSH 经验或需要离线时，`node bootstrap.mjs --workspace <目录>`。它不是 DSH 的默认安装方式；`--workspace` 只设一次性 `ASSISTANT_WORKSPACE`，不写工作区绑定文件；产品 home 默认 `~/.dsh-smart-assistant`，之后 `--product` 复用 profile Config。 **研发/开发**：本仓开发用 `pnpm start`（dev home），不要用产品安装器；两者不混。 **可选 OpenViking 记忆层（不装也照常跑）**：插件与四房间不依赖 OV；缺席时 `ov doctor` exit 2、Viki 503，这是明确的降级而不是装坏。要装就按 [《安装手册》](_dist/安装手册.md)（`pnpm export-dist` 生成，含 server 0.5.1.1 的安装/配置/启动/doctor/故障表/卸载，命令不含本机绝对路径）；关键前提是 server 起在 `127.0.0.1:1933`、storage 指向持久目录、doctor 读的是运行中 server 同一份 config。装好后 profile 的 `openviking` 行默认 `baseUrl` 即可接上，再跑一次 doctor 确认绿。 （仓内开发时用 `pnpm dsh --profile …`；它经 `dev/env/dsh.mjs` 启动 pinned CLI，强制 `DSH_HOME=dev/harness-home` 并把仓根作为 cwd。） ## 从哪个入口开始 起服务五步、开发环、验证链、评测的命令与判据，**唯一清单** = [`docs/commands.md`](docs/commands.md)（启动五步仍住根 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) 的启动段） （本 README 不复述；唯一例外是下面「知识导入」与「专家部署装配」两条部署 CLI，家在本文）。 **按问题找**（纯路由，不复制正文）： | 你的问题 | 去哪儿 | |---|---| | 产品是什么、怎么装/起、工作区/交付包归谁 | [docs/product.md](docs/product.md)（dedicated profile、Plugins 页/CLI/安装器、Config、交付包、失败模式） | | 某个功能的主链、实现入口、最小验证 | [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) §八（功能路由） | | 一条命令 / 一条消息 / 一次点击进来经谁、哪里可观察 | [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) §七（运行链路 + 失败模式表） | | 组合里到底有没有这一行 | `pnpm dsh --profile dev --dump-config`（路由见 [docs/dev.md](docs/dev.md) §六） | | 运行态现在长什么样（四房间、两个根文件） | [docs/home.md](docs/home.md)；实际文件在 `dev/harness-home/assistant/` | | 怎么把插件交给别人、怎么备份/迁移一个人的数据 | [docs/delivery.md](docs/delivery.md)（agent 物 vs 用户数据、handoff 扫描、两目录导出/导入） | | 能不能发、发什么渠道、版本/兼容范围怎么定 | [docs/release.md](docs/release.md)（发布/发行宪章；操作步骤在 [docs/dev.md](docs/dev.md) §九） | | 某次会话为什么答成这样 | [docs/dev.md](docs/dev.md) §六「逐事件复盘」行（过滤样例：[repo-live-probe](.agents/skills/repo-live-probe/SKILL.md)）；聚合视图 `pnpm usage` / `pnpm desk-loop` | | 我要改 X，最小验证是什么、回归资产在哪 | [docs/testing.md](docs/testing.md) §一页证据地图（唯一表主）；判断细则与假绿清单在 [.agents/skills/pre-push-evidence/](.agents/skills/pre-push-evidence/SKILL.md) | | 改了为什么不生效 | [docs/dev.md](docs/dev.md) §四 三条纪律（build / preset 代际 / pin） | | 这个决定为什么这么定 | 先查 `docs/` 对应合同（理由多已内联）；再按关键词搜 `notes/`（`grep -ril '<关键词>' notes/`；负知识在 `notes/rejected/`；怎么读见 [notes/README.md](notes/README.md)）；**方向类推敲史**在 `_backlog/_archive/settled_issues/` 与 `_backlog/_archive/research/`（同法按关键词 grep） | 运行数据的根：产品 home（`DSH_HOME`，可选）、助手 `dataDir`、用户工作区、源码 cwd；产品层见 [产品合同](docs/product.md)，开发层见 [开发手册](docs/dev.md)。 打包安装的形状（`pnpm pack` 出 tarball 再 `dsh plugin --profile

add `）由 `pnpm release-smoke` 机械验证： pack → 干净 home → 装 → 组合断言。**装完不需要改 profile**：默认 preset 随 bundle patch 发 （`- id: agent-preset-registry` 的 `default: assistant`），Plugins 页 / `dsh plugin add` / 市场 Discover 装进任意 web profile 都直接生效；用户级 `selectedDefault` 仍优先。registry 不扫目录、也不接受 preset 路径： `assistant` 的定义随包发（`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `preset-assistant` 行），装包即进组合 —— 不必再指 `presets/` 目录。 **知识导入**（把文件/目录导成知识页草稿）：`pnpm import-knowledge -- --data-dir <文件或目录>… [--dry-run]`。 **专家部署装配**（把全新的 working folder 装成管理岗专家的）：`pnpm expert-setup -- --data-dir ` —— 只在 `SOUL.md` 还是未经改动的默认种子时替换为管理岗身份（改过就跳过：装配不覆盖它的主人）， 知识种子按治理写入路径落 `draft`；`draft → stable` 的人审有两条合法路径——**你亲手改** `status`（那一下就是评审）， 或**你明确批准后由助手 `promote_page` 执行那次翻转**（批准是你的，助手只做编辑）。 **养护定时（默认带）**：本包的 host patch 直接挂 `schedule` + `ui-schedule` 两行。Web 组合开箱即用：到期任务 以原会话 follow-up 消息投递、重启后仍生效，`schedule_create`（`prompt`+`title` 必填、`after_seconds` 延时秒）即可建首个养护或提醒任务。**headless 组合例外**：`schedule` 依赖 web-app 层的 `sessionController`，纯 headless 部署里挂上激活不了，profile patch 应显式 `disabled: true` 该行 （本仓先例：`dev/profiles/profile-patch-headless.yml`）；依赖机理与报错形态的合同 = [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) §二 schedule 行。 ## 开发 ```sh git submodule update --init # vendor/dsh submodule（pin 出处 = vendor/UPSTREAM.md） pnpm install pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm verify ``` 首次进入到此为止。日常开发环（dev / dev-task 两个 profile 各自验什么、one-shot 与 Web UI 的分工、 换 pin 的步骤）：命令清单唯一表主 = [`docs/commands.md`](docs/commands.md)，展开细节在 [`docs/dev.md`](docs/dev.md) §四 —— 本段不复制。 契约在 `docs/`（`docs/home.md` 是 working folder 的契约，`docs/identity.md` 是身份名）， 决策与被否决的方案在 `notes/`，agent 的入口链在 `AGENTS.md`。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-sidebar-dock

把 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）左栏里「工作区 / 会话记录」那一块**单独停靠到 **左 / 右 / 上 / 下**
任意一边，插件图标条、品牌行、底部设置钮留在原位 —— 用来解决「左侧栏插件装太多、会话列表被挤得没法看」。

Dock the **workspace / session list** of DeepSeek Harness to the left, right, top or bottom edge,
leaving the plugin rail where it is. Switchable at runtime in **Settings → General**.

| 设置行 | 右侧停靠 | 上侧停靠 + 自动收纳展开 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![](docs/settings.png) | ![](docs/dock-right.png) | ![](docs/dock-top-peek.png) |

## 功能

- **四向停靠**：左侧（默认，等于不改） / 右侧 / 上侧 / 下侧，点一下立即生效，无需重启。
  「工作区 / 会话记录」跟着宿主数据自动更新 —— 以后新建的工作区、会话照常出现在那一侧。
- **左栏宽度**：`原始`（保持宿主宽度，默认） / `适中 176px` / `紧凑 112px`。停靠到别的边时，
  左栏会按这个宽度收窄，把空间还给会话内容。
- **自动收纳**：面板平时收成贴边 5px 的一条线，鼠标贴到那条边才展开；移开 420ms 后自动收起。
- **触发范围**：`窄 32 / 标准 64 / 宽 104 / 很大 160` px —— 触发带只监听 `pointermove`，
  本身不可见、不接收点击，所以放大后也不会挡住任何按钮。
- 所有状态存 `localStorage`；卸载或禁用插件即自动还原宿主布局（不写宿主文件、不改宿主配置）。

## 安装

本插件是一个 DSH **bundle**（`package.json` 里声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`）。

**方式一（推荐）** —— 在 DSH 的 Agent 会话里让它安装这个目录：

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<本仓库的绝对路径>
```

它会把自己加进 profile 依赖并自动 enable，返回 `application: applied` 即生效。

**方式二** —— 命令行（只加依赖，之后还要在「插件」界面把 bundle 打开）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile-name> add <本仓库的绝对路径>
```

装好（或改了 `client.js`）之后，**已经在跑的窗口需要重载一次页面 / 重启软件端**才会拿到新的
client 模块（DSH 的插件集合在启动时定型，应用内的「刷新」按钮在部分版本上救不了）。

卸载：在「插件」界面关掉 / 移除该 bundle。`localStorage` 里的几个键可以留着，下次装回来直接生效。

## 设置项

**设置 → 通用 → 工作区列表停靠位置**

| 控件 | 取值 | `localStorage` 键 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 停靠位置 | `左侧` / `右侧` / `上侧` / `下侧` | `dsh-sidebar-dock/position` |
| 左栏宽度 | `原始` / `适中 176px` / `紧凑 112px` | `dsh-sidebar-dock/rail` |
| 触发范围 | `窄 32` / `标准 64` / `宽 104` / `很大 160` px | `dsh-sidebar-dock/zone` |
| 自动收纳 | 开 / 关 | `dsh-sidebar-dock/peek` |

想恢复原样：把停靠位置点回 `左侧`，或清掉上面几个键。

## 原理（为什么是样式表）

宿主 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout` 的三列 grid 写死在 AppFrame 里，`ctx.layout` 只暴露
`toggleSidebar / openRightbar / closeRightbar / selectPanel`，没有「换边」的 API；而
`sidebar.workspaces` 是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar` 内部渲染的，插件无法把它挂到别的 slot。
所以这里走**最小侵入的样式表**：

1. `apply()` 之后用 **DOM 顺序锚点**认列：`[data-shell-bottom]` 的父节点是 frame，它前面的 3 个元素
   兄弟依次是 `sidebar / center / rightbar`（`DocumentTitle` 渲染 null，不占位），再给
   `[data-slot="sidebar.workspaces"]` 打上 `data-dssb-tree`。
2. `measure()` 从宿主**自己的计算轨道**（`getComputedStyle(frame).gridTemplateColumns`）读回列宽，
   算出 `--dssb-rail`（左栏视觉宽）、`--dssb-rail-width`、`--dssb-pull`、`--dssb-right-rail`；
   窗口缩放、右栏开合都会重算 —— 宽度从不写死。
3. 一张包自有样式表按 `html[data-dssb-pos]` / `html[data-dssb-peek]` 生效：
   - `left`（默认）：**一条规则都不写**，与宿主完全一致；
   - 停靠在别处：左栏按 `--dssb-rail-width` 收窄，center 用 `margin-left:-pull` 贴过来（不留空档），
     整棵树 `position:fixed` 停到目标边，center 用 padding 让出面板厚度，**不覆盖会话**。
4. 卸载 / 禁用时移除属性、样式表、数据标记和测得的自定义属性，布局自动还原。

### 踩过的坑（留档）

- **`height:5px` 收不到 5px**：元素是 `box-sizing:border-box`，padding 合计 20px + border 0.5px，
  border-box 下 used height 被撑到 21px。收起态必须同时 `padding:0`。
- **设置行显示 `position.title`**：内联词典是嵌套的（`{position:{title}}`），查找却用扁平键。
  现在按点路径取，并且 `props.t` → locale 命名空间 → 内置词典逐级回退，最坏也不显示键名。
- **壁纸主题下穿模**：`--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill` 是半透明的，会话文字会透上来。改用
  `--dsw-alias-bg-base` + `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1` 渐变 + `backdrop-filter: blur(18px)`。
- **`renderSlot` 的占位元素是 `display:contents`**：要给它的子节点打 `position:fixed` 前必须先
  `display:flex !important`，否则没有盒子。
- **收起侧栏时树是空的**：`WorkspaceBrowser` 在 `wide=false` 时只渲染图标变体。所以停靠在非左侧时
  先通过公开的 `ctx.layout.toggleSidebar()` 展开侧栏；若仍收着就**不接管布局**并在设置行提示。

## 已知边界

- 侧栏收起（rail 态）时插件不接管布局，设置行会提示先展开。
- 非左侧停靠时宿主的分栏拖拽把手会隐藏：它的 `left` 是按默认 lane 算的像素值，换边后必然错位。
  改回「左侧」即恢复。
- 右栏（rightbar / better-sidebar 等）保持原位，面板会让开它；但其它插件自己的固定层
  （例如顶部 tab、右下气泡）z-index 更高，可能压住面板边角。
- DSH 升级后宿主 class 名可能变（hash 前缀）。本插件不依赖 class 名，只依赖
  `data-shell-bottom` / `data-rightbar-col` / `data-slot="sidebar.workspaces"` 这几个稳定属性。
- 官方 `ui-plugin.md` 建议「挑一个已经分配好空间的 slot，不要读别人的 DOM」。本需求物理上做不到
  （宿主不给换边 API，slot 里也没有可放树的位置），因此采用**只加可移除样式 + 自己的 data 属性**
  的最小侵入方案，并把边界写在这里。

## 目录结构

```
.
├── client.js           # Client 半：标记 / 测量 / 样式表 / 指针揭示 / 设置行（全部逻辑）
├── index.js            # Host 半（空实现，只为保住 Loader 行）
├── cordis.patch.yml    # bundle 的 insert 行
├── locale/{zh,en}.json # meta.title / description 与行文案
├── icon.svg            # 插件图标
├── docs/               # README 截图
├── CHANGELOG.md
└── LICENSE
```

## 开发

```bash
node --check client.js     # 语法检查（CSS 是模板字符串，注意别在注释里写反引号）
```

- 以 `link:` 方式装进 profile 后，改源码即时生效，只需重载页面。
- 设置行走 `ctx.slots.register({ name, id, order }, DockRow)`，标题、控件、描述全部自绘
  （`settings.general.item` 不向 occupant 投影任何 label）。
- 想换包名 / 发到 npm：改 `package.json` 的 `name`（例如 `dsh-sidebar-dock`）后重装一次 bundle 即可，
  `client.js` 里的 `NS` 不需要跟着改。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-system1 **Connect to multiple decision providers and models through one interface: Jev via TypeSafe, Clef via Cloudflare, Drex via Nace, Decider 1 via meraGPT, self-hosted Laya, and compatible custom providers.** Agents and plugins can classify content, filter candidates, score against criteria, or locate objects in images, then use structured results in their own workflows. Requests can include text, images, audio, and video where the provider and model support them. The agent can call the built-in `system1_decide` tool, and plugins can use the same service through `ctx.system1.decide()`. [![CI](https://github.com/exoticknight/dsh-system1/actions/workflows/check.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/exoticknight/dsh-system1/actions/workflows/check.yml) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-system1)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-system1) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/exoticknight/dsh-system1)](LICENSE) [![Maintained with RED](https://img.shields.io/badge/maintained_with-RED-C1121F)](https://github.com/exoticknight/red) [![dsh.pub registry status](https://dsh.pub/api/badges/exoticknight/dsh-system1.svg)](https://dsh.pub/en/plugins/?q=exoticknight%2Fdsh-system1) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/exoticknight/dsh-system1) [![dsh-xray](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Funstone.github.io%2Fdsh-xray%2Fbadge%2Fexoticknight__dsh-system1.json)](https://unstone.github.io/dsh-xray/p/exoticknight__dsh-system1.html) [![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/) [![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
## Providers and models Choose a built-in provider or add one that implements the public provider contract. Model options and supported inputs vary by provider and model. | Provider | Model options | Deployment and notable support | | --- | --- | --- | | TypeSafe (`typesafe`) | `jev-latest`, `jev-preview`, `jev-1.14.0`, `jev-1.13.0` | Hosted Jev; PNG/JPEG; `box` requires `jev-1.14.0` or `jev-preview`; optional 262k context. | | Cloudflare (`cloudflare`) | `clef`, `clef-flash`, `clef-omni` | Workers AI or a compatible local Clef service; PNG/JPEG/WebP; `clef-omni` also accepts audio and video. | | Nace.AI (`nace`) | `drex-v2.0`, `drex-v1.5`, `drex-max`, `drex-max-v1.1` | Hosted Drex; both Max versions accept images, up to 512 questions and 255 choice/score options. Original Max selects from state up to 524k tokens, allows 262k per question and caps combined long questions at 1,048,576; v1.1 caps the whole request at 262k. | | meraGPT (`meragpt`) | `decider-1` (`sd-1`, `state-decider-1`) | Hosted Decider 1; 4k-token whole-request context, up to 64 questions and 10 choice/score options. Uses prepaid API credit. | | Laya (`laya`) | `auto`, `english`, `multilingual`, `typed-decisions` | Self-hosted [Laya server](https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya); text only; API key optional. | | Custom | — | Any backend implementing the public provider contract. | See [provider setup](docs/providers.en.md) for credentials, endpoints, and full capability limits. [System One models](https://systemonemodels.org/guides/what-is-a-system-one-model/) are decision models that return typed answers with probabilities instead of generated text. The name borrows Kahneman's "fast thinking": they handle narrow judgments such as gating, routing, and scoring, while the main LLM writes and reasons. | Primitive | Result | | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `noul` | Yes/no: probability that the proposition is true (`probabilityTrue`) | | `choice` | Candidate key and the full probability distribution | | `score` | Expected zero-based level and the probability distribution | | `box` | Normalized image coordinates for a located object (model-dependent) | Requests and responses are validated, and each question gets its own result. Calls support cancellation, per-attempt timeouts, and fallback models, and return execution metadata. ## Install from npm Install the package in a project that uses System One: ```sh npm install dsh-system1 ``` To activate the bundled service and providers in dsh, add the npm package to the profile you run. Replace `` with your profile name: ```sh dsh plugin --profile add dsh-system1 ``` The dsh plugin command requires a profile; installing into one profile does not activate the bundle in other profiles. To use the GitHub repository as the package source, replace `dsh-system1` in that command with `github:exoticknight/dsh-system1`. The bundled patch mounts the service and built-in providers. The service defaults to model `jev-latest` on provider `typesafe`. Each attempt uses a request-level `timeoutMs` when supplied, then that provider's configured timeout or its own default: 800 ms for TypeSafe, Laya, and Cloudflare; 60,000 ms for Nace. Set a provider timeout in that provider's settings page. Use plugin settings to choose the service and model, add fallbacks in order, configure connections, and store keys in DSH credentials; environment variables are also supported. Each fallback gets the full timeout budget, so total request time can grow with the chain length. Adjust the selected provider's `timeoutMs` for backend latency, especially local CPU inference. ## Update notices The first load of a new plugin release in DSH Web automatically shows an update summary. Select **Release notes** in the System One plugin settings to read it again. The summary ships with the plugin and works offline; the full release notes link requires a connection. The current browser stores only the last shown notice ID for the current DSH origin. Refreshing or restarting does not repeat the notice; clearing site data, switching browsers, or downgrading and upgrading again may show it again. If browser storage or cross-tab coordination is unavailable, automatic notices are skipped and manual viewing remains available. ## Agent tool Once installed, the agent can call the `system1_decide` tool without a consumer plugin. The main model can hand yes/no checks, classification, and scoring to System One and decide the next step from the returned probabilities. The tool uses the default service and model configured above. The bundle's `system1-tool` component provides the tool and is enabled by default. Turn the component off on the Plugins page to remove the tool, or set `disabled: true` on its entry in a headless profile. See [the API reference](docs/api.en.md#agent-tool) for arguments and results. ## Use from a consumer plugin In your consumer plugin project, install the package with the npm command above. Then declare `inject: ['system1']` and import this package's Cordis type augmentation: ```ts import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis' import type {} from 'dsh-system1' export const inject = ['system1'] export async function apply(ctx: Context) { const result = await ctx.system1.decide({ state: 'The user asked about a refund.', questions: { refund: { type: 'noul', instructions: 'Is the user asking about a refund?', }, topic: { type: 'choice', instructions: 'Choose a topic.', criteria: { billing: 'Billing', technical: 'Technical support' }, }, urgency: { type: 'score', instructions: 'Rate urgency.', criteria: ['Normal', 'Urgent', 'Critical'], }, }, }) if (result.answers.topic.status === 'ok') { return result.answers.topic.answer.value // 'billing' | 'technical' } return result.answers.topic.error } ``` `noul` returns `probabilityTrue`; `choice` returns a candidate key and its full distribution; `score` returns an expected level and probabilities ordered by `criteria`; `box` returns normalized image edges. These are model outputs, so consumer plugins choose their own decision thresholds and actions. Runtime failures are reported per question with `status: 'error'`; malformed call structures throw `System1InputError`. See [API and provider development](docs/api.en.md) for the full contract and [the consumer example](examples/consumer.ts). TypeSafe supports `jev-latest`, `jev-preview`, `jev-1.14.0`, and `jev-1.13.0`; see [provider setup](docs/providers.en.md) for other services and their limits. ## Development Use the Node.js and pnpm versions declared in `package.json`: ```sh pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm verify ``` `pnpm test` runs the plugin and provider tests with local fixtures, as CI does; `pnpm test ` runs a subset. Live model probes, `pnpm probe `, read credentials from `.env.local`, and local targets set up their own service on first use; hosted probes send real requests and can use account quota or prepaid credit. See [testing and live model validation](docs/testing.en.md). See the [contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [release process](docs/releasing.en.md). ## License Licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE).

decision.reason: Static evidence chain reviewed. Apache-2.0, exact npm gitHead and documented Git identity agree. dsh.compatibility declares 0.1.7-rc.1 through below 0.3.0. The patch mounts engine, TypeSafe, Laya, meraGPT, Nace, Cloudflare and tool exports; all mounted modules and literal relative imports were captured at this commit (27 files). No lifecycle hooks. External requests send credentials and selected text/image/audio/video data; local Laya uses HTTP and provider endpoints are configurable. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# Harness Anything **Every agent run should make your repository smarter.** Harness Anything is the self-evolving harness for self-evolving repositories. It turns decisions, failures, facts, and reviews into durable project memory — then gates *"done"* so progress compounds instead of evaporating into chat.

Get started | Why it compounds | How it works | Docs

English | 简体中文

--- ## Quickstart Choose the setup you need, then paste its prompt into your coding agent: | Harness Anything only | Harness Anything + DeepSeek Harness plugin | | --- | --- | | CLI, daemon, GUI and skills for your coding agents | The same Harness setup plus the plugin for an installed **macOS DSH desktop App** | | [harness-download](./skills/harness-download/SKILL.md) | [harness-dsh-install](./skills/harness-dsh-install/SKILL.md), reusing an existing Harness installation | ### Harness Anything only ```text Read skills/harness-download/SKILL.md from https://github.com/FairladyZ625/harness-anything and use it to guide me through first-time Harness Anything setup: check the environment, download the source to a persistent directory, symlink the full skill set into my selected agents’ user directories, then initialize this repository, set up the CEO knowledge locations, and complete one real task with harness-ceo. Read information available in the project and environment directly. When a choice or approval is needed, show me the concrete proposal first, and do not ask again about something I have already confirmed. ``` ### Harness Anything + DeepSeek Harness plugin (macOS) Copy this single paragraph to your agent: ```text Read skills/harness-dsh-install/SKILL.md from https://github.com/FairladyZ625/harness-anything and use it to install Harness Anything, its complete skill set, and the plugin for my macOS DeepSeek Harness desktop App. Reuse my existing Harness installation and preserve customized skills; install only what is missing. Check the DSH version, list my profiles and let me confirm the desktop profile, then install the plugin and verify ha from DSH, the ha-ceo/ha-worker presets, the tutorial, and the Harness panel. Continue repository onboarding if this project needs it, and report any prerequisites or checks that remain incomplete. ``` The [installation skill](./skills/harness-dsh-install/SKILL.md) prepares the plugin from a persistent source checkout and links it into the chosen DSH profile. The plugin is currently private; do not use an unpublished npm install command. The checkout must contain `packages/dsh-plugin`. For manual installation after the agent prepares it, prefer DSH **Plugins → Add plugin** with the absolute `link:` path it provides; the profile-specific CLI command is the fallback. The skill installs all available usage skills and preserves existing custom versions.
Skills installation options and setup details Install the onboarding skill for the agents you use. This example selects Codex and Claude Code; omit an agent you do not use, or choose other supported agents interactively: ```bash bunx skills add FairladyZ625/harness-anything --skill harness-download -g -a codex claude-code ``` Without Bun, replace `bunx` with `npx`. Bun runs the Skills installer; Harness itself currently runs on Node 24+ from a persistent source checkout. The agent continues through each stage: | Skill | Responsibility | | --- | --- | | [harness-download](./skills/harness-download/SKILL.md) | Prepare the environment and persistent source checkout, link the skills, and coordinate the remaining setup | | [harness-install](./skills/harness-install/SKILL.md) | Adopt the available Harness installation in a target repository, preserving existing instructions and identity approvals | | [harness-ceo](./skills/harness-ceo/SKILL.md) | Initialize user-owned knowledge locations, select models, carry out real work, and verify delivery | Download the tools once. Use `harness-install` for another repository and `harness-ceo` for daily work. User model matrices, issue records, and feedback stay in the workspace; public skill updates do not overwrite them. You can also inspect or install the complete skill set: ```bash bunx skills add FairladyZ625/harness-anything --list bunx skills add FairladyZ625/harness-anything --skill '*' -g -a codex claude-code ``` The Skills CLI's installed copy is separate from the source installation. The onboarding flow then links the selected agents to the persistent source checkout. Existing customized skills with the same name are checked for conflicts, not automatically overwritten. Moving the source directory breaks those links, so do not keep it in a temporary location. An existing, usable current-generation ledger is reused. Only an identified older generation is routed to [harness-migration](./skills/harness-migration/SKILL.md); an existing directory alone does not authorize overwriting or migration. See the [official Skills CLI documentation](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) for installation syntax and agent directory selection. Skills can be discovered directly from GitHub. Listing and indexing on [skills.sh](https://skills.sh/docs) are controlled by that service; adding repository documentation does not prove that the service has indexed it.
## Your agent can write code. Can your project learn? Most agent runs are disposable. The reasoning stays in a transcript, settled decisions get reopened, the same mistakes return, and *"done"* is whatever the agent says it is. Harness Anything makes the work accumulate: | Without a harness | With Harness Anything | | --- | --- | | Reasoning disappears with the session | Decisions and facts become durable project memory | | The next agent repeats old mistakes | Failures can become rules, checks, and better workflows | | Completion is a claim | Completion is a state earned through gates | This is not a better chat log. It is a compounding loop for how agents work in your repository. ## Why It Compounds ```text DECIDE → WORK → VERIFY → LEARN → THE NEXT RUN STARTS STRONGER ``` ### Memory that survives the session Every task leaves behind the context that matters: what was decided, what was tried, what was observed, and what remains unresolved. The next agent starts from project memory instead of reconstructing history from scratch. ### Mistakes that become infrastructure A failure should pay rent. Capture it as a fact, turn a recurring lesson into a decision, check, or preset, and the repository becomes harder to break in the same way twice. ### “Done” that means something Agents do not get to close work by confidence alone. A six-field Submission Packet gives the reviewer a traceable claim and inspection entry points; the reviewer records what was checked and why the round is or is not acceptable. Completion then applies the gates declared by the task's resolved preset/profile contract. Coding contracts can require CI, but the kernel requires neither CI nor any minimum number of Facts universally (dec_mrg3z1we/CH1, CH4; ADR-0027 D5-D7). ## Self-Involving By Design Harness Anything is developed through Harness Anything. Its own tasks, decisions, facts, reviews, and completion gates run through the same system it gives your repository. The harness observes its own failures, turns lessons into stronger constraints, and uses those constraints on the next round of development. That is what *self-evolving* means here: not magic, and not autonomous churn. Each completed loop leaves the system better equipped for the next one. Your repository gets the same compounding mechanism. ## Install and run Choose [Harness Anything only](#harness-anything-only) or [Harness + DSH](#harness-anything--deepseek-harness-plugin-macos) above. Both setup skills use a persistent source checkout and require Node.js 24+. Find desktop App builds on the [GitHub Releases page](https://github.com/FairladyZ625/harness-anything/releases). macOS releases are Apple Silicon arm64 only (dmg/zip); Windows releases are x64 NSIS and may show SmartScreen; Linux releases include x64 AppImage (automatic updates) and deb (manual upgrades). For source installation (CLI, daemon, and GUI in one pass, including the Electron download), follow [harness-download](./skills/harness-download/SKILL.md); it is the only source-install recipe. The [contributor guide](./docs-release/contributing/en/01-local-setup.md) covers working on this repository. ## Breaking change: existing repositories must migrate The ledger format has changed by a generation and this project keeps no backward compatibility, so existing repositories cannot be upgraded in place. The old repository is archived read-only and replayed into a new one; it is never at risk. **You do not have to do this by hand, and you do not need the current version installed first.** Paste this to a coding agent working in the repository you want to migrate: > Read `skills/harness-migration/SKILL.md` from > https://github.com/FairladyZ625/harness-anything and > follow it to migrate this project's `harness/` ledger to the current format. > Ask me before each decision the skill says to ask about. The skill fetches the current source into a temporary directory and runs everything from there, so an older Harness installation on the same machine — including a running daemon — is left untouched. It stops and asks you at each point where a choice destroys something: file conflicts between your ledger and the freshly initialized one, records the strict format rejects, and presets that must be rebuilt rather than copied. Prefer to drive it yourself? The [migration guide](./docs-release/migration-genesis-replay.md) is the same procedure in reference form. ## How It Works Harness Anything gives agent work three durable primitives: - **Decision** — what was chosen, what was rejected, and why. - **Task** — what is being changed, its plan, progress, review, and closeout. - **Fact** — what was actually observed, with source and confidence. They live as plain Markdown inside a private nested git ledger. Git provides the history; a rebuildable projection makes the records queryable; gates control which state transitions are allowed. The result is a repository that remembers more than its code: - why its architecture looks the way it does; - which attempts failed and should not be repeated; - which work is truly complete and which claims remain open; - how its own development process should improve next. ## Documentation - [Start](./docs-release/start/en/00-what-is-this.md) — install it and run one real loop. ([中文](./docs-release/start/zh/00-what-is-this.md)) - [Learn](./docs-release/learn/en/00-overview.md) — understand the memory model, gates, and compounding loop. ([中文](./docs-release/learn/zh/00-overview.md)) - [Architecture](./docs-release/architecture/en/00-overview.md) — explore the kernel, storage model, write path, and projections. ([中文](./docs-release/architecture/zh/00-overview.md)) - [Release posture](./docs-release/release-posture.md) — see what is shipped, foundational, or planned. - [Harness CEO](./skills/harness-ceo/SKILL.md) — model-neutral delegation, evidence-based acceptance, and onboarding and improvement methods for user-owned model matrices. - [Migration](./docs-release/migration-genesis-replay.md) — replay an older-generation ledger into the current format. ([agent skill](./skills/harness-migration/SKILL.md)) - [Ledger recovery](./docs-release/migration-legacy-ledger-recovery.md) — repair a repository whose legacy ledger the current daemon refuses to attach. ([中文](./docs-release/migration-legacy-ledger-recovery.zh-CN.md)) - [Minimal example](./examples/minimal-project/) — inspect the smallest working project. ## Contributing Sharp bug reports, failing test cases, architecture questions, and focused documentation fixes are especially useful right now. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening a pull request. ## License [AGPL-3.0-or-later](./LICENSE). Harness Anything stays open, including when it is offered as a service.

dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck

**中文** · [English](docs/README.en.md) **拨开战争迷雾看见终点，剩下的交给 MattSkillsDeck。** 让 [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) 在 DSH 里化作游戏系统的任务面板。 你的 ⭐是我夜空中最亮的星。 *Part the fog of war, see the end — MattSkillsDeck handles the rest.* [![版本](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck?label=%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck) [![下载量](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.npmjs.org%2Fdownloads%2Fpoint%2Flast-month%2Fdsh-mattpocock-skills-deck&query=%24.downloads&label=%E4%B8%8B%E8%BD%BD%E9%87%8F&suffix=%2F%E6%9C%88&color=brightgreen)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck) [![下载总量](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck?label=%E4%B8%8B%E8%BD%BD%E6%80%BB%E9%87%8F&color=red)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck) [![最近更新](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck?label=%E6%9C%80%E8%BF%91%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0&color=FE7D37)](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck/commits/main) [![月提交](https://img.shields.io/github/commit-activity/m/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck?label=%E6%8F%90%E4%BA%A4%E6%95%B0&color=DFAB01)](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck/graphs/commit-activity) [![技能包](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E6%8A%80%E8%83%BD%E5%8C%85-mattpocock%2Fskills-9D7CD8)](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) [![欢迎提交PR🌹](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E6%AC%A2%E8%BF%8E%E6%8F%90%E4%BA%A4PR%F0%9F%8C%B9-red.svg)](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck/issues) 欢迎提交PR，不要求完美无瑕，有缺陷也会在合入后进行优化而不是拒绝，星星之火🔥可以燎原！
唯一要求：使用技能 /pr 填写PR信息。

INSTALL
安装

```bash # ① 安装 DSH CLI（已装跳过） npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh # ② 安装 MattSkillsDeck —— --profile 必填：装进你实际使用的 DSH 入口对应的 profile # （装错 profile 等于没装，重启多少次都不会加载） dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck # 用自启 web 服务（dsh web） # 或者 dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck # 用 DSH Desktop 桌面应用 # 锁定最新版更稳（当前 1.9.0-beta.34）： dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck@1.9.0-beta.34 --registry https://registry.npmjs.org # 或者 dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck@1.9.0-beta.34 --registry https://registry.npmjs.org ``` > **用 GitHub 后端前的权限前提**：插件替你改 ISSUE，用的是本机 `gh` 已登录账号的权限——建标签、改票需要仓库的 `push` 权限；改指派、流转标签需要 `triage` 权限。账号在该仓库只有 `只读` 权限时，插件会把仓库如实标成只读：改票、打标签与标签流转不可用，浏览与刷新照常。

BOARD
任务板

DSH侧边栏-总览任务面板全貌。通过插件内置SKILLS的任务拆分，可以做到session并发处理。效率加倍省心。
👇 列表中展示：探索地图、实施地图、普通ISSUE。并且提供便捷按钮一键注入prompt。
 👇 实战案例：任务经过拆分，可以大量同时执行任务。
👇 地图详情：像素风卡片呈现所有可以执行的任务。
 👇 单票详情：描述、验收、进度、评论等信息不再需要打开原始文件。

STATUSBAR
对话框胶囊栏

胶囊状态栏：核心信息直接呈现，快捷入口方便高效。
👇 可接任务、故障、需要诊断分流、刷新、ISSUE处理路径表。清晰可见。
 👇 工作路线：清晰展示当前会话处理ISSUE的心路历程。

DEMAND
新增需求

新增需求：在“探索流程”和“实施流程”中二选一，通过插件引导最终将所有IDEA落地。
👇 右侧面板，按需选择不同流程。
 👇 胶囊栏，按需选择不同流程。

SKILLS
技能面板

内置 27 个技能（v1.3.2）：同时提供技能原文，在使用过程中提供便利的学习原文途径。
👇 可以注入到对话框。可以查看技能详情
 👇 技能详情页面，方便学习原始技能。

BACKENDS · ENV
多后端切换与环境检查

根据办公环境不同提供多样后端：GitHub、本地 Markdown、GitLab。
👇 在不同后端中进行切换。
 👇 环境逐项自检。如果不准确点击刷新重新检测。

VERSION
版本管理

提供简化的版本管理页面，方便查看。
👇 改动：fetch、pull、push、add、commit
 👇 提交历史
 👇 工作树

APPEARANCE
设置与外观

按钮颜色 = label标签颜色。调色板可以给每类标签配置颜色。
👇 设置主页
 👇 调色板：设置标签颜色可以改变按钮颜色。

INIT FLOW
初始化流程

六步完成工作区的初始化。
👇 第 1 步：选择工作区并新建会话
 👇 第 2 步：新会话提示选择后端
👇 第 3 步：选择后端为 GitHub
 👇 第 4 步：点击确认后注入提示词
👇 第 5 步：等待 AI 执行初始化
 👇 第 6 步：环境检测不通过时需要补齐并刷新。

JOIN
欢迎您加入我们

非常欢迎提交PR、共同维护项目，现在迭代中很缺对markdown后端的开发和完善，Gitlab目前无人力开发。

致谢
