Plugin: install into a dsh profile (dsh >= 0.2.1-rc.2: npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@next) dsh plugin --profile web add "git+https://github.com/hsliuustc0106/dsh-jiuwen-adapter.git" # 3. Make it the default model, then chat printf -- '- id: agent-default-model\n config:\n provider: jiuwen\n model: jiuwen-default\n' >> ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml dsh --profile web ``` Step-by-step guide for Mac and Linux: **[docs/quickstart.md](./docs/quickstart.md)**. To try it without a Gateway, run `npm run mock:gateway`. ## Features | | What you get | Default | |---|---|---| | 🧠 **Jiuwen brain** | One dsh turn is one Gateway `chat.send`. Agents, team mode, skills and memory run in Jiuwen | on | | 💬 **Live activity** | Reasoning, 🔧 tool calls, subtasks and token usage stream into dsh | on | | ✅ **dsh approvals and questions** | Jiuwen permission prompts, plan approval and `ask_user` go through dsh's own dialogs, and deny when no answer comes | on | | 🔁 **Session continuity** | dsh sessions map to Jiuwen sessions. Only new text is sent after the first turn | on | | 🛟 **Drop recovery** | If the Gateway drops mid-answer, the reply is recovered from history and marked as recovered | on | | 🧾 **Local titles and compaction** | Titles and `/compact` are handled locally, so they never cost a Jiuwen turn | on | | ⌨️ **`/jiuwen` command** | Sessions, models, modes, skills, agents, cron, MCP and more ([list](./docs/dsh-integration.md#5-jiuwen-slash-command-dsh-command-registry)) | on | | 🖼️ **Multimodal** | Image and file parts are sent as Jiuwen media | on | | 🪪 **System prompt → Jiuwen** | `injectSystem: full\|persona` sends the host system prompt (any role/profile) once per Jiuwen session, resent only on change, capped by `injectSystemMaxBytes`. `injectSystemUpdate: diff` (default) resends only changed sections (safety gates may still send full); optional `hostSystemSectionsAllow`/`Deny` filter by heading; an optional `hostProfile` object can name your host's persona sections. Hosts that need the full orchestrator role keep `full`; ordinary dsh chats may use `persona`/`off` | default `full` (`off` to disable) | | 📚 **Host skills → Jiuwen** | Skills Jiuwen lacks go as an index (name + description) loaded on demand via the passthrough `skill` tool, or inline bodies when that tool is absent; hash-gated across restarts, best-effort secret redaction, `skillBodyMaxChars` cap with a truncation marker | default `index` | | ⏹️ **Interrupt on new message** | A user message that arrives while a Jiuwen turn is running interrupts it (`chat.interrupt`), coalesces everything that arrived meanwhile into one step, and resends with a note that the previous turn was cut (side effects not rolled back). Waits for a pending approval card first ([docs](./docs/configuration.md#interrupt-on-busy-onbusymessage)) | default `interrupt` (`onBusyMessage: queue` / `JIUWEN_ON_BUSY_MESSAGE=queue` for the old wait-until-done) | | 🪜 **Full trajectory** | `trajectoryDetail: full` renders Jiuwen tool calls, results, subtasks and plan steps as Markdown steps in the reasoning block | default `full` (`summary` to disable) | | 🔌 **dsh tools → Jiuwen** | All dsh host/plugin tools exposed to Jiuwen over MCP by default (`toolAllowlist: '*'`; `core` = restricted shell/file + skill + session-query set, plus `toolAllowlistExtra` and host-declared `passthrough: true`), each call gated by an approval. Per-session proxies are released on session end or after `mcpSessionIdleMs`, stale ones GC'd at start; reconnect only when the tool set changes | on with `hostSync` | | 🎛️ **Per-profile overrides** | `sessionOverrides` by host agent preset (`preset` glob) sets model / chat mode / template defaults; request, catalog and `/jiuwen mode` still win | opt-in | | 🧭 **Bridges** | Model discovery, typed events | opt-in | | 🔄 **Host → Jiuwen sync** | Skills, MCP, model, plan, workDir, title, delete, goal, pause, permissions, fork, schedules ([docs](./docs/host-sync.md)) | on | | 🩺 **Config validation** | Unknown keys get a "did you mean" hint and deprecated keys get a warning. Never throws | on | ## Compatibility Other dsh plugins must keep working. The adapter is tested against the **full dsh agent runtime** (`dsh-agent`, `dsh-agent-loop`, compaction, subagents, goals, plan mode, a bash sandbox, approvals and user-questions). The same scripted session runs once with jiuwen loaded and once without. Every row of the [compat matrix](./docs/known-issues.md#15-round-8-full-runtime-scenarios--version-matrix) must match, covering events, tool calls, plan exit, goal rounds, auto-compaction, subagents, bash, host event counts, globals and load failures. | Component | Supported | Tested in CI | |---|---|---| | dsh | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` | 0.2.1-rc.2, 0.2.1-rc.5 | | Cordis | `^4.0.5` | 4.0.5 | | Node | `>=22` | 22, 24 | | JiuwenSwarm | 0.2.x Gateway | 0.2.7 (live) | The adapter also works in any Cordis app that has an `llm` service ([usage](./docs/usage.md)). ## Docs - [Quickstart](./docs/quickstart.md), [Configuration](./docs/configuration.md), [Troubleshooting](./docs/troubleshooting.md) - [Using it from code and Gateway features](./docs/usage.md), [Gateway RPC coverage](./docs/coverage.md) - [dsh integration](./docs/dsh-integration.md), [Host → Jiuwen sync](./docs/host-sync.md), [Testing](./docs/testing.md), [Known issues and test logs](./docs/known-issues.md) - [Publishing to a dsh plugin market](./docs/marketplace.md), [Architecture](./ARCHITECTURE.md) ## Development ```bash npm run lint # node --check over index.js, src/, bin/, scripts/, test/ npm test # unit, mock-gateway and runtime suites npm run test:coverage # + coverage floors and the test-count baseline (what CI runs) bash scripts/guard-live.sh # box-side nightly live guard (real Jiuwen + plain dsh), see docs/testing.md npm run compat -- --diff # with vs. without jiuwen compat matrix (needs DSH_NM=) npm run market:index # regenerate market/index.json ``` Licensed under [Apache-2.0](./LICENSE).

# deepclean-mydisk

## 独立项目

本目录是一个**独立 Git 仓库/项目**，位于 `~/Documents/deepseek-harness/plugins/deepclean-mydisk-plugin`：

- 不依赖 `deepclean-mydisk` skill 仓库，也不依赖 `default-workspace`；
- 扫描器内置于 `resources/`（与 skill 同源、独立维护，可选用 `scripts/sync-scanner.sh` 同步）；
- 有自己的许可证、测试、CI、Windows 验收文档与发布流程。

> 仓库：https://github.com/huangxiaoliang/deepclean-mydisk-plugin
> 安装：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:huangxiaoliang/deepclean-mydisk-plugin`（或本地 `file:/绝对路径`）
> 测试：`npm test`（55 个用例；GitHub Actions 矩阵 macOS + Windows）
> Windows 真机验收：`docs/windows-acceptance.md` + `scripts/acceptance-windows.ps1`

DSH 插件：只读磁盘体检（macOS / Windows），提供**原生侧边栏页面** + 3 个模型工具。

## v0.9.0 打开即显示磁盘容量

- 打开面板立刻显示 **已用 / 总量 / 可用** 与环形图，不需要先跑体检；
- 数据由宿主直接 `statfs` 读取（毫秒级、只读），不启动扫描、不碰用户文件；
- 与扫描报告同口径：macOS 统计数据卷（`/System/Volumes/Data`），Windows 统计系统盘；
- 标题栏常驻一行「共 X · 已用 Y」，任何子页都能看到；容量每 60 秒 / 回到前台时经轻量 `GET /api/disk` 刷新，清理后立刻回显；
- 无扫描结果时可安全清理等估算显示「—」，避免误读为 0；
- 新增 5 个测试（宿主容量快照 + 打开即显示 / 中英 / 回退渲染），共 55 个。

## v0.8.0 信息架构重构

- 一级导航合并为 5 个：**体检 / 空间 / 清理 / 历史 / 设置**；大文件、相似照片改为子页；
- 首页单 CTA「开始体检」+ **体检向导**：推荐清单（默认勾选推荐项）→ 二次确认 → 已释放 + 撤销；
- 清理页：**分区总览卡**（项数/大小，点击切换）+ 全选/清空/按大小阈值批量选择 + 每类安全提示；
- 大文件：目标磁盘下拉（含可用空间）、空间对比与不足警告、完成后打开目标文件夹；
- 相似照片：保留策略（最大/最新/路径最浅）、文件夹筛选、并排对比弹层；
- 新增 48 个自动化测试（含 7 个页面 × 中英 × 有数据渲染），GitHub Actions 双平台。

## v0.7.2 国际化与安全沟通

- 中英双语：设置页可切换 中文 / English（持久化到 localStorage）；主界面、按钮、Tab、提示、确认框均翻译。
- 扫描器文案：常见 why/advice/分类通过模式翻译（未覆盖的专有名词保留原文）。
- 安全沟通：
  - 首次打开显示安全说明卡（只移动不删除、可恢复、保护规则）；
  - 每项展开显示「为什么在这里 / 删了会怎样 / 怎么恢复」；
  - 清理/照片/搬家确认框明确写出「移到废纸篓，可在历史恢复；不会永久删除」；
  - 设置页新增安全说明四条。

## v0.7.1 修复

- 跨 Tab 勾选的「已选 N 项 · 大小」改为全量统计（之前只算当前 Tab）
- 清理页显示"扫描结果超过 10 分钟"警告，避免点击后才发现过期
- 面板重新打开时从 `/api/state` 恢复"撤销上次清理"
- 相似照片页新增「撤销照片清理」按钮
- 空间搬家改为后台任务：逐文件进度、可取消、完成后自动重扫
- 复制命令按平台生成（Windows 用 `Move-Item`，macOS 用 `mv`）
- 侧边栏徽标改回稳定文案（避免动态重注册闪烁）

## v0.7 功能

- **相似照片**：sips + dHash 扫描 Pictures/Downloads/Desktop/Documents，按汉明距离分组，缩略图对比；
  默认保留每组最大一张，其余可移到废纸篓（可撤销，最多 600 张/次）。
- **空间搬家**：大文件页勾选 → 填目标目录（可外接盘）→ 跨盘复制 + SHA-256 校验后删除原文件；
  同盘直接 rename；目标空间不足/校验失败自动保留原文件。
- **状态徽标**：侧边栏入口显示可用空间（`DeepClean MyDisk · 100G`），每分钟刷新。
- 扫描器与 skill 0.5.0 同步。

## v0.6 功能

- **微信 / 企业微信 / QQ 专清**：按 App 与类型（缓存/聊天缓存/图片/视频/语音/文件/表情）聚合大小；
  - 只读展示全部类型；
  - **仅「缓存」可勾选清理**（CEF、Wedoc、WeMail、TencentMeeting 等）；
  - 「聊天缓存」与聊天文件默认锁定（删除后可能无法恢复），需人工确认。
- 清理页新增「微信/QQ」Tab；一键清理同样走废纸篓 + 可撤销 + 白名单保护。

## v0.5 功能

- **空间可视化**：懒加载目录树 + 可点击钻取的环形图（`GET /api/tree?path=`），只允许浏览家目录；
- **大文件 / 旧文件**：大小、修改时间、类型筛选、排序；复制路径 / 在 Finder 中显示（只读）；
- **浏览器缓存细分**：Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari / Arc（只统计 Caches，不碰书签/密码/历史）；
- **开发缓存专项**：Xcode DerivedData/DeviceSupport/Archives、CoreSimulator、Docker、CocoaPods、SwiftPM、npm/pnpm、Maven、Codex 等；高风险的标记「需确认」且不进入一键清理；
- **智能体检**：扫描后自动选中推荐项（安全档 + 可再生缓存/开发缓存），核对后一键清理。

## v0.4 功能

- 首页 Dashboard：磁盘环形图、可用/总量、可回收估算、历史趋势、快捷扫描；
- 扫描后台化：进度条 + 阶段 + 取消（`POST /api/scan`、`GET /api/scan`、`POST /api/scan/cancel`）；
- 列表增强：大小/名称排序、搜索、风险徽章（安全/需确认/系统/保护）、行内展开详情；
- 清理后自动重扫 + 历史和恢复中心（跨重启从审计日志恢复批次）；
- 白名单/保护名单：勾选「加入保护」或设置页添加，白名单路径永不清理；
- 保留：一键清理（移到废纸篓/隔离区，可撤销）、复制命令、权限检查。

## 功能

- **侧边栏「磁盘体检」**：三档清单（可安全清理 / 需确认 / 缓存与开发缓存 / 不要动）、每项详情、可回收估算、快速/完整扫描、权限检查；勾选后可**一键清理**（移到废纸篓/隔离区，可撤销，写审计日志）或复制命令。
- **模型工具**：`disk_check_permissions`、`disk_audit`、`disk_self_test`（只读）。
- **HTTP API**：
  - `GET /dsh-deepclean/api/permissions` → `{ code, text }`
  - `GET /dsh-deepclean/api/report?quick=1|full=1` → `{ report, at }`
  - `POST /dsh-deepclean/api/clean` `{ paths }` → 移入废纸篓/隔离区
  - `POST /dsh-deepclean/api/undo` `{ batchId? }` → 撤销上一批
  - `GET /dsh-deepclean/api/state` → `{ canUndo, lastBatchId }`
- 扫描器内置于 `resources/`，与 `deepclean-mydisk` skill v0.4.4 同源；本机需要 `python3`（Windows 为 `py -3`）。

## 安全边界

- 扫描与查询接口只读；一键清理只**移动**（移到废纸篓/隔离区），不永久删除。
- 清理只接受最近一次扫描（10 分钟内）允许列表里的路径：可安全清理档 + 用户勾选的缓存/开发缓存；「需确认」档永不接受。
- 符号链接一律拒绝；目标名冲突自动加序号，不覆盖；撤销只回滚仍存在且原位置为空的条目。
- 清理/撤销写入 `$DSH_HOME/deepclean-audit.log`。

## 安装（本地开发）

包名/显示名：`deepclean-mydisk` / **DeepClean MyDisk**。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-deepclean
# 然后重启 DSH
```

## 配置

- `dsh.bundle.patch`：`./cordis.patch.yml`，插入 `deepclean-mydisk` 条目。
- `dsh.client`：`platform: web`，导出 `./client`（手写 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` bundle，无构建步骤）。
- peer：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools@0.2.1-rc.5`。

## 已知限制

- 扫描在宿主进程内同步执行（快速版约 20–30s），UI 期间显示「扫描中」。
- 侧边栏页面在 Web GUI 与桌面端共用；Windows 真机尚待验收。
- 撤销批次保存在内存里，DSH 重启后不可撤销（废纸篓里的文件仍在，可手动恢复）。

No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# dsh-enhance · DSH 增强插件

A single DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle that ships many small UI extensions. One package, one entry, one switch — instead of one package per tiny feature.

一个插件包，装多个小扩展。目标：**一份代码、一个入口、一处启停**。

> 面向使用者：直接跳到 [安装](#安装)。面向开发者：跳到 [加一个新功能](#加一个新功能)。

---

## 功能

| 功能 | 位置 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 全部关闭 / Close All | 右侧面板标签页右键菜单 | 一次关掉当前会话的所有标签（停靠 / 分栏 / 浮出都算）。**标签少于 2 个时该行不出现** |

关掉最后一个停靠标签时，侧栏按内置规则收起，下次展开重新播默认引导页——和手动点最后一个 × 的行为一致。整批关闭在侧栏的历史里记成一步，可一次撤销。

---

## 安装

前提：已装 `dsh`（`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`）并能跑 `dsh web`。

### 从 npm

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @huashaoya/dsh-enhance
```

### 从 GitHub

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:huashaoya/dsh-enhance
```

### 从本地目录（离线 / 自己改过）

解压或 clone 到任意绝对路径，然后：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add D:/plugins/dsh-enhance
```

**装完必须刷新浏览器页面。** 插件的模块图在页面启动时组好，新装一个包等于图里多一条入口，不重载就拿不到。

### 在图形界面里装

也可以不敲命令：在 DSH 的 **Settings → Plugins** 里安装，效果相同。

---

## 使用

在右侧面板（文件预览 / 浏览器 / 终端）的任意标签上**右键**，菜单里会出现「全部关闭」。点它，当前会话的标签一次关完。

只有一个标签时这一行不出现——单个标签用菜单自带的「关闭」就够。

---

## 停用与卸载

```bash
# 停用（保留文件）
dsh plugin --profile web remove @huashaoya/dsh-enhance

# 或只想去掉某个功能：改 client.js 里的 FEATURES，见下
```

图形界面：**Settings → Plugins** → 「DSH 增强 / DSH Enhance」关掉即可。

---

## 加一个新功能

所有功能都在 `client.js` 一个文件里，三层排布：

```
1. 共享层   MENU_ITEM 样式 / MenuRow 菜单行 / useLocaleRevision /
            registerCopy / openTabIds / closeOne / closeMany
2. 功能层   一个功能一个 IIFE，自己持有 SLOT、NS、文案、组件
3. 注册层   FEATURES 数组 + apply() 聚合
```

加功能的完整流程：在第 2 层写一个 IIFE，往 `FEATURES` 加一行。**不要**动 `package.json`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`index.js`。

```js
const featureMyThing = (() => {
  const SLOT = "sidebar.right.tab.menu.item";  // 换成你要挂的槽位
  const NS = "enhance.myThing";                // 独占文案命名空间

  const createItem = (ctx) => {
    const t = ctx.locale.bind(NS);
    return function MyThing(props) {
      useLocaleRevision(ctx);
      return h(MenuRow, {
        action: "my-thing",
        onClick: () => { props.dismiss(); /* 干活 */ }
      }, t("label"));
    };
  };

  return {
    id: "my-thing",
    inject: ["slots", "locale"],   // 按需加 sidebarRight 等服务
    apply(ctx) {
      registerCopy(ctx, NS, { zh: { label: "我的功能" }, en: { label: "My Thing" } });
      ctx.slots.inject(SLOT, () => ctx.slots.register(
        { name: SLOT, id: "my-thing", order: 20 },
        createItem(ctx)
      ));
    }
  };
})();
```

然后：

```js
const FEATURES = [
  featureCloseAllTabs,
  featureMyThing,        // ← 加这一行
];
```

### 三条约定

1. **`id` 全局唯一**，槽位内也一样；重复的 id 会顶掉别的项。
2. **文案走 `registerCopy` + `bind`**，不要硬编码中文——界面语言可切。
3. **数据从服务读，不读 DOM**；动作走宿主自己的命令通路（如 `ctx.sidebarRight.closeIn`），不直接改 store。

### 为什么每个功能单独包一层 `ctx.inject`

聚合 `apply()` 对每个功能做：

```js
ctx.inject(feature.inject, (sub) => { feature.apply(sub) })
```

每个功能跑在**自己的 cordis 子 fiber** 上，因此：

- 声明的服务缺失 → 只有这个功能不激活，其余照常；
- 功能内部抛错 → 只记一条 `console.error`，不会把整个 bundle 打成 FAILED；
- 卸载插件 = 子 fiber 全部 dispose = 槽位注册、文案字典、监听器自动撤销。

### 怎么找槽位

不要猜槽位名。运行时查：

```js
cordis_inspect_query({ platform: "client", provider: "Slots", method: "listSubTree", input: {} })
```

返回整棵槽位树：`kind`（`single` 会顶掉内置 / `list` 只增 / `keyed` 按 key 分派 / `chain` 可改道）、`purpose`、`ownerProps`、注册要求。

---

## 文件结构

```
dsh-enhance/
├── client.js          ← 所有功能都在这里（唯一需要改的文件）
├── index.js           ← Host 半边，目前为空；将来放工具 / 服务
├── cordis.patch.yml   ← Loader 入口（整个插件只占一行）
├── package.json       ← bundle 声明 + 浏览器 bundle 声明
├── locale/{zh,en}.json ← 插件在设置页里显示的名字和描述
├── icon.svg
└── README.md
```

**改名要改三处**：`package.json` 的 `name`、`cordis.patch.yml` 里那一行的 `name`、`client.js` 第一行的 `id`。三者对不上，插件会加载但拿不到自己的 client bundle。

---

## 发布到 npm

```bash
npm publish --access public
```

注意 `files` 里必须包含 `client.js`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`locale/*.json`、`icon.svg`，否则装完是坏的。用 `npm pack --dry-run` 核对实际打包清单。

---

## 已知限制

- **必须刷新页面**才生效（模块图在 boot 时组好）。
- `immediately: true` 意味着页面启动阶段就要注册；因此 `apply` 绝不能抛错——现在的 try/catch 保证了这一点。
- 行内 `style` 而非 `<style>` 标签注入：卸载时不会留下幽灵样式，代价是不能用媒体查询和伪类。
- 样式只引用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌：令牌改名只会让外观退化，不会让组件崩掉。

---

## License

MIT

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# @iasiv5/dsh-skills

DeepSeek Harness 插件：把 [iasiv5/skills](https://github.com/iasiv5/skills) 仓库的 skill 合集以 **bundled skill** 方式注册进 DSH 宿主 skill 注册表——安装插件即用，**不再需要**把 skill 拷贝进 `.agents/skills/` 或 `.dsh/skills/`。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @iasiv5/dsh-skills
```

或 DSH 桌面/网页端 Plugins 页按名安装（dsh-m 市场收录后可直接从市场装）。安装后**重启宿主并新开会话**生效。

## 使用

- skill 经宿主 skill 注册表统一暴露：模型按情境自动触发（`modelInvocable`），或 `/` 斜杠手动调用（`userInvocable`）。
- 部分 skill 带 `disable-model-invocation: true`（仅斜杠可调），与目录安装行为一致。
- workspace 内 `.dsh/skills/`、`.agents/skills/` 的同名副本优先级**高于**本插件（rank 100–500 vs bundled 600）——要用插件版，请清理本地同名副本。

## 内容与许可

- skill 清单：见仓库根 README；本包按 as-is 收录（不裁剪上游文件）。
- 许可归属：见 [NOTICE.md](./NOTICE.md)——注意 Anthropic 系（docx/pdf/xlsx）上游许可禁止再分发，相关条目附使用注记。

## 更新

仓库内容变更后由维护者发新版；`dshm upgrade`（或插件页更新）+ 重启 + 新会话生效。本地副本不会自动跟随本包更新。

# iasiv5/skills

𝓲-Collection：iasiv5 的 Agent Skills 合集。面向 Claude Code、Codex、DeepSeek Harness 等多种 harness 的可复用任务技能（每个 skill 一个目录，`SKILL.md` + 随附脚本/资产）。

## 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）中使用

推荐以 DSH 插件方式安装（免拷贝、随版本更新）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @iasiv5/dsh-skills
```

桌面端在 Plugins 页按名安装 `@iasiv5/dsh-skills`；dsh-m 市场收录后亦可从市场一键安装。安装后重启宿主、**新开会话**生效。详见 [`dsh-plugin/README.md`](./dsh-plugin/README.md)。

> 插件 skill 的优先级低于 workspace 内 `.dsh/skills/`、`.agents/skills/` 的同名副本——若之前用下方脚本安装过，请清理副本后再用插件版。

## 其他 harness（传统方式）

`./update.sh` 从 GitHub 拉取 `.your-skill-collection.json` 声明的上游 skill 覆盖更新（旧版备份到 `.backup/`）。**注意：该流不适用于 DSH**——DSH 用户请走上面的插件安装。

- `local` 列表（本地自研源头）与 `skip` 列表中的 skill 不参与更新。

## 目录约定

- 每个 skill 一个根级目录，入口 `SKILL.md`（YAML frontmatter：`name`/`description`/可选 `whenToUse`/`disable-model-invocation`/`user-invocable`）。
- `Geek-skills-*` 目录名仅是收藏来源标记，实际 skill 名以 frontmatter `name` 为准（如 `keqian-method`）。
- `docs/`（ADR/计划/handoff）为仓库自身文档，不属于任何 skill。
- 上游来源与子目录映射见 `.your-skill-collection.json`；许可归属见 [`dsh-plugin/NOTICE.md`](./dsh-plugin/NOTICE.md)。
- 术语与设计决策：[GLOSSARY.md](./GLOSSARY.md)、`docs/adr/`。

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # doubao-image — generate images with the local Doubao app > 面向：使用者 · 状态：stable · 最近核对：2026-09-20 Registers one tool, `generate_image`, that drives the **locally installed and logged-in Doubao (豆包) desktop app** to produce a picture, saves the full-resolution file, and sends it into the conversation. ``` plugins/doubao-image/ ├── package.json # type: module, dsh.bundle.patch, exports ├── cordis.patch.yml # bundle patch: the loader row ├── lib/ │ ├── index.js # cordis plugin: the generate_image tool │ ├── doubao.mjs # app launch, prompt submission, result harvest │ ├── cdp.mjs # dependency-free Chrome DevTools Protocol client │ ├── watermark.mjs # removes Doubao's own overlay, with a self-check │ ├── image.mjs # minimal PNG codec + raster helpers │ └── generate.mjs # CLI driver, for testing without spending a model turn └── test/ # node --test (no DSH, no app, no network) ``` ## Install ```bash # from npm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-doubao-image # or from the repository root — the leading ./ matters: DSH anchors relative specs # against your current directory, otherwise pnpm would resolve it inside the profile dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/doubao-image ``` Then restart DSH (or reload the profile). The tool appears as `generate_image`. ## Use ```bash # exercise the whole path without going through the model node plugins/doubao-image/lib/generate.mjs \ --prompt "一只戴黄铜护目镜的橘猫，坐在双翼飞机驾驶舱里" \ --style "黏土质感 C4D 渲染，暖色夕阳光" \ --out ~/Pictures/doubao ``` The tool takes `prompt` (required) plus `style`, `composition`, `aspect`, `negative`, `count`, `dir`, and `reuseCurrentChat`. ## How it works, and why it is built this way Doubao ships a **full Chromium** (`Contents/Helpers/Doubao Browser.app`), and its launcher forwards unknown flags, so starting it with `--remote-debugging-port` yields a real CDP endpoint. That is the whole reason this works without the macOS Accessibility permission that `osascript` would need — which matters, because that permission is not granted on this machine. The findings each step depends on, all established by probing the running app: | Step | What is actually true | | --- | --- | | Launch | Doubao holds a **singleton lock**. A normally-launched instance never opens the debug port, and launching again just forwards to it. The app must therefore be quit and restarted — the first call costs ~10–40 s. | | Attach | `doubao-chat` is the real 1200×800 window. `doubao-launcher` is a 400×600 **sidebar that also accepts prompts** and renders results at 90 px, and `doubao-chat` is *additionally* served as an empty `hello` shell. Identification uses live window size plus the presence of the editor, never the URL alone. | | Type | The box is `div.tiptap.ProseMirror[contenteditable=true]`. `execCommand('insertText')` goes through the same `beforeinput` path a keystroke does, so the app's own state and send button update. Assigning `innerText` would not. | | Detect | The status sentence 「已生成 N 张候选图」 is the completion signal, not the image count — the grid mounts placeholders before the renders arrive. | | Harvest | The picture in the grid is a `cpreview_wm1` render behind an overlay, and its full-size sibling `` is a bare `data:image/svg+xml` **placeholder with no pixels**, so the bytes cannot be read from the grid. Instead the tool clicks each thumbnail to open the image viewer and uses the app's own `[data-testid=edit_image_download_button]`, which writes the file to `~/Downloads`; the tool then moves it to `dir`. | `dsh-doctor`-style checks live in the unit tests: the output schema must stay in sync with `execute`, because a tool that returns a value without a declared schema is refused at registration and takes the **whole plugin tree — and every DSH boot, the desktop app included — down with it**. ## The watermark Doubao stamps 「豆包AI生成」 into the bottom-right of every saved picture. It is an overlay the app composites on, not part of the artwork, which is what makes removal a solved problem instead of an inpainting guess. All of this was measured, not assumed: | Property | Measurement | | --- | --- | | Position | Anchored to the bottom-right corner; a glyph mask from one image correlates with an unrelated image's corner at **NCC 0.949** (inverse control −0.949, exactly symmetric) | | Scale | Proportional to the image's **short side**, not its width: 2048²→321×69 box, 1365×2048→214×46 box, both giving width/short ≈ 0.1567. Verified on a second sample per shape | | Blend | Plain alpha composite `C = a·W + (1−a)·B`, fitted at **a = 0.638**, W = 234.4, RMS residual 6.3/255 | | Soft edge | Glyph interiors measure a = 0.63 while the antialiased rim ramps to 0 — which is why a hard 0/1 mask left a visible outline | Removal inverts the composite per pixel, and estimates the artwork behind the mark by coarse-grid interpolation that excludes masked pixels. The output PNG is encoded losslessly (round-trip delta verified 0). **Self-check.** The `verifyOnFlat` helper turns "does it look clean?" into a number: on a flat-background sample the artwork behind the mark is a constant, so any residual offset inside the glyph area *is* the watermark that survived. Measured on a flat 2048² sample: **residual 46.3 → 0.0 (100% removed)**. On a photograph the same metric would be meaningless, so it detects a non-flat frame (background IQR > 8) and says so instead of printing a flattering zero. **Scope.** This targets this one overlay, at this one anchor, with this one calibrated blend. It is not a general watermark remover. It exists for internal reference material — animation reference, storyboards, internal review. Doubao's official API (Volcengine Ark) returns images with no watermark at all, and that is the right channel for anything published or commercial. **Stripping is off by default** (owner's decision, 2026-09-25): an image comes back with Doubao's own 「豆包AI生成」 badge unless the caller explicitly asks for `stripWatermark: true`. Keeping the badge is the safe default — it is what makes a picture traceable to the tool that made it — and the capability stays here for the internal-reference case described above. ## Known limitations - **Generation consumes the user's Doubao quota** (the app reports 「本次生成将 消耗每日免费额度」). Exactly one generation is issued per call; if the plugin cannot confirm a submission it stops rather than retrying, because a blind retry is what once produced duplicate generations. - **The app window is closed and reopened** on the first call, and Doubao must stay running-and-instrumented for the harvest to complete. - The harvest depends on Doubao's own UI markup (`image-box-grid`, `edit_image_download_button`). A Doubao redesign breaks it; the selector surface is deliberately kept to those two names. - The watermark pass only re-encodes PNG. Other formats are saved exactly as downloaded rather than silently recompressed. # DSH Mobile **中文** · [English](README.en.md) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![listed in awesome-deepseek-harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/listed%20in-awesome--deepseek--harness-4D6BFE?logo=awesomelists&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Dominic789654/awesome-deepseek-harness) [![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Dominic789654/awesome-deepseek-harness) [![iOS 17+](https://img.shields.io/badge/iOS-17%2B-000000?logo=apple&logoColor=white)](docs/VERSIONING.md) [![TestFlight](https://img.shields.io/badge/TestFlight-join-0D96F6?logo=apple&logoColor=white)](https://testflight.apple.com/join/tHKQsbCk) [![connector on npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-mobile-link?label=connector)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-mobile-link) [![CI](https://github.com/jayantTang/DSH_Mobile/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jayantTang/DSH_Mobile/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) 把电脑上的 [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 会话接到 iPhone 上：原生 iOS 客户端、电脑侧连接器、可自建的公网中转。手机与电脑连接同一个 DSH host，看到同一批会话与同一条 消息流；电脑上运行中的任务在锁屏后继续执行，电脑上挂起的提问可在手机上直接回答。 电脑不需要公网 IP，也不需要 VPN。 ![每一步工具调用都摊开 · 不用公网 IP 扫码就连上 · 浏览预览一键下载 · 让它把电脑上的文件发回手机](docs/artifacts/demo/appstore/overview.jpg) > 配图为 App Store 宣传图（8 张中的 4 张，横版拼合），内容出自同一套合成会话：输出是真实 agent > 输出，项目为虚构，`relay.example.com` 是占位符。分张素材与生成方式见 [`docs/artifacts/demo/`](docs/artifacts/demo)。 ## 状态与兼容性 | 组件 | 当前版本 | 分发方式 | |---|---|---| | iOS App | 1.0 | TestFlight 公开测试（[加入](https://testflight.apple.com/join/tHKQsbCk)）；需先安装 TestFlight，构建 90 天后过期 | | 连接器 `dsh-plugin-mobile-link` | 0.7.0 | npm | | 中转（DLP v1） | 本仓库 `relay-go/`（Go，`go-0.2.3`） | 自行部署 | 三者的版本组合与发布策略见 [`docs/VERSIONING.md`](docs/VERSIONING.md)。 表中版本以 **npm 上已发布的为准**（`npm view dsh-plugin-mobile-link version`），不是仓库里 `package.json` 的值。 ## 前提 - 电脑上已安装并可运行 DSH（`dsh web`）。 - 连接器需要 Node.js ≥ 22。 - 自建中转需要一台有公网 IP 的主机（macOS 或 Linux）与 Caddy。 - 从源码构建 App 需要 macOS + Xcode 16 以上；日常使用不需要。 ## 快速开始 ### A. 使用公共中转 1. 手机上安装 App：先装 Apple 的 TestFlight，再用 加入测试。 2. 电脑上安装连接器——**按宿主装**（两种宿主档案独立，装错不会报错，只是连接器不会被加载）： - 命令行 web 版（终端里跑 `dsh web`）：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-mobile-link` - 官方桌面版（双击图标打开的应用）：用应用内的插件页，或应用自带的 `dsh` 命令装进 `desktop` 档案 （普通 npm 版 `dsh` 会拒绝该档案，这是官方设计）。宿主形态的识别判据（双击图标启动还是敲命令启动）见 [`docs/ONBOARDING.md`](docs/ONBOARDING.md)。 3. 登记到中转：打开 DSH 左下角的「移动端连接」，确认预填的中转地址，点「登记」。开放登记是唯一 入口，不需要邀请码；无头环境用 `dsh-mobile-link enroll --relay wss://<中转地址>/dsh-link`。 4. 面板登记成功后原地重连，不需要重启 DSH。只有命令行登记且宿主正在运行时才需要重启一次 （`dsh web`）；宿主未运行则下次启动生效。**第 2 步装插件本身不需要重启**——命令行 web 宿主会 自己把新装的插件挂上；桌面版按应用内提示。 5. 手机 App →「扫码配对」，扫描电脑上的二维码：点 DSH 界面**左下角的「移动端连接」**，小窗里就是 二维码与配对码（点「重新生成」才会换；也可用 `node scripts/dev/show-pair-qr.mjs` 在没有界面的环境里出图）。 开放登记是唯一入口，中转按来源限流。登记后确认手机顶部显示「已连接」，即为成功。完整步骤与 故障排查见 [`docs/ONBOARDING.md`](docs/ONBOARDING.md)。 ### B. 自建中转 自建使用仓库内的 Go 实现（`relay-go/`）。按 [`relay-go/deploy/README.md`](relay-go/deploy/README.md) §2–§3 在服务器上构建二进制、写入 `build.json` 并安装 `dsh-relay-go.service`；Caddy 路由用 [`relay-go/deploy/Caddyfile.snippet`](relay-go/deploy/Caddyfile.snippet)，由 [`relay-go/deploy/caddy_splice.py`](relay-go/deploy/caddy_splice.py) 插入既有站点块（§4）。 ```bash # 首次部署 sudo systemctl enable --now dsh-relay-go # 开放登记是唯一入口，不需要先建账号或铸码。 ``` 实时负载与每设备流量： `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/stats`（仅监听回环）。限额与运维细节见 [`relay-go/README.md`](relay-go/README.md) 与 [`relay-go/deploy/README.md`](relay-go/deploy/README.md)。 ## 组件与数据流 ``` ┌──────────────┐ WSS ┌────────────────────┐ WSS ┌───────────────────┐ │ iPhone App ├─────────►│ Relay（公网主机） │◄─────────┤ 电脑侧连接器 │ │ SwiftUI │ │ 鉴权 + 转发 │ │ (DSH 插件) │ └──────────────┘ └────────────────────┘ └─────────┬─────────┘ │ HTTP + WS ┌─────────▼─────────┐ │ dsh web │ │ 127.0.0.1: │ └───────────────────┘ ``` | 组件 | 位置 | 职责 | |---|---|---| | iOS App | 手机 | 会话列表、转写、图片与文件、配对与设备管理 | | 连接器 | 电脑（DSH 插件） | 以 `127.0.0.1` 访问本机 DSH，转成中转帧 | | 中转 | 公网主机 | 鉴权与按 `agentId` 转发；**不解析会话内容** | | DSH host | 电脑 | 会话、agent 与工具的真实执行方 | 产品上只提供经中转这一条连接方式（`dsh://direct` 是 DEBUG-only 的测试通道）。选型与边界见 [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) 与 [`docs/PAIRING.md`](docs/PAIRING.md)。 ## 配置 仓库中出现的 `relay.example.com` 一律是占位符：中转地址属于部署方，不属于仓库。真值只存在于本机， 且均被 gitignore： | 位置 | 用途 | 提供方式 | |---|---|---| | `.env.local` | 发布脚本、开发探针 | `cp .env.example .env.local`，填 `DSH_SITE` / `DSH_RELAY_URL` / `DSH_OTA_HOST` | | `~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json` | 连接器的中转地址与身份 | 面板「登记」，或 `dsh-mobile-link enroll --relay <地址>` | | `ios/DSHMobile/Config.local.xcconfig` | App 内预填的中转地址与更新源 | 从 `Config.xcconfig` 复制后填写 | 因此直接 clone 构建出的 App 默认连不上任何中转，这是有意设计。 ## 开发 ```bash cd ios/DSHMobile/DSHKit && swift test # 协议层 cd plugins/mobile-link && npm test # 连接器 cd relay-go && make test # 中转（Go，生产实现） cd mail && ../.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q # 信件服务 npm run check:secrets # 本机真值没有进跟踪文件 npm run check:docs # 文档规范（结构、口吻、链接） cd ios/DSHMobile && xcodebuild -scheme DSHMobile \ -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=DSH-Test' build ``` 上述单测与一次「不带任何本机配置」的 Release 构建由 GitHub Actions 在干净仓库上执行。需要仿真器、 真实中转或开发者团队 ID 的验证不在 CI 内——CI 通过不等于可以发布。 界面测试是一套独立测试台：`./test/run.sh prepare` → `run <用例>` → `report --verdict …`，口径见 [`test/RULES.md`](test/RULES.md)，可复制的用例模板见 [`test/examples/`](test/examples)。 ## 文档 | 文档 | 内容 | |---|---| | [`docs/ONBOARDING.md`](docs/ONBOARDING.md) | 两种部署路径的选择、操作步骤、故障排查 | | [`docs/GLOSSARY.md`](docs/GLOSSARY.md) | 术语表（DSH、host、连接器、中转、DLP 等） | | [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) | 架构与关键决策 | | [`docs/DSH-PROTOCOL.md`](docs/DSH-PROTOCOL.md) | DSH 原生协议参考（权威、面向实现） | | [`docs/RELAY-PROTOCOL.md`](docs/RELAY-PROTOCOL.md) | DLP v1 中转协议规范 | | [`docs/CONNECTOR-NOTES.md`](docs/CONNECTOR-NOTES.md) / [`docs/RELAY-NOTES.md`](docs/RELAY-NOTES.md) | 实现与规范的偏差记录 | | [`docs/PAIRING.md`](docs/PAIRING.md) | 连接方式与配对设计 | | [`docs/IMAGES.md`](docs/IMAGES.md) | 图片能力的设计约束与实现 | | [`docs/VERSIONING.md`](docs/VERSIONING.md) | 三处部署的版本与发布策略 | | [`docs/PRIVACY.md`](docs/PRIVACY.md) | 隐私说明：App 不收集数据，中转只做转发 | | [`docs/dsh-rpc-catalog.json`](docs/dsh-rpc-catalog.json) | 某次快照：机器可读的 RPC 目录（不是持续校验的契约） | | [`docs/artifacts/samples/`](docs/artifacts/samples) | 从真实 DSH 抓取的响应样例（已脱敏） | 参与开发见 [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md)，安全问题的报告方式见 [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md)， 版本变化见 [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md)。 ## 已知限制 - **iOS 安装走 TestFlight**：需先安装 Apple 的 TestFlight；测试构建 90 天后过期，到期需安装新构建。 自行部署时也可以走 OTA（部署脚本会生成 `https://<站点>/ios/`）：那用 Ad Hoc 描述文件， 只覆盖已登记 UDID 的设备，适合自己用，不适合公开分发。 - **后台通知覆盖这些场景**：从手机发出任务后把 App 退到后台，任务完成、以及 Agent 提问后 等待回答（App 列表顶部会显示一条待回应提示）这两件事，仍会通知到手机。它只在 「有任务在跑，或有待回答的提问」时生效，空闲时不耗电。 - **这些场景不覆盖**：手机在后台时，电脑端**新开始**的会话唤不起 App（需要 APNs，尚未实现）； 长时间未回答的提问可能丢失。 - 文件发送仅在经中转时可用。 ## 许可 MIT，见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。

# dsh-plugin-mobile-link

[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![listed in awesome-deepseek-harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/listed%20in-awesome--deepseek--harness-4D6BFE?logo=awesomelists&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Dominic789654/awesome-deepseek-harness)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-mobile-link)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-mobile-link)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](../../LICENSE)

> 面向：使用者与实现者 · 状态：stable · 最近核对：2026-09-20

**The computer half of [DSH Mobile](https://github.com/jayantTang/DSH_Mobile): it
dials a relay over WSS, so the native iOS client reaches this DSH instance even
though the computer has no public IP.**

```
iPhone App ──WSS──▶ Relay（公网，只鉴权与转发）──WSS──▶ this plugin ──HTTP+WS──▶ 127.0.0.1:<port>
```

The connector always talks to the local DSH as `127.0.0.1:<port>`, so the host's
authority and its trust fence are unaffected: no `--trusted-host`, no rewritten
`Host`, no new listening port on this machine.

```
plugins/mobile-link/
├── package.json          # type: module, dsh.bundle.patch, bin: dsh-mobile-link
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle patch: the loader row + config reference
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js          # cordis plugin: starts the agent, registers 5 routes
│   ├── link.js           # the DLP agent transport: identity, socket, heartbeat, reconnect
│   ├── router.js         # frames ⇄ local DSH mux streams, per-device `$events`
│   ├── dlp.js            # DLP v1 frame codec (shared with the relay)
│   ├── files.js          # phone → computer file transfers (`_link/file*` methods)
│   ├── enroll.js         # open enrollment (no invite code), writes ~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json
│   ├── journal.js        # lifecycle journal: why a relay link was dropped, after the fact
│   ├── routes.js         # status, enroll, pair-code, pair-code/regenerate, devices/revoke
│   ├── qr.js             # dependency-free QR SVG
│   └── cli.js            # dsh-mobile-link: enroll / mint-pair-code
└── test/                 # node --test, 100+ tests (no DSH, no network)
```

## Install

The connector runs in whichever host runs your DSH. There are two supported hosts today —
**the official desktop app** and **the command-line web host** — and each keeps its own
profile, so you install the plugin into the one you actually use. The connector discovers
the local DSH by itself in both (the host hands it the authenticated loopback address);
you never type an address or a token.

**Command-line web host**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-mobile-link
```

**Official desktop app** — install through the app's own plugin page, or with the CLI that
the app ships (`…/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh`, installable from its settings). The npm
`dsh` refuses this profile on purpose (`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the
Electron application`). Two prerequisites matter in practice: let the app start once so it
initializes its profile, and **quit it completely** before installing — otherwise the
profile is locked.

```bash
# quoting the app's bundled CLI; see docs/ONBOARDING.md for the section titles
"<DeepSeek Harness.app>/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-mobile-link
```

Then restart the host (or reload the profile). From a checkout the same command takes
a path — the leading `./` matters, because DSH anchors a relative spec against
your current directory instead of resolving it inside the profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/mobile-link
```

## Use

1. Register this computer with a relay (once). Open the **移动端连接** panel at the
   bottom of the DSH sidebar: the relay address is prefilled (editable) from the
   installation default; click **登记**. The connector derives the computer name
   automatically, writes `~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json` and reconnects in place —
   no terminal and no DSH restart. Open enrollment is the default; the relay
   rate-limits by source. If an installation has no panel (headless, CI), the CLI
   still works:

   ```bash
   dsh-mobile-link enroll --relay wss://<你的站点>/dsh-link
   ```

   …or register it on the relay host with `dsh-relay admin agent-register
   --write-config ~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json`.

2. The same panel shows the pairing code and its QR once the relay link is up.
   The CLI can still mint one directly:

   ```bash
   dsh-mobile-link --mint-pair-code        # prints JSON: code + relay + agentId
   ```

   The code is persistent: it stays valid until you click 重新生成. Each paired device
   has a quiet 撤销 action; revoking one device leaves the code and other devices alone.

3. Scan it in the iOS app. The code can be claimed again for another phone, a reinstall
   or a new device; only 重新生成 revokes it (already-paired devices stay connected).
   After that the phone reconnects on its own — nothing else has to be run by hand.

`GET /mobile-link/status` reports whether the link is up, which devices are
attached, and whether this computer is registered yet. Its `enroll` block also
carries `panel` (this connector can enroll from the DSH panel), `relayPrefill`
and `relayLocked` (the address to prefill and whether it came from config).
`POST /mobile-link/enroll` performs that enrollment (open enrollment; no invite code); it returns the agent id and
name, never `agentSecret`, and is behind the same DSH request fence as pairing. `GET /mobile-link/devices` lists the full paired roster (including offline) for the panel, and
`POST /mobile-link/devices/revoke` revokes one paired device by `deviceId` through the relay; both are behind
the fence and authenticated with the agent secret. Its `journal` block carries
the current process's newest lifecycle events (link opened/closed with the reason,
device attached/detached); the counters in it reset when the plugin hot-reloads, so
the full history — across restarts — is the JSONL file at `journal.path`.

## Configuration

All optional; the defaults are what a stock deployment needs. Set them in the
plugin's config block (`cordis.patch.yml`), not by editing this file.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` stops the outbound link without uninstalling |
| `relayUrl` | from `agent.json` | Relay base URL; a bare deployment dials `<relay>/link/agent`. Pinning a real value here outranks the enrolled identity and makes the panel field read-only |
| `defaultRelayUrl` | empty | Form-only default: prefills the panel's relay input, but never outranks the enrolled identity. Official installs set this so users can still edit it |
| `agentId` / `agentSecret` | from `agent.json` | Override the enrolled identity |
| `stateFile` | `~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json` | Where the identity lives |
| `journalFile` | `~/.dsh/mobile-link/link-events.jsonl` | Lifecycle journal (rotated once at 256 KiB); `false` keeps it in memory only |
| `slowRequestMs` | `2000` | A slower single request gets its own `request.slow` entry; `0` disables those (per-attach `device.summary` is still written) |
| `diagnostics` | `true` | `false` refuses the phone's phase uploads; the phone ignores the refusal and stays connected |
| `dshUrl` | discovery | Explicit local DSH base URL (usually unnecessary — the host hands the connector its own address) |
| `heartbeatMs` | `20000` | DLP ping interval |

The connector does **not** read an endpoint handoff file any more: discovery happens inside
the host process (`ctx.inject(['webServer','connection'])`), which is what makes one npm
package work on both the desktop app and the command-line host. It **writes** one instead —
`$DSH_HOME/mobile-link/endpoint.json`, mode 0600 — for tools that run *outside* the host
(our dev/test scripts and the iOS integration helpers).

Address resolution order: this config block, then `DSH_RELAY_URL` (or
`DSH_MOBILE_LINK_RELAY`), then the enrolled identity file, then the repository
placeholder `wss://relay.example.com/dsh-link` — the placeholder being the
"nothing configured yet" sentinel rather than a real address.

## Design notes

- **No required services.** `inject` is empty and the routes are attached through
  `ctx.inject([...])`, so a future DSH that renames or drops `webServer` /
  `connection` cannot make the tunnel fatal on boot.
- **Protocol-transparent.** Nothing outside `lib/` is imported and no DSH
  business API is touched: the connector forwards frames, it does not interpret
  sessions. The relay has the same property.
- **Disable** by removing the row from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, or by
  setting `enabled: false`.

## Test

```bash
cd plugins/mobile-link && npm test    # zero dependencies
```

The wire protocol is specified in
[`docs/RELAY-PROTOCOL.md`](https://github.com/jayantTang/DSH_Mobile/blob/main/docs/RELAY-PROTOCOL.md).

MIT.

客户端、电脑侧连接器、可自建的公网中转。手机与电脑连接同一个 DSH host，看到同一批会话与同一条
消息流；电脑上运行中的任务在锁屏后继续执行，电脑上挂起的提问可在手机上直接回答。

电脑不需要公网 IP，也不需要 VPN。

![每一步工具调用都摊开 · 不用公网 IP 扫码就连上 · 浏览预览一键下载 · 让它把电脑上的文件发回手机](docs/artifacts/demo/appstore/overview.jpg)

> 配图为 App Store 宣传图（8 张中的 4 张，横版拼合），内容出自同一套合成会话：输出是真实 agent
> 输出，项目为虚构，`relay.example.com` 是占位符。分张素材与生成方式见 [`docs/artifacts/demo/`](docs/artifacts/demo)。

## 状态与兼容性

| 组件 | 当前版本 | 分发方式 |
|---|---|---|
| iOS App | 1.0 | TestFlight 公开测试（[加入](https://testflight.apple.com/join/tHKQsbCk)）；需先安装 TestFlight，构建 90 天后过期 |
| 连接器 `dsh-plugin-mobile-link` | 0.7.0 | npm |
| 中转（DLP v1） | 本仓库 `relay-go/`（Go，`go-0.2.3`） | 自行部署 |

三者的版本组合与发布策略见 [`docs/VERSIONING.md`](docs/VERSIONING.md)。
表中版本以 **npm 上已发布的为准**（`npm view dsh-plugin-mobile-link version`），不是仓库里 `package.json` 的值。

## 前提

- 电脑上已安装并可运行 DSH（`dsh web`）。
- 连接器需要 Node.js ≥ 22。
- 自建中转需要一台有公网 IP 的主机（macOS 或 Linux）与 Caddy。
- 从源码构建 App 需要 macOS + Xcode 16 以上；日常使用不需要。

## 快速开始

### A. 使用公共中转

1. 手机上安装 App：先装 Apple 的 TestFlight，再用 <https://testflight.apple.com/join/tHKQsbCk> 加入测试。
2. 电脑上安装连接器——**按宿主装**（两种宿主档案独立，装错不会报错，只是连接器不会被加载）：
   - 命令行 web 版（终端里跑 `dsh web`）：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-mobile-link`
   - 官方桌面版（双击图标打开的应用）：用应用内的插件页，或应用自带的 `dsh` 命令装进 `desktop` 档案
     （普通 npm 版 `dsh` 会拒绝该档案，这是官方设计）。宿主形态的识别判据（双击图标启动还是敲命令启动）见
     [`docs/ONBOARDING.md`](docs/ONBOARDING.md)。
3. 登记到中转：打开 DSH 左下角的「移动端连接」，确认预填的中转地址，点「登记」。开放登记是唯一
   入口，不需要邀请码；无头环境用 `dsh-mobile-link enroll --relay wss://<中转地址>/dsh-link`。
4. 面板登记成功后原地重连，不需要重启 DSH。只有命令行登记且宿主正在运行时才需要重启一次
   （`dsh web`）；宿主未运行则下次启动生效。**第 2 步装插件本身不需要重启**——命令行 web 宿主会
   自己把新装的插件挂上；桌面版按应用内提示。
5. 手机 App →「扫码配对」，扫描电脑上的二维码：点 DSH 界面**左下角的「移动端连接」**，小窗里就是
   二维码与配对码（点「重新生成」才会换；也可用 `node scripts/dev/show-pair-qr.mjs` 在没有界面的环境里出图）。

开放登记是唯一入口，中转按来源限流。登记后确认手机顶部显示「已连接」，即为成功。完整步骤与
故障排查见 [`docs/ONBOARDING.md`](docs/ONBOARDING.md)。

### B. 自建中转

自建使用仓库内的 Go 实现（`relay-go/`）。按 [`relay-go/deploy/README.md`](relay-go/deploy/README.md)
§2–§3 在服务器上构建二进制、写入 `build.json` 并安装 `dsh-relay-go.service`；Caddy 路由用
[`relay-go/deploy/Caddyfile.snippet`](relay-go/deploy/Caddyfile.snippet)，由
[`relay-go/deploy/caddy_splice.py`](relay-go/deploy/caddy_splice.py) 插入既有站点块（§4）。

```bash
# 首次部署
sudo systemctl enable --now dsh-relay-go

# 开放登记是唯一入口，不需要先建账号或铸码。
```

实时负载与每设备流量：
`curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/stats`（仅监听回环）。限额与运维细节见
[`relay-go/README.md`](relay-go/README.md) 与 [`relay-go/deploy/README.md`](relay-go/deploy/README.md)。

## 组件与数据流

```
┌──────────────┐   WSS    ┌────────────────────┐   WSS    ┌───────────────────┐
│  iPhone App  ├─────────►│  Relay（公网主机）  │◄─────────┤ 电脑侧连接器       │
│  SwiftUI     │          │  鉴权 + 转发        │          │ (DSH 插件)        │
└──────────────┘          └────────────────────┘          └─────────┬─────────┘
                                                                     │ HTTP + WS
                                                           ┌─────────▼─────────┐
                                                           │ dsh web           │
                                                           │ 127.0.0.1:<port>  │
                                                           └───────────────────┘
```

| 组件 | 位置 | 职责 |
|---|---|---|
| iOS App | 手机 | 会话列表、转写、图片与文件、配对与设备管理 |
| 连接器 | 电脑（DSH 插件） | 以 `127.0.0.1` 访问本机 DSH，转成中转帧 |
| 中转 | 公网主机 | 鉴权与按 `agentId` 转发；**不解析会话内容** |
| DSH host | 电脑 | 会话、agent 与工具的真实执行方 |

产品上只提供经中转这一条连接方式（`dsh://direct` 是 DEBUG-only 的测试通道）。选型与边界见
[`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) 与 [`docs/PAIRING.md`](docs/PAIRING.md)。

## 配置

仓库中出现的 `relay.example.com` 一律是占位符：中转地址属于部署方，不属于仓库。真值只存在于本机，
且均被 gitignore：

| 位置 | 用途 | 提供方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `.env.local` | 发布脚本、开发探针 | `cp .env.example .env.local`，填 `DSH_SITE` / `DSH_RELAY_URL` / `DSH_OTA_HOST` |
| `~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json` | 连接器的中转地址与身份 | 面板「登记」，或 `dsh-mobile-link enroll --relay <地址>` |
| `ios/DSHMobile/Config.local.xcconfig` | App 内预填的中转地址与更新源 | 从 `Config.xcconfig` 复制后填写 |

因此直接 clone 构建出的 App 默认连不上任何中转，这是有意设计。

## 开发

```bash
cd ios/DSHMobile/DSHKit && swift test        # 协议层
cd plugins/mobile-link  && npm test          # 连接器
cd relay-go && make test                     # 中转（Go，生产实现）
cd mail && ../.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q   # 信件服务
npm run check:secrets                        # 本机真值没有进跟踪文件
npm run check:docs                           # 文档规范（结构、口吻、链接）

cd ios/DSHMobile && xcodebuild -scheme DSHMobile \
  -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=DSH-Test' build
```

上述单测与一次「不带任何本机配置」的 Release 构建由 GitHub Actions 在干净仓库上执行。需要仿真器、
真实中转或开发者团队 ID 的验证不在 CI 内——CI 通过不等于可以发布。

界面测试是一套独立测试台：`./test/run.sh prepare` → `run <用例>` → `report --verdict …`，口径见
[`test/RULES.md`](test/RULES.md)，可复制的用例模板见 [`test/examples/`](test/examples)。

| [`docs/artifacts/samples/`](docs/artifacts/samples) | 从真实 DSH 抓取的响应样例（已脱敏） |

参与开发见 [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md)，安全问题的报告方式见 [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md)，
版本变化见 [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 已知限制

- **iOS 安装走 TestFlight**：需先安装 Apple 的 TestFlight；测试构建 90 天后过期，到期需安装新构建。
  自行部署时也可以走 OTA（部署脚本会生成 `https://<站点>/ios/`）：那用 Ad Hoc 描述文件，
  只覆盖已登记 UDID 的设备，适合自己用，不适合公开分发。
- **后台通知覆盖这些场景**：从手机发出任务后把 App 退到后台，任务完成、以及 Agent 提问后
  等待回答（App 列表顶部会显示一条待回应提示）这两件事，仍会通知到手机。它只在
  「有任务在跑，或有待回答的提问」时生效，空闲时不耗电。
- **这些场景不覆盖**：手机在后台时，电脑端**新开始**的会话唤不起 App（需要 APNs，尚未实现）；
  长时间未回答的提问可能丢失。
- 文件发送仅在经中转时可用。

## 许可

MIT，见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。

# dsh-plugin-send-image

> 面向：使用者 · 状态：stable · 最近核对：2026-09-20

**Lets the agent put a picture into the conversation.** A screenshot, the
clipboard, or a file — the host normalizes and persists the bytes, every DSH
client renders it inline, and the user can open it full screen.

Why a plugin is needed at all: DSH's model adapters declare **text-only output**,
so the agent cannot emit an image in its answer. The bytes reach the client
through the Host's attachment service (`ctx.attachments.saveImage`, which
normalizes and persists them) and the returned reference rides on this tool's
**result**, as an image content block — so every client draws the picture inside
the agent's own turn.

Submitting it as a prompt instead — which is what this plugin used to do — is
wrong twice over: a prompt is a **user message**, so the picture looked like
something the user had sent, and it **started a turn**, so the agent answered its
own screenshot. `send-image.mjs --via-prompt` keeps that path for a client that
cannot render tool-result images; nothing here uses it.

```
plugins/send-image/
├── package.json          # type: module, dsh.bundle.patch
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle patch: the loader row
├── lib/index.js          # cordis plugin: registers the send_image tool
└── test/                 # node --test, 19 tests (no DSH, no network)
```

The tool is a thin shell around
[`skills/send-image/send-image.mjs`](https://github.com/jayantTang/DSH_Mobile/blob/main/skills/send-image/send-image.mjs),
which owns the capture quirks (`screencapture`, `pngpaste`, the screen-recording
permission message) and prints one JSON descriptor. Standalone it only
*prepares* — the publishing half needs the Host context this plugin has:

```bash
node skills/send-image/send-image.mjs --screenshot        # prints the descriptor
node skills/send-image/send-image.mjs --file ./out/render.png
node skills/send-image/send-image.mjs --clipboard         # needs pngpaste
```

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-send-image
```

Then restart DSH (or reload the profile). From a checkout a relative spec works
too — the leading `./` matters, because DSH anchors it against your current
directory instead of resolving it inside the profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/send-image
```

## Use

The agent calls `send_image`. Exactly one source per call:

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `file` | Path to an image (absolute, or relative to the working directory) |
| `screenshot` | `true` captures the whole screen — the picture contains everything on it |
| `clipboard` | `true` sends the image on the clipboard (needs `pngpaste`) |
| `caption` | Text shown with the picture |

Passing none or several is a readable tool error rather than a schema failure:
source exclusivity is a runtime rule here, so the model is told what to fix.

### You can also take the screenshot yourself

Inside the DSH window, `⌥⌘S` (or the button at the left of the composer) starts a drag-select; the
selected rectangle is **attached to the current conversation as a draft** — you decide whether to send
it. The shortcut only works while the DSH window has focus (no system-wide hotkey), and it can be
rebound under Settings → Shortcuts. `Esc` cancels without leaving a file, and a missing Screen
Recording grant prints where to enable it and which program to restart.

Both supported hosts (the official desktop app and the command-line web host) run the same client
half, shipped in this package. The plugin is hot-pluggable: enabling or disabling it adds or removes
the shortcut, the composer button and its styles in place — no host restart, no page reload.

## Test

```bash
cd plugins/send-image && npm test    # 14 tests, zero dependencies
```

MIT.

[`relay-go/deploy/caddy_splice.py`](relay-go/deploy/caddy_splice.py) 插入既有站点块（§4）。

```bash
# 首次部署
sudo systemctl enable --now dsh-relay-go

# 开放登记是唯一入口，不需要先建账号或铸码。
```

实时负载与每设备流量：
`curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/stats`（仅监听回环）。限额与运维细节见
[`relay-go/README.md`](relay-go/README.md) 与 [`relay-go/deploy/README.md`](relay-go/deploy/README.md)。

## 组件与数据流

```
┌──────────────┐   WSS    ┌────────────────────┐   WSS    ┌───────────────────┐
│  iPhone App  ├─────────►│  Relay（公网主机）  │◄─────────┤ 电脑侧连接器       │
│  SwiftUI     │          │  鉴权 + 转发        │          │ (DSH 插件)        │
└──────────────┘          └────────────────────┘          └─────────┬─────────┘
                                                                     │ HTTP + WS
                                                           ┌─────────▼─────────┐
                                                           │ dsh web           │
                                                           │ 127.0.0.1:<port>  │
                                                           └───────────────────┘
```

| 组件 | 位置 | 职责 |
|---|---|---|
| iOS App | 手机 | 会话列表、转写、图片与文件、配对与设备管理 |
| 连接器 | 电脑（DSH 插件） | 以 `127.0.0.1` 访问本机 DSH，转成中转帧 |
| 中转 | 公网主机 | 鉴权与按 `agentId` 转发；**不解析会话内容** |
| DSH host | 电脑 | 会话、agent 与工具的真实执行方 |

产品上只提供经中转这一条连接方式（`dsh://direct` 是 DEBUG-only 的测试通道）。选型与边界见
[`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) 与 [`docs/PAIRING.md`](docs/PAIRING.md)。

## 配置

仓库中出现的 `relay.example.com` 一律是占位符：中转地址属于部署方，不属于仓库。真值只存在于本机，
且均被 gitignore：

| 位置 | 用途 | 提供方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `.env.local` | 发布脚本、开发探针 | `cp .env.example .env.local`，填 `DSH_SITE` / `DSH_RELAY_URL` / `DSH_OTA_HOST` |
| `~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json` | 连接器的中转地址与身份 | 面板「登记」，或 `dsh-mobile-link enroll --relay <地址>` |
| `ios/DSHMobile/Config.local.xcconfig` | App 内预填的中转地址与更新源 | 从 `Config.xcconfig` 复制后填写 |

因此直接 clone 构建出的 App 默认连不上任何中转，这是有意设计。

## 开发

```bash
cd ios/DSHMobile/DSHKit && swift test        # 协议层
cd plugins/mobile-link  && npm test          # 连接器
cd relay-go && make test                     # 中转（Go，生产实现）
cd mail && ../.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q   # 信件服务
npm run check:secrets                        # 本机真值没有进跟踪文件
npm run check:docs                           # 文档规范（结构、口吻、链接）

cd ios/DSHMobile && xcodebuild -scheme DSHMobile \
  -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=DSH-Test' build
```

上述单测与一次「不带任何本机配置」的 Release 构建由 GitHub Actions 在干净仓库上执行。需要仿真器、
真实中转或开发者团队 ID 的验证不在 CI 内——CI 通过不等于可以发布。

界面测试是一套独立测试台：`./test/run.sh prepare` → `run <用例>` → `report --verdict …`，口径见
[`test/RULES.md`](test/RULES.md)，可复制的用例模板见 [`test/examples/`](test/examples)。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [`docs/ONBOARDING.md`](docs/ONBOARDING.md) | 两种部署路径的选择、操作步骤、故障排查 |
| [`docs/GLOSSARY.md`](docs/GLOSSARY.md) | 术语表（DSH、host、连接器、中转、DLP 等） |
| [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) | 架构与关键决策 |
| [`docs/DSH-PROTOCOL.md`](docs/DSH-PROTOCOL.md) | DSH 原生协议参考（权威、面向实现） |
| [`docs/RELAY-PROTOCOL.md`](docs/RELAY-PROTOCOL.md) | DLP v1 中转协议规范 |
| [`docs/CONNECTOR-NOTES.md`](docs/CONNECTOR-NOTES.md) / [`docs/RELAY-NOTES.md`](docs/RELAY-NOTES.md) | 实现与规范的偏差记录 |
| [`docs/PAIRING.md`](docs/PAIRING.md) | 连接方式与配对设计 |
| [`docs/IMAGES.md`](docs/IMAGES.md) | 图片能力的设计约束与实现 |
| [`docs/VERSIONING.md`](docs/VERSIONING.md) | 三处部署的版本与发布策略 |
| [`docs/PRIVACY.md`](docs/PRIVACY.md) | 隐私说明：App 不收集数据，中转只做转发 |
| [`docs/dsh-rpc-catalog.json`](docs/dsh-rpc-catalog.json) | 某次快照：机器可读的 RPC 目录（不是持续校验的契约） |
| [`docs/artifacts/samples/`](docs/artifacts/samples) | 从真实 DSH 抓取的响应样例（已脱敏） |

参与开发见 [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md)，安全问题的报告方式见 [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md)，
版本变化见 [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 已知限制

- **iOS 安装走 TestFlight**：需先安装 Apple 的 TestFlight；测试构建 90 天后过期，到期需安装新构建。
  自行部署时也可以走 OTA（部署脚本会生成 `https://<站点>/ios/`）：那用 Ad Hoc 描述文件，
  只覆盖已登记 UDID 的设备，适合自己用，不适合公开分发。
- **后台通知覆盖这些场景**：从手机发出任务后把 App 退到后台，任务完成、以及 Agent 提问后
  等待回答（App 列表顶部会显示一条待回应提示）这两件事，仍会通知到手机。它只在
  「有任务在跑，或有待回答的提问」时生效，空闲时不耗电。
- **这些场景不覆盖**：手机在后台时，电脑端**新开始**的会话唤不起 App（需要 APNs，尚未实现）；
  长时间未回答的提问可能丢失。
- 文件发送仅在经中转时可用。

## 许可

MIT，见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。

# dsh-browser-view · Live Browser View for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) English | [中文](README.zh.md)

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-alive-badge

给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个「它还活着吗」的窗口。

用 Harness 的时候最烦的是不知道它到底在干活还是在发呆。屏幕上什么都不动，你以为卡了，其实是模型在想；或者反过来，真卡了，你还以为它在想，一等十分钟。

这个东西就是解决这个的。输入框旁边挂一个小点，点一下弹一个黑底绿字的窗口，一直挂在旁边：

- 上面一行写着现在在干什么：在想、在写、在跑哪个工具
- 中间是它正在说的话，一行一行往外冒
- 下面是工具调用的原文：跑的命令、读的文件、出来的结果
- 最下面是这台机器的底细：CPU、内存、显卡、这一轮吃了多少上下文

## 硬件监控能读到什么

分三种情况，不是每种机器都一样：

**显卡**。有 NVIDIA 卡且装了驱动，走 `nvidia-smi`，能读到每张卡的占用、显存、温度、功耗。没有 N 卡也没关系，走 Windows 自带的接口，能拿到显卡名字和整体占用率，温度和功耗拿不到——这两个数据只有厂商自己的驱动给，编不出来，宁可不显示。有几张卡就显示几行，一张都没有就写 no nvidia-smi。

**CPU 占用和内存**。这个任何机器都有，不用装东西。

**CPU 温度**。Windows 自己不给。ACPI 热区在很多主板上是空的，试过 `MSAcpi_ThermalZoneTemperature`、`Win32_TemperatureProbe`、`\Thermal Zone Information` 性能计数器，全是空的。要读温度只能靠驱动级工具，现在接的是 [LibreHardwareMonitor](https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor)：

- 它会解到 `vendor/lhm/`，开机自启，最小化在托盘里
- 本插件通过它的本地 HTTP 口（`127.0.0.1:8085`）读温度，5 秒一次
- 它没跑的时候，温度显示空着，其他照常

不想装的话，删掉 `vendor/lhm/` 和启动项里的快捷方式就行，别的功能不受影响。

- 右下角一只像素小人，在敲键盘。闲着就趴着，出错就发抖，睡着了戴睡帽

超过七十秒没动静，整个窗口变红，还会弹一条系统通知。同时把当时的情况存一份到硬盘，事后能翻出来看到底断在哪。

## 为什么值得装

出问题的时候不用猜。以前卡住了，只能重启，重启完什么线索都没了。现在卡住那一刻，参数、工具、进程状态全都在一个文件里。

跑长任务的时候不用守着。切去干别的，有事它弹通知。

上下文快满了能提前看见，不至于下一秒被截断才发现。

## 装

```bash
npm install link:/path/to/dsh-alive-badge
```

或者手工改 profile 的 `package.json`：

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "@dsh-external/dsh-alive-badge": "link:/path/to/dsh-alive-badge" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@dsh-external/dsh-alive-badge"] } }
}
```

改完重启 Harness。

有个坑先说：插件自己那份 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，`name` 必须写完整包名 `@dsh-external/dsh-alive-badge`，不能写简称。写简称的话界面那一半会悄悄不加载，只剩后台那一半，表现就是「重启之后小点不见了，但接口还通」。

## 怎么用

小点移上去看一眼，点一下开独立窗口。窗口关掉就没了，再点一次重开。

窗口一直钉在最前面，切别的程序也不会被盖住。

状态词：`IDLE` 待着、`THINKING` 在想、`WRITING` 在写、`EXEC xx` 在跑某个工具、`STALLED` 卡住了、`ERROR` 出错了、`NO_HOST` 后台没响应。

## 文件在哪

事件一条一行写在插件目录的 `logs/events.jsonl`，单个文件到 8MB 换下一个，留五份。

卡住的现场在 `logs/stall/`，留四十份。

## 换角色

`anim/` 下面按状态分了十个文件夹，每个放一串透明底 PNG。`anim.json` 里写每个状态几帧、多少 fps。不放图也能用，会退回内置的手绘像素画。

`anim/PROMPT-v2.md` 是给画图的 AI 用的提示词。

## 许可

MIT。字体用的是[最像素 Zpix](https://github.com/SolidZORO/zpix-pixel-font) 和 Google 的 Press Start 2P，都是 OFL 协议。

# dsh-site-bridge

**English** · [Русский](README.ru.md) · [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**Hands and eyes for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in your own browser.**
Capture a page's markup and its BFF traffic into files an agent can read, drive the page with trusted
input, and verify the extension you just wrote — live, in the same tab.

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

Two halves, one bridge:

| Half | What it does |
|---|---|
| **DSH plugin** (`lib/`) | Owns the loopback bridge and exposes eight tools to the model. Writes the snapshot bundle into the session workspace. |
| **MV3 extension** (`extension/`) | Lives in your Chrome/Edge profile, works with your cookies, captures markup and network over CDP, drives the page with real input events. Localized: English, Русский, 中文. |

Neither half is useful alone: the plugin holds the model-facing surface and the files, the extension
holds the browser session and the fidelity.

---

## Why

Writing an extension that embeds into someone else's site is mostly archaeology: what the markup is
actually made of, which selector survives the next deploy, and which BFF endpoint this button calls
with which payload. By hand that means DevTools, copy-paste and guesses.

This project turns the archaeology into a capture:

```
site_capture → captures/<host>/<timestamp>/
  dom.html          serialized markup of the captured scope
  dom.json          element tree: boxes, attributes, selector candidates
  styles.json       computed styles of key nodes + CSS custom properties
  selectors.md      shortlist of stable selectors, with why each is stable
  network.jsonl     every captured xhr/fetch, one JSON object per line
  api.md            endpoints grouped by method+path, with request/response contracts
  screenshot.png    optional full-page render
```

The agent reads those files like any other source and writes the extension. Then `site_inject` runs
that code in the live page, so "it should work" becomes "it works here".

## Features

- **Markup** — element tree with boxes and visibility, computed styles of interactive nodes, CSS
  variables of the theme, and selector candidates ranked by stability (`data-testid` > `id` > `name` >
  `aria-label` > class path > positional path), each checked for uniqueness against the live DOM.
- **BFF traffic** — `xhr`/`fetch` with method, status, request headers, request body, response
  headers and response body, scoped to the inspected site.
- **Trusted input** — clicks, typing, select, key presses, scrolling and file uploads through CDP
  `Input.*` / `DOM.setFileInputFiles`: events the page cannot tell apart from a human's.
- **Virtual cursor** — a DOM overlay that moves to the target plus a real mouse event at those
  coordinates, for controls that ignore synthetic `click()`.
- **Deep selectors** — `host >>> inner` resolves through open shadow roots and same-origin iframes;
  click coordinates are corrected for frame offsets.
- **Works in background tabs** — reading, clicking, typing and screenshots work while the tab is not
  focused (Chrome throttles only timers and animation there).
- **No stored credentials** — see [Security](#security).

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the `dsh` CLI and a profile (Desktop or Web).
- Chrome or Edge 125+ (the extension uses `chrome.debugger` and MV3 service workers).
- Node.js 22+ for the tooling in `tools/` and for the tests.

## Install

### 1. Host half

```powershell
# from the repository root
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1
```

The script links the plugin into your profile, adds it to `dsh.profile.bundles`, and stages the
extension into `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\site-bridge\extension`. Manual equivalent:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <path-to-this-repo>
```

Add `"dsh-site-bridge"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`
if the CLI did not, then restart DSH — the host half loads at profile start.

### 2. Browser half

1. `chrome://extensions` → enable **Developer mode** → **Load unpacked** →
   `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\site-bridge\extension`.
2. Open the popup. It shows the port and the path to `bridge.json` (the same is printed by
   `site_status`).
3. Click **Import bridge.json** (`Импорт bridge.json` / `导入 bridge.json`) and pick that file, or
   paste the token — it saves itself, no button.
4. Open the page you want to work on and click **Connect this tab**.

Chrome shows the "started debugging this browser" banner: that is the CDP session everything runs
on. It disappears when you press **Disconnect**.

The popup UI follows the browser language: English, Russian and Simplified Chinese ship in
`extension/_locales`.

## Usage

```text
site_status                     → bridge state, pairing path, current tab
site_tabs {action:"list"}       → tabs; {action:"claim", tabId} binds one
site_network {action:"start"}   → begin recording, then act on the page
site_capture {screenshot:true}  → write the bundle into the workspace
site_act {steps:"[...]"}        → click/fill/type/select/press/scroll/upload/wait/eval
site_cursor {x,y,click:true}    → virtual cursor, real mouse event
site_shot {fullPage:true}       → screenshot to captures/shots/*.png
site_inject {js:"..."}          → run your script in the page to verify it
```

A typical loop for writing a page-embedded extension:

1. `site_tabs` → bind the page.
2. `site_capture` → read `selectors.md`, `styles.json`, `api.md`.
3. Write the userscript / content script in your own repository.
4. `site_inject` with the script body → check that the anchor is found and the BFF call passes with
   the browser's cookies.
5. Iterate on the selectors the capture marked as fragile.

## Architecture

```
┌──────────────────────────── DSH host ────────────────────────────┐
│  tools (site_*)  ──►  bridge: 127.0.0.1, token, long-poll queue    │
│  redaction on ingest ──► in-memory buffer ──► artifacts writer     │
└───────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────┘
                                │ HTTP long-poll (no websocket)
┌───────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────┐
│  MV3 service worker: chrome.debugger ──► CDP                        │
│    Network domain  → requests with headers and bodies              │
│    Input domain    → trusted mouse/keyboard, file uploads          │
│    Runtime domain  → DOM snapshot, selectors, injected scripts     │
│  popup: pairing, target tab, capture toggle (ru / en / zh)         │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

The wire protocol is small and documented in [docs/protocol.md](docs/protocol.md).

## Security

- **Credentials never leave the browser.** The extension does not read cookies or tokens: the page
  makes its own requests and the browser attaches them. The bridge sees them in flight, but values of
  `cookie`, `authorization`, `x-csrf-token`, `x-api-key`, `set-cookie` and similar headers,
  credential-shaped query parameters and credential-shaped JSON/form fields are replaced with
  `«redacted»` **on ingest** — before anything is stored.
- **Nothing credential-shaped is written to disk.** Header *names* are kept, because "this endpoint
  needs `x-csrf-token`" is part of the contract; the value is not.
- **Capture is site-scoped.** Only the inspected site's own `xhr`/`fetch` (same host, same
  registrable domain, or third-party JSON) is recorded. Telemetry and security agents that POST a full
  page dump to their servers are filtered out — otherwise page source with inline tokens would land in
  the bundle.
- **Loopback only.** The bridge binds `127.0.0.1` and rejects any request without the 32-byte pairing
  token. `site_status` prints the path to the token file, not the token.
- **Residual risk.** Header values and bodies still pass through the DSH process in memory. If a site
  puts a secret under an unusual key, redaction will not recognise it. Treat a capture bundle as
  sensitive, exactly like any traffic dump.

## Limitations

Cross-origin iframes, closed shadow roots and body size caps are analysed in
[docs/limitations.md](docs/limitations.md) — with the exact code location, the plan to remove each and
the expected cost.

## Tests

```powershell
node test\redact.test.mjs     #  8 — redaction rules
node test\bridge.test.mjs     #  8 — wire protocol, token, liveness
node test\artifacts.test.mjs  #  5 — bundle layout and large-body spill
node test\plugin.test.mjs     #  2 — tool registration and the full tool path
node test\e2e.mjs             # 31 — real Chrome through the wire protocol
node test\tools-chrome.mjs    # 19 — real Chrome through the tools
```

`e2e.mjs` and `tools-chrome.mjs` launch a throwaway Chrome, load the extension with
`Extensions.loadUnpacked`, and exercise capture, trusted input, the virtual cursor, upload, injection
and screenshots against a local page with a working BFF endpoint.

## Repository layout

```
lib/            DSH plugin: tools, bridge, redaction, artifact writer
extension/      MV3: service worker (CDP), popup, icons, locales
docs/           protocol, limitations, detailed guide
scripts/        install.ps1
tools/          icon rasteriser, popup/icon previews, asar reader (dev only)
test/           unit, integration, end-to-end
```

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

# Antigravity Next for DSH

[![CI](https://github.com/kizaki-R/Antigravity-Next-for-DSH/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/kizaki-R/Antigravity-Next-for-DSH/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.5.0-blue.svg)](package.json) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.1.5--rc.1%20%3C0.3.0-orange.svg)](https://deepseek.com/harness/) [English](README.md) | [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) An unofficial model provider plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek.com/harness/) (DSH). It connects locally installed Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist models directly to your DSH agent loop under provider id `agy-next`. > **Disclaimer:** Unofficial integration. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially supported by Google or DeepSeek. Requires an authorized Google account and a local installation of the official Antigravity application. --- ## Highlights - **Zero Cloud Console Setup:** Automatically resolves OAuth client pairs from your local official Antigravity installation. No need to create a project or credentials in Google Cloud Console. - **Multi-Account Pooling:** Add multiple Google accounts. Set quota safety thresholds and automatically failover to standby accounts when quotas expire. - **Visual Quota Dashboard:** Live visual telemetry for Gemini, Claude 3p, and Gemini 4 Argon weekly/5-hour quota buckets in the Settings panel. - **Thinking Level Control:** Native mapping for Gemini 4 Argon reasoning efforts (Low, Medium, High). - **Private & Local:** Client discovery is read-only. Tokens remain strictly inside your local `/storages/agy-next-oauth.json`. --- ## Requirements 1. **DeepSeek Harness:** `>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.3.0` running on Node `>=20`. 2. **Official Antigravity App:** Installed locally on Windows (macOS/Linux detection in progress). Download from [official portal](https://antigravity.google/product/antigravity-2). *The app does not need to be running.* 3. **Google Account:** With browser consent capability and access to Gemini / Cloud Code Assist models. --- ## Installation ### Method 1: In DSH Web or Desktop (Recommended) 1. Open **Plugins → + Add plugin** in the DSH sidebar. 2. Enter the repository URL into the input field: ```text https://github.com/kizaki-R/Antigravity-Next-for-DSH ``` *(Or enter `agy-next` once published to npm).* 3. Select **Install**. DSH will automatically mount the plugin and register the settings interface. 4. Restart DSH. ### Method 2: Local CLI / Developer Link If developing from a local checkout: ```bash # Register the local link in your DSH profile dsh plugin --profile add link:/absolute/path/to/agy-next ``` Ensure `agy-next` is included in your profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, then restart DSH. --- ## Getting Started ### 1. Verification & Login Open **Settings → AGY-Next** in DSH: 1. **Installation Status:** Verify that DSH detects your local Antigravity installation path. 2. **Sign In:** Click **Sign in / Add account**. A browser window will open for standard Google OAuth consent. 3. Once authenticated, your account appears in the Account Pool with real-time quota indicators. *Headless / CLI alternative:* ```bash npm run login # Add / sign in account npm run login -- --status # Check active status & quota npm run login -- --force # Force re-authentication npm run login -- --logout # Clear stored credentials ``` ### 2. Custom Installation Path If your Antigravity application is installed in a non-standard directory, specify it before launching DSH: ```powershell # PowerShell $env:AGY_NEXT_INSTALL_PATH = 'C:\Custom\Path\To\Antigravity' ``` --- ## Configuration Add or edit the plugin section in your profile's `cordis.yml` if custom parameters are needed: ```yaml - id: agy-next name: agy-next config: credentialPath: "" # Default: /storages/agy-next-oauth.json streamIdleTimeoutMs: 300000 # 5 minutes idle stream protection discoveryTimeoutMs: 8000 # Local binary client detection timeout projectCacheTtlMs: 1800000 # Project metadata cache TTL (30 mins) runtimeModel: "" # Optional: pin a specific upstream model id ``` --- ## Supported Models | Model Family | Key Variants | Features | |---|---|---| | **Gemini 4 Argon** | `gemini-4-argon` | Low / Medium / High reasoning effort, 5h & weekly quota tracking | | **Gemini Pro / Flash** | `gemini-2.5-pro`, `gemini-2.5-flash` | Multimodal streaming, tool invocation | | **Claude (3p)** | `claude-3-7-sonnet`, `claude-3-5-sonnet` | Integrated Cloud Code Assist Claude runtime | --- ## Development & Test Suite Run strict offline tests inside `agy-next/`: ```bash npm run check # Syntax checks across all 39 source modules npm test # Offline regression suite (21 fixture tests) npm run test:peers # Strict host peer contract test (0 skips tolerated) ``` For peer contract testing, export the DSH runtime dependencies: ```powershell $env:AGY_PEER_ROOT = 'C:\path\to\dsh\node_modules' npm run test:peers ``` --- ## Security & Storage Architecture - **No Secret Hardcoding:** This repository contains no bundled Google OAuth Client IDs or Client Secrets. Everything is resolved dynamically at runtime from local binary resources. - **Isolated Storage:** Credentials are saved to `agy-next-oauth.json` under your DSH home directory. The official Antigravity app's internal database is never modified or read. - **Tombstone Lifecycle:** Logging out completely writes an empty book with a `loggedOut: true` tombstone to prevent phantom auto-imports from legacy configs. --- ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © [Kizaki](https://github.com/kizaki-R)

# 订阅用量显示 **额度与余额，不必离开对话。** 在 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器旁看余量；点开药丸，查看额度窗口、重置时间与余额。 [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-subusage?color=3b82f6&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-subusage) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-64748b)](#license--security--许可与安全) [![DSH Core](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH_Core-0.2.x-64748b)](#compatibility--兼容性) [快速开始](#快速开始) · [功能预览](#功能预览) · [支持清单](#支持的数据--supported-data) · [兼容插件](#兼容的插件与路由) · [手动匹配](#手动匹配-provider) · [凭据指引](docs/credentials.md) 真实组件 · 虚构数据 · 真实组件离线预览，不是运行中的 DSH 截图
> **0.20.0**：Antigravity 用量接入本机 dsh-tool-antigravity——新增 `antigravityAuth` 通道（与既有 dsh-antigravity-acp 的 `agyQuota` 双通道自动探测，同一份订阅只出一条），选中 `google-antigravity` 模型时输入区药丸直接显示 Gemini 与 Claude/GPT 两组的 5 小时 / 周额度。[查看更新记录](docs/changelog.md)。 ## 快速开始 ```console dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-subusage ``` `web` 是示例 Profile，请替换为实际目标。**Desktop 使用目标桌面壳提供的 DSH Desktop CLI**，不要从独立公共 CLI 管理保留的 `desktop` Profile。 1. **启用插件**：按部署方式重载，让 Host 与 Client 一起生效；只刷新页面不保证 Host 已升级。 2. **配置需要的提供商**：打开 **设置 → 订阅用量 → 提供商管理**。填 API Key，或使用对应提供方插件的登录态；MiMo 可“登录并自动导入”，手机上可用**小米账号扫码登录**（不需要导出 Cookie）。[不知道该填什么？](docs/credentials.md) 3. **回到对话**：选择该提供商的模型，输入区出现用量药丸。点开看明细；读取失败会说明原因，不把未知当充足。 **已经登录 DSH 的 DeepSeek 账号？** 默认开启的「DeepSeek 账号」直接读取宿主余额，不需要复制 token。独立 API Key 使用另一个「DeepSeek API」入口，两份余额不相加、不互相替代。[两种入口的区别](docs/providers.md#deepseek-api-与-deepseek-账号) ## 功能预览 ### 看额度：最紧张的窗口，先提醒你 一个窗口一根余量条。正常时保持简洁；周窗偏少、额度耗尽、读取失败时，药丸明确提示。点开后再看百分比、适用范围与重置倒计时，不需要先切到控制台。 ### 看余额：金额直接显示，单位不混淆 无套餐窗口且数据完整时，药丸直接显示金额。人民币、美元与 credits 各按自己的规则展示；**余额不等于订阅额度，也不能盖过已耗尽的套餐**。DeepSeek API 与本机账号有各自的开关、凭据来源与余额。 ### 管账户：需要时展开，不让长列表占满界面 Command Code 可在弹层和设置页切换固定账户，或查看自动轮换池的健康度。逐账户详情默认折叠，受限周期明确标注。**自动轮换模式的用量仍是默认账户，不跟随实际服务中的账户。** ## 支持什么 **31 条数据入口，新安装默认开启 11 条。** 按使用场景，主要分为： | 你想看什么 | 代表提供商 | |---|---| | 订阅窗口与重置时间 | Kimi、MiMo、Codex、GitHub Copilot、SuperGrok、MiniMax、Z.ai、OpenCode Go、OpenDesign | | 账号钱包与 API 余额 | DeepSeek API / 账号、SiliconFlow、Novita、Hyperbolic、DeepInfra | | 套餐、余额与多层预算 | Command Code、NanoGPT、OpenRouter、ZenMux、LiteLLM、APIGOTO | | 账号级套餐与企业席位 | 火山方舟 Agent Plan / Coding Plan | [查看完整支持清单](#支持的数据--supported-data) · [查看哪些经过真实账号验证](#support-status--实测覆盖) 本插件**只显示用量，不注册模型路由**。Codex 默认关闭，避免与提供方自带药丸重复；需要统一展示时可手动开启。私有额度接口可能变化，数字仅供参考，不是计费依据。 ## 手动匹配 provider 模型能够调用，但药丸没有显示，可能是模型路由的 provider 名与订阅入口不同。打开 **设置 → 订阅用量 → 提供商管理 → 手动匹配 provider**： 1. 开启开关（默认关闭）。 2. 在对应订阅项的下拉列表中选择本机已注册的 provider；同一订阅可连续添加多个，适合不同协议或端点拆成多条路由的情况。 3. 选择后立即保存；点击绑定旁的 `×` 可移除。一个 provider 只能绑定一个订阅，已绑定项不会出现在其他下拉列表中。 **只改变药丸显示哪份订阅数据**，不改变模型路由、凭据来源、额度查询端点或检测开关。手动绑定优先于内置匹配，未绑定的 provider 继续自动匹配；关闭开关会恢复自动匹配，但保留已保存的绑定。目标订阅仍需启用检测并配置其所需凭据。绑定关系不会校验两个账号是否相同，请选择与该模型实际使用账号对应的订阅。 ## 兼容的插件与路由 以下列出当前代码已适配的插件或工具及具体范围。**药丸匹配、登录凭据复用、额度联动是不同能力**；支持其中一项不代表接管该插件的登录、账号切换或全部设置，也不代表所有版本均已实机验证。 ### 模型路由与登录凭据 | 插件 / 工具 | provider → 本插件订阅入口 | 适配范围与条件 | |---|---|---| | `dsh-volcengine-provider` | `volcengine-agent-plan` → `arkcli-agent-plan`；`volcengine-coding-plan` → `arkcli-coding-plan` | 自动匹配对应 Agent / Coding 药丸；仅路由别名，不读取该插件账号选择或 OAuth。额度仍使用本插件配置的 IAM AK/SK。 | | `dsh-opendesign-corouter` | `opendesign-corouter-plan`、`opendesign-corouter-paid` → `opendesign` | 套餐赠送和付费模型共用 OpenDesign 订阅药丸；不按模型拆分余额，也不读取该插件的登录态。额度仍使用本插件的控制台 Cookie；OpenDesign 检测默认关闭。 | | `@volcengine/ark-plan-api`（旧版） | `ark-agent-plan-cn` → `arkcli-agent-plan`；`ark-coding-plan-cn` → `arkcli-coding-plan` | 保留两条旧国内路由的药丸匹配；额度仍走当前 Ark 订阅入口。 | | 官方 `arkcli` | `arkcli-agent-plan`、`arkcli-coding-plan`、`arkcli-agent-plan-team`、`arkcli-coding-plan-team` → 同名入口 | 直接匹配四条路由；个人版与 Team 检测独立，Team 默认关闭；额度需 IAM AK/SK，而非推理 API Key。 | | `@mars-sea/dsh-commandcode-provider` | `commandcode` → `commandcode` | 复用凭据来源、账户列表与账号切换；支持固定账户和轮换池摘要。自动轮换时的用量不跟随每次请求实际服务账号。 | | `dsh-grok-kit` / 官方 Grok CLI | `xai-oauth` → `xai-oauth` | 共享 Grok 登录文件；token 过期时可借 `dsh-grok-kit` 的登录链续约，再读取 X / SuperGrok 额度。 | | `dsh-codex-connect` / DSH 内置 Codex 路由 / 官方 Codex CLI | `openai-codex` → `openai-codex` | 匹配 Codex 药丸，支持读取 CLI 的 ChatGPT 登录文件；API Key 登录不能读取 ChatGPT 订阅额度。检测默认关闭。 | | `dsh-codex-subscription` | 其 OAuth 用于 `openai-codex` 额度入口 | 优先只读活动账号记录，兼容旧 OAuth 引用；不迁移或续约凭据。不额外假定它注册的模型路由名，名称不同时使用手动绑定。 | | `@inventec/dsh-copilot-auth` | `github-copilot` → `github-copilot` | 只读该插件写入 DSH 凭据库的 OAuth 记录；登录和续约由提供方负责。检测默认关闭。 | OpenDesign 药丸按当前路由标注计费来源：套餐模型显示「使用套餐额度」，付费模型显示「使用余额」；任一套餐窗口确认用尽后，套餐模型也改标「使用余额」，展开药丸可查看续用说明与套餐重置时间。数据过期、缺失或查询失败时，套餐模型显示「计费来源待确认」。原始 `opendesign` 入口及其他自定义路由不推断模型分类；标注不会改变推理计费或触发余额消费，也不代表余额一定充足。套餐与付费路由仍共享同一份账号用量，展示的套餐窗口不等同于付费模型的余额。 上述火山和 OpenDesign 新别名已根据对应插件源码核对，并通过隔离路由回归；尚未完成安装后的真实 GUI 联调。其他使用标准 provider ID 的模型插件可直接匹配本插件的[支持清单](#支持的数据--supported-data)；自定义名称可使用手动绑定。路由匹配不意味着新增一种额度接口。 ### 额度联动 | 插件 | 本插件报告入口 | 适配范围 | |---|---|---| | [`dsh-tool-antigravity`](https://github.com/Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-antigravity) | `antigravity` | 读取其 `antigravityAuth` 服务的 `usage()`（`QuotaStatusView`：Gemini 与 Claude/GPT 两组各带 5h / 周窗口的剩余比例）。**选中它的 `google-antigravity` 模型路由时，输入区药丸直接显示这份额度。** | | [`dsh-antigravity-acp`](https://github.com/KouzakiUmi/dsh-antigravity-acp) | `antigravity` | 读取其 `agyQuota` 服务提供的额度快照（分组窗口 + 套餐名 + AI Credits），信息比 `antigravityAuth` 更全。 | | [`dsh-connect-trae`](https://github.com/dingminhua/dsh-connect-trae) | `trae`、`trae-global`、`trae-enterprise` | 读取其本机只读用量接口；仅返回已登录且有可用报告的区域。 | Antigravity 在本机可能装了上面**两个提供方插件中的任意一个**（或都装、或都没装）：它们读的是同一份 Google Antigravity 配额，本插件只出一条 `antigravity`，`agyQuota` 在场时优先（带套餐名与 credits），否则回落到 `antigravityAuth`；两个都不在时该条目不出现。这些联动**没有本插件的设置卡片或检测开关**，也不在手动绑定的目标订阅列表中：登录、额度采集及账号管理仍由对应插件负责，本插件不读取它们的凭据。Antigravity 联动除了出现在 `subusage_quota` / `quota()` 报告，还接入输入区药丸；Trae 联动目前仅出现在工具报告中。 ## 也可以直接问 Agent “看一下 Kimi 和 Codex 还剩多少额度。” 模型可调用只读工具 `subusage_quota`，读取与界面同源的额度与余额；可按提供商筛选，Command Code 可分别返回各账户状态。本机装了 [`dsh-tool-antigravity`](https://github.com/Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-antigravity)、[`dsh-antigravity-acp`](https://github.com/KouzakiUmi/dsh-antigravity-acp) 或 [`dsh-connect-trae`](https://github.com/dingminhua/dsh-connect-trae) 时，报告里还会带上它们所报的 Antigravity / Trae 额度（**联动项**：读它们自己算好的结果，不读凭据、不写设置）。不会通过该工具修改设置。[工具与 Host 服务契约](#额度查询-api) ## 使用前，先知道这三点 - **不猜数据**：查询失败、缓存与部分覆盖会明确标注；接口读取成功不保证仍可续用。 - **不把凭据放进截图或结果**：API Key、Cookie 与 OAuth token 不回填界面；但本插件手动配置仍可能明文落盘，**它不是加密凭据库**。 - **验证有范围**：历史真实账号记录覆盖 7 个入口，其余主要依靠桩测试；新图是虚构数据离线渲染，不能作为真实账号在线验收证明。[实测范围与风险](#support-status--实测覆盖)
