# dsh-seeker-bot **DeepSeek Harness 的对话体验增强套件**：让对话读得更顺、能出可交互的卡片、把执行过程翻译成人话； 再把记忆 / SKILL / 连接器 / 用量 / 画廊 / 档案 / 系统提示词 / 同步设置收成一排工作台。 零 DSH 源码改动 —— 全部能力以 Cordis 插件注入，官方升级不动它。 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:Kr-ATG/dsh-seeker-bot ``` 装完重启 DSH 即可。本包声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，`dsh plugin add` 会自动加进 profile 的 bundles 层，不用手改配置文件。 --- 安装/回滚请按 [docs/INSTALL-TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/INSTALL-TROUBLESHOOTING.md)； **不要手工改 profile，也不要用定时 kill 重启当前 DSH**。 --- ## 目录 - [你可能最想要的](#你可能最想要的) - [Seeker 视图：双栏执行大盘](#seeker-视图双栏执行大盘) - [正文里能出卡片](#正文里能出卡片) - [对话读起来更顺](#对话读起来更顺) - [对话完成胶囊](#对话完成胶囊) - [侧边栏：工作区 ⇄ 操作间](#侧边栏工作区-操作间) - [八个工作台](#八个工作台) --- ## 你可能最想要的 | 想要 | 在哪 | |---|---| | 看 AI 到底在干什么，但不想要一屏工具日志 | [Seeker 视图](#seeker-视图双栏执行大盘)右侧大盘；左栏只留一行「正在…」 | | 让 AI 直接给个能点的小工具 / 可视化 / 演示页 | 正文里写 ` ```html ` 围栏 → [HTML 卡片](#html-沙箱卡片能跑真-htmljs) | | 让 AI 画流程图 / 架构图 / 时序图 | 正文里写 ` ```html ` 围栏，手写内联 SVG → [HTML 卡片](#html-沙箱卡片能跑真-htmljs) | | 快速取值换算 / 对比 / 清单，不要长篇大论 | 输入框发 `/iu 开头` → [iu 原生卡片](#iu-原生交互卡片) | | 让 AI 知道「我现在开着什么」 | 输入框打 `@` → [运行中的程序](#运行中的程序打--直接挑窗口) | | 给不会编程的人看「这轮做了什么」 | 右栏**操作面板**卡，中文人话时间线 | | 跑完以后提醒我，点一下回到那条会话 | [对话完成胶囊](#对话完成胶囊)（左下角小横条 / 顶部悬浮） | | 让 AI 记住我的偏好和身份 | 工作台**记忆** | | 存账号密码 / 卡 / 证件照片，还要能自动进上下文 | 工作台**[档案](#档案)** | | 存 Clash 订阅 / 配置文件 / 证书，换机也不丢 | 工作台**[档案](#档案)** → 记录详情「文件」区（随云同步上传） | | 换机后账号密码 / 记忆 / 技能 / MCP / 供应商与密钥一起跟过来 | 工作台**[同步设置](#同步设置)** → 勾选要漫游的资产，推自己的 GitHub 私库（端侧加密） | | 管 API Key / 代理 / 生图模型 | 官方设置弹窗 → **供应商** | | 搜索额度打满了，自动换一家继续搜 | [网页搜索降级链](#网页搜索降级链额度没了自动换一家)（AnySearch → Tavily → DeepSeek） | | 想要一整个 Personal Agent 团队：主 Bot + 子 Bot + 群聊 + 日记 + 通话 | 侧栏顶部 **Work / Bot** 切到 Bot → [Personal Agent](#personal-agentbot-模式) | --- ## Seeker 视图：双栏执行大盘 会话头部标签栏多一个 **「Seeker」**（内部代号 KR），与官方「对话 / 轨迹」并列。点进去， 底层仍是官方 ChatView（多轮历史、虚拟滚动、Markdown、输入框全部原样），右边多一栏全高执行大盘。 ``` ┌─ 左栏（官方 ChatView）────────────┬─ 右栏 Seeker 大盘 ────────────┐ │ │ ┌ 子智能体 ────────────────┐ │ │ [你] … │ │ 固定 5 行，整行可点跳转 │ │ │ [AI] … │ └──────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ ┌ 操作面板 ────────────────┐ │ │ (Seeker 正在读取文件 ··· 12s) │ │ 头像 + 当前这一件事 │ │ │ ┌ 思考过程 ─────────────────┐ │ │ 默认收起，点开看完整流水 │ │ │ │ 贴在对话流里，跑时展开 │ │ └──────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ 收口自动折叠成一行 │ │ ┌ 任务 ────────────────────┐ │ │ └───────────────────────────┘ │ │ 只列本轮清单 │ │ │ │ └──────────────────────────┘ │ │ ┌ 最终回答（总结卡）─────────┐ │ ┌ 产出物 ──────────────────┐ │ │ │ │ 本次做出的文件，可点预览 │ │ │ │ └──────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ ┌ 记忆 ────────────────────┐ │ │ │ │ 钉在底部，默认折叠 │ │ └───────────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────┘ **为什么子智能体卡固定 5 行**：它顶在滚动区最上面、卡高与内容无关，所以紧贴 其下的「操作面板」永远停在同一位置 —— 子智能体多几个少几个都不会把操作面板 推走。没有子智能体时整卡不可见但位置照留（同样是为了不推动下面的卡）。 ``` **左栏干净**：只有一行状态卡（头像 + 「Seeker 正在…」+ 末尾三点 + 用时读数）。工具明细不在这边堆。 **切轮次入口**：右键你自己发的那条消息，右栏大盘切到对应轮次；左键保持正常文本选择 / 复制，不触发大盘。 > **顶栏标签行位置**：`Seeker` 排在官方「对话 / 轨迹」左侧、紧贴右侧工具区，是插件用一组 > `order` 规则把标签行插到标题与工具区之间实现的（零 DOM 改动，官方按 `tabs.length` 增删 > 标签行时不会崩）。DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` 给标签行外面多包了一层 `.tabs` 容器，旧规则全部打在 > 内层 tablist 上导致标题被挤到最右、官方「…」跑到 Seeker 左边 —— 已按新结构补规则，两版 > 选择器靠 `:not([role='tablist'])` 区分，rc.2 / rc.3 都能正常显示。 ![Seeker 对话流](docs/shots/seeker-chat-flow.jpg) **大盘设置**：「Seeker」标签右侧有一枚齿轮按钮，点开在视口中央弹出设置卡片，里面是 「提示词通道」三条（中文优先 / 对话内交互卡片 / 团队协作）、「任务清单」 两条（任务清单纪律 / 回合结束自动收口）、「展示」三条（总结卡外框 / 工具调用卡 / 操作面板）， 以及下方通栏的「工作区记忆」。齿轮与卡片 联动（再点收起、Esc 关闭、点遮罩关闭），改完立刻生效、刷新后保留。 卡片约 1000×512，排版在 2026-10-25 按「拥挤、排版不合理」重做过一轮： - **上方两栏**：左「提示词通道」3 行（中文优先 / 对话内交互卡片 / 团队协作）， 右「展示」3 行 +「任务清单」2 行（任务清单纪律 / 回合结束自动收口），中间一道发丝线。 - **任务清单组里的两行没有合并成一个开关**：任务清单纪律往提示词里写一条行为约束（开工 先列、收尾清零），回合结束自动收口是 host 侧监听器（`agent/turn-stopping` 把残留的 `in_progress` 改写成 `pending`），一个字都不进提示词。两者作用机理相反，绑成一个开关 会强迫用户做无意义的交易 —— 想关掉「末项别再转圈」就得连带关掉「清单纪律」。归到同一 组只负责「看起来归一类」。 - **下方通栏**：「工作区记忆」独占一整条，带极淡底色与上方分隔线（**不套卡片外框** —— 面板里再套一层圆角卡就是卡中卡，本仓库老坑）。它从右栏搬下来是因为三个性质都对不上： 它是**列表**（长度跟工作区数量走）、是**唯一按工作区存**的一组、行结构是「名称 + 路径 + 两枚迷你开关」横排 —— 挤在 392px 右栏里路径会被截成 `D:\AI\E…`，而路径正是「哪个工作区」 唯一无歧义的标识。 - **行内三列 grid**：标签定宽 132px / 说明弹性 / 开关定宽 40px。原来是 flex，开关跟着文字 长度浮动，左右两栏停在两条不同的竖线上，扫「开没开」时每换一栏都要重新找位置。 - **说明常态一行**：短句只讲「这一行与别行有什么不同」，共性提到组头右侧（「每会话首步 · 存于 host」「本机浏览器 · 不进提示词」）。全文挂在 `title` 上，鼠标悬停 / 键盘聚焦 / 触摸 点按任一方式都能展开 —— 是**按需展开**，不是删字。 - 窗口窄于 820px 回退单列；窄于 560px 时行降成两列（标签+开关一行、说明独占下一行）。 「工作区记忆」**列出本机全部工作区**，每个工作区两枚开关：**记录**（要不要往这个工作区攒新记忆 —— 关掉后不再自动提取、模型也不能手动记）与**不注入**（要不要把已有记忆读进它的会话）。 两件事语义相反、互不影响：关掉「记录」不影响已有记忆照常注入，打开「不注入」也不影响继续攒。 当前会话所在的工作区带「当前」角标与左侧主色竖条；列表限高可滚，工作区多了不会把下面顶出卡片。 **右栏五张卡**： | 卡 | 讲什么 | |---|---| | **子智能体** | **整场会话**派出去的独立会话，一行一个、整行可点跳到那个子会话。不按轮次切分（切到哪一轮都看得全）；分**两段**、各带段标题——上面主色的「正在执行 N」（呼吸点 + 计数，无底色），下面带对勾的「已完成 N」折叠带（灰底、整条可点、带 chevron）。行首用形状图标分状态（进行中转圈 / **健康提醒** | 「休息时间」「凌晨注意休息」两个时段开关，到点胶囊持续提示 | | **跟随字号** | 尺寸跟随官方「设置 → 字号」（--dsh-content-font-size），另有「胶囊大小」「胶囊字体」两个自有设置 | 设置入口：官方「设置 → 通用」里新增 9 行（胶囊形态 / 对话完成胶囊 / 任务完成提醒 / 休息时间提醒 / 凌晨注意休息 / 胶囊大小 / 胶囊字体 / 录屏帧率 / 录屏画质）。 ```text ┌ 左下角小横条（默认形态）──────────────┐ │ ● 3 个对话完成 · 「整理会议纪要」摘要… │ ← 侧边栏设置行上方 └────────────────────────────────────────┘ 悬停/点按 → 上方滑出「进行中 + 最近完成」面板 ``` > 从 `dsh-companion` 迁入：存储键（`dsh.donePill.*`）、样式类名与宿主路由保持原样，浏览器里的已读状态、位置与外观设置无缝延续。`dsh-companion` 若同时启用，两套胶囊会重复显示——只保留一个即可（本插件已内置完整胶囊，不需要再开 companion 的 pill 模块）。 --- ## 侧边栏：工作区 ⇄ 操作间 侧边栏「更多」下面只有一行切换菜单，两屏互斥： | 当前显示 | 那一行写 | 点它之后 | | --- | --- | --- | | 工作区（会话 / 工作区列表） | **操作间** | 工作区收起，下面列出记忆 / SKILL / 连接器 / 用量 / 画廊 / 档案 / 系统提示词 / 同步设置 | | 操作间（八个工作台入口） | **工作区** | 那八个条目收起，会话列表回来 | 也就是「这一行永远写着点下去会去哪」。当前停在哪一屏会记住（刷新不跳屏）， 从任何一个工作台页回到会话时自动切回**工作区**——否则在操作间里点「新会话」 会看不到会话列表。 侧栏折叠成 56px 图标态时，这条二级导航整块让位，官方「工作台」图标行接管 （那里放不下一整屏二级导航），入口在任何形态下都不会丢。 ### 顶部的 Work / Bot 分段控件 品牌行下面那枚「Work | Bot」分段控件来自本插件（`src/client/mode-switch/`）。 2026-11-01 起 **Bot 模式重新开放**：点 Bot 会切到全屏 Personal Agent（见下一节）， 点应用里的 Work 回到官方工作台。模式记在 `localStorage` 的 `dsh-seeker-bot.ui-mode`， 刷新后保持。 这枚控件与 Bot 应用左侧栏里的 `.pa-mode-seg` 是**同一套视觉规格**（容器 4px 内边距 / 13px 圆角 / 3px 缝，按钮 34px 高 / 10px 圆角 / 14px 字），位置也钉在同一处： 左边距 14px、顶边 y=74（品牌行 66px 底 + 8px 间距）。两个模式来回切时，分段不会 跳尺寸也不会跳位置；改一边记得同步另一边。 --- ## Personal Agent（Bot 模式） Bot 模式是一个覆盖整个 DSH Web 视口的自绘应用，参考截图逐项复刻： 左侧 248px 的 Bot 名册、中间微信式聊天、右侧 300px 的 Bot 详情栏。 **首次进入只有主 Bot**：不再预置任何演示子 Bot、群聊、消息、记忆、例行任务或期刊； 旧版本留在 localStorage 里的七个演示 Bot 与示例数据会在第一次加载时自动迁移清理， 只保留主 Bot 和用户自己创建的内容。 ![Personal Agent 主界面](docs/shots/personal-agent-home.png) ### 布局与交互 | 区域 | 内容 | |---|---| | 左侧栏 | 顶部「+」（新建 Bot）→ Work/Bot 切换器 → 主 Bot（48px 头像 + 在线点）→ 子 Bot 分组 → 群聊 → 底部「期刊日记 / 设置」 | | 聊天区 | 会话头（44px 头像 / 名称 / 角色 / 电话呼叫 / 更多）、消息流、输入框（附件 / 粘贴图片 / 白色圆形语音或发送键；录音时整块切换成语音条） | | 右侧栏 | 详情 / 资料库 / 电脑三个 tab：任务卡、工具权限、主动询问、例行任务、主 Bot 的子 Bot 管理（有子 Bot 时才出现）；记忆检索；文件树 + 终端 | | 弹层 | 新建 Bot、群聊设置、新建群聊、例行任务、设置、期刊阅读器、通话卡片 | - **自适应主题**：默认「跟随」DSH 当前主题（读 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 与 body 实际底色，系统深浅切换也会同步）；设置里可强制「深色 / 浅色」。所有面板、 气泡、输入框、弹窗与右栏都有对应浅色 token，不是只换背景色。 - **主 Bot 控制子 Bot**：主 Bot 右栏「子 Bot 管理」可暂停/启用、改名、移动分组、删除； 子 Bot 可自主在各自会话里主动询问、跑例行任务、维护独立记忆。 - **分组**：设置弹窗里可新建 / 改名 / 删除分组；每个子 Bot 行悬浮 `...` 可移动到任一分组。 - **群聊**：左侧「群聊」标题旁的 + 新建群聊（选成员 + 起名）；群内可 `@成员`， 成员用各自模型回复并以发送者头像/名字标记；群聊设置支持「跟随各自 Bot / 全组统一模型」。 - **主动询问**：每个 Bot 右栏「主动询问」可开关；点「现在问一次」立即发一条带选项的询问； 新建 Bot 创建后由真实模型按岗位发第一条自我介绍与问题。 - **例行任务**：每个 Bot 都可新建（每天 / 每 2 小时 / 每周一）、启停、立即运行、删除； 页面开着时每 30 秒检查到期任务并真实发消息。 - **记忆隔离**：每个 Bot 的「资料库」只列自己的记忆；主 Bot 的资料库列出全部 Bot 的记忆并标注来源。 - **期刊日记**：到达第二天 0:00–8:00 且连续 30 分钟没有任何用户主动对话时自动生成前一天的 总结日记；期刊为米白纸张 + 衬线标题 + 16:9 宽幅配图（调用生图模型，失败回退程序化封面）。 侧栏「期刊日记」可翻期、查看规则、立即检查或模拟 07:30 触发。 ![期刊日记](docs/shots/personal-agent-journal.png) - **语音输入（与 Work 模式同链路）**：输入框麦克风不是 `webkitSpeechRecognition`， 而是 MediaRecorder 录音 → 16 kHz 单声道 WAV → `ctx.remote.speech.transcribe` （本机 SenseVoice，与 Work 模式同一条 ASR）。录音时整块输入框换成一条语音条： 左「X」取消、中间一排实时音量波形（静音时是点阵基线，说话时跟着起伏）、 右「停止方块 + 发送箭头」；停止后先转写（「正在转写…」），转写完成即**收起语音条** 并把文字并入输入框——不自动发送，确认后用输入框的发送键发出；点 X 随时丢弃。 ![语音输入条](docs/shots/personal-agent-voice-bar.png) - **图片输入**：输入框里直接 Ctrl+V 粘贴截图（或点「+」选图片）→ 缩略图预览 → 随消息发出。 图片先经 `POST /api/personal-agent/upload` 落盘到 bot 工作区的 `uploads/`，消息里只存 同源 URL（`/file?path=…`），刷新、重开都还在；宿主会把图片路径写进这一轮的 user 消息 提示，bot 需要看内容时自己 `read_image`。支持 PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP，单张上限 12MB。 ![图片输入](docs/shots/personal-agent-image-input.png) - **通话是真实链路**：麦克风录音 → DSH ASR → 该 Bot 配置的真实模型回复（宿主 `/api/personal-agent/reply`）→ Edge TTS 播放；弹窗里能看到「正在思考」、逐条转写， 也可直接打字作为麦克风不可用时的兜底。最小化收起到右栏顶部，挂断后写一条默认折叠的 「语音通话」消息到该 Bot 会话，展开可见来源、发生时间、最终时长与逐条转写。 - **对话内交互 UI**：选项 / 按钮 / 表单卡片可直接操作；提交后追加用户消息、Bot 继续回复， 部分表单会真实创建例行任务；卡片标记「已提交」防重复。 - **动效**：每条消息上滑入场（`pa-rise` 260ms）、弹窗缩放淡入、通话呼吸波纹、列表选中态 120ms。 ### 回复形态：Bot 是聊天，不是工作台 Bot 跑的是宿主完整的 agent loop（工具、技能、MCP 全都在），但**输出形态按对话设计**， 和 Work 模式刻意不一样： - **正文精炼**：1–3 句、最多两小段，先结论后补充；不用加粗伪标题、多级清单、表格、 代码块，不贴文件路径 / 命令 / 参数（用户明确说「详细说 / 报告 / 清单 / 代码」才展开）。 - **过程不进正文**：工具调用块在 Bot 消息里默认不渲染（`generate_image` 例外，出图卡直接 落在对话流里），正文最多一句「我看了下」——过程属于界面，不属于消息。 - **Work 专属提示段被摘掉**：每个 Bot 的 agent 作用域里会过滤 `team:policy`（Agent Teams 协作纪律）、`ui:deliverable-file-references`（present / 文件路径链接规则）、 `app:web-surface`（Web GUI 与 HMR 说明）、`harness:source`（实现 checkout 位置）。 实现在 `src/host/personal/agent.ts` 的 `trimWorkOnlyPrompt()`：全局段用同名空 section 覆盖，`team:policy` 走 `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall 过滤（它是 agent 作用域注册的， 同名覆盖会撞注册表，实测会把建会话流程带崩）。实测 bot 的系统提示从 ~8.7k 字符降到 ~4.3k。 - **一份契约两个入口**：契约写在 `buildBotPrompt()`；agent 不可用时的降级路径 （`/reply` 的 chat 补全）用同一份措辞，避免「同一个 bot 换个入口就换了语气」。 ### 撤回一条消息（连上下文和记忆一起） 用户消息气泡 hover / 触屏常显「↺ 撤回」，确认后同时做三件事： 1. **删本地消息**：这条用户消息 + 它之后到下一条用户消息之前的全部消息（含 pending、 群聊里同轮多个 Bot 的回复），原位置插一条「你撤回了一条消息」系统提示； 2. **删记忆**：该时间窗口内、这一轮参与 Bot 记下的记忆条目（`MemoryEntry`）； 3. **撤上下文**：`POST /api/personal-agent/recall` → `src/host/personal/recall.ts` 在 agent 会话的 surface 上追加一条 `replace` 事件，把该轮所有节点（用户消息 + 注入上下文 + assistant 回复 + 工具结果）整体遮蔽。日志保留，之后的模型请求重建历史时看不到它们。 实现要点（踩过的坑都写在代码注释里）： - Session 日志 append-only，但 surface 支持 `replace`（compaction 同一机制）； 遮蔽区间必须覆盖每一个 surface 节点（`sourceEventSeqs`），否则宿主校验拒绝。 - 找目标消息只认 `source.kind === 'user'`：宿主会往 user 角色塞注入上下文 （agent-instructions / runtime-context / system-reminder），按它们切区间会把撤回缩成一条。 - 撤回节点是 `developer/message`，`source.kind` 必须写成 `plugin:dsh-seeker-bot`； v3 的 `plugin` 包装会被 v4 落盘校验拒绝，表现为「当场生效、重启后又想起来了」。 - append 后必须 `sessions.flush()`：不落盘的话，下一次 turn 会被 pre-step 判成 blocked。 > 语义边界：撤回只影响**之后的模型上下文**。模型在产生那条回复的那一步已经看过原文， > 这里保证的是「后续对话不再带着它」。 ### 数据与真实能力 - 前端状态持久化在 `localStorage` 的 `pa:state:v1`（Bot / 群聊 / 消息 / 记忆 / 任务 / 期刊）。 - Host 路由 `/api/personal-agent` 提供九项真实能力（任一项失败都自动回退本地引擎）： - `POST /reply`：用宿主 `ctx.llm.stream` 按该 Bot 配置的 provider/model 生成回复； - `POST /reply/stream`：同一条回复的 SSE 流（`text` / `tool` / `error` / `done`）， Bot 对话据此实时显示正文与工具进度（生图 / 生视频占位卡靠它出现）； - `POST /journal/image`：调用当前生图模型生成 16:9 期刊配图，落盘到 `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-seeker-bot/personal-agent/journals/`； - `POST /tts`：本机 `edge-tts` 生成 mp3（Edge 在线语音）； - `POST /asr`：宿主 `speechController`（本机 SenseVoice）转写； - `GET /file`：bot 工作区里的媒体文件（生图 / 生视频落盘产物与正文里的文件）。相对 路径以 bot 工作区为基准，图片 24MB、其它媒体 256MB；视频 / 音频支持 HTTP Range （`206` + `content-range`，浏览器可拖动进度条），`mov` 按 `video/mp4` 声明。 - `GET /office/info|page|pdf`：Office / PDF 预览（复用 `src/office` 的 LibreOffice 页图与 PDF 转换），准入与 `/file` 同一套工作区闸门。 - **生图 / 生视频实时卡（与 Work 模式一致）**：bot 调 `generate_image` 时，对话流里先出现 按本次图片比例 / 张数呼吸的点阵占位；工具结果一回来（含被 spill 的大结果——host 会读回全文、把 base64 解码落盘到 `\_tmp\generated-images\`），同位置 换成真实图片，点开是大图。`generate_video` 同理：生成中显示「正在生成视频」点阵 + 实时秒数 + 提示词；结果里有视频 URL / b64 就落盘到 `_tmp\generated-media\` 并内嵌 `

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-cad — CAD Plugin for DeepSeek Harness

![dsh-cad banner](docs/img/banner.svg)

[![homepage](https://img.shields.io/badge/homepage-dsh--cad-4D6BFE)](https://lau-mars.github.io/dsh-cad/)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@deepseek-ai%2Fdsh?label=dsh)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D%2022-4D6BFE)](https://nodejs.org/)
[![occt](https://img.shields.io/badge/occt-7.9.3-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/opencascade-ts)
[![occt.ts](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/occt.ts?label=occt.ts)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/occt.ts)
[![ansatz](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/ansatz-wasm?label=ansatz)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ansatz-wasm)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4D6BFE)](./LICENSE)

English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A CAD plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
an **embedded 3D/2D CAD viewer** plus a **native parametric modeling tool family**
(OCCT kernel) in the Web UI, letting the agent build and inspect CAD geometry
step by step — "model while you watch".

## Preview

A full modeling session, end to end: the agent builds a parametric assembly
from plain chat — a 120×80×8 base plate with R5 rounded corners, then four
bolt instances placed at the corners — while the resident CAD panel tracks
every step live (parts tree with per-instance colors, ViewCube, "装配体"
assembly tab, 5 instances · 1,740 triangles). The finished assembly exports
as a structured STEP document and the agent verifies it by reading the file
back — 2 solids, 3 products, 2 assembly usages, 1,125.00 mm³:

![dsh-cad assembly session](docs/img/assembly-preview.png)

## Downloads

Cumulative downloads from the npm registry, refreshed daily by CI:

![npm cumulative downloads](docs/img/downloads-cumulative.svg)

## Feature Overview

| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| ⚙️ Kernel chain: cadorange → occt.ts | Modeling goes through **[cadorange](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/cadorange)** (the agent-native CAD runtime wrapping the occt.ts/OCCT WASM; public API + the supported `cadorange/occt` escape hatch for meshing/HLR/wire construction); the direct occt.ts adapter stays as the fallback tier — `DSH_CAD_KERNEL` pins one explicitly (the opencascade.js tier was removed in v0.15.1, −64MB install). The old "no editing after shell" seam is gone — fillet/chamfer/boolean keep working after shelling |
| 🔍 CAD viewing | STL / OBJ / STEP / IGES / BREP / DCPRT (3D), DXF / SVG (2D); interactive viewport in the resident right panel (orbit / zoom / wireframe / pan), with a one-line result row in the conversation |
| 🌗 Dark-mode surfaces | Every rendered surface follows the host theme — viewport slab, DXF/drawing strokes, the Three.js grid / XYZ triad / feature edges / default mesh color / sketch overlays, and the ViewCube plate; a theme flip restyles mounted viewers live. Overrides: `--dsh-cad-bg`, `--dsh-cad-stroke`, `--dsh-cad-paper` |
| 🧭 CAD editor interactions | Onshape-style ViewCube (26-zone click-to-orient), hover/click face & edge picking with live measurement (area mm² / length mm), Faces+Edges / Faces / Wireframe render modes, switchable BRep demo parts (bracket / flange / shaft) |
| 🏗️ Parametric modeling | Primitives, profile extrusion, **loft**, **sweep**, **revolve**, booleans, all-edge fillet/chamfer, **shell**, **draft**, **patterns** (linear/circular), transforms; profiles take **curve segments** (arcs/circles exact BRep; B-splines sampled approximation) — exact OCCT BRep, not a mesh approximation. `cad_loft` sections accept **curves** too: point loops, `{through}` splines or planar `{profile}` chains; `smooth: true` fits a **periodic B-spline** through point loops — one continuous B-spline lateral face instead of planar strips meeting at G0 creases |
| ✏️ Named sketches | Standalone named profiles (Sketch1…) kept in the document (`cad_sketch_new` / `edit` / `list` / `delete`); extrude/revolve/sweep reference them **by name**, and `cad_sketch_edit` rewrites the definition in place + replays the log, rebuilding every dependent feature — the parametric loop. Sketches render as Onshape-style **blue curves + plane frame** in the viewport (refreshing live on edit), listed in a left-side **feature tree** (sketches + features, eye-toggle visibility, click-to-highlight bodies) over the Part tab |
| 🗂️ Codex-style document tabs | The resident display panel gets a tab strip with a "+" menu: **Part** (Part Studio, the default) / **Assembly** (instance insert/move/remove) / **Drawing** (true hidden-line sheets); tabs are closable and keep their state |
| 🔩 Joint-driven assemblies | The build123d joint family (rigid/revolute/linear/cylindrical/ball/planar/polar): `cad_assembly_joint` defines, `cad_assembly_connect` pairs-and-solves (parent fixed, child repositioned onto the joint frames), `cad_assembly_drive` drives motion values with cascading re-solve (motion studies), `cad_assembly_explode` for exploded views; the assembly-tree panel gains a JOINTS section (kind/current value/pairing link). Pure main-thread placement algebra — kernel-independent, replays from the op log |
| 📥 STEP assembly import | `cad_step_import` imports a STEP document as an assembly: names, nesting and instance placements survive, identical geometry dedupes into one body referenced by N instances (a bolt pattern is one body); files cache as content-addressed workspace assets so op-log replay stays self-contained (cadorange kernel) |
| 📁 Multi-document file space | Named documents per workspace (`.dsh-cad/docs/`), each session bound to its own active document — new sessions start empty instead of inheriting leftovers; a folder button in the panel lists every document (preview / delete), and `cad_doc_new` / `cad_doc_open` manage the modeling target from chat |
| 📐 Engineering drawings | GB first-angle layout: front / top / left views + isometric, true OCCT hidden-line removal via the **occt.ts** kernel (an npm dependency, dashed); sheet frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale series; exports SVG / DXF |
| 🔗 Constraint solving & motion | **Ansatz** geometric constraint solver (**one command: `npm install ansatz-wasm`** — a wasm dependency, no Rust toolchain, no native binary): entity/constraint modeling (assembly instances ↔ rigid3 poses mapped automatically), solve-with-writeback, full DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics (LLM-oriented), and parametric kinematic sweeps (`cad_constraint` / `cad_solve` / `cad_motion`) |
| 📐 Geometry measurement | Exact volume (mm³), bounding box, triangle counts, DXF layers |
| 📤 On-demand export | STEP (parametric) / STL (mesh); files are written only when the user asks |
| 🖥️ Resident CAD panel | A permanent panel right of the conversation: Codex-style tabs (Part / Assembly / Drawing), tracking the latest model in real time while modeling. A host-independent liveness poll (`GET /dsh-cad/docs` → per-document op count) keeps the viewport following modeling ops even when the conversation meta pipeline goes stale, and auto-returns from a file preview |
| ⚡ Zero-copy render pipeline | worker mesh → in-memory binary → three.js typed arrays; zero base64 / zero intermediate files / zero per-step disk writes |
| 💾 Modeling document persistence | Operation log (JSON) + debounced disk mirror; automatically replayed to restore state after a process restart |
| 🖼️ Image → profile | PNG sketch/screenshot → Otsu binarization → contour tracing → extrusion-ready polygon (`cad_image_profile`) |
| 🔌 FreeCAD executor | Run the same op family on an external FreeCAD console (STEP in/out); requires a local FreeCAD install |
| ☁️ Onshape executor | Run the same op family on **Onshape** over its signed REST API — zero local install; every op compiles to a **standard Onshape feature** pushed into the target Part Studio (no Feature Studio setup). Readback is three-tier: cheap per-part STL by default, `readback: "step"` for exact-BRep-derived named meshes via a server-side STEP translation, or `readback: "none"` — build only and return the document link (~3 calls, quota-friendliest). Exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid). Quota-aware errors distinguish credential problems from free-plan cooldowns; the Onshape document URL is always surfaced |

## Installation

The plugin is published to npm — one line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cad
```

The installer applies the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` (declared in the `dsh.bundle` manifest) automatically, so there is nothing to configure by hand.

### Version requirements

- **Node.js** and **dsh CLI** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`): minimum versions live in
  the badge row above and the `engines` field of `package.json` — kept out of
  the prose so they never go stale

### Install from source (dev mode)

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LAU-MARS/dsh-cad.git
cd dsh-cad
npm install && npm run build && npm test   # deps include occt.ts (true-HLR drawing kernel, ~20MB wasm)

npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh pnpm
dsh web                                  # let the first launch init the profile, then Ctrl-C

dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-cad

dsh web
```

The patch insert ships as `cordis.patch.yml` in the package root and is applied by the installer via the same `dsh.bundle` manifest.

Set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and you are ready — for example:

- “open bracket.stl” → `cad_view`
- “model a 100×60×5 plate, punch a ⌀20 hole in the middle, R2 fillets on the four
  corners, add a ⌀16 boss 20 tall, export plate.step”
  → `cad_create_prim` + `cad_boolean` + `cad_fillet` + `cad_export`, with the 3D tab
  updating live at every step
- “build a snowman” → spheres + a cone nose + a cylinder hat (precise `at`/`axis` placement)
- “add two more b1, one rotated 90 degrees” → `cad_assembly_insert` + `cad_assembly_move`, the Assembly tab updates live
- “make an A3 drawing of b1 and export dxf” → `cad_drawing` (three views + iso + dashed hidden lines + dimensions) → `cad_export` `.dxf`

## Modeling Tool Family

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cad_view` | Open a CAD file and render it in the viewer (resident panel) |
| `cad_info` | Read-only geometry metadata (format / counts / bounding box / units / layers) |
| `cad_create_prim` | Primitives (mm, Z-up); `at` for placement, `axis` for orientation (exact axis-angle rotation) |
| `cad_sketch_new` | Create a named sketch (Sketch1…): {start, segments} / {circle} / flat points loop — referenced by name from the profile features |
| `cad_sketch_edit` | Redefine a sketch (回改): the definition op is rewritten in place and the log replayed — every referencing feature rebuilds |
| `cad_sketch_list` | List the document's sketches (name / form / size) |
| `cad_sketch_delete` | Delete a sketch (refused while features still reference it) |
| `cad_extrude_profile` | Extrude a closed XY-plane profile along +Z into a solid — inline points/segments/circle or a named sketch (`sketch`) |
| `cad_loft` | Loft: skin a solid through successive closed sections (each a [x,y,z,…] loop in its own plane, or a curve/`profile` section); sections may differ in shape and point count; `smooth` fits a periodic B-spline through point loops for a **crease-free** skin; `ruled` for straight sides |
| `cad_revolve` | Solid of revolution: revolve a closed profile around an axis (profile coords = (radius, height); curve segments supported — rounded rims exact); optional `angle`; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_chamfer` | Chamfer: bevel every sharp edge with one equal distance (mm) |
| `cad_pattern` | Pattern: linear (`delta` spacing) or circular (principal axis + `at` point + sweep angle); creates copy bodies, fuse afterwards for one body |
| `cad_shell` | Shell: hollow to a wall thickness (inward, outer skin preserved); `open` lists outward normals of the faces to open (empty = sealed). Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_draft` | Draft: tilt the walls `angle` degrees about a neutral plane (mold release); `direction` is the pull direction, walls auto-selected by default. Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_sweep` | Sweep: pipe a closed 2D profile along a 3D [x,y,z,…] path; the profile is auto-placed on the start plane, so no manual orientation; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_boolean` | fuse / cut / common (classic hole punching: plate cut cylinder) |
| `cad_fillet` | Constant-radius fillet on all sharp edges |
| `cad_transform` | Translate / Euler rotate / mirror |
| `cad_volume` | Exact BRep volume (mm³) |
| `cad_drawing` | Engineering drawing: front/top/left + isometric views, dashed hidden lines, frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale, A4/A3 |
| `cad_assembly_insert` | Insert a body into the assembly as a placed instance (`at` position, `rotate` orientation) |
| `cad_assembly_move` | Set an instance's absolute placement |
| `cad_assembly_remove` | Remove an instance from the assembly (the body stays) |
| `cad_assembly_joint` | Define a joint on an instance (build123d family: rigid/revolute/linear/cylindrical/ball/planar/polar), frame in the instance's local coordinates |
| `cad_assembly_connect` | Pair joints to place a child: the parent stays fixed, the child is repositioned so both joint frames coincide (optional connect-time drive value) |
| `cad_assembly_drive` | Drive a joint's motion value and re-solve every pairing (one motion-study step; ranges enforced) |
| `cad_assembly_solve` | Re-solve all pairings at current joint values (after moving a parent manually) |
| `cad_assembly_explode` | Exploded-view factor (instances push radially from the assembly center; view-state only, exports/drawings stay assembled) |
| `cad_assembly_info` | Read the assembly state: placements + joint labels/types/values + pairings + explode factor |
| `cad_step_import` | Structured STEP import: names, part structure and placements survive; identical geometry dedupes into one body referenced by N instances |
| `cad_constraint` | Declare the constraint model: entities (assembly-instance bindings) + constraints (distance/angle/mate/coaxial…), persisted in the op log |
| `cad_solve` | Solve with Ansatz and write poses back; returns DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics |
| `cad_motion` | Kinematic sweep: drive one constraint value from `from` to `to`, solve frame by frame, apply the last pose, return the motion table |
| `cad_export` | Export STEP / STL / DCPRT (the native replayable part document) to a workspace path; `target: "assembly"` writes the assembly STEP, `target: "drawing"` writes the sheet as SVG / DXF |
| `cad_delete` | Delete a body |
| `cad_docs` | List the workspace's modeling documents (id / name / bodies / updated, active marked) |
| `cad_doc_new` | Create a named document and make it the session's modeling target (start multi-part projects here) |
| `cad_doc_open` | Open an existing document (by id or name) as the session's modeling target — bodies replay exactly |
| `cad_doc_rename` | Rename a document |
| `cad_doc_delete` | Permanently delete a document (requires `confirm: true`) |
| `cad_freecad` | Run an op program on an external FreeCAD executor (optional STEP input / export) |
| `cad_fusion` | Run an op program on an external Fusion 360 executor (GUI bridge; optional export) |
| `cad_onshape` | Run an op program on the Onshape cloud (signed REST API): creates or drives a document, returns its URL; `readback: "step"` for exact BRep meshes; exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid) |
| `cad_image_profile` | PNG → contours → extrusion-ready polygon points |
| `cad_script` | Deterministic script evaluation for geometry math (profile point arrays, arc coordinates): `js` runs in-process (Node vm — works even when the host shell is unavailable), `py` uses a system Python |

After every modeling step: **the chat result row updates in place** (stable viewId +
versioned URL), and the resident panel's "Part" tab tracks the latest model in real time.

## Connectors (roadmap)

Modeling runs on the **occt.ts kernel** via cadorange (OCCT in the browser —
zero install). The connectors below refer to **external CAD engines** acting as
executors for the same tool family, planned for future support:

| Connector | Suite | Platform | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Built-in kernel** | CAD modeling kernel based on OCCT + WebGL, runs in the browser — zero install | All platforms (WebGL rendering) | ✅ Built-in |
| FreeCAD | open-source parametric suite — natural local executor via its Python API (console + GUI window modes) | Windows / macOS / Linux | ✅ Available (needs local install) |
| Fusion 360 | Autodesk CAD/CAM — resident add-in + spool bridge (no headless; the Fusion window doubles as a viewer) | Windows / macOS | 🧪 Experimental (`cad_fusion`) |
| SolidWorks | Dassault Systèmes industry-standard 3D CAD, COM/.NET automation | Windows only | 🚧 Windows demo scaffold (`scripts/solidworks-bridge/`) |
| Onshape | PTC cloud-native SaaS CAD, fully in the browser — signed REST API (cad.onshape.com or chamber hosts); every op compiles to a standard Onshape feature pushed into the Part Studio, results read back as per-part STL + mass properties, the cloud is the viewer | All platforms (browser) | ✅ Available (`cad_onshape`; set `DSH_ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY` / `DSH_ONSHAPE_SECRET_KEY`) |
| ZW3D（中望3D） | ZWSOFT all-in-one CAD/CAM | Windows / Linux | 🚧 Planned |
| GstarCAD 3D（浩辰3D） | Gstarsoft 3D CAD | Windows | 🚧 Planned |

All external engines implement the same **GeometryExecutor contract** (`available()` /
`run(opProgram) → meshes`), so the WebGL display layer never changes — swapping a
backend changes only the quality of the produced geometry.

## Architecture

```
cad_view(path)                        modeling tools (cad_create_prim, …)
  → import worker (occt-import-js)      → modeling worker (occt.ts WASM via cadorange)
  → CadScene JSON (base64-f32)          → exact BRep geometry + meshing
  → GET /dsh-cad/scene/<id>            → in-memory binary scene (f32/u32 packed)
                                        → GET /dsh-cad/bin/<docId>
            ↓ session presentationMeta (viewId + versioned URL) ↓
        browser card + persistent "3D" tab (three.js / SVG, Z-up, XYZ axes)
```

- **Two workers**: import (occt-import-js, read-only STEP/IGES/BREP) and modeling
  (cadorange over the occt.ts wasm) are separate, both lazily started
- **Zero-copy pipeline**: modeling scenes use zero base64 / zero large JSON arrays /
  zero per-step disk writes (disk mirror debounced 1.5s, replayed only on service
  restart); `cad_export` is the only explicit file export
- **Modeling document**: `<workspace>/.dsh-cad/model.json` operation log; all bodies
  are restored by replay after a restart
- **Drawing HLR kernel**: hidden lines run on **occt.ts** (npm dependency,
  `npm i occt.ts`) — true OCCT removal, no fallback engine, a missing kernel is
  a hard error. Kernel APIs: `hiddenLines()` true hidden-line
  removal, byte-level STEP/BRep `readStep`/`readBrep`/`writeStep`/`writeBrep`
  without MEMFS, tessellation with built-in feature-edge extraction, and a
  `hasError()`/`lastError()` error contract. Geometry crosses kernels as STEP
  bytes and the projected segments are remapped into the sheet frame. Kernel
  dist resolution: `DSH_OCCTJS_DIST` env var → Node's own resolution of the
  `occt.ts` dependency (walks up every parent node_modules — npm/yarn flat and
  pnpm symlink layouts all hit) → `<repo>/../opencascade-ts/dist` (sibling
  checkout) → `vendor/` → `node_modules/opencascade-ts`
- **Constraint solving (Ansatz)**: the solver is the npm dependency
  **`ansatz-wasm`** (a wasm-bindgen build, single package ~538KB, zero deps) —
  installing dsh-cad pulls it automatically, and `npm install ansatz-wasm` alone
  upgrades it. **No Rust toolchain, no native binary, platform independent.**
  Resolution: the npm package (node_modules) → a `DSH_ANSATZ_WASM` directory → a
  sibling Ansatz checkout's pkg-node. The solver speaks one JSON envelope
  contract, with tool-layer errors (e.g. `unsupported_constraint`) surfaced
  verbatim for the LLM. Assembly placements (translate + XYZ Euler
  degrees) map bidirectionally to the solver's rigid3 poses (translate +
  exponential-map rotation, radians). Solver capability is staged
  (point-distance-to-origin today) — the plumbing contract is finished and needs
  no changes as it grows
- **Kernel chain**: modeling goes through **cadorange** (agent-native CAD
  runtime; public build123d-style API for prims/curve-segment profiles (TRUE
  B-spline interpolation)/loft/sweep/revolve/booleans (cleaned by default)/
  fillet/chamfer/shell/draft/native mirror/centroid, plus the supported
  `cadorange/occt` escape hatch for viewer tessellation, engineering-drawing
  HLR (zero STEP hops, one wasm session) and wire construction); the direct
  occt.ts adapter stays as the fallback tier (`DSH_CAD_KERNEL` pins one; see
  docs/cadorange-integration.md for the verb-by-verb mapping). Editing after
  shelling is seamless. Assembly STEP export writes a **structured document**
  (cadorange
  `exportStepAssembly`): one root product plus one named, placed child
  per instance — instance separation survives the file (STL stays a single
  fused mesh). Instance separation stays in
  the assembly scene/document for the fuse paths.
  Face selection matches `describe()` plane normals (outermost along ±normal)
- **Client**: esbuild single-file CJS factory (three.js inlined ~560KB, react provided
  by the host module table), Z-up CAD convention, empty scene with XYZ axis labels
  and a ground grid always displayed

## Theming (dark mode)

The viewer follows the host appearance automatically. DSH publishes the theme as
`color-scheme` on `<html>` plus `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`; the plugin resolves
that (falling back to `prefers-color-scheme`) and themes every surface the host
tokens cannot reach:

- the viewport slab behind the transparent WebGL canvas and 2D scenes,
- default 2D entity strokes (DXF / engineering-drawing entities),
- the Three.js ground grid, XYZ axis triad/labels, feature edges, default mesh
  color and sketch overlays,
- the ViewCube face plate (canvas texture).

A theme flip restyles mounted cards and the resident panel live — no reload and
no lost camera. Engineering drawings loaded as SVG keep a white sheet; in dark
mode it is framed as paper on the dark slab instead of filling the viewport.

Hosts can override the surfaces the plugin owns; an explicit definition wins in
either theme:

| CSS variable | Applies to | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dsh-cad-bg` | viewport background (any CSS `background` value) | light `#f5f6f8→#e9ecf0`, dark `#1b1b1c→#151517` |
| `--dsh-cad-stroke` | default 2D entity stroke | `#4c5561` light / `#c8ced6` dark |
| `--dsh-cad-paper` | drawing paper behind SVG sheets | `#ffffff` |

```css
:root { --dsh-cad-bg: #0b0d10; }          /* flat canvas in both themes */
```

## Tests

```sh
npm test                             # full suite: converters / modeling worker (exact volume assertions) / DCPRT round-trip / FreeCAD + Onshape executors / image profiles / binary pipeline / document persistence
node test/route-check.mjs            # JSON scene routing layer
node test/visual/serve.mjs           # browser card/tab visual verification page (http://127.0.0.1:3987)
```

Representative assertions covered: the boolean-punched volume exactly equals the
analytic value (28429.20 mm³), L-shaped profile extrusion 3000 mm³, volumes and
bounding-box flips of sphere/cone/torus placed with `at`/`axis`, 8-byte alignment
of the binary packing, an STL export round-trip (export → read back by the
phase-1 parser), and a DCPRT document round-trip (serialize → replay on the
OCCT worker → exact bounds).

## Known Limitations

- DWG (closed-source) is unsupported; DXF bulge arcs are approximated by chords;
  glTF/3MF viewing is not implemented (the structure is reserved)
- `cad_fillet` is all-edge constant-radius (per-edge selection is unstable under
  embind); chamfer is not implemented
- Sketch extrusion supports polygon profiles only (arc profiles are constructed by
  boolean combinations of cylinders/tori)
- dsh framework limitation: an already-mounted single slot (the right-side details
  panel itself) does not respond to components registered later, so the persistent
  view is provided as the "3D" view tab (a list slot, the official composition)
- The host reads CAD files via node:fs (the platform fs service supports UTF-8 text
  only and cannot carry binary data)

## Community

| QQ Group (🇨🇳 China) | Feishu (🇨🇳 China) | X / Twitter (🌍 International) | Discord (🌍 International) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `485038246` (join note: dsh-cad) | 🚧 Coming soon | 🚧 Coming soon | 🚧 Coming soon |

# DSH Remote — Android 远程控制器

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/liaoguogang-hub/dsh-remote-public)

手机原生 App，直接控制电脑上的 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**。不是 WebView 套壳：
Kotlin/Compose 直连 DSH 自带的 HTTP API + WebSocket 网关。

这是**公共版**，与作者自用版的唯一差别：

| | 自用版 | 本仓库（公共版） |
|---|---|---|
| 连接方式 | 局域网 / 自建中继 / 自定义 | 局域网 / **ngrok 隧道** / 自定义 |
| 内置服务器地址 | 有 | **无** |
| 内置登录凭证 | 有（30 天 cookie） | **无** |
| 包名 | `com.dsh.remote` | `com.dsh.remote.ngrok`（可与自用版共存） |
| 应用名 / APK | `DSH` / `DSH-Remote-v*.apk` | `DSH Remote` / `DSH Remote-v*.apk` |

功能与 UI 与自用版 4.12.2 完全一致。

## 下载手机端 App

**DSH Remote v4.21.0** · Android 8.0 (API 26) 及以上 · 2.8 MB

[⬇️ 下载 APK](https://github.com/liaoguogang-hub/dsh-remote-public/releases/download/v4.21.0/DSH-Remote-v4.21.0.apk) ·
[全部版本](https://github.com/liaoguogang-hub/dsh-remote-public/releases)

安装后应用名「DSH Remote」，包名 `com.dsh.remote.ngrok`（可与作者的 `DSH` 自用版共存）。
手机端不通过 npm 分发——npm 包 `dsh-remote-hub` 是电脑侧的 DSH 插件，两者配合使用：

```
电脑：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-remote-hub   → 起桥接 / 开隧道 / 签 Cookie
手机：装上面这个 APK → 填电脑给出的地址与 Cookie → 连接
```

## 扫码配对（手机端）

电脑上 `dsh-remote qr` 打开配对页 → 手机 App「设置 → 扫码配对」扫一下就自动填好地址与凭据，
不用手抄 Cookie。

二维码里**不含 Cookie**：只含一个 **10 分钟有效、用一次就作废**的配对码。
相机不可用时可以点「手动输入」，填地址 + 配对码同样能连上。

## 功能

| 能力 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| 三种连接方式（局域网 / ngrok / 自定义），地址与凭证首次填写后本地保存 | ✅ |
| 会话列表：搜索、排序（最近更新 / 手动）、归档筛选（隐藏 / 全部 / 仅归档） | ✅ |
| 会话列表默认显示最近 10 条，「展开其余 N 个会话」每次 +5 | ✅ |
| 长按会话：重命名 / 归档会话（或取消归档） | ✅ |
| 发消息、逐字流式回复、随时中断 | ✅ |
| 历史分页（「加载更早的消息」）与本地缓存（先显示上次内容再同步） | ✅ |
| 模型选择（分组目录 + 切换） | ✅ |
| 权限模式 | ⚠️ 只能读取当前值（DSH 未开放远程切换权限的接口） |
| 自定义地址历史（点选填入 / 删除） | ✅ |

## 三步连上（推荐：一键脚本）

1. **电脑上双击 `connect.cmd`**（和 App 一起发布的文件）。
   它会自动做四件事：起桥接 → 签发 30 天 Cookie → 尽量开公网隧道 → 打印结果。
2. 等黑窗口打印出这两行：
   - `DSH 地址: http://192.168.x.x:6300`（同一 WiFi，最快）
   - `Cookie: dsh-auth-…`（已自动复制到剪贴板）
   如果网络允许，还会多给一行公网地址 `https://xxx.trycloudflare.com`（人在外面时用）。
3. **App 里选「自定义」档** → 把地址粘进「DSH 地址」框 → Cookie 粘进「Cookie」框 → 点连接。

> 电脑端那个黑窗口要保持开着；关掉 = 断开手机。下次用重新双击一次，抄新的地址和 Cookie 即可。
> 结果同时会写到同目录的 `connect-info.txt`。

### 公网隧道说明

脚本按这个顺序尝试，**局域网地址永远可用**，公网则尽力而为：

| 情况 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 装了 `ngrok` 且在 PATH 里 | 用 ngrok 开隧道 |
| 有 `cloudflared`（脚本会自动找/下载）且 `api.trycloudflare.com` 可达 | 免费 trycloudflare 地址，免注册 |
| 两者都不行（常见于受限网络） | 只给局域网地址，并提示需要自备内网穿透（cpolar / natapp / 花生壳 / 自建 frp） |

### 用 ngrok 拿一个永久固定域名（可选，需注册）

cloudflared 的免费 quick tunnel **每次重启地址都会变**；想要固定域名就用 ngrok 免费账号。


![ngrok 注册要点：左栏三处](docs/ngrok-dashboard-annotated.png)

上图红框就是全部要点：① Share Localhost ② Your Authtoken ③ Domains。

**注册（约 2 分钟）**

1. 打开 <https://dashboard.ngrok.com/get-started/setup>，在首页选 **Share Localhost**
   （「Put your local app on a public URL」——它明确写着 *stable, auth-protected URL*）；
2. 跟着 **Get started** 走完，进 dashboard 后取两样东西：
   - **Authtoken**：左侧 `Getting Started` → `Your Authtoken`
     <https://dashboard.ngrok.com/get-started/your-authtoken>
   - **免费固定域名**：左侧 `Universal Gateway` → `Domains`，免费账号自带一个
     `xxxx-yyyy.ngrok-free.app` <https://dashboard.ngrok.com/domains>
3. 下载 ngrok 单文件（同样免安装、不需要管理员权限），放进 `tools\ngrok.exe`，或装到 PATH。

**配置（只需一次）**

```powershell
tools\ngrok.exe config add-authtoken <你的 Authtoken>
```

然后双击 `connect.cmd`：它会自己发现 ngrok、问你一次固定域名（记在
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-remote\ngrok-domain.txt`），之后每次都复用同一个地址。

> - **Host 必须改写**：脚本用 `--host-header=127.0.0.1:1815`，否则 DSH 的信任栅栏会 403，
>   而且 cookie 的 authority 对不上。
> - **不要加 ngrok 的 Basic Auth**：App 是用 DSH 的签名 cookie 认证的，Basic Auth 会让每个
>   API 调用先被 ngrok 拦下（401），App 连不上。安全性由 30 天签名的 cookie 保证。
> - **免费额度**：约 40 连接/分钟、1 GB/月。App 是长连接 + 流式输出，日常够用；
>   偶发断连多半是额度或连接数超限，可换付费或 cloudflared。

### 自己下载 cloudflared（可选，单文件免安装、不需要管理员权限）

脚本会优先在 `connect.cmd` 同目录、`tools\`、`%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-remote\` 等位置找
`cloudflared.exe`；找不到才下载。想自己放一份，按下面来：

```powershell
# 1) 镜像优先：国内直连 GitHub 下 52 MB 基本必超时
$url = "https://ghfast.top/https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-windows-amd64.exe"
# 官方直连（网络允许时）：
# $url = "https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-windows-amd64.exe"

$dest = "tools\cloudflared.exe"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $dest) | Out-Null
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $dest -TimeoutSec 300 -UseBasicParsing

# 2) 一定要验签：镜像可能给错文件，但签名伪造不了
Get-AuthenticodeSignature $dest | Format-List Status, SignerCertificate
```

合格标准：`Status = Valid`，`Subject` 里含 `Cloudflare, Inc.`。
参考值（2026.10.5 版）：`55,343,328` 字节，
SHA256 `DB4E4C413612A0916F3E1679D3CAAF376F94911952D163028FB726FB2E0516A9`。

> 脚本自己下载时也会做同样的验签（`Get-AuthenticodeSignature` + 主体含 Cloudflare），
> 校验不过就丢弃并换下一个源 —— **不要用哈希对比代替验签**，镜像可以把哈希一起改掉。

### 手工方式（想自己控制时）

```bash
node lan-proxy.mjs 6300 127.0.0.1:1815     # 桥接：把 Host 改写成 DSH 认可的 127.0.0.1:1815
ngrok http 6300 --host-header=127.0.0.1:1815   # 或 cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:6300
node mint.mjs "127.0.0.1:1815" 30              # 签发 30 天 Cookie
```

```text
浏览器打开 DSH 页面 → F12 → Application → Cookies → 复制会话 cookie
  （cookie 只对签发时的 authority 有效，所以桥接必须改写 Host 到同一个值）
```

## 安全说明

- **本仓库不包含任何地址、Token 或 Cookie**：`DshDefaults.kt` 里全是空字符串，首次连接在 App 里填。
- **Cookie 由你自己的电脑签发**：脚本用 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 里的密钥签一个 30 天有效的凭据，
  只在你自己机器和手机之间流动，不要提交到任何仓库。
- **局域网默认是明文 HTTP**：`lan-proxy.mjs` 监听 `0.0.0.0:6300`，同一 WiFi 内 Anyone 能访问它，
  所以请只在可信网络里用局域网模式；要跨网请用 ngrok / cloudflared 这类带 TLS 的隧道。
- **App 允许明文与用户证书**（`network_security_config.xml`）：DSH 通常跑在明文 HTTP 上，
  自签 CA 的中转也要能信任；代价是它不会阻止你连明文地址，所以地址来源要自己把关。
- **别把 ngrok 的 Basic Auth 和 DSH 的 Cookie 混用**：App 只带 DSH 的 Cookie，
  Basic Auth 会让每个请求先被隧道 401 拦掉。

## 构建

```bash
./gradlew assembleRelease      # 产物：dist/DSH Remote-v<version>.apk
```

需要 JDK 17 与 Android SDK（`local.properties` 指向本机 SDK）。

## 版本

当前 `4.12.2`（versionCode 58），与自用版 4.12.2 功能一致。

## 作为 DSH 插件安装（推荐）

本仓库根目录同时是一个 **DSH plugin**（Node 侧），装进 DSH 后由宿主负责起桥接、开隧道、签 Cookie，
并把地址与 Cookie 写进 `~/.dsh/dsh-remote/`，手机 App 直接抄。

```bash
# 从 NPM 安装（推荐，会出现在 DSH 内的「插件中心」）
# https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-remote-hub
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-remote-hub
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-remote-hub      # web profile 同样可用

# 或直接从本仓库源码安装（不经过 NPM）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:liaoguogang-hub/dsh-remote-public
```

装完重启 `dsh web`（或桌面端），插件会自动：

1. 起桥接：`0.0.0.0:6300`，把 Host 改写成 `127.0.0.1:1815`（Cookie 因此不会因端口变化失效）；
2. 自动发现 DSH 宿主端口（宿主每次重启都换端口，插件每次失败会重新扫一遍）；
3. 开隧道：**有 ngrok 就用 ngrok**（固定域名），否则自动下载并验签 cloudflared 开免注册 quick tunnel；
4. 签发 30 天 Cookie，写到 `~/.dsh/dsh-remote/status.json` 与 `connect.txt`。

查看结果：

```bash
dsh-remote qr         # 打开配对页（二维码），手机扫一下就自动填好
dsh-remote start --open   # 起桥接并打印地址/Cookie，同时打开二维码页（connect.cmd 用的就是它）
dsh-remote status     # 局域网地址、公网地址、Cookie、上游端口
dsh-remote connect    # 直接打印要抄进手机的两行
dsh-remote doctor     # 逐项自检：凭据、ngrok、cloudflared、宿主端口
dsh-remote start      # 不开 DSH 也能单独前台跑（Ctrl+C 退出）
```

插件配置（profile 行里覆盖即可）：

| 键 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 关掉插件但不卸载 |
| `port` | `6300` | 桥接监听端口（手机连这个） |
| `authority` | `127.0.0.1:1815` | 桥接呈现的 Host，Cookie 绑定它 |
| `tunnel` | `auto` | `auto` / `off` / `ngrok` / `cloudflared` |
| `upstreamPort` | `0` | 固定 DSH 宿主端口，`0` 表示自动发现 |

> 公网隧道受网络影响：`api.trycloudflare.com` 不可达时插件会跳过公网、只给局域网地址，
> 并在 `status.json` 里写明原因，不会假装成功。

### 装完之后

插件随 DSH 启动自动工作，**不需要手动跑 connect.cmd**；装的时候没有提示是正常的，日志里会出现：

```
dsh-remote: ready — 手机端扫码：dsh-remote qr（或浏览器打开 http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/_dsh-remote/pair）
```

想手动确认/手动起，就在仓库目录双击 `connect.cmd`（它和插件是同一份代码，会打印地址与 Cookie 并自动打开二维码）。

**Cookie 跨重启有效**：桥接始终向 DSH 呈现固定 authority（默认 `127.0.0.1:1815`），
所以 DSH 换端口、桥接重启都不会让手机上的凭据失效；只有签名密钥变化或 Cookie 到期（30 天）才需要重新扫码。

### 升级插件（重要：必须完全重启 DSH）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-remote-hub     # 或 --profile web
```

**升级后请完全退出 DSH 再重新打开，不要只靠插件热重载。** 原因是旧版本的桥接监听可能不会被热重载回收，
它会继续占着端口，而这个"旧桥接"里没有新版本的路由：

| 症状 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| 配对页打不开，或打开是**乱码/无关页面** | 端口被**旧版桥接**占着，请求被它转发走了 |
| `dsh-remote status` 里 `bridgePort` 是 `0`、地址是 `http://x.x.x.x:0` | 旧版本绑不上端口的回退 bug（0.3.0 及更早） |

0.3.1 起这些都能自愈，但仍建议完全重启，理由是会残留**旧代码的监听**：

- 绑不上端口时先探 `/_dsh-remote/health`：
  - 是支持配对的本插件桥接 → 直接**采纳**，不重复开隧道；
  - 是旧版桥接（没有配对路由）或别的程序 → 自动**改用临时端口**，并在日志/`status.json` 里写明真实端口；
- 插件热重载时通过进程内注册表**先关闭上一实例**的监听。

升级后确认当前真实端口：

```bash
dsh-remote status        # 打印 bridgePort / 局域网 / 公网 / Cookie
# 或直接看健康检查
curl http://127.0.0.1:<bridgePort>/_dsh-remote/health
```

> 提示：`cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `port` 只是**首选**端口。若被占用，实际端口会写在 `~/.dsh/dsh-remote/status.json`，
> 一切链接与二维码都以那里为准，不必手改配置。

### 用自己的服务器做中转（阿里云等自建 relay）

如果你不用 ngrok，而是用一台云服务器（Caddy/nginx 终止 TLS + SSH 反向隧道）把本机暴露出去，
就让插件把这个地址写进二维码，否则扫码只会得到 ngrok/cloudflared 的地址：

```bash
# 方式一：临时环境变量
export DSH_REMOTE_PUBLIC_URL="https://your-relay.example"     # Windows: $env:DSH_REMOTE_PUBLIC_URL="https://..."
dsh-remote start --open

# 方式二：写进 profile 配置（推荐，长期有效）
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml 的 dsh-remote 行：
#   publicUrl: 'https://your-relay.example'
```

配置后插件不再启动 ngrok/cloudflared，并把该地址作为「公网地址」放进配对载荷；
启动时会探测 `<publicUrl>/_dsh-remote/health`，结果记在 `status.json` 的 `public.reachable`
（中转在、但反向隧道断了 → `false` 并打印警告）。

前提：服务器侧确实把请求转发到**桥接监听的端口**（默认 6300）。

### 扫码配对（一次性配对码）

不想手抄 Cookie 就用二维码：

```bash
dsh-remote qr
```

浏览器会打开 `http://127.0.0.1:6300/_dsh-remote/pair`，显示一个二维码。手机 DSH Remote 里点
「扫码配对」，扫完自动填入地址并换取登录凭据，直接连上。

扫码一次会同时写入「局域网」和「ngrok」两档地址；连接时优先局域网（同 WiFi 最快），局域网不通才走 ngrok。扫码后即保存，之后不用再扫。

安全设计：
- 二维码里**不含 Cookie**，只含一个 **10 分钟有效的一次性配对码**（`{"v":1,"u":"<地址>","c":"<配对码>","e":<过期时间>}`）；
- 兑换成功即作废，截图/偷拍泄漏的是一个立刻失效的码，而不是 30 天访问权；
- 配对码只存在内存里，插件重启即全部失效（失效安全）。

端点（都在桥接上，不经 DSH）：

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/_dsh-remote/pair` | 配对页（二维码 HTML） |
| GET | `/_dsh-remote/pair.svg` | 只要二维码 SVG |
| POST | `/_dsh-remote/pair/redeem` | `{code}` → `{url, cookie}`；用过即失效 |

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# inbox Source

本包是到岗的收件 Source，也是可以挂进 DeepSeek Harness 的 Cordis 插件。CLI 仍用 `LocalInbox.receive`，不经过 Cordis：

- 任务腿分配一个 `worker-<ticketId>` 会话名
- 闲聊腿记到 `main`
- 同一个 Trigger id 再投一次得到 `duplicate`，不新开票

这不等于底座的 Assignment，也没有调用 `DshExecutor.start`。产品层的角色写在卡片上，实现层仍是一票一个会话名。派工在分发器的 `ExecutorPort`：默认 `LocalExecutor`。设置 `DAOGANG_DSH_ROOT` 时，适配器才按路径调用克隆里的 `start` / `deliver`。

## 对照上游食谱

不要把 [dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype) 整仓复制进来。Source 的写法以这篇为准：

[docs/008-cookbook.md](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype/blob/main/docs/008-cookbook.md)

| 食谱 | 本包 | 状态 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 译成 Trigger（稳定 id、Thread、actor、`addressed`） | `inboxTrigger` | CLI 每条输入 `addressed: direct` |
| `scope`，未列入的对话仍交给 receive | `inboxKind.scope` → `inboxScope` | 只看 `meta.conversation`。真实 Engine 未挂 |
| Policy 的 explicit 与 admission `rows` | `inboxKind.policy`，Zod `schema` | 默认 `allowed: []`。`rows` 的形状在；名单还没有进底座已保存的 Policy |
| Channel：`send` 幂等，只有永久失败才 `gone` | 分发器里的 `main-stub` | 主窗是本地桩，不是底座 Channel.send |
| `threadContext` | — | 未做 |
| 插件 `name` / `inject` / `apply`，`effect` 里 register，循环里 `receive` | `apply` + `watchInbox` | `register` 的返回值当作卸载函数，和 `SourceRegistry.register` 一样 |
| `package.json` exports、`cordis.patch.yml` insert | `exports["."]` → `lib/index.js`、`cordis.patch.yml` | 默认 `disabled: true`。Node 不剥离 `node_modules` 里的 TypeScript，所以入口是构建产物 |

`@deepseek-ai/cordis` 和 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 都不是本包的 dependency 或 peerDependency。唯一的依赖是 `zod@4.4.3`，和上游锁定的主版本一致，用来提供 `schema.parse` / `safeParse`。pnpm 会把可选 peer 写进锁文件并装上，所以这里不声明 cordis。执行口用 `DAOGANG_DSH_ROOT` 指到本机克隆；要让 Cordis 解析到本包，在 DSH profile 里用 `file:` 或 `link:`。

不能依赖的内部类见仓库 [底座结构笔记 §6](../../docs/notes/底座结构笔记-2026-11-01.md)。本包不 import `Engine`、`Store`、`DshExecutor`。

## 挂到本机 DSH 克隆

上游单独 clone，不要复制进本仓。下面的安装不需要 API key。`dsh` 的版本号来自上游 `docs/006-deployment.md` 里当时写明的公开 pin；`engines.dsh` 仍是 `^0.2.1-alpha.2`。

```bash
# 终端 A：上游自己的目录
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype.git
cd dsh-superagent-prototype
pnpm install && pnpm build

# 还没有 superagent profile 时，按上游 Install 一节（会装公开的 dsh CLI，不需要模型 key）：
# npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.3
# dsh superagent --from-default-profile web --dump-config > /dev/null
# dsh plugin --profile superagent add "link:$PWD"

# 终端 B：本仓。把 inbox Source 装进同一个 profile。两条里走一条。
# link: 与上游给自己 bundle 的写法相同。file: 一样能被 Node 解析。
dsh plugin --profile superagent add "link:$PWD/packages/inbox-source"
# dsh plugin --profile superagent add "file:$PWD/packages/inbox-source"
```

改过 `src/` 之后先构建，再挂。仓库里已经有一份 `lib/`，没改源码就不用再构建：

```bash
pnpm build:inbox
```

`dsh plugin add` 读到 `package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch`，把本包加进 profile 的 bundle 列表。补丁 [cordis.patch.yml](./cordis.patch.yml) 插入 `id: daogang-inbox`，**默认 `disabled: true`**。Cordis 对 `disabled: true` 的条目不 import。

Node 拒绝剥离 `node_modules` 里的 `.ts`（`ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING`）。`file:` 会进 pnpm 的 store，因此入口必须是 `lib/index.js`。`link:` 通常是指到仓库目录的符号链接，解析到的也是这份构建产物。

要打开，把 [examples/profile.cordis.patch.yml](./examples/profile.cordis.patch.yml) 里的两行合并进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（上游示例是 `~/.dsh/profiles/superagent/cordis.patch.yml`）。不要把本包补丁里的 `disabled` 改成 `false` 再交回上游。

没有 `dsh` CLI 时，可以先只检查包能否被解析。在一个空目录里：

```bash
pnpm add @daogang/inbox-source@file:<到岗仓>/packages/inbox-source
node --input-type=module -e "import('@daogang/inbox-source').then(m => console.log(m.name, typeof m.apply, typeof m.inboxKind.schema.safeParse))"
```

期望打出 `daogang-inbox function function`。

对照克隆里的注册表（不启动 DSH，不读密钥）：

```bash
# 在本仓。DAOGANG_DSH_ROOT 指向上游克隆，且该目录已经 pnpm install。
DAOGANG_DSH_ROOT=<上游克隆> node scripts/check-inbox-attach.mjs
```

没设这个变量时，脚本只检查本包的 export、补丁和 Zod，然后退出 0。`pnpm test` 不读它。

## 默认行为

- 插件名 `daogang-inbox`，`inject` 是 `orchestrator`。这个服务由上游 `Runtime` 提供，和 `github-watch` 一样。
- 配置 schema 默认 `{ conversation: 'cli' }`。只匹配这一条对话。多余的键或非法对话名让 `safeParse` 失败，`SourceRegistry` 会关掉该实例并回落到这份默认。
- 策略 schema 默认 `{ allowed: [] }`。没人被写成可以发起工作。
- `configured()` 为 false 时循环上报 `setupPending` 并且不 `receive`。底座的 `configured()` 要等 GitHub 仓库和智能体 CLI 通过 Setup；飞书可以空着。`SETUP_FIELDS` 里没有 `inbox`。

## 无密钥核对（2026-11-02）

上游是公开仓 `main` 的 `6337fc823ce20251c8de8085948165c81aaa701e`。克隆只留在检查机上，没有抄进本仓，也没有改它。没有 API key，没有调用 `gh` / `lark-cli`。

已经对上的：

- `pnpm add` 的 `file:` 和 `link:` 都能 `import('@daogang/inbox-source')`，得到 `daogang-inbox` 和 `schema.safeParse`。改成 `lib/index.js` 之前，`file:` 进 `node_modules` 会在加载 `.ts` 时被 Node 拒绝。
- 已发布的 `@deepseek-ai/cordis@4.0.5` 与 `@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader@1.0.6`：`disabled: true` 不加载模块；打开之后 `apply` 会 `register`。`safeParse({})` 成功，非法配置失败。宿主 `configured()` 为 false 时上报 `setupPending`，不 `receive`。这是临时 loader 加一个假的 `orchestrator`，不是 dsh-superagent 进程。
- 克隆里的 `SourceRegistry`：只有 `parse`、没有 `safeParse` 的 schema，`instances()` 抛 `safeParse is not a function`。本包的 Zod schema 可以被登记。存进去的非法配置会把实例关掉，并回落到 `{ conversation: 'cli' }`。`scope` 对其他对话给出 `conversation_not_listed`。`register` 的返回值能卸掉 kind。
- 克隆里的 `Setup.run`（空 settings）：返回 false，`configured()` 为 false，`problem.code` 是 `repositoryUnset`（位置 `github`）。空飞书 CLI 的 `resolveFeishuBot` 得到 `undefined`，不单独失败。`SETUP_FIELDS` 只有 `github` 的 `repository` / `cli` 和 `feishu` 的 `cli`，没有 `inbox`。自定义 Source 不加 Setup 字段，但没配 GitHub 仓库时整个 runtime 的 `configured()` 仍是 false。
- `dsh@0.2.1-rc.3`：用 web 模板建了一个临时 profile，没有装 dsh-superagent 本体，也没有启动进程。`dsh plugin --profile superagent add` 的 `file:` 和随后的 `link:` 都成功，本包进入 dependencies 和 `dsh.profile.bundles`。`dsh --profile superagent --dump-config` 退出 0，组合结果里有 `id: daogang-inbox`、`name: '@daogang/inbox-source'`、`disabled: true`。

`scripts/check-inbox-attach.mjs` 复跑的是 `SourceRegistry` 和 `Setup` 这一段。上游源码用了参数属性，脚本会自己加上 Node 的 `--experimental-transform-types`，不必先 `pnpm build` 上游。

## 还没验证

没有启动 superagent 进程，临时 profile 里也没有 dsh-superagent 的 `orchestrator`。活的 worker Session、卡片进 worker prompt、enqueue 写进底座 SQLite，都没有。Channel 和 `threadContext` 没做。临时 loader 不是上游 `Runtime` 那条整链。

# 到岗（daogang）

一句话把 agent 叫到岗：打断能接住，走神能续上。

到岗是叠在 [deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype) 上的拟人化实时协作层。人只面对一条对话；后台判断这句话该谁接、有多急，再把活派进对应的工单会话。招领看板不负责派活：它做审计和交接，并在派单失败时接住。

面向作品集，也给以后的宿主插件留接口。可用版之后的适配顺序是 **对影**，然后 zcode，然后 Codex。

## 为什么做

任务看板和 multi-agent 编排已经很多。缺的是工作节奏：永远秒回像假人，只靠异步轮询又像失联。到岗把「像同事」拆成可以复跑的五件事：即时到场、接得住打断、走神能回来、响应节奏不像机器、记得刚才说过的话。

底座于 2026-10-31 以 MIT 开源，周边还空。到岗不改它的内核，只走它公开的扩展面。

## 架构草图

```
一句话
  → 外围分发器
      Flash 路由 + 关键词兜底
      { target, urgency, cards }
  → inbox Source（合法 Trigger）
  → 底座 Ticket / Assignment
  → 每个 Ticket 一个 worker Session
      launch / delivery
  → 自建审计板（SQLite + JSONL）
      留痕，交接备注 ≤ 200 字
      目标离线或超时 → 落板招领
```

技术前提以 2026-11-01 的结构笔记为准：

- 底座是 **TypeScript / pnpm / DeepSeek Harness（Cordis）**，不是 Python 应用。
- 扩展路径是 **Source 插件 + 外围分发器**。上游有 Panel（运维侧栏）和 Source 先例，没有名为 bridge 的扩展层。
- Worker 是 **一张 Ticket 一个 Session**（`worker-<ticketId>`），不是三个一直活着的角色进程。角色可以有多个，用路由表映射到 Ticket。
- 上游仓库关闭了 Issues。待验证问题记在本仓笔记里。

分发器先放在外围：自己做路由、打断和 mixed 拆分，再经 Source 注入。站稳之后再考虑收成 Cordis 插件。

## 外围可用版 `0.1.0-peripheral`

这一版是外围 CLI，不是挂进 DeepSeek Harness 的插件。没有 API key 也能跑。

今天能用：

- `pnpm dispatch` / `pnpm listen`：一句话进，打出 `{target, urgency, cards}`。没设 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 时用关键词；设了才请求 `deepseek-flash`，失败仍回落关键词。
- 闲聊走 `mainReply`（通道 `main-stub`），和任务腿分开。任务排队或失败时，主窗回复已经留下。
- 更高优先级打断正在忙的工单：那一行改成 `queued`，交接备注不超过 200 字。同级或更低只排队。
- 接单失败追加 `"status":"claim"` 的招领行。`DAOGANG_FAIL_LANE=task` 用来演示离线或超时。
- `bash scripts/demo.sh` 把上面串成一次终端演示。记录在 [docs/demo/peripheral.cast](docs/demo/peripheral.cast)。GIF 还没有。

**B2 仍半开。** 默认没有真 DSH 会话。可选根目录只把 `start` / `deliver` 的 enqueue 接上，不拉起 worker。

- 默认执行口是 `LocalExecutor`（`packages/dispatcher/src/executor.ts`）。它把派工记在 `.daogang/executor.json`，会话名是 `worker-<ticketId>`。不需要密钥，也不需要 clone 底座。
- `DAOGANG_EXECUTOR=dsh` 且没设 `DAOGANG_DSH_ROOT`：和以前一样，抛出「DSH 未接线」，这次派工落成招领。
- 设了 `DAOGANG_DSH_ROOT`（且没有把执行口显式锁成 `local`）：适配器按路径加载该克隆里的 `DshExecutor`，调用 `start` → `enqueue('launch', assignmentId, { ticketId, assignmentId })`，`deliver` → `enqueue('delivery', ticketId, { ticketId })`。入队记在到岗侧的站位 effects 上，不写底座 SQLite，也不进私有 `launch()`。克隆加载失败同样落招领。
- 卡片仍在审计行里。上游把卡片写进 worker prompt 的逻辑在私有 `launch()`，这一步不调用。
- inbox Source 可以按 [packages/inbox-source/README.md](packages/inbox-source/README.md) 用 `file:` 或 `link:` 挂到本机 DSH 克隆，默认 `disabled: true`。本地 `LocalInbox` 仍是 CLI 的接单路径。`configured()` 在空 GitHub 配置下为 false，这一点在上游克隆里核对过；Cordis 整链进程和活 worker Session **未验证**。

## 状态

- 2026-11-01：阶段 A 完成。底座结构笔记和 MVP 边界已写入 `docs/notes/`。
- 版本号写在根 `package.json` 的 `0.1.0-peripheral`。这是外围可用版，不是底座插件发布。

## 快速试跑

需要 Node.js `>=22.19` 和 pnpm 10。没有 API key 也能跑。

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm test
pnpm dispatch -- "帮我补上安装说明"
pnpm board
```

`pnpm dispatch` 往标准输出打一份 JSON：`target`、`urgency`、`cards`，以及本地 inbox 的接单回执。审计行在 `.daogang/board.jsonl`（可用 `DAOGANG_HOME` 改目录）。`.daogang/` 不进仓库。

从标准输入读一行：

```bash
printf '%s\n' "你好" | pnpm dispatch
```

常驻进程，一行一句，直到标准输入结束：

```bash
pnpm listen
```

设置密钥后，同一条命令会先请求 `deepseek-flash`（思考模式关掉）。请求失败或没密钥时仍回落到关键词。变量见 `.env.example`。不要把真实密钥提交进仓库。

接单回执里的 `worker-<ticketId>` 是本地会话名，用来把「有人接」跑通。它还不是底座里那个 Ticket Session。

## 两条路

### 纯外围演示

不设置 `DAOGANG_DSH_ROOT`，也不要 `DAOGANG_EXECUTOR=dsh`。上面的 `pnpm test`、`pnpm dispatch` 和 `bash scripts/demo.sh` 都走这条路。`scripts/demo.sh` 会把执行口锁成 `local` 并清空 `DAOGANG_DSH_ROOT`，避免外壳里已经导出的根目录把演示带进适配器。

### 可选：指向本机 DSH 克隆

底座仓库单独 clone，不要复制进本仓。`@deepseek-ai/cordis` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 不是本仓的 dependencies，也不是 peerDependencies（pnpm 会把可选 peer 装进锁文件）。inbox Source 的挂载步骤、默认关闭的补丁，以及无密钥核对了什么，写在 [packages/inbox-source/README.md](packages/inbox-source/README.md)。

```bash
# 终端 A：上游自己的目录，按它的 README 安装依赖。本仓测试不需要这一步。
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype.git
cd dsh-superagent-prototype

# 终端 B：本仓
export DAOGANG_DSH_ROOT=/绝对路径/dsh-superagent-prototype
pnpm dispatch -- "帮我补上安装说明"
```

成功时输出里 `executor` 是 `dsh`，回执会话名仍是 `worker-<ticketId>`。这只说明克隆里的 `DshExecutor.start` 对站位 `effects.enqueue('launch', …)` 被调用了。失败时标准输出里有招领行，原因以 `DSH 加载失败` 或 `DSH 未接线` 开头。

插件文件在 `packages/inbox-source/cordis.patch.yml`，默认 `disabled: true`。profile 里另写 `id: daogang-inbox` 且 `disabled: false` 才会启用。入口是 `lib/index.js`。下面几件在无密钥检查里已经对上，细节见 inbox Source 的说明：空 GitHub 配置时 `configured()` 为 false（`repositoryUnset`）；空飞书 CLI 不单独挡住；`SETUP_FIELDS` 没有 `inbox`；Zod schema 能被 `SourceRegistry` 收下，只有 `parse` 的 schema 会被拒。

`dsh@0.2.1-rc.3` 在临时 profile 上试过 `plugin add`（`file:` 与 `link:`）和 `--dump-config`：组合结果里有默认关闭的 `daogang-inbox`。那个 profile 没有启动，也没有装上 dsh-superagent。

下面几件仍然 **未验证**：

- 正在跑的 superagent 进程，以及 `orchestrator` 注入后的整链
- enqueue 是否写进底座 Effects 的 SQLite，以及 worker Session 会不会起来
- 卡片文本有没有进入 worker prompt

## 接着试

快速试跑不用改。下面这组用一块干净目录，把主窗、打断和招领连起来。仍然不需要 API key。

```bash
bash scripts/demo.sh
```

脚本里发生四件事：先派一件普通任务；再派一句更急的 mixed（输出里有 `mainReply`，同时把上一张工单改成排队并写交接备注）；再派一件不急的，它只排队、不打断；最后用 `DAOGANG_FAIL_LANE=task` 让任务腿失败，看板上多一行 `"status":"claim"`。`pnpm board` 打在最后。

同一段输出也录在 `docs/demo/peripheral.cast`。装了 asciinema 时可以 `asciinema play docs/demo/peripheral.cast`。需要重录时跑 `node scripts/record-cast.mjs`。没有 GIF。

## 文档

- [文档索引](docs/README.md)
- [开发预案](docs/开发预案-到岗-2026-11-01.md)
- [任务清单](docs/TASKS.md)
- [底座结构笔记](docs/notes/底座结构笔记-2026-11-01.md)
- [MVP 边界：外围分发器](docs/notes/MVP边界-外围分发器-2026-11-01.md)
- [HostAdapter：对影优先](docs/notes/HostAdapter-对影-2026-11-01.md)

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 lingze818-maker

本仓库是独立实验，不是 DeepSeek 官方产品。上游原型：[deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype)（MIT）。

# dsh-intelligent-UI

An independent open-source presentation plugin for the official DeepSeek Harness Desktop, with an offline UI component library built in. This repository contains the intelligent renderer, silent frontend-development tools and themes in one project and one installable plugin. It builds and tests on its own and uses the official application unchanged.

The historical package name **`@lisihao/dsh-solar-intelligent-experience-platform`**, RPC/tool names and data directory are retained for installed-user compatibility. They do not introduce a dependency on another project. The public preview is distributed as a prebuilt GitHub Release archive. npm publication is not required; community-market listing depends on the catalog maintainers accepting its entry.

**内置组件智能**：同一个插件包含 Uiverse 离线组件库、静默前端开发 skill 和自动内容渲染。开发时可按需检索 3,802 个真实组件；展示图表、任务、记录和流程时，自动使用 15 个经过适配验证的组件，并保留原文、数据与来源。

## Built-in component intelligence

Uiverse component reuse is a core feature of intelligent UI, shared by frontend development and live content presentation.

| Path | Automatic behavior | Source evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Intelligent content rendering | Local analyzers recognize charts, tasks, records and flows; semantic roles select approved card/control adapters while keeping the chosen theme. Empryo and other v1 themes participate automatically; explicit component themes keep their selection. | Fifteen compiled source-backed adaptations carry original component IDs and SHA-256 on rendered elements. |
| Frontend development | The model discovers the bundled skill for frontend/UI tasks, searches suitable components and reads their complete source before adapting new controls. Existing suitable project controls take precedence. | All **3,802 components in 11 categories** from the official Galaxy snapshot, with authors, license, original source and hashes. |
| Source-preserving review | Original/comparison views retain text, tables, units and qualifications; isolated previews can be inspected within the authorized task. | The same pinned archive backs lookup and live adapter provenance. |

The archive pin is [`adbd2adde0a299a3956ea288fb444ec01891ca41`](https://github.com/uiverse-io/galaxy/tree/adbd2adde0a299a3956ea288fb444ec01891ca41), dated 2024-09-02. It is a complete snapshot of that archive, rather than a current full-site mirror. Live presentation uses the curated compiled adaptations; the full archive supplies development lookup and sandbox previews. OpenUI still owns its chart marks and native form internals.

The component capability is silent: it adds no library sidebar, page or popup. Its model-invocable skill loads on demand through DSH's official skill mechanism. `solar_ui_search`, `solar_ui_source` and `solar_ui_preview` are included in this plugin; a separately installed component plugin is unnecessary. Normal tool history and the owner's permissions remain in effect. Actual model selection varies with the model and task; runtime semantic layout selection itself requires no extra model call.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Original content] --> B[Local semantic analysis]
  B --> C[Component role selection]
  C --> D[Theme-consistent live adapters]
  U[Pinned Uiverse archive] --> C
  U --> S[Silent frontend skill and tools]
```

See [component architecture and boundaries](docs/design/integrated-uiverse.md), [runtime selector](src/uiverse-render.ts), [silent Host capability](src/uiverse/host.ts) and [source manifest](resources/uiverse/upstream.json).

## Research workspace (preview)

The conversation-level **研究工作区** control adds report, judgments, sources and technical-comparison views inside the current UI-owned output. Reading remains source-preserving. Citation links and table cells open the report-local evidence inspector; returning to a source block retains the report. The inspector distinguishes a reference recorded in the report from an independently checked external source.

The first six components cover judgments, conditions, evidence inspection, technical comparisons, alternative/challenging material and open questions. Explicitly different conditions are grouped separately for charts while every original table row stays available. No causal edge, statistical significance or numeric confidence is invented.

**AI 整理** is opt-in: review its inline fee notice and start a visible request in the current conversation using its selected model. The plugin does not change model/provider/tool settings. The requested task is organization of supplied report text; execution still follows the existing session's permissions, not a new isolated research engine. Returned quote anchors and report identity are checked, but AI interpretations remain **待复核**. Human notes/review and editable question drafts are stored separately. Follow-up drafts are copy-only and never sent automatically.

Research metadata lives only in this plugin's `research/` namespace. Reopening the same source restores its notes; changed source text cannot silently reuse a pending analysis. Uncertain submissions are not replayed. No other plugin's code, original report or session data is rewritten. Cross-session topics, autonomous research, cross-report change analysis and scenario simulation are future work.

This is source/build candidate behavior; the new archive requires centralized Desktop installation acceptance. See [design and interfaces](docs/design/research-workspace.md) and the [candidate acceptance record](docs/acceptance/2026-11-01-research-workspace.md). Screenshots and private runtime receipts are never committed or uploaded.

## What it does

- Optional takeover of standard assistant/tool output and generated content. One conversation-level **显示** control switches visual, original and comparison views.
- Local content analysis chooses suitable icons, charts, table columns, relationship graphs, read-only task boards and list/detail layouts. It preserves original text, cells, units, qualifications and complete tables. Unsupported content remains readable; no model call is required to choose a layout.
- Unmodified OpenUI components supply Markdown, charts, forms and streaming UI. React Flow and ELK supply source-relationship diagrams with animated edges, pause, pan/zoom and keyboard selection. Edges describe source relationships and do not assert that work executed.
- Content-aware Uiverse adapters are selected automatically for supported UI-owned semantic surfaces. Three explicit component themes also supply coordinated buttons, inputs, toggles, cards and loaders, with original-source comparison. Foreign pages retain token/CSS appearance compatibility and their original behavior. See [mapping and compatibility](docs/design/uiverse-component-themes.md).
- Selectable data-only themes control color, typography, roundness, density, depth and transparency. Compatible independent conversation pages receive reversible appearance rules while retaining their original components and behavior.
- An optional, explicitly configured MCP Apps adapter preserves UI metadata and uses an isolated bridge. Existing MCP connections are untouched. This connector remains off by default.

The official DSH navigation and settings stay in place. Disabling takeover restores original output/page presentation. Disabling or uninstalling this plugin removes its owned styles, controls and listeners; retained plugin data remains in its own namespace. It does not patch foreign plugin packages, source or configuration.

## Install and use

Compatibility target: **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**, macOS arm64. Install a built archive through the official plugin manager. Back up affected profile configuration and quit the app before updating an existing installation:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add --ignore-scripts \
  "https://github.com/lisihao/dsh-intelligent-UI/releases/download/%40lisihao%2Fdsh-solar-intelligent-experience-platform%400.1.0-preview.1/lisihao-dsh-solar-intelligent-experience-platform-0.1.0-preview.1.tgz"
```

Use the official application's bundled `dsh` CLI for an installed Desktop profile. Lifecycle scripts are disabled; the published renderer does not need its optional install telemetry.

In **Settings → 智能体验**, enable **接管输出与兼容页面外观**. Initial takeover is off. The conversation header has one **开启透明** checkbox, synchronized with content appearance settings. It reveals a wallpaper already supplied by the host; this plugin does not read or change the wallpaper file, and it does not make the native window transparent to the macOS desktop.

### Updating an older two-package installation

Earlier previews installed `@lisihao/dsh-solar-uiverse-components` separately. This feature now belongs to the intelligent UI package. Disable/remove that former companion through the normal plugin manager before installing the integrated build, then restart normally. Its occupied tool/skill/service names produce a clear `UIVERSE_REGISTRATION_CONFLICT` rather than replacing another owner. Preserve existing settings, sessions and other plugins. The preview is supplied as a built GitHub Release archive. Community-market catalog review is separate from downloading or installing it.

### Themes and content appearance

The default theme source is this independent repository's [`theme/` directory](https://github.com/lisihao/dsh-intelligent-UI/tree/main/theme). In **界面主题 → 主题来源**, change the directory address and choose **保存来源**; **恢复默认来源** restores this repository. **浏览来源主题** reads its `index.json`; **下载导入** downloads and verifies the chosen package before adding it to the selector. Network/format/checksum errors are visible and leave installed themes intact. Downloading an identical built-in is acknowledged without duplicating or overwriting it. A custom source can be a GitHub `tree/branch/directory` URL or an HTTP(S) directory with the same catalog format. Source selection persists across restarts; the plugin sends no GitHub credential or private Session data to the theme source.

**Paper · 连续信息流** adds a source-ordered composition inspired by [paper.design](https://paper.design/): an arched intro, wide primary scenes, source-paragraph captions and expandable long argument. Real period tabs and optional demonstration playback select actual charts; narrative tables can use read-only list/detail. It reuses the existing OpenUI charts and a single Markdown AST, preserving reference links, footnotes, full tables and data definitions. Select the downloadable Paper theme with the updated plugin; old themes keep document layout. Streaming and short prose keep their ordinary presentation. See [design / compatibility](docs/design/paper-flow.md).

**界面主题** includes built-in Empryo and **简洁**. The default online source also offers **炭墨 · Carbon**, **钴夜 · Cobalt**, **暖金 · Amber** and **雾白 · Porcelain**, adapted from the supplied Unslop references; see [theme collection and attribution](docs/design/unslop-themes.md). Import a UTF-8 `.dsh-theme.json` package, then select it; importing alone does not activate it. Download the current package or an authoring example from Settings. Removing an active imported theme restores Empryo. Theme selection/import/removal are owner-only, revision-checked and durable.

Empryo uses translucent dark gray by default, rounded panels and subtle hover lift. 简洁 uses an opaque dark gray, system fonts and standard comparisons. The color picker and transparency toggle override appearance; selecting a different theme applies its defaults. Reduced-motion preferences suppress lift and animation.

Theme packages contain validated JSON tokens, with no executable code, arbitrary CSS or remote assets. Unknown fields/versions, packages above 32 KiB, duplicate/reserved IDs and more than 32 imported packages are rejected. See the [theme examples](theme/README.md), [format and lifecycle](docs/design/experience-themes.md), and [design system](DESIGN.md).

### Optional MCP Apps

Set this plugin's native `mcpEndpoint` Config to the explicitly chosen HTTP(S) server and enable MCP Apps. URLs containing embedded credentials are refused. This adapter denies external resource networks, device permissions and sampling. Model/tool actions use DSH's normal tool guards; durable action receipts prevent automatically replaying an outcome that is uncertain. Opening a saved result reuses that result rather than rerunning the original tool.

## Data and boundaries

Plugin-owned data is confined to `$DSH_HOME/solar/intelligent-experience-platform/`: versioned settings, per-session artifacts, widget state and action receipts. Config limits default to 1 MiB per artifact and 500 artifacts per Session; exceeding them fails explicitly rather than silently truncating source data. Historical sessions cannot recover metadata that the original host never saved.

Appearance support is a bounded adapter to known public conversation-view outlets and neutral variables. Persona, Mnemon memory, context, execution and benchmark controls remain owned by their respective plugins. Their appearance compatibility does not imply that every business operation has been tested. Billion-context's pre-existing unbound-proxy behavior is not fixed by this plugin. The known same-origin ThoughtDAG canvas has an explicit reversible stylesheet bridge; unknown frames, cross-origin apps and unrelated portals are excluded. See [upgrade boundaries](UPGRADING.md) before changing host or external-plugin versions.

## Development

Use Node **22.19+ within v22, or v24+**, and pnpm **10.31.0**. All required DSH packages are published dependencies pinned to the baseline; no host source checkout is required.

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
pnpm check
```

`check` builds the package, typechecks, runs unit/integration tests and installs the built package into a disposable published-DSH profile. The scratch test runs plain Node and a deterministic local Agent/tool adapter, checks sources/settings/disposal, exercises owner-only theme RPCs and verifies persistence across separate Host processes. It makes no external model call and does not use the installed Desktop profile. Local HTTP transport tests require permission to bind loopback sockets.

For a browser preview:

```sh
pnpm build:preview
python3 -m http.server 4173 --bind 127.0.0.1
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:4173/tools/browser-experience/`. This preview uses a local stub and synthetic examples by default. `EXPERIENCE_MARKDOWN_REPORT`, `EXPERIENCE_REAL_REPORT` and `EXPERIENCE_LAYOUT_OUTPUTS` accept explicit local inputs. Keep research reports, account data, receipts and captures outside Git. The preview is not installed-app acceptance.

`tools/real-layout-output.mjs --help` exports actual source imports, package commands and reference-analysis records; an explicitly supplied Vitest JSON report adds actual task records. `tools/real-output-demo.mjs --help` and `tools/installed-canary.mjs --help` describe optional retained-profile helpers. Those helpers write to an explicitly supplied DSH home and require separate installation/acceptance authorization; `pnpm check` does not invoke them.

## Verification status

The integrated source is checked through build, types, unit/integration tests and a disposable published-DSH Host with a deterministic keyless Agent. The integration checks the official skill loader, model visibility, original component source, previews, tool availability, runtime role selection, theme/state preservation and disposal. See [current integration evidence](docs/acceptance/2026-11-01-integrated-uiverse.md) for exact results and native acceptance limits.

Earlier installed-app receipts cover their exact historical archives. The integrated research preview still needs a new normal Desktop installation receipt. Build, type checks, 347 tests, a disposable Host/Agent and browser interaction checks passed before packaging. No paid model selection test, exhaustive foreign-plugin business-flow test or npm publication is implied. Market visibility follows the community catalog review, not source publication alone.

The [Empryo reference analysis](docs/design/empryo-foundation.md), [token catalog](docs/design/empryo-tokens.json) and [local reference atlas](docs/design/empryo-atlas.html) document the visual foundation. They are analysis records, not copied Empryo application source or branding assets.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). Bundled Recursive and DM Sans font files retain the SIL Open Font License in `assets/Recursive-OFL.txt` and `assets/DM-Sans-OFL.txt`; dependency attribution and redistribution notes are in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). OpenUI, React Flow, ELK and other projects are consumed through pinned published packages behind this plugin's adapters, without carried upstream source patches.

### Settings layout

Theme selection, online sources and local theme files use compact groups and a shared control scale. Settings have an opaque backing in the selected background color to keep underlying report text from interfering with controls; content transparency and hover effects remain independently adjustable.

### Hover and background transparency

Ordinary AI reply cards lift slightly on mouse hover; reduced-motion preferences disable the displacement. Hover or focus **开启透明** to reveal the background-transparency range. The public preview is distributed as a prebuilt GitHub Release archive. npm publication is not required; community-market listing depends on the catalog maintainers accepting its entry.
