# OmniMux

角色生成与视频复刻
用文字或照片建立角色，结合参考视频制作角色视频

--- ## 简介 **OmniMux 聚焦角色生成与视频复刻。** 从文字描述或有权使用的照片建立角色，结合参考视频制作角色视频，核心创作能力为生图与生视频。现行定位与表述边界见[产品定位](docs/contracts/product-positioning.md)。 本仓是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的桌面插件工程，不是官网工作台源码。官网的角色创建旅程不等于本仓已经逐项完成；实际能力须核对[能力记录](docs/capabilities.md)、当前代码及对应版本证据。 灵感、素材、画布与必要剪辑服务于角色视频成片。多账号矩阵、自动排期和独立运营分析不是默认产品主线；不承诺固定降本比例、零抽成或素材始终只留本地。 ## AI 应用：历史目标与审计边界 以下通用应用是历史方案，不是当前产品扩展任务；现行范围见[产品定位](docs/contracts/product-positioning.md)。历史目标是 schema 驱动的通用应用，而非写死业务页面：唯一宿主入口，视频/图片/音频三类二级栏，选应用后收起且可重开；compact tabs 后单个左右大卡片，左表单、右历史/示例。空历史默认示例但不得伪造历史；发布者自主上传/选择多图、多视频与封面并保存 Demo 输入快照。 **纠正此前不实宣称**：针对固定审计基线 `e416238631cc78ef8caeab7b5313d9571947ef5a` 至目标 `a1ecf7bddc110992d870efd3b4e56511dfe43c9e`，Production Ready、零缺陷、端到端闭环、Apps 持久化、CI 已接入、11 组对抗测试、完整团队 TDD 均不成立。仅有 4 个 Apps 单测与 1 个 mock seam 单测通过、弱静态扫描通过；原区间 `git diff --check` 因行尾空白失败。上述结果不能替代真实宿主、媒体播放与执行验收。 固定目标 SHA 的原型仍为未挂载向导、内存 Registry、硬编码表单、4 秒 mock 成功、无真实播放器/上传选择器；原型代码留在 `omnimux-dsh-wt-contracts`，不代表 main、Dev 或生产已具备这些能力。本次仅将已审计文档融合到 main 基线，不合入原型代码，没有修复代码、接入 CI 或完成运行验收。 具体目标与需求—验收—实现状态见 [AI 应用 UI 规范](docs/contracts/ai-app-ui-spec.md)；目标职责、技术约束与已验证源码缺口见 [Canvas / Apps 边界](docs/contracts/workflow-app-boundary.md)。Canvas 调度，Hub 管凭证、provider HTTP 与模型路由，Apps 管表单、发布规范和域存储；Apps 不重造执行器。计费/退款/算力、评分、第四类 agent、VS SYNC/wipe、冗余回填及工作流源链接不属于本次 AI 应用需求。 ## 工程结构与能力状态 执行中枢负责身份、凭证、模型路由与媒体执行；领域插件管理各自的素材、灵感、画布和剪辑职责。结构与术语见 [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md)，调用边界见[中枢合同](docs/contracts/hub.md)。 已有账号、发布、运营分析等插件保留其技术职责，但不因存在源码而成为当前对外承诺。安装阶段以[插件生命周期清单](plugins/omnimux/src/plugin-lifecycle.json)为准，真实可用性以[能力记录](docs/capabilities.md)及当前验收为准，不维护第二份正式可用徽章或素材数量表。 ## 文档入口 | 需要了解什么 | 入口 | | --- | --- | | 当前产品方向与宣传边界 | [产品定位](docs/contracts/product-positioning.md) | | 角色视频制作的目标与验收 | [角色生成与视频复刻指南](docs/guides/ecommerce-video-replication.md) | | 开发文档与适用合同 | [文档导航](docs/README.md)、[智能体约束](AGENTS.md) | | 灵感库合集整理与能力状态 | [灵感插件说明](plugins/omnimux-inspiration/README.md#本地灵感合集)、[能力记录](docs/capabilities.md) | | 中枢接口目录快照 | [接口面板](docs/tools/hub-interfaces.html)，不是部署状态或上游能力真源 | | 软件使用与商业授权 | [许可原文](LICENSE)、[商业授权说明](COMMERCIAL.md)，不等于生成免费 | | 第三方来源与许可 | [致谢与第三方声明](ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md) | ## 💼 许可 OmniMux 自行编写的插件代码采用 **[AGPL-3.0](LICENSE)**，另附 [NOTICE](NOTICE) 中的 AGPLv3 第 7 条署名要求；同时提供商业授权，与 [new-api](https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api) 的做法相同。 | 用法 | AGPL-3.0（免费） | 商业授权 | | :--- | :---: | :---: | | 个人、团队或企业使用、修改、自行部署，包括商业用途 | ✅ | ✅ | | 修改后对外提供服务或分发，且公开修改后的源码 | ✅ | ✅ | | 修改后对外提供服务或分发，但不公开修改 | ❌ | ✅ | | 移除 `Powered by OmniMux` 署名，以自有品牌发布 | ❌ | ✅ | 从上游 fork 或引入的代码保留原许可（多为 MIT），见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) 第 4 节与 [ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md](ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md)。2026-10-28 之前发布的版本按其发布时的许可证授权。许可不等于生成免费，详见 [COMMERCIAL.md](COMMERCIAL.md)。 统一源码公开仓：[omnimux-ai/omnimux-ai](https://github.com/omnimux-ai/omnimux-ai)（`plugins/` 将收录本仓源码）。 ## 🚀 快速启动 (Quickstart) ### 环境要求 * **Node.js**：`^22.19 || >=24` * **pnpm**：`>=9` * **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**：通过 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh` 或本地 DSH 环境运行。 ### 本地开发与交付 从 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) 和[仓库 workflow](.agents/skills/omnimux-repo-workflow/SKILL.md)进入开发流程： 1. 在仓内隔离 worktree 实施，运行与变更面相关的自动化测试、静态检查和独立评审；选择依据见[插件 QA](docs/contracts/plugin-qa.md)。例如在当前任务 worktree 执行 `pnpm --filter test`，文档变更执行 `git diff --check` 与 `pnpm doc:lint`。 2. PR 满足 required CI，经 Merge Queue 合入 `main`。CI `qa:pass` 只证明合入前静态与测试，不证明 Dev 已通过。 3. 界面变更在任务隔离工作树内取得实际功能路径浏览器证据；合入后仅影响已安装运行时的改动物化 Dev `~/.omnimux-dev`。45120 的开发版验收由人工负责；纯文档无需安装或重启应用。完整规则见[插件 QA](docs/contracts/plugin-qa.md)。 没有合并前独立 App/Host 测试环境。不得将未合并 worktree link 或物化到 Dev/Prod；生产 `~/.omnimux`、`--prod`、`--all` 与正式发布仍需独立授权。完整边界见[开发环境合同](docs/contracts/dev-pipeline.md)。 --- ## 💬 社区交流与开发者群 (Community) 可选择常用的平台参与讨论，交流 AI 视频出片技巧、探讨插件二次开发、反馈需求与跟踪最新进展：
微信 / 企业微信开发者交流群 全球社交媒体与开发者频道

扫码加入 OmniMux 开发者交流群
（微信或企业微信均可扫码进入）

欢迎提交 Issue、参与功能共建或在 Discord / X 与全球开发者互动！
--- ## 🤝 贡献与共建 (Contributing) 我们非常欢迎开发者参与共建！无论是修复 Bug、编写文档，还是为 OmniMux 贡献新的 Agent Skills 或插件： 1. 查阅 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) 了解代码规范与 PR 提交流程。 2. 遵守 [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) 行为准则。 3. 发现安全问题请按照 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 私密通报。 --- ## 🙏 开源公示与致谢 (Acknowledgements & Third-Party Credits) OmniMux 的构建与演进站在了开源巨人的肩膀上，我们对以下直接 Fork、深度二开或集成的开源先锋项目致以由衷的敬意与感谢： * **[@cocofhu/skillhub](https://github.com/cocofhu/skillhub)** (MIT License, by [@cocofhu](https://github.com/cocofhu))：`omnimux-market` 插件市场（技能/插件/专家/连接器四 Tab 架构）的 Fork 二开真源。 * **[Augani/openreel-video](https://github.com/Augani/openreel-video)** (MIT License, by Augani)：`omnimux-clip` 剪辑工坊全套 WebCodecs/WebGPU 时间轴与微应用 Vendorize 真源。 * **[Crosery/dsh-viewer](https://github.com/Crosery/dsh-viewer)** (MIT License, by Crosery)：`omnimux-viewer` 全能媒体渲染器插件真源，提供 36 种媒体与文档格式的就地内联播放能力。 * **[omdsh-dev/dsh-browser](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser)** (MIT License, by Yuxiang Lin)：`omnimux-browser` 浏览器伴侣插件与 Chrome 扩展底座真源，打通网页媒体感知与双向桥接。 * **[deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)** (MIT License, by DeepSeek AI)：官方核心 Agent 运行底座与 Harness 插件规范。 * **[anywhere-labs/deepseek-harness-desktop](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/deepseek-harness-desktop)** (MIT License, by Anywhere Labs)：OmniMux 桌面端 Electron Shell 的 Fork 底座。 * **[@xyflow/react (React Flow)](https://github.com/xyflow/xyflow)** (MIT License, by xyflow)：`omnimux-workflow` 无限画布 DAG 节点连接与编排引擎。 * **[Umami Analytics](https://github.com/umami-software/umami)** (MIT License)：`omnimux-analytics` 隐私友好的插件指标与社媒运营分析。 * **[Blobatar](https://github.com/joshglendenning/blobatar)** (MIT License, by Josh Glendenning)：`omnimux` 账号与 Agent 动态色彩头像生成。 * **模式致敬**：感谢 **[n8n](https://n8n.io)**（可视化节点编排与可持续源码许可）的产品与商业化启发。 *完整第三方开源项目清单与许可证声明详见 **[ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md](ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md)**。* --- ## # omnimux-video 自包含的本地 ffmpeg 视频处理插件（OmniMux 插件套件成员）。通过 `video_process` 工具和一个 neutral seam `videoProcess` 暴露 12 项视频后处理能力：剪辑、合并、拆分、音频提取/重编码、缩略图、压缩、分镜、图文成片、字幕烧录导出、**黑白深度图视频**。 无 Docker、无 Gxgen 引擎、无云端、无 HTTP 桥接——纯本地 `ffmpeg` / `ffprobe` / ONNX Runtime 子进程，装好即用。 ## 前置 本机需要一个可用的 ffmpeg（含 ffprobe）。macOS 推荐： ```sh brew install ffmpeg ``` 深度图（`video_depth`）额外需要： ```sh pip install onnxruntime opencv-python ``` 首次运行会把 Depth Anything V2 Small ONNX 下载到 `$DSH_HOME/models/depth/`（或 `~/.dsh/models/depth/`）：`fast` 档用 int8 量化版（约 27MB），`quality` 档用 float32 版（约 99MB）。 ### 性能档位（`mode`） | 档位 | 模型 | 长边 | 实测（8.75s / 576×1024 / 210 帧） | 说明 | |---|---|---|---|---| | `fast`（默认） | int8 量化 | 384 | **约 10.5s**（20 fps） | 与 quality 相关性约 0.99，边缘略软 | | `quality` | float32 | 518 | 约 31s（6.8 fps） | 原始画质 | - 默认值可用 `Config.video.depthMode` 或环境变量 `OMNIMUX_VIDEO_DEPTH_MODE=quality` 覆盖；工具入参 `mode` 优先级最高。 - `auto` provider 顺序已改为 **CUDA → CPU → CoreML**：CoreML 在该模型上因分区回退实测只有 3.7 fps，不再优先。显式 `provider` 仍可强制。 每次 `video_depth` 执行前会按顺序挑选运行时： 1. 显式配置 `Config.video.pythonPath` / `OMNIMUX_VIDEO_PYTHON_PATH`：只认该解释器，失败不回退； 2. 系统 Python 候选链 `python3.16 → … → python3`（逐个探测 `numpy` / `cv2` / `onnxruntime`，选中首个可用的并缓存）； 3. **uv 托管运行时**（桌面 App 自带 uv，可免装 Python）：`OMNIMUX_UV_PATH` / `UV_PATH` 或 PATH 中的 `uv`，执行 `uv run --no-project --python 3.11 --with numpy --with opencv-python-headless==4.10.0.84 --with onnxruntime python depth_engine.py …`，首次运行由 uv 下载托管 Python 与 wheels 到自身缓存，之后复用；结果 `result.python` 标记 `uv (managed python 3.11)`。 三者都不可用时抛 `video-depth-deps-missing`（带已尝试解释器、安装与 `pythonPath` / `UV_PATH` 指引），不会把 Python traceback 直接抛给调用方。单个候选探测超时只会记为失败并继续下一个候选；只有调用方取消才立即中止。 ffmpeg 缺失不会阻止插件加载；工具/seam 调用时会抛 `ffmpeg-missing` 并给出安装指引。 ## 12 个能力 slug | slug | destKind | 默认超时 | 输入要点 | |---|---|---|---| | `media_metadata` | none | 120s | `mediaUrl` / `videoUrl` / `audioUrl`，`mediaKind?` | | `video_trim` | single | 600s | `videoUrl` + `startSeconds` / `durationSeconds` / `endSeconds` | | `video_merge` | single | 900s | `videoUrls[]`（≥2） | | `video_split` | multi | 900s | `videoUrl` + `segments[]` | | `audio_extract` | single | 600s | `videoUrl` + `outputFormat mp3\|m4a` | | `audio_prepare` | single | 300s | `audioUrl` + 重编码参数 | | `video_thumbnail_extract` | single | 180s | `videoUrl` + 时间/尺寸 | | `video_inline_analysis_prepare` | single | 600s | `videoUrl` + 体积上限（crf+scale 递减逼近）；显式 `preserveTimeline: true, keepAudio: true` 保留完整时间轴及可选 AAC 音轨，核验前后时长，超预算失败；默认仍为旧前 100 秒无声预览 | | `video_scene_detect` | multi | 300s | `videoUrl` + `threshold` | | `slideshow_export` | single | 1200s | `imageUrls[]` + 转场/背景乐 | | `video_export` | single | 1200s | `clips[]` + `subtitles` / 分辨率 / 画幅 | | `video_depth` | single | 1800s | `videoUrl` + `mode? fast\|quality` / `maxEdge?` / `invert?` / `sideBySide?` / `keepAudio?` | ## 聊天例子 ``` 把 ~/Desktop/a.mp4 截 2-7 秒 → video_process(video_trim, videoUrl, dest) 把 a.mp4 和 b.mp4 合并 → video_process(video_merge, videoUrls, dest) 把这 4 张图做成 9:16 轮播配背景乐 → video_process(slideshow_export, ...) 给这条片烧中文字幕，导出 9:16 720p → video_process(video_export, clips[] + subtitles, dest) 把舞蹈视频转成黑白深度图 → video_depth(video, dest) 或 video_process(video_depth, ...) 要更高画质 → video_depth(video, dest, mode: 'quality') ``` 工具的 `input` 字段值为本地绝对路径或 `http(s)` URL 皆可： - **单输入**能力（trim / metadata / extract / thumb / split / inline / depth）可直接把 URL 交给 ffmpeg； - **多输入**能力（merge / slideshow / export）需要 seekable 本地文件，URL 会自动物化到临时目录。 ## seam 例子 ```js const video = ctx.get('videoProcess') const out = await video.execute({ capability: 'video_merge', input: { videoUrls: ['/tmp/a.mp4', '/tmp/b.mp4'], keepAudio: true }, dest: '/tmp/merged.mp4', signal, // AbortSignal，可选 }) // out => { mode: 'live', files: [{ path, kind: 'video', meta }], result? } const depth = await video.execute({ capability: 'video_depth', input: { videoUrl: '/tmp/dance.mp4', maxEdge: 518, keepAudio: true }, dest: '/tmp/dance_depth.mp4', }) ``` ## Config / env Standard Schema `Config`（从 `src/config.js` re-export）： ```js Config.video = { ffmpegPath: '', // 空 = 走 PATH maxConcurrent: 2, // 并发子进程上限，超出排队 pythonPath: '', // 空 = python3；深度估计引擎解释器 modelsDir: '', // 空 = $DSH_HOME/models/depth 或 ~/.dsh/models/depth } ``` - 环境变量 `OMNIMUX_VIDEO_FFMPEG_PATH` 非空则覆盖 `Config.video.ffmpegPath`。 - 环境变量 `OMNIMUX_VIDEO_PYTHON_PATH` / `OMNIMUX_VIDEO_MODELS_DIR` 覆盖 python / 模型目录。 - `maxConcurrent` 必须是 `整数 >= 1`，否则 Config validate 报 issue。 ## 错误码 | 码 | 含义 | |---|---| | `ffmpeg-missing` | 未找到 ffmpeg / ffprobe（含 brew 指引） | | `unknown-capability` | slug 不在 12 项清单内，message 附清单 | | `video-invalid-input` | 主输入字段缺失 / 非法 | | `video-ffmpeg-failed` | ffmpeg / ffprobe 非零退出，附截断 stderr 尾部 | | `video-depth-failed` | 深度估计 Python/ONNX 推理失败 | | `video-depth-deps-missing` | 系统 Python 候选与 uv 托管运行时都不可用（显式配置时只试配置值、不回退）；message 列出已尝试解释器，hint 给出 `pip install onnxruntime opencv-python`、`OMNIMUX_VIDEO_PYTHON_PATH`、`OMNIMUX_UV_PATH` / `UV_PATH` 三条处理路径 | | `video-incompatible-streams` | merge 各路视频流编码/尺寸/pix_fmt 不一致（fail-fast，提示先统一转码） | | `video-canceled` | 调用方 signal abort，进程已杀、半成品清理 | | `video-timeout` | 超过能力默认超时，已杀进程、半成品清理 | | `video--failed` | 能力级失败（如 merge 兼容性检查内部失败） | ## 非目标（v1） - 不做 Docker、Gxgen 引擎、云端/HTTP 客户端、token。 - `video_export` 高级项 **不实现**：`chromaKey` 绿幕、`textOverlays` 文字层、`dedupe` 去重（传入的会被静默忽略）。 - 不做聊天 chrome、登录、模型路由、任务 UI、`ctx.jobs` 后台化。 - `video_export` 当前输出不混音轨（`-an`）——合并轨道音频是 v1.1 事项。 ## scene_detect 说明 `video_scene_detect` 用 ffmpeg 的 `select='gt(scene,TH)'` + `showinfo` 近似切点（roomate 熵-阈值近似），**不等价** Python scenedetect 的 adaptive/content 检测器。`detectorType` 在 v1 统一映射到同一个 scene 阈值；`returnBase64` 参数被忽略（本地执行无意义）。README 及以上声明为近似实现。 ## 开发 ```sh cd plugins/omnimux-video node --test # L1 单测（纯 mock 参数构造 + 真 ffmpeg 冒烟） OMNIMUX_VIDEO_SKIP_FFMPEG=1 node --test # 跳过需要真二进制/网络的冒烟 ``` 本插件只提供工具与服务端 seam，没有客户端产物：`package.json` 不声明 `dsh.client`，也没有 `./client` 导出，因此不需要构建步骤。 - `node --test` 结果 0 = 全绿。冒烟在没有 ffmpeg 时会自跳过（不红）。 - 单测禁止依赖本机 ffmpeg（spawn 已做成可注入 mock），冒烟除外。 # OmniMux

角色生成与视频复刻
用文字或照片建立角色，结合参考视频制作角色视频

--- ## 简介 **OmniMux 聚焦角色生成与视频复刻。** 从文字描述或有权使用的照片建立角色，结合参考视频制作角色视频，核心创作能力为生图与生视频。现行定位与表述边界见[产品定位](docs/contracts/product-positioning.md)。 本仓是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的桌面插件工程，不是官网工作台源码。官网的角色创建旅程不等于本仓已经逐项完成；实际能力须核对[能力记录](docs/capabilities.md)、当前代码及对应版本证据。 灵感、素材、画布与必要剪辑服务于角色视频成片。多账号矩阵、自动排期和独立运营分析不是默认产品主线；不承诺固定降本比例、零抽成或素材始终只留本地。 ## AI 应用：历史目标与审计边界 以下通用应用是历史方案，不是当前产品扩展任务；现行范围见[产品定位](docs/contracts/product-positioning.md)。历史目标是 schema 驱动的通用应用，而非写死业务页面：唯一宿主入口，视频/图片/音频三类二级栏，选应用后收起且可重开；compact tabs 后单个左右大卡片，左表单、右历史/示例。空历史默认示例但不得伪造历史；发布者自主上传/选择多图、多视频与封面并保存 Demo 输入快照。 **纠正此前不实宣称**：针对固定审计基线 `e416238631cc78ef8caeab7b5313d9571947ef5a` 至目标 `a1ecf7bddc110992d870efd3b4e56511dfe43c9e`，Production Ready、零缺陷、端到端闭环、Apps 持久化、CI 已接入、11 组对抗测试、完整团队 TDD 均不成立。仅有 4 个 Apps 单测与 1 个 mock seam 单测通过、弱静态扫描通过；原区间 `git diff --check` 因行尾空白失败。上述结果不能替代真实宿主、媒体播放与执行验收。 固定目标 SHA 的原型仍为未挂载向导、内存 Registry、硬编码表单、4 秒 mock 成功、无真实播放器/上传选择器；原型代码留在 `omnimux-dsh-wt-contracts`，不代表 main、Dev 或生产已具备这些能力。本次仅将已审计文档融合到 main 基线，不合入原型代码，没有修复代码、接入 CI 或完成运行验收。 具体目标与需求—验收—实现状态见 [AI 应用 UI 规范](docs/contracts/ai-app-ui-spec.md)；目标职责、技术约束与已验证源码缺口见 [Canvas / Apps 边界](docs/contracts/workflow-app-boundary.md)。Canvas 调度，Hub 管凭证、provider HTTP 与模型路由，Apps 管表单、发布规范和域存储；Apps 不重造执行器。计费/退款/算力、评分、第四类 agent、VS SYNC/wipe、冗余回填及工作流源链接不属于本次 AI 应用需求。 ## 工程结构与能力状态 执行中枢负责身份、凭证、模型路由与媒体执行；领域插件管理各自的素材、灵感、画布和剪辑职责。结构与术语见 [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md)，调用边界见[中枢合同](docs/contracts/hub.md)。 已有账号、发布、运营分析等插件保留其技术职责，但不因存在源码而成为当前对外承诺。安装阶段以[插件生命周期清单](plugins/omnimux/src/plugin-lifecycle.json)为准，真实可用性以[能力记录](docs/capabilities.md)及当前验收为准，不维护第二份正式可用徽章或素材数量表。 ## 文档入口 | 需要了解什么 | 入口 | | --- | --- | | 当前产品方向与宣传边界 | [产品定位](docs/contracts/product-positioning.md) | | 角色视频制作的目标与验收 | [角色生成与视频复刻指南](docs/guides/ecommerce-video-replication.md) | | 开发文档与适用合同 | [文档导航](docs/README.md)、[智能体约束](AGENTS.md) | | 灵感库合集整理与能力状态 | [灵感插件说明](plugins/omnimux-inspiration/README.md#本地灵感合集)、[能力记录](docs/capabilities.md) | | 中枢接口目录快照 | [接口面板](docs/tools/hub-interfaces.html)，不是部署状态或上游能力真源 | | 软件使用与商业授权 | [许可原文](LICENSE)、[商业授权说明](COMMERCIAL.md)，不等于生成免费 | | 第三方来源与许可 | [致谢与第三方声明](ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md) | ## 🚀 快速启动 (Quickstart) ### 环境要求 * **Node.js**：`^22.19 || >=24` * **pnpm**：`>=9` * **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**：通过 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh` 或本地 DSH 环境运行。 ### 本地开发与交付 从 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) 和[仓库 workflow](.agents/skills/omnimux-repo-workflow/SKILL.md)进入开发流程： 1. 在仓内隔离 worktree 实施，运行与变更面相关的自动化测试、静态检查和独立评审；选择依据见[插件 QA](docs/contracts/plugin-qa.md)。例如在当前任务 worktree 执行 `pnpm --filter test`，文档变更执行 `git diff --check` 与 `pnpm doc:lint`。 2. PR 满足 required CI，经 Merge Queue 合入 `main`。CI `qa:pass` 只证明合入前静态与测试，不证明 Dev 已通过。 3. 界面变更在任务隔离工作树内取得实际功能路径浏览器证据；合入后仅影响已安装运行时的改动物化 Dev `~/.omnimux-dev`。45120 的开发版验收由人工负责；纯文档无需安装或重启应用。完整规则见[插件 QA](docs/contracts/plugin-qa.md)。 没有合并前独立 App/Host 测试环境。不得将未合并 worktree link 或物化到 Dev/Prod；生产 `~/.omnimux`、`--prod`、`--all` 与正式发布仍需独立授权。完整边界见[开发环境合同](docs/contracts/dev-pipeline.md)。 --- ## 💬 社区交流与开发者群 (Community) 可选择常用的平台参与讨论，交流 AI 视频出片技巧、探讨插件二次开发、反馈需求与跟踪最新进展：

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# omnimux-viewer **Everything renders.** One `display_file` tool that puts images, video, audio, PDF, Office documents and local web pages inline in the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) web UI — with a real player, not a filename and a byte count. [English](README.md) · [中文](README.zh.md) · MIT
--- ## What it does The harness ships `read_image`, whose job is to put a picture into **model context**. It refuses on a text-only route, it handles four raster formats, and the built-in web client draws no card for it — so the human in front of the screen sees one line of text. This plugin inverts that. Its job is to put a file **on your screen**. A text-only model route is a normal outcome, not a refusal, and every medium a browser can play is in scope. **36 file extensions across 6 render kinds:** | Kind | Element | Extensions | | --- | --- | --- | | Image | `` + click-to-zoom lightbox | `png` `jpg` `jpeg` `webp` `gif` `svg` `avif` `bmp` `ico` `apng` | | Video | `

# omnimux-workflow 当前产品方向见[角色生成与视频复刻](../../docs/contracts/product-positioning.md)。本页保留该组件的技术职责与既有实现记录，不证明全部功能当前可用，也不扩展默认产品范围；模型/渠道信息属于内部执行，普通用户的简化入口仍需对应实现证据。 > 运维入口：`cd ~/Desktop/Project/omnimux-desktop-fork && yarn omnimux:sync omnimux-workflow`（+ `yarn omnimux:restart`）。原 `scripts/deploy.mjs` 转发器已随旧同步旁路一起删除，勿再加私有同步逻辑。详见 `docs/contracts/ops-entry.md`。 > > **Gxgen 迁移蓝图（代理必读）**：产品树 [`docs/contracts/gxgen-workflow-migration.md`](../../docs/contracts/gxgen-workflow-migration.md) —— 进度矩阵 + Phase0 项目壳优先 + 术语表。动手改画布对齐前先更新/阅读矩阵。 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的工作流无限画布插件：拖拽节点、连线成 DAG、编排多模态生成任务，并允许 dsh 会话里的 **Agent 通过工具查询与执行画布**。画布自身零模型 API 调用——所有生成经 OmniMux 执行中枢的 seam 提交（M4 已接通）；数据 100% 本地文件（`$DSH_HOME/omnimux/workflow/`）。 ## 产品能力总览（M1–M5） | 里程碑 | 能力 | |---|---| | M1 脚手架 | 四区目录（client/canvas/host/shared）+ 三 bundle 构建；React 19 island 桥（宿主 React 18 与 island 双 React 共存）；侧边栏「工作流」入口 + product-stage 全屏页；`--wb-*` 主题变量层 + 暗色跟随 | | M2 编辑器 | React Flow 画布 + MaterialNode（prompt/模型/参数配置面板）；连接校验链（类型矩阵/环检测/mutation gateway）；撤销重做/剪贴板/右键菜单；1s 防抖自动保存 + 乐观锁（409 冲突保护） | | M3 执行引擎 | Kahn 拓扑分层调度 + maxParallel 节流并行；暂停/恢复/取消/单步/断点；11 事件 SSE 协议（带回放缓冲）；执行记录持久化 + 重启断点恢复；节点执行徽标 + 下游边流动动画 | | M4 真实生成 | OmniMuxSeamClient 经 cordis seam 消费执行中枢（不 import hub、零三方依赖、不落 key）；三模式装配（omnimux/mock/auto）+ 晚绑定单向升级；seam 并发上限（默认 2）；能力目录真数据；组/子集执行（上游闭包） | | M5 产品化 | **Agent 工具**（workflow_list / workflow_run / workflow_snapshot）+ workflow:ops 系统提示词；性能基线（200 节点 DAG 实测，见下）；渲染优化（节点 memo 修复 + 视口裁剪） | ## Agent 工具（M5） dsh 会话里的 Agent 可通过三个宿主侧工具指挥画布（注册在 cordis `tools` 座位，直连进程内 store / executionManager，无额外 HTTP 调用）： | 工具 | 参数 | 行为 | |---|---|---| | `workflow_list` | `include_executions?: boolean` | 列出工作区（id/name/version/nodeCount/updatedAt，新→旧）；`include_executions=true` 附带最近 5 条执行概览（状态 + 进度） | | `workflow_run` | `workspace_id \| workspace_name`、`mode: full\|subset`、`node_ids?`、`wait?`、`timeout_ms?`（默认 120000） | 创建执行。`wait=false`（默认）立即返回 `executionId` + 提示（用户可在画布看实时进度）；`wait=true` 轮询到终态（completed/error/cancelled）返回结果摘要：各节点状态、文本产物摘录（240 字截断）、媒体文件 URL + 本地绝对路径。subset 模式自动补传递上游闭包 | | `workflow_snapshot` | `workspace_id`、`include_nodes?: boolean` | 工作区摘要（节点/边计数、素材类型分布、执行设置）或完整节点/边结构（供 Agent 分析画布 / 给修改建议） | - 错误统一 `{error, message}` 返回形态（不抛出）：`invalid-args` / `workspace-not-found` / `ambiguous-workspace-name` / `invalid-subgraph` / `empty-graph` / `execution-not-found` - 系统提示词：`ctx.systemPrompt.section` 注册 `workflow:ops`（order 60，与 omnimux-assets 的 assets:ops=50 不冲突），说明三工具用法场景与「用户在画布上操作时 Agent 可查询/触发执行」的协作方式 - 生成结果如实上报（含 `[omnimux:]` 节点错误），Agent 不编造产物 ## 安装 ```bash # 本地源码位于 product/omnimux-dsh/plugins/omnimux-workflow/ cd /path/to/omnimux-workflow pnpm install # workspace 根执行亦可：pnpm install --filter omnimux-workflow # prepare 会现场 build 三 bundle；禁止 --ignore-scripts npm run build # 显式重建：dist/index.js + lib/client.js + lib/canvas.js（不进 Git） ``` 三 bundle **不入库**。新 clone 没有 `dist/` / `lib/*.js` 是正常的；`dsh plugin add` 本地目录、`yarn omnimux:sync` / `scripts/sync-to-app.sh` 都会先 build 再拷进 profile。禁止为「跟仓」提交生成物。 ### Profile 方式加载（dsh 标准安装形态） 在目标 profile（如 `~/.dsh/profiles//package.json`）中： ```jsonc { "dependencies": { "omnimux-workflow": "link:/plugins/omnimux-workflow" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* ...既有 bundles... */ "omnimux-workflow" ] } } } ``` `pnpm install` 后 profile 的 `node_modules/omnimux-workflow` 是指向源码树的 **symlink**——重新 `npm run build` 即生效，无需拷贝。重启 dsh web 加载（见下方运维注意）。 ## 打开画布 1. dsh web 侧边栏「新会话」下方出现「工作流」条目（32/14/14 规格行） 2. 点击条目 → 全屏 claim product-stage（`omnimux-workflow`）→ 首次打开时懒加载画布 island（`GET /omnimux-workflow/canvas.js`，内容 hash 缓存戳） 3. 画布内：左侧工具栏添加素材节点（文本/图片/视频/音频）→ 选中节点展开配置面板（prompt + 模型）→ 悬停节点出现锚点拖线（类型校验 + 环检测）→ 更改自动保存（1s 防抖 + 乐观锁） 4. 画布顶部执行控制条：**▶ 执行全部**（拓扑分层 + maxParallel 节流并行）/ **⏸ 暂停 / ▶ 恢复 / ✕ 取消**，进度 `completed/total` 实时更新；节点卡片显示执行徽标（运行中转圈 + 下游边流动动画 / 完成绿 / 失败红 + 错误信息），节点面板内可**单节点执行**（subset 子图：该节点 + 上游闭包） ## 执行引擎（M3） - **调度**：Gxgen ExecutionScheduler 全量移植（TypeScript strict 化，算法语义不变）——Kahn 拓扑分层、maxParallel 并行节流（默认 3，读工作区 settings）、Promise 挂起式暂停/恢复、取消（含在途任务 abort）、单步模式、500ms 防抖 DAG 状态落盘 - **协议**：11 种 SSE 事件（execution_start / node_start / node_progress / node_complete / node_error / node_skipped / execution_paused / execution_resumed / execution_complete / execution_error / execution_cancelled），与 Gxgen 前端协议逐字段对齐；事件带回放缓冲（迟订阅也能拿到完整序列） - **断点恢复**：执行记录与 DAG 状态持久化到 `$DSH_HOME/omnimux/workflow/executions//`（execution.json + dag-state.json，原子写）；宿主重挂载时自动恢复（fromPersistedState），暂停的执行保持暂停等待手动恢复，崩溃时在途节点自动回置 pending - **HTTP API**（`/omnimux-workflow/*` 为 canonical 前缀，legacy `/dsh-workflow/*` 全量别名兼容）： - `POST /omnimux-workflow/api/workspaces/:id/executions` `{mode: 'full'|'subset', nodeIds?}` - `GET .../executions`（列表）/ `GET .../executions/:execId`（状态快照） - `POST .../executions/:execId/pause | resume | cancel` - `GET .../executions/:execId/events`（SSE，text/event-stream） ## 真实网关（M4：OmniMux 执行中枢接缝） 生成的默认通道是 **OmniMuxSeamClient**（`src/workflow/seam/omnimuxGateway.ts`）：画布插件通过 cordis 依赖注入 `ctx.get('videoGenerate' | 'imageGenerate' | 'textComplete')` 消费执行中枢（hub）能力——**不 import hub 包、不自带 HTTP client、不落任何 provider key**（红线，`docs/contracts/hub.md`）。 ### 装配与降级 挂载时（`mountWorkflowHost`）按以下顺序选择网关（`src/workflow/seam/gatewaySelection.ts`）： | 环境 | 行为 | |---|---| | `OMNIMUX_WORKFLOW_GATEWAY=omnimux` | 强制 seam 客户端；hub 缺席时节点错误 `[omnimux:needs-provider]`（**绝不静默 mock**） | | `OMNIMUX_WORKFLOW_GATEWAY=mock` | 只在本地模拟生成；Hub 在场时读取其模型合同目录，未安装 Hub 时使用静态测试目录 | | 未设置（默认 `auto`） | 探测 `ctx.get` seam：hub 在场 → seam 客户端；否则 mock。auto 模式在每次提交前重新探测，hub 晚于本插件挂载时自动升级（单向 mock→omnimux，已提交任务仍归原网关所有） | 代码注入优先级最高：`mountWorkflowHost(ctx, { gateway })` 显式传入网关时跳过装配（测试用）。 强制模拟模式只调用本地 `modelCatalog.list()` 投影模型、模式和参数，不调用生成 seam。模拟输出在执行记录和画布节点中保留 `simulated: true`，完成节点显示「模拟结果」；后续真实输出会清除该标记。模拟完成不能作为真实模型调用成功的证据。 ### 输入映射（节点 data → seam 请求） | 节点字段 | seam 请求字段 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `prompt` / `content` / 上游文本 | `prompt` | 必填 | | 上游图片产物 | `image` | i2v / 图生图 / 视觉文本输入 | | 上游音频产物（视频节点） | `audio` | 参考音频 | | `params.duration` | `duration` | 秒 | | `params.model` | `model` | 省略 → hub 默认（`Config.media` + env 覆盖） | | — | `dest` | `$DSH_HOME/omnimux/workflow/media/executions//.`，**hub 负责下载落盘**，回填 `mediaUrl` 走既有 M3 链路 | | 取消 | `signal` | AbortSignal 贯通 hub 的 submit/poll/download | 提交语义：`wait:false` 异步提交拿 `taskId` → `{ dest, taskId }` 轮询 + 下载。`textComplete` 无 taskId 机制，在 awaitTask 阶段一次性执行并把文本落盘。 ### 并发与限流 - 节点级并发：工作区 `settings.maxParallel`（=1 串行，N>1 批量，M3 既有行为，真实网关下不变） - **seam 级并发上限**：对 hub 的在途请求数上限，默认保守 **2**，`OMNIMUX_WORKFLOW_MAX_SEAM_CONCURRENCY` 或 `mountWorkflowHost({ seamConcurrency })` 可调——宽 DAG 不容易触发 hub 侧限流 - 组/子集执行：右键选中多个节点 →「**执行选中节点（含上游）**」；右键单节点 →「**执行此节点（含上游）**」（subset 模式，host 自动补传递上游闭包） ### 错误处理 hub 错误（`OmnimuxError`，带 `code`）映射为节点执行错误，格式 `[omnimux:] `，透传到节点徽标（Agent 工具的结果摘要同样如实上报）；单节点失败按节点 `failStrategy`（abort/skip）处理，不炸整个执行。常见 code：`needs-provider`（seam 缺失）、`omnimux-unconfigured`（未配置 OMNIMUX_API_KEY）、`unknown-model` / `unknown-provider`（路由解析失败）、`omnimux-request-failed` / `omnimux-download-failed`（HTTP 失败）。磁盘异常（如盘满）时快照写入经 tmp+rename 原子写保护——失败时旧文件完好，host 返回 500 `{error:'internal'}`；canvas.json 损坏（无法通过 zod 校验）按「工作区不存在」处理（404），不会让整个插件崩溃。 ### 能力目录（模型下拉数据源） `GET /omnimux-workflow/api/capabilities` 在 seam 可达时返回 hub `modelCatalog.list()`（`source: "omnimux"`，含 `fingerprint` / `defaults` / 四类模型行，按显示名 A–Z）。文本来自 hub `CHAT_MODELS`，图/视/音来自 hub `src/media/catalog.js` SPECS。`OMNIMUX_*_MODEL` env 与 Settings 默认模型字段只覆盖 **defaults**，不收缩列表。画布 ConfigPanel 无生产假回退；已保存但不在目录中的 `params.model` 保留并标 deprecated。hub 不可达 / mock 模式返回 `source: "static-stub"` 夹具。 ## 性能基线（M5） `npm run perf:baseline`（`scripts/perf-baseline.mjs`）：200 节点 / 380 边分层 DAG + **零延迟网关**（隔离调度/持久化/事件管道的纯开销，不含生成延迟），本机实测（Apple Silicon，Node 22）： | 指标 | 数值 | |---|---| | 拓扑分层 `getTopologicalGroups`（50 次均值） | ~0.15ms | | subset 上游闭包 `resolveExecutionSubgraph`（50 次均值） | ~0.14ms | | 引擎直跑 `scheduler.execute()`（200 节点，602 事件） | ~3ms（~20 万事件/s） | | 200 节点快照保存 PUT（JSON 序列化 + 原子写） | ~6ms | | 创建执行 POST executions | ~6ms | | host 全链路（创建 → SSE execution_complete，1002 事件） | ~10ms（~10 万事件/s，~2.1 万节点/s） | | 状态快照轮询 GET executions/:id | ~0.4ms/次 | 结论：200 节点规模下 host 侧调度与事件管道开销在毫秒级，瓶颈只会出现在真实生成的网络等待（这正是 seam 并发上限守卫的场景）。 **island（浏览器）侧验证方法**（现场手动，不强制自动化）： 1. 造图：打开画布 → 控制台执行批量建节点脚本（或复制粘贴 10×20 网格），达成 200+ 节点 2. 检查 React DevTools：「Highlight updates when components render」下拖拽/框选时确认只有视口内节点重渲染（`onlyRenderVisibleElements` 视口裁剪 + `flowNodes` memo 化 + MaterialNode `memo` 三层防护） 3. DevTools Performance 面板录一段「执行全部」：主线程无长任务阻塞（SSE 事件到达时只更新变化节点的 data，无全量 setState） 4. 回归项：滚动后离屏节点重回视口时状态完整恢复（节点数据在 canvasStore，不依赖组件存活） ## 架构速览 ``` ┌ dsh web（宿主 React 18）────────────────────────┐ │ sidebar-entry ── shell.overlay slot │ │ └ WorkflowStage（React 18 chrome） │ │ └ CanvasBridge ── DOM 容器 + plain props│ ├ ────────────────── React 边界（硬规则）──────────┤ ┌ canvas island（自带 React 19.2.8，懒加载）──────┐ │ React Flow 画布 + MaterialNode(memo) + canvasStore│ │ 执行控制条 + useExecutionController(SSE) + 徽标 │ │ 连接校验链（Gxgen 移植） + --wb-* 主题变量层 │ ├ HTTP /omnimux-workflow/*（同源 fetch + SSE）────┤ ┌ host（Node，dist/index.js，零运行时三方依赖）───┐ │ ┌ Agent 工具层（M5）──────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ ctx.tools: workflow_list / _run / _snapshot │ │ │ │ ctx.systemPrompt: workflow:ops section │ │ │ └──────┬ 直连（无 HTTP 调用）────────────────┘ │ │ WorkspaceStore（快照 + 乐观锁 + 原子写） │ │ ExecutionManager + Scheduler + Context + SSE │ │ 扩展点：执行器注册表 / GenerationGateway │ │ ├ mockGateway（开发/离线回退） │ │ └ OmniMuxSeamClient ── ctx.get seam ──→ hub │ └ 磁盘 $DSH_HOME/omnimux/workflow/ ──────────────┘ ``` 详见 `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` 与 `docs/contracts/`。 ## 命令 | 命令 | 作用 | |---|---| | `npm run build` | 三 bundle 构建（host/client/canvas） | | `npm run typecheck` | tsc（canvas + host 双 project，strict） | | `npm run dev` | esbuild watch，改码 1-2s 重建，刷新 dsh web 生效 | | `npm test` | host 冒烟 + 执行引擎/路由 + seam 客户端 + agent 工具测试（node --test，51 个） | | `npm run verify:m5` | M5 自验：工具注册 + 三工具往返 + 性能基线（mock 网关，零真实请求） | | `npm run perf:baseline` | 200 节点 DAG 性能基线（零延迟网关，输出上表数字） | | `node scripts/m3-self-verify.mjs` | M3 执行链路端到端自验（SSE/暂停恢复取消/断点恢复） | | `node scripts/m4-self-verify.mjs` | M4 真实网关自验（fake seam 全链路/回退/并发上限） | ## 运维注意 - **重启要杀净进程**：OmniMux Desktop 的 quit 可能残留旧 Host 进程（「假重启」）——旧进程继续以旧路由/旧 bundle 服务，表现为新前缀/新构建「不生效」。重启后若行为异常，先确认只有一个 Host 进程再排查代码。 - profile 中 `node_modules/omnimux-workflow` 是指向源码树的 symlink：重新 `npm run build` 即生效；改依赖（package.json）才需要重新 `pnpm install`。 - 旧会话/书签用的 `/dsh-workflow/*` 前缀长期兼容（in-memory 改写，不重定向），无需迁移。 ## 已知限制 - **视频输入和参数按型号、模式限定**：阶段一七款 APIMart 型号的素材角色、画幅、时长和上限见[视频阶段一合同](../../docs/specs/2026-09-05-video-phase-one-scope.md)。不兼容的输入保留并提示，修正前阻止提交。 - **音频生成不可用**：hub 无 `audioGenerate` seam；音频生成节点在真实网关下报 `[omnimux:needs-provider]`，能力目录 audio 列表为空 - **能力目录不代表真实执行历史**：目录来自 Hub 的本地合同投影；文档确认、适配就绪和真实执行证据分别记录。 - **跨进程任务恢复优先复核，无法复核才重新提交**：提交成功后 `taskId` / 能力 / 提交时刻 / **归属后端**随节点状态落盘（`nodeStates[].upstreamTask`），进程重启后在途节点仍回置 pending，但执行器先按该引用向 hub 复核——上游已完成则直接下载回填（不重复提交、不重复计费），未完成则在**剩余窗口**内继续等待（deadline 锚定持久化的提交时刻，不因重启重置），上游失败则节点标错。回退重新提交有**三个**条件，任一成立即回投：①「无引用」（#1382 之前的老记录）；② hub 明确不认这个任务（`omnimux-invalid-request`，含 404/410）；③ **引用登记的归属后端是 mock**——mock 的任务不跨进程存活，其 `reconcileTask` 显式报「不可复核」，因此回投，与今天行为一致。第 ③ 条依赖持久化的 `owner`（#1386）：重启后的进程没有提交时的内存任务表，只能靠引用自身说明归属；未记录 `owner` 的旧引用按 hub 处理，老记录行为不变。 - **Agent 工具为只读 + 触发执行**：不提供画布结构修改工具（防误改用户画布）；Agent 需要改图时给出建议、由用户操作 - hub 不可达时的 auto 回退是 mock 网关（模拟生成）——`source: "static-stub"` 目录会明示；要硬保证不跑 mock，用 `OMNIMUX_WORKFLOW_GATEWAY=omnimux` - canvas.json 损坏（zod 校验不过）按「工作区不存在」（404）处理——文件仍在磁盘上，可手工修复后恢复 - 宿主进程内 unmount 时在途执行的后台 loop 可能短暂续跑（监听已摘除，不会污染恢复记录）；进程重启场景无此问题 - React DevTools 双 root（宿主 18 + island 19）为预期现象 # OmniMux

--- ## 简介 **OmniMux 聚焦角色生成与视频复刻。** 从文字描述或有权使用的照片建立角色，结合参考视频制作角色视频，核心创作能力为生图与生视频。现行定位与表述边界见[产品定位](docs/contracts/product-positioning.md)。 本仓是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的桌面插件工程，不是官网工作台源码。官网的角色创建旅程不等于本仓已经逐项完成；实际能力须核对[能力记录](docs/capabilities.md)、当前代码及对应版本证据。 灵感、素材、画布与必要剪辑服务于角色视频成片。多账号矩阵、自动排期和独立运营分析不是默认产品主线；不承诺固定降本比例、零抽成或素材始终只留本地。 ## AI 应用：历史目标与审计边界 以下通用应用是历史方案，不是当前产品扩展任务；现行范围见[产品定位](docs/contracts/product-positioning.md)。历史目标是 schema 驱动的通用应用，而非写死业务页面：唯一宿主入口，视频/图片/音频三类二级栏，选应用后收起且可重开；compact tabs 后单个左右大卡片，左表单、右历史/示例。空历史默认示例但不得伪造历史；发布者自主上传/选择多图、多视频与封面并保存 Demo 输入快照。 **纠正此前不实宣称**：针对固定审计基线 `e416238631cc78ef8caeab7b5313d9571947ef5a` 至目标 `a1ecf7bddc110992d870efd3b4e56511dfe43c9e`，Production Ready、零缺陷、端到端闭环、Apps 持久化、CI 已接入、11 组对抗测试、完整团队 TDD 均不成立。仅有 4 个 Apps 单测与 1 个 mock seam 单测通过、弱静态扫描通过；原区间 `git diff --check` 因行尾空白失败。上述结果不能替代真实宿主、媒体播放与执行验收。 固定目标 SHA 的原型仍为未挂载向导、内存 Registry、硬编码表单、4 秒 mock 成功、无真实播放器/上传选择器；原型代码留在 `omnimux-dsh-wt-contracts`，不代表 main、Dev 或生产已具备这些能力。本次仅将已审计文档融合到 main 基线，不合入原型代码，没有修复代码、接入 CI 或完成运行验收。 具体目标与需求—验收—实现状态见 [AI 应用 UI 规范](docs/contracts/ai-app-ui-spec.md)；目标职责、技术约束与已验证源码缺口见 [Canvas / Apps 边界](docs/contracts/workflow-app-boundary.md)。Canvas 调度，Hub 管凭证、provider HTTP 与模型路由，Apps 管表单、发布规范和域存储；Apps 不重造执行器。计费/退款/算力、评分、第四类 agent、VS SYNC/wipe、冗余回填及工作流源链接不属于本次 AI 应用需求。 ## 工程结构与能力状态 执行中枢负责身份、凭证、模型路由与媒体执行；领域插件管理各自的素材、灵感、画布和剪辑职责。结构与术语见 [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md)，调用边界见[中枢合同](docs/contracts/hub.md)。 已有账号、发布、运营分析等插件保留其技术职责，但不因存在源码而成为当前对外承诺。安装阶段以[插件生命周期清单](plugins/omnimux/src/plugin-lifecycle.json)为准，真实可用性以[能力记录](docs/capabilities.md)及当前验收为准，不维护第二份正式可用徽章或素材数量表。 ## **Part of Persevere with DSH**

-----

On macOS 14 or later this plugin uses the DSH native provider and rejects the MCP backend and MCP driver settings. The model uses the registered `cua` tool and its per-application authorization flow. Background AX operations and screenshots are supported; typed browser tabs are not. If a capability is unavailable, report the limitation. A profile host must support profile tool admission. Preview captures use the same application authorization without changing model screenshot coordinates. The driver measurements and behavior below apply to `backend: mcp` on other platforms.

The profile host must also support required-tool health reporting. Tool registration leaves connection readiness unknown until an operation succeeds; a native transport failure is reported for the owning session and shown in its preview. A missing helper or provider startup failure leaves the native-only requirement in place and reports an unavailable reason.

Native hover uses AX alternate UI when available. Otherwise it returns `UNSUPPORTED` without activating the app or moving the system pointer; use an advertised accessibility action or operate the control manually. Leaving previously revealed alternate UI may restore it before this error. A newly revealed alternate UI reports `dispatched: true`; entering an already revealed descendant reports `dispatched: false` because no new AX action is sent; consumers must accept either boolean. Both report `verified: false`, `hoverRoute: "accessibility"`, and `systemPointerMoved: false`; inspect fresh state to confirm the effect. Successful hover displays a virtual cursor at the target position observed before the action; it may be stale if the target moves during the action and does not verify the result. Disconnecting drops hover tracking without restoring the application UI. AX clicks with available target geometry also display the native cursor and click marker. The marker remains fully visible for 1.5 seconds before fading over 0.5 seconds, unless another input or an error hides it sooner. The separate cursor window is excluded from native window captures.

Existing macOS configurations must remove `backend: mcp` and MCP-specific options such as `command`, `args`, `allow`, and `indicator`. A compatible host suppresses known conflicting CUA driver entries and migrates matching saved profile entries with a backup. For a read-only presenter in a macOS profile, use the `perse-cua/presenter` entrypoint; `presenterOnly: true` on the main entry cannot release the native requirement. Automatic native previews require this plugin to own the provider and its authorization lifecycle.

## What the MCP backend solves on other platforms

cua-driver 0.28.1 advertises **56 tools**. Every one of them is attached to *every*
model request whether or not the task touches a GUI. Measured on the released driver:

| | tools | model-facing schema | ≈ tokens per request |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| plain `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row | 56 | 95.1 KB | ~24,300 |
| through `perse-cua` (default) | 53 | 61.7 KB | ~15,800 (**−35%**) |

And once a task *is* driving an app, a raw window snapshot is mostly menu bar: on a
230×408 Calculator window the menu subtree was 145 of 146 elements and **88% of the
rendered bytes**. It can never be an automation target — menu items are reached with
`invoke_menu` by path — so it is pure grounding noise.

## What the MCP backend does on other platforms

1. **Condenses descriptions** to their first sentence — this is where the default saving
   comes from. Parameter schemas pass through untouched, so every tool still validates.
2. **Denies only proven waste.** With `bestExperience` on (the default) the default
   `deny` list is the three tools that cannot change a task outcome: the
   `check_for_update` probe and the two deprecated compatibility shims
   (`escalate_session`, `get_session_state`). Set `bestExperience: false` to also deny
   the four `*_agent_cursor_*` tools, restoring the old surface. Everything else the
   driver advertises reaches the model.
3. **Strips the accessibility menu bar** out of rendered trees, leaving the window block
   byte-identical — including the original element numbering, because an `element_token`
   must keep resolving against the snapshot the driver cached.
4. **Enables the MCP best experience** by default: at boot the plugin opens a named
   driver session (default label `perse-cua`) and shows its **agent cursor** — the
   Codex-style effect where you watch a visible cursor do the work in a background
   window while your own mouse, keyboard focus, and frontmost app stay untouched.
   The four `*_agent_cursor_*` tools stay in front of the model so it can re-theme,
   re-time, or hide the cursor mid-task. A driver that rejects the call degrades to
   "cursor hidden"; the boot never breaks.

### Why the default is this conservative

An earlier revision curated against a hand-written "desktop-automation loop" allow list
and reported a 58% saving. Most of that extra 21 points was **capability removal, not
waste removal** — it dropped web automation, trajectory replay, session lifecycle, and
the real pointer, then presented the total as an efficiency win. Measured with the
corrected split:

| policy | tools | schema | ≈ tokens | capability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| description condensation alone | 56 | 62.7 KB | ~16,000 | complete |
| **default: condensation + deny waste** | **53** | **61.7 KB** | **~15,800** | **complete** |
| condensation + `MINIMAL_ALLOW` (cursor unioned in) | 31 | ~41.5 KB | ~10,700 | desktop only |

The condensed-everything row is the honest upper bound on what is free. An allow list is
a **capability ceiling**: a tool missing from it is invisible to the model rather than
merely unused, and the model cannot ask for what it cannot see.

On platforms that use the MCP backend, opt in to the aggressive cut explicitly if request size matters more than reach:

```yaml
- id: perse-cua
  config:
    backend: mcp
    allow: !!js (await import('perse-cua')).MINIMAL_ALLOW
```

## Use this plugin

`perse-cua` ships `dsh.bundle.patch`, so installing it already registers its loader row.
macOS requires the native backend and no backend override. On other platforms, select the external MCP driver with a **config override** — not a second `insert`, which would collide on the loader id
(preflight rule R-07):

```yaml
- id: perse-cua
  config:
    backend: mcp
    command: /Users/you/.local/bin/cua-driver
    serverName: cua
```

Install the plugin and remove any plain `dsh-mcp-client` row pointed at the same driver:

```sh
npm pack --workspace perse-cua
dsh plugin --profile web add ./perse-cua-0.3.1-rc.3.tgz
```

### Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `presenterOnly` | `false` | Provide only the preview service outside macOS profiles; macOS profiles use `perse-cua/presenter` |
| `backend` | `native` on macOS; `mcp` elsewhere | macOS requires `native` and macOS 14 or later; `mcp` is available on other platforms |
| `command` | `cua-driver` | Driver executable |
| `args` | `["mcp"]` | Arguments for the driver |
| `env` | — | Extra environment for the child process |
| `serverName` | `cua` | Namespace; tools appear as `mcp__<serverName>__<tool>` |
| `allow` | omitted | Bare tool names to keep. Omit to keep every advertised tool except `deny`. Pass `MINIMAL_ALLOW` for the token-tight desktop-only cut (cursor tools are unioned back in under `bestExperience`) |
| `deny` | 3 shims | Bare tool names to drop; wins over `allow`. `bestExperience: false` restores the four cursor tools to the deny set |
| `bestExperience` | `true` | Keep the agent-cursor tools and show the visible cursor at boot (implicit transport session) |
| `bestExperienceSession` | omitted | Driver session label that owns the best-experience cursor |
| `indicator` | follows `bestExperience` | Show the macOS menu-bar indicator; set `false` to disable it |
| `indicatorStateFile` | `~/Library/Application Support/perse-cua/indicator.json` | State file shared with the indicator helper |
| `condenseDescriptions` | `true` | First-sentence descriptions |
| `trimMenuTrees` | `true` | Remove `AXMenu*` subtrees from rendered trees |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Per-call timeout |
| `startupTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Spawn + handshake budget |

Both `allow` and `deny` accept bare (`click`) or namespaced (`mcp__cua__click`) names.
An `allow` entry that matches no advertised tool is reported in the log rather than
silently ignored, so a driver upgrade that renames a tool is visible.

## Driving previews

Native previews refresh after observed operations using the same application authorization. Closing a preview suppresses automatic rediscovery; a later operation on that window can show it again, while listing windows leaves it closed. A failed call clears the image and triggers a fresh capture; only a failed preview capture marks the screenshot unavailable. Permission denial clears affected frames and suspends automatic capture until another CUA operation. Other discovery failures report the affected application without stopping unrelated applications. Turn completion or cancellation stops background captures and marks the retained frame; a later turn resumes capture after it uses CUA. Previews are scoped to the selected Session and the Remote gateway authorizes access to that Session.

With the MCP backend, the plugin streams separate window images to its browser client. It identifies targets from window reads and window-targeted actions, and preserves the action session when requesting a preview. Select a card to enlarge it, switch windows, or close a card. The image time is the response receipt time. A brief click indicator appears only when the driver accepts a pixel click bound to the same window, session, and captured image; it is an action marker, while the actual agent cursor is rendered by the driver on the target window and may not appear in window screenshots. Actions without a verified pixel position show no marker. The plugin checks the target window list before publishing a preview; an off-screen or absent window keeps its last image and time and is marked unavailable. If capture or enumeration fails, the card marks the screenshot unavailable; dismiss it when no longer needed. The client clears stale cards and retries an unexpectedly ended preview stream. A preview requires an Agent owner and the host Remote gateway and client slots.

The exported `PreviewService` can also receive `put` and `remove` calls from a different provider. That provider owns authorization, cursor behavior, and removing its windows.

The `perse-cua/presenter` entry registers only the preview service and never starts or configures the driver. Its provider owns authorization and cursor behavior. The action-position marker identifies the submitted point on the matching captured image; a driver may dispatch that action using accessibility rather than a pointer press.

## What it deliberately does not do

- **No reconnect.** A driver process that dies is reported as a failed call; the next
  call fails too until the harness reloads the plugin. cua-driver is a local process,
  and silent respawn was judged worse than a visible failure.

## Platform notes

- The macOS native backend needs Accessibility and Screen Recording permission for the responsible host/helper.
- MCP backend actions run in the background by default and do not steal the user's focus.
  `move_cursor` in its default window scope paints the agent overlay only; moving the
  real OS pointer needs `scope: "desktop"`, which is a foreground takeover.
- The legacy MCP menu-bar indicator starts with the plugin where supported and exits after 60 seconds without
  a state update. The next non-read-only tool call restarts it, also after choosing
  **Hide indicator** or a failed launch; read-only calls do not restart it. Concurrent
  calls in one plugin instance share a pending launch. Unloading the plugin removes
  its state file and closes the launch waiter; the helper observes removal and
  exits after its startup grace period of up to 10 seconds. Indicator failure
  does not prevent driver tool calls.
- A driver that cannot resolve a window's accessibility surface returns an **empty tree
  with `degraded_reason: ax_window_unresolved`** instead of a tree from the wrong
  surface. If you see that, the app's window changed underneath the driver; re-launch
  the app and snapshot again.

## Development

The standalone `perse-cua/native` loader entry also exposes the native provider for a host that manages its own loader row. The helper source README describes build and packaging requirements.

```sh
npm ci
npm run typecheck
npm run build      # tsc -> lib/types, then tsdown -> lib/index.js
npm run build:indicator --workspace perse-cua # macOS: build and verify the universal helper
npm test           # build + node --test test/*.test.mjs
```

Packing copies this README, its Chinese counterpart and LICENSE into the package.
The helper build compiles both macOS architectures in a temporary directory and
requires ad-hoc signing and strict verification before replacing the bundled app.
Verify the extracted archive's signature before delivery; synchronized source
folders can add Finder metadata that is absent from the npm archive. Ad-hoc signing
does not provide Developer ID or notarization.

Indicator lifecycle tests run the built plugin with real subprocess fixtures for
the driver and LaunchServices waiter. They cover exit, retry, concurrent calls and
disposal without launching a GUI. Verify status-item appearance, idle recovery and
removal separately on macOS with the packaged helper.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Copyright © 2026 Xilong Liu.

# Memex — the extra-context layer for AI agents

[![CI](https://github.com/QiuXu-Tech/memex/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/QiuXu-Tech/memex/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)

**A high-performance extra-context layer between an agent's history and its model window.** Memex treats context as a hierarchy — not a notes app: when the native context window fills up, older spans are moved out verbatim into sticky L2/L3 archives, capacity is managed through a lossless cold tier plus bounded batch digests, and a model can retrieve matching records with hybrid search; retrieval and window selection do not guarantee that every relevant fact is included.

**Context, not just memory.** Raw session history is evicted verbatim from L1 into sticky L2/L3 context pools, paged back in with budget-aware retrieval, and compacted to a lossless cold tier — so selected context can be made available again within a budget; relevant facts can still be omitted. Read the concept: [Extra context, not just memory](docs/context-layer.md). Next direction: [Context materialization](docs/context-materialization.md) — exact window materialization and transformer context-specialist variants. Implemented: canonical events, materialized resident window (optional in the repository checkpoint; host profiles can enable it), trained transformer encoder reference, runnable paged-KV/prefix host, structural fidelity eval. **A-route validated on GPU:** vLLM 0.10.2 + Qwen2.5-0.5B reused a 2,498-token stable prefix via native paged-KV prefix cache (99.2% second-request prefix hit). A separate KV-tensor probe paged 720 blocks CPU↔GPU and reconstructed the cache **exactly** (paged-vs-direct logit diff 0.0). A **custom vLLM KV connector** now stores materialized prefixes externally; 8/8 second requests hit at 0.5B, **Qwen2.5-3B**, and **real Qwen2.5-7B-AWQ** (36 layers, 420MB KV, 91% GPU utilization; steady store 0.147s → hit 0.094s). End-to-end: a real materializer window was stored through the connector and hit on the second request (1,488 KV tokens, 0.018s hit).

It started as a DeepSeek Harness plugin and is now **agent-agnostic**:

| Agent | Integration |
|---|---|
| **DeepSeek Harness** | native Cordis bundle (L1 eviction seam, Web panel, 9 HTTP routes, 7 tools) |
| **Claude Code** | MCP server + `SessionStart` / `UserPromptSubmit` / `PreCompact` hooks + `CLAUDE.md` manual |
| **OpenAI Codex** | MCP server + `AGENTS.md` manual + `config.toml` snippet |
| **Gemini CLI, Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, Zed, …** | one stdio MCP server (`packages/memex-mcp`), 10 tools + catalog resource |
| **Any HTTP agent** | the same core can be embedded (`@qiuxu/memex-core`) |

> Status: **0.65.0 (Memex), with unreleased fixes on main** — agent-agnostic core, MCP server, hot-body rescue, Claude Code/Codex adapters, **21 model profiles** (13 family bases + dedicated **GPT-6.1 Sol/Terra/GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5/Sonnet 5.5/Fable 5.1/Haiku 5.5, DeepSeek Flash** variants), **196/196 offline tests**, **36/36 SQLite consistency tests**, and a vLLM paged-KV prefix-cache validation on a Blackwell GPU. DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` for DSH mode; any MCP-capable agent otherwise. Memex stores records locally and adds no telemetry; an agent can send recalled content to its model provider.

## 7B KV strategy comparison (latest)

Same real **Qwen2.5-7B-AWQ** model, 8 prefixes ×2 requests (1,856-token prefix), RTX PRO 6000 96GB:

| strategy | first request | second request | notes |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| no cache | 0.0907s | 0.0924s | recompute prefix |
| native vLLM prefix cache | 0.0922s | **0.0187s** | fastest hot path |
| Memex external KV | 0.1468s | 0.0583s | 8/8 external hits, 654MiB disk, ~91% GPU |

Takeaways:

- Native GPU prefix cache is **~3× faster** than external disk KV on the second request.
- External KV still beats recompute (~37% faster) and adds persistence, tenant isolation and cross-restart reuse.
- The first external-store request pays significant overhead; gzip makes hit latency worse.
- Next: **hybrid routing** (native hot cache + external cold cache), async/pinned KV loading, prefix-length crossover tuning, and lower GPU KV reservation to free memory.

Raw data: `docs/assets/benchmarks/kv-strategy-comparison.json`.

## Historical GPU connector experiment and DSH integration

- Real 7B-AWQ + external connector: throughput saturates ~**19 rps**; p50 75.6ms @1 concurrency, 1637ms @32 (single process).
- A prior DSH profile was configured with a **`local-memex`** provider backed by the connector vLLM through an SSH tunnel; current runtime state has not been verified by this retest.
- Real-trace encoder: pretrained **BGE-small** lifts real-archive ranking from 0.518 to **0.593** (still small-corpus limited).

## Six KV optimizations (v0.31.0)

- Hybrid native-first routing: hot prefixes stay on native prefix cache; external KV only for cold/uncached prefixes.
- Prefix threshold (`min_prefix_tokens`), parallel batch layer loads, cold-only gzip.
- Low GPU reservation test: 50,103/97,887 MiB with external cold KV still working.
- Crossover evidence: 512/1024/1856-token prefixes ~0.013–0.020s native; cold 2,800-token external 0.363s then native 0.024s.

## Prefix-length crossover (v0.32.0)

Real 7B-AWQ, unique prefixes, 50% GPU reservation: native prefix cache is fastest at every length (**0.0175–0.0249s** for the second request). External KV beats recompute at 2,833 tokens (0.102s vs 0.139s) but pays a first-store cost; hybrid short prefixes hit native ~0.017–0.022s.

## Learned real-trace cross-encoder (v0.34.0)

Fine-tuned BGE-small cross-encoder on the real archive split: **0.963 sample accuracy / pairwise ranking** (vs 0.593 bi-encoder), but on a small, record-shared, templated-query split. Key next step: record-disjoint real-query evaluation and query-aware materializer integration.

## Learned materializer prototype (v0.35.0)

Query-aware BGE cross-encoder selector vs current rule materializer on real archive split (27 val groups, 500-token budget):

- rule materializer positive recall **0.519** (327 tokens avg)
- learned selector **0.963** (388 tokens avg), **8.64ms/query** on GPU

Caveat: templated queries and record-shared split; not production generalization, not yet integrated into JS/DSH.

## Real-query generalization: negative result (v0.36.0)

Real DSH session queries, record-disjoint validation (4 val groups): rule materializer **0.50** recall; learned cross-encoder **0.25**; zero-shot BGE **0.25**. The earlier templated 0.963 was optimistic; learned materializer is not production-ready.

## Hybrid rule + learned materializer (v0.37.0)

On real session-query validation, rule recall 0.222 → learned top-1 0.500 → **rule ∪ learned 0.667**. On the small manual real-query set: 0.500 → 0.750. Learned alone is unstable; the hybrid keeps rules as a safety net and adds the learned candidate.

## JS hybrid materializer hook (v0.38.0)

Optional `query` + `learnedRerank` adds a learned candidate to the materialized window. Real session-query val: rule 0.222 → hybrid 0.333 at 500 tokens; 0.722 → 0.833 at 1,000; 0.778 → 0.889 at 1,500–2,400. At that time the default rule path was unchanged.

## Long-horizon memex A/B (v0.44.0)

Synthetic 60-decision archive, 10 evicted-fact probes, two real API models: baseline recent-tail **0/10**, memex materialized archive **10/10**, same-size decoy archive **0/10**. The gain is content-specific, not just extra tokens. Cost: +2.3k/+3.6k prompt tokens.

<!-- autonomy20261102:start -->
**Cross-session follow-up (2026-11-02; in progress):** Real public issues are being replayed in two separately registered, randomized Claude Code cohorts. At this snapshot, 10/30 original and 23/30 recovery-protocol pairs completed both sessions; blinded AI review is reported separately. Automatic and agent-initiated writes are distinguished, and missing usage is retained. [Results and limitations](docs/production-autonomy-20261102.md).

![Cross-session issue replay progress](docs/assets/benchmarks/production-autonomy-20261102/autonomy-summary.svg)
<!-- autonomy20261102:end -->

## Prospective engineering canary (2026-10-31)

**Three-session issue replay (2026-11-01):** An analysis of the previous study found 28/28 treatment first sessions searched empty stores. MCP now distinguishes an empty archive from a nonempty search miss and avoids suggesting unnecessary fallback calls. Three new public-issue coding replays had **0/3 complete original Codex pairs** after interrupted sessions. A separately registered Claude continuation on one reused issue wrote and later opened a memory, but its candidate failed an additional inherited-setter regression despite passing the original fixed checks. AI review disagreed on the candidate; the adjudicator scored control/Memex **2/1**. A fourth, new Chalk issue initially timed out in both arms. A separately registered longer-timeout retry on that same issue completed 3/3 sessions per arm and both passed the frozen check; Memex wrote no memory and used **18.7% more input tokens**, while its account-window solver charge candidate was lower for this single retry. A post-hoc reproduction of an existing upstream assertion failed on both patches, and both final explanations made inaccurate underline-color claims that the frozen-criteria AI scores did not flag. Claude and Qwen review failures were retained; GPT and post-hoc DeepSeek scored both 2/2, as did a Gemini adjudicator. Contradictory model-specific search/open hints were aligned with the shared manual, and guidance now labels unverified hypotheses. These historical replays do not establish production correctness or savings. [Methods, failures, cost and results](docs/production-longhorizon-20261101.md).

![Agent replay coverage, prior token use and a supplemental compatibility check](docs/assets/benchmarks/production-longhorizon-20261101.svg)

![Post-hoc Chalk retry: session completion, token use, blinded scores and legacy assertion](docs/assets/benchmarks/production-longhorizon-20261101/chalk-retry.svg)

<!-- real30:start -->
**Post-repair 30-issue study (completed with post-hoc retries):** 28/30 original public-issue attempts completed both two-session Codex arms; 25/30 have two blinded AI ratings and adjudication without recovery, plus 3 supplemental adjudications. 30/30 distinct tasks have an evaluable pair including post-hoc retries. 3 adjudication rationales are flagged. These are historical source investigations without project acceptance tests; full cost and production impact remain unknown. [Results, usage and limits](docs/production-real30-20261101.md).

![Coverage, AI reviews and paired token use for the 30-issue study](docs/assets/benchmarks/production-real30-20261101.svg)

In the post-hoc sensitivity view, AI adjudication was equal on 27 tasks, higher for Memex on 0, and higher for control on 3. The 28 complete original pairs reported 8.59M control versus 12.04M Memex input tokens, including cache.

**Preview mechanism canary:** In two reused, memory-prompted Codex pairs, the new option used two searches and no opens versus two searches and two opens; reported input was 26.6% lower. Both answers per pair received 2/2 from two AI reviewers and the adjudicator. This is a small mechanism check, not evidence of production savings.
<!-- real30:end -->

**Executable real-agent follow-up (2026-11-01):** Two more registered public-issue shadow tasks were run in three fresh Codex sessions per arm. Both arms passed the original issue checks; on a related extra Happy DOM check, control passed and Memex failed. In both Memex arms the agent wrote, later opened and cited the same record, while also having access to the ordinary handoff. The Memex arms reported more input tokens in these two trials; cached input and unknown subscription costs prevent a cost-savings conclusion. This brings the original cohort to **6/30** paired investigations, with one interrupted and 23 not started. Two `memory_grep` defects were fixed and regression-tested. These are historical replays with AI-only review; one task uses mocked ML dependencies. [Results, usage, repairs and limitations](docs/production-value-20261101.md).

![Executable checks and reported input for two paired tasks](docs/assets/benchmarks/production-value-20261101.svg)

**Earlier independent-issue checkpoint (2026-11-01):** Thirty public-issue investigations from different repositories and owners have frozen source snapshots and criteria. At this checkpoint, **4/30** completed randomized three-session Codex arms; one was interrupted and 25 had not started. All four Memex arms searched but did not write a record; the first two encountered a `memory_grep` defect that was fixed before the other two ran. These were source investigations with AI-only review, without project-specific executable acceptance tests. In a separate Krkn coding canary, both arms passed a frozen mocked sandbox test and one Memex record was written, opened and cited across sessions; overlapping archive access leaves its necessity unknown. Fourteen matched gateway-review rows total a candidate **$0.062814**; Codex subscription and other costs remain unknown. [Results, task registration, review disagreements and limitations](docs/production-cohort-30-20261101.md).

![Earlier checkpoint across 30 registered public-issue investigations](docs/assets/benchmarks/production-cohort-30-20261101.svg)

**Real-agent follow-up (2026-11-01):** The isolated repository and test worker is now available through MCP to actual Codex and Claude Code clients. In two related paired Codex tasks, **4/4 candidates passed frozen tests**; both audit candidates also failed the original unadapted test fixture, which was updated for integration. In a separately registered, adaptive third session, Codex searched, opened and cited a record it had written in the previous process under the standard Memex manual. Two AI audits agreed on trace fidelity and cited use but disagreed on necessity; the adjudicated necessity is **unknown**. An earlier run with an unexpectedly loaded connector was interrupted and retained. Codex's reported usage and subscription cost gaps, AI-review disagreements, and the **$0.010644 candidate APIMaster subtotal** are documented in the [report](docs/production-real-agent-20261101.md). This is not a completed independent production study or a demonstrated cost saving. [Agent setup](docs/integrations/isolated-pilot.md).

![Real-agent paired tests and an observed cross-session memory lifecycle](docs/assets/benchmarks/production-real-agent-20261101.svg)

**Two-task shadow follow-up (2026-11-01):** An isolated Memex maintenance task and a public Axios issue were each tried with and without Memex. The four initial attempts made **0/4 requested edits**. An adaptive retry made four edits, but both Memex candidates failed the frozen ordering test; the Axios candidates received partial or conflicting AI assessments and remain unverified. A further Memex-only repeat with a sandbox test tool passed the frozen checks in both arms, but both candidates failed additional checks prompted by AI-review disagreement. A later fresh session did not use the available memory tools. An investigator fixed the audit-validator defect and added tests. Across the attempts and reviews, **124 successful requests** match a candidate **$0.065068** subtotal; 11 failed 503 attempts and non-model costs retain unknown charges. These repeated shadow tasks do not complete the 30–50-task production study. [Results, review, billing and limitations](docs/production-forward-pilot-20261101.md).

![Initial and retry results for the same two shadow tasks](docs/assets/benchmarks/production-forward-pilot-20261101.svg)

**Integration readiness follow-up (2026-11-01, unreleased):** MCP record operations now respect workspace and session visibility, default L2 sessions no longer span MCP processes, new global Codex configuration does not pin the setup project, and long single-line bodies can be continued. Four synthetic Codex checks retained a denied write and an invalid fixture; a corrected read confirmed the project scope, and a scripted write-search-open cycle worked in a temporary writable workspace and was read back by a new MCP process. This is not a production A/B or evidence of autonomous memory management. [Repairs, checks, usage and limitations](docs/production-readiness-20261101.md).

![Four synthetic Codex integration checks, including the denied write and invalid fixture](docs/assets/benchmarks/codex-readiness-smoke.svg)

**Earlier API-agent follow-up (separate cohort):** **30 distinct public-issue pairs** have both randomized arms completed, two format-valid AI ratings per arm and the necessary format-valid disagreement adjudications. This combines **18 earlier issues and 12 new follow-up issues**, includes separately registered post-hoc ratings and adjudications, and excludes two no-history controls. Among these selected pairs, the resolved AI correctness score was equal on 25, higher for Memex on three and higher for keyword retrieval on two. The adaptive batches, shared projects, public solution exposure and AI-only judging prevent a claim of independent production improvement, cost savings or autonomous memory management. [Results, method and limits](docs/production-prospective-canary.md#follow-up-30-evaluable-public-issue-pairs-with-post-hoc-recovery).

The new follow-up registered 20 distinct issues; 24 of 40 consolidated arm slots passed partial checks, five had nonzero checks, four were incomplete, two were unknown after timeouts and five were not started. Successful provider rows for this follow-up match **$0.631912** by model and aggregate token counts; two timeout charges and full non-model costs remain **UNKNOWN**. Earlier 503s carried `system_cpu_overloaded`, but the issuing upstream and its CPU metrics were not verified. [Gateway evidence and billing](docs/production-prospective-canary.md#gateway-503-investigation-and-usage).

![Follow-up issue pairs, partial-check outcomes and AI review coverage](docs/assets/benchmarks/production-prospective-independent-pairs.svg)

A preregistered, isolated canary compared three conditions on **one manually selected public Lodash issue**. The original patch filter rejected all three outputs before testing; a corrected, uniformly applied post-hoc check passed **3/3** unchanged candidates. Two blinded AI reviewers agreed on correctness but disagreed on side-effect safety in **3/3** paired ratings. This is a narrow process check, not evidence of a production improvement or autonomous memory management; the requested 30–50-task study remains **incomplete**.

An initial engineering canary and earlier separate instrumentation batches are followed by **30 additional open-source issues**, each with checks and a randomized paired order registered before its calls. Both arms completed and passed the partial checks for **21/30 issues**, including two explicitly marked no-history controls. Only **16/30** had complete final responses and two format-valid original AI ratings per arm; 14 remain after excluding the two no-history controls. Including separately registered supplementary ratings gives 20/30, or 18 without those controls, without requiring valid adjudications. Across 41 candidates with two valid original ratings, 28 had score disagreements, and 19 of those original adjudications were invalid. Separately registered post-hoc reviews and failures are retained in the ledger. These adaptive, correlated batches and short public issue discussions are **not a completed independent production study**; they do not establish a production gain, savings or autonomous memory management. [Results, registrations and limitations](docs/production-prospective-canary.md#gateway-recovery-and-30-additional-public-issues).

For the new gateway work, 637 requests reported **5,389,529 input / 160,684 output tokens** where available. Successful provider rows match a candidate subtotal of **$1.229982**; four failed requests lack usage and their final charges are **UNKNOWN**. Eight Qwen reviews reported output-token usage above the requested limit, whose gateway enforcement is unverified. Logged retries are limited to explicit 503 responses and tested with mocks; no live 503 occurred in the new trials, while timeouts and a transport error did occur. [Billing evidence and gaps](docs/production-prospective-canary.md#gateway-recovery-and-30-additional-public-issues).

![Real-issue agent instrumentation outcomes by separate registration](docs/assets/benchmarks/production-prospective-agent-outcomes.svg)

![New issue pairs by retrieval arm and partial-check outcome](docs/assets/benchmarks/production-prospective-new-pairs.svg)

## Retrospective pilot follow-up (2026-10-31)

A follow-up fixed the pilot harness's bounded answer continuation and separated historical-source IDs from observed-memory IDs in the unblinded audit. Twelve historical questions from six correlated sessions were replayed in five randomized conditions. A first cohort suffered 32 incomplete answers during a gateway outage; the separately registered post-outage replication completed **60/60** answers, including **6** that continued after the output limit. This is replay, not verified completion of the original tasks.

In the replication, **24/24** unblinded AI autonomy audits passed the then-current citation/schema checks, while model opinions about memory fidelity diverged. A later stricter prior-write-use check has not been applied to those historical ratings. Blind answer reviews were valid in **92/120** calls; Astra returned **27 HTTP 403** errors and the two reviewers agreed on **15/29** comparable non-null correctness ratings. Both cohorts and connectivity probes generated **728 recorded calls** with **4,410,105 prompt / 316,373 completion tokens reported**; **77 calls lack prompt/completion usage**, and actual charges remain **UNKNOWN**. Results do not demonstrate production accuracy, savings or reliable autonomous memory. [Results, methods, failure evidence and full cost gaps](docs/production-pilot-followup.md).

![Retrospective follow-up task usage and observed memory actions](docs/assets/benchmarks/production-pilot-followup-usage.png)

## Earlier expanded retrospective validation pilot (2026-10-31)

A preregistered five-condition replay of nine historical questions from three correlated sessions produced **41/45 complete answers** and four truncated answers. After tool budgets were exhausted, the pilot harness produced complete fallback answers in 8/9 affected answer phases. In the nine write-enabled runs, the agent wrote before the question in eight and searched, opened and cited its own earlier write in three. These are replay observations, not verified production success or proof of faithful memory management.

Two blinded AI reviewers produced **79/82** format- and source-ID-valid ratings; DeepSeek returned 41/41 valid ratings after its thinking mode was disabled. Their correctness scores agreed on **17/36** answers for which both gave a non-null rating. The separately planned unblinded autonomy audit had only **8/18** valid results. The gateway reported **2,409,708 prompt / 153,749 completion tokens** across this follow-up's trials, reviews, audits and six diagnostic calls; one failed call lacked usage and actual costs remain **UNKNOWN**. Sample reuse, clipped evidence and AI review preclude claims of a production accuracy gain or cost savings. [Methods, full results, ledger and limitations](docs/production-pilot-expanded.md).

![Expanded pilot reported usage and observed memory actions](docs/assets/benchmarks/production-pilot-expanded-usage.png)

## Earlier exploratory production-validation pilot (2026-10-31)

A preregistered, isolated five-condition replay used four actual historical questions from two sessions, including Memex-related work. **17/20 runs** produced nonempty answers; three reached the tool-round limit. In four write-enabled runs, the agent wrote before the question in three, and in one it later searched, opened and cited its own write. This is a mechanical observation, not verified fidelity or production success.

The user requested AI instead of human review. Only **29/51** blind machine-review responses passed format and historical-source-ID checks; the second useful model was added post hoc after repeated empty DeepSeek responses. The 0/1/2 rubric and clipped evidence limit interpretation. Across task runs, blind reviews, post-hoc audits and synthetic preflight, the gateway reported **1,110,947 prompt / 113,967 completion tokens**; invoices and total cost are **UNKNOWN**. The four questions are not a production benchmark or proof of improved correctness or savings. [Methods, results, cost ledger and limits](docs/production-pilot.md).

![Pilot reported usage and observed memory actions](docs/assets/benchmarks/production-pilot-usage.png)

## Synonym and archive excerpt retest (2026-10-31)

The pager can optionally ask the configured model for search paraphrases (`materializerQueryExpansion: true`, **off by default**) and can extract a query-relevant excerpt from an oversized archive body before building its card. The option sends the question to that provider and adds model latency and cost. In ten seeded layouts of 12 handcrafted questions, rule included target facts **4/120 → 91/120** and hybrid **0/120 → 104/120** with rewriting enabled; the same 12 questions were reused across seeds. One English question failed across all layouts. A deep-archive probe now includes its fact, but complete recall is not guaranteed. Ten exact-cue 10M assigned-token stores retained **400/400** rule and hybrid fact availability without rewriting; none of the quiet-start gates passed. [Results, charts and limitations](docs/pager-semantic-evaluation.md).

A one-session replay compared the prior rule against the repaired rule with query rewriting: two-order machine judging favored the prior rule in 3/18 valid pairs, the expanded rule in 8/18, tied in 1/18, and changed with order in 6/18; two of 20 pairs were excluded for empty answers. Neither synthetic fact availability nor a single-session replay establishes production accuracy, cost savings or autonomous memory management. The [production validation protocol](docs/production-validation-plan.md) specifies randomized controls, independent human review and complete cost accounting.

![Synthetic query expansion diagnostic across seeded layouts](docs/assets/benchmarks/pager-semantic-comparison.png)

## Historical query-aware pager and hybrid ranking repair (2026-10-31)

At [repair commit `a0a33db`](https://github.com/QiuXu-Tech/memex/commit/a0a33db5319ead359b089b3f5fb585212245e044), the pager adds scoped search hits to its candidates, and hybrid ranking prioritizes query-term coverage before using learned scores as a tie-breaker. Query-aware rule selection now tries search hits within the budget; hybrid remains opt-in. On 400 **paired exact-cue synthetic** 10M assigned-token probes, rule fact availability changed **22/400 → 400/400** and hybrid **0/400 → 400/400**. With identical post-fix candidates, the hybrid ranking ablation was **0/400 → 400/400**. All ten quiet-start gates failed; this is not a production or low-load performance claim.

A separate 20-question synthetic topic diagnostic found the target fact **16/16** when searchable vocabulary overlapped, but **0/4** for lexically disjoint synonym questions. The system therefore still needs broader, human-verified evaluation. [Methods, raw data, replay and limitations](docs/pager-recall-evaluation.md).

In a retrospective replay of 10 questions from one real session, two-order machine judging of 20 question/model pairs favored rule in both orders for 6, hybrid for 10, tied in 1 and changed with order in 3. These are not human labels or proof of production accuracy; at that historical commit a synthetic archive card omitted a deep fact even after its record was selected; the reproduced case is fixed in the newer retest above.

![Paired 10M synthetic pager results before and after repair](docs/assets/benchmarks/pager-recall-comparison.png)

## Historical pager body repair and 10M retest (2026-10-31)

The pager now loads stored bodies, forwards excerpt/tokenizer options and preserves source-marked excerpts. At v0.65.0 + [pager fix `bfeee59`](https://github.com/QiuXu-Tech/memex/commit/bfeee596cc7a06fd304b025b0b031de05bbd2f12), two five-seed synthetic cohorts each yielded separate search hit@1 **200/200**. Rule/hybrid pager windows contained the target fact **12/200 / 0/200** on Node 25.9, and **10/200 / 0/200** on Node 24.21. Each cohort was deliberately split 50/50 between resident and nonresident targets; these are availability checks, not production answer accuracy. No quiet-start gate passed. [Methods, raw data and limitations](docs/pager-retest.md).

A separate retrospective replay from one real session produced 16 valid question/model answer pairs. In two-order **machine** judging, rule won both orders in 4 pairs, hybrid in 5, ties in 2, and the outcome changed with presentation order in 5. Four pairs were excluded for empty answers. This is not human annotation or a production benchmark; no default strategy change was made.

![10M synthetic pager materializer comparison](docs/assets/benchmarks/pager-10m-comparison.png)

## 10M-token controlled long-context experiment (2026-10-31)

Synthetic **10,000,000-token archive** (2,000 records ×5,000 tokens; 50% cold), 40 probes whose facts exist only in the archive:

| condition | DeepSeek Flash | Claude Haiku | avg prompt tokens |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| recent tail only | **0/40** | **0/40** | 536 / 548 |
| **memex retrieved evidence** | **40/40** | **40/40** | 234 / 216 |
| same-size distractor | **0/40** | **0/40** | 234 / 216 |

- Retrieval hit@1: **40/40 = 100%**, median **4.94 ms**
- Stor
