接入真实 QQ 需要 Aurabot 适配器 + 一次 DSH 重启。

---

# 死群冒泡（Aurabot 之外的小补丁）

群完全没人说话时，Aurabot 的群聊策略（需要近 5 分钟 ≥3 条消息）不会触发。`group-chatter` 负责在死群开话题：

```bash
npm run chatter:dry    # 试跑：只打印不发送
npm run chatter        # 跑一次
npm run chatter:loop   # 常驻（推荐 setsid nohup）
```

规则在 `config/group-chatter.json`：只在 UTC 1~15 点（北京 09:00-23:00）、群安静 ≥90 分钟、
每群每天 ≤2 条、两次间隔 ≥120 分钟、50% 概率才开口；监听群消息只用于判断"有没有人说话"，不回复任何人。
状态在 `data/group-chatter-state.json`，日志在 `logs/group-chatter.log`。

---

# 生产链路（当前）：Aurabot 整合包

**2026-10-31 起，QQ 主通道切换为 Aurabot 整合包**（`accomplish07zrh-eng/dsh-aurabot-qq`），
`dsh-napcat` 保留但已禁用（`enabled: false`），作为回滚通道。

| 组件 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| Aurabot | 已安装进 `web` profile；配置在 `~/.dsh/plugins-data/aurabot/config.json`；人格在 `personas/` |
| dsh-napcat | 已禁用（不连 NapCat），补丁/脚本保留 |
| 面板 | DSH 左侧栏「自动化任务 → Aurabot」 |
| 数据 | `~/.dsh/plugins-data/aurabot/`（随插件升级保留） |

回滚：`config/dsh-napcat.json` 把 `enabled` 改回 `true` 并 `npm run sync-config`，
同时把 Aurabot 总开关关掉，重启即可恢复旧通道。

Aurabot 配置要点（已预置）：
- OneBot WS `ws://<NapCat 地址>:3001/`，token `***`，机器人 QQ `33989730`，主人 `2152719569`
- 群白名单 `859287920, 375788082, 1109246265`（最后这个需要把机器人号拉进群）
- 群聊插话：基础概率 0.18、冷却 120s、每小时最多 4 次；静默时段按 UTC 配成 `[17,8]`＝北京 01:00–08:00
- 私聊主动找人 `speakUp`：`awakeFrom=0, awakeTo=15`（UTC）＝北京 08:00–23:00
- 人格 `dafish-tsundere`（傲娇大肥鱼），本地副本见 `persona/aurabot-dafish-tsundere.md`

> 备注：容器时区是 UTC，Aurabot 的作息类配置按 UTC 填写；不要直接照搬北京时间。

---

# 旧链路（已禁用）：DSH × QQ 机器人（dsh-napcat）

仓库里有两套东西：

- **生产链路（当前在用）**：`dsh web` 进程内的 `dsh-napcat` 插件 + 本仓库的 3 个补丁与配置同步工具；
  完整设计、策略、运维手册见 **[docs/SYSTEM.md](docs/SYSTEM.md)**。
- `src/` 下的 ACP 桥接：早期调研产物，用于把 dsh 以 ACP 协议接进其他 IM，未在生产使用，保留作参考。

## 一条命令恢复整套体系

```bash
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
npm run setup     # config → persona → 3 个补丁 → 自检
npm run doctor    # 20 项体检（含 NapCat 连通性）
npm run usage     # token 用量统计（--send 直接私聊给管理员）
```

## 目录

| 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `config/dsh-napcat.json` | 配置唯一真源（触发/记忆/表达/权限/分层映射） |
| `persona/dafish-tsundere.md` | 人设唯一真源 |
| `scripts/sync-config.mjs` | 配置写进 profile 补丁层 |
| `scripts/sync-persona.mjs` | 人设展平后注入 `personaOverrides` |
| `scripts/doctor.mjs` | 体系自检 |
| `scripts/usage.mjs` | token 用量统计 + 每日预算告警（可 `--send` 私聊） |
| `scripts/patrol.mjs` | 定时巡检：doctor + 用量，异常私聊告警（`--loop N` 常驻） |
| `config/qq-preset.patch.yml` | QQ 会话受限 preset（无文件/命令/网络工具） |
| `patches/dsh-napcat-bubbles/` | 按句拆多条气泡 |
| `patches/dsh-napcat-policy/` | 按群分层触发 + 主动发言 |
| `patches/dsh-napcat-humanize/` | 拟人节奏（阅读延迟 × 时段 × 活跃度 + 气泡间隔抖动） |
| `patches/dsh-napcat-stream/` | 流式气泡（边生成边发）+ 打断重听 |
| `patches/dsh-napcat-memory/` | 中文友好的记忆检索（bigram 加权打分） |
| `patches/dsh-napcat-social/` | 戳一戳回话 + 撤回清引用 + 人物卡精确召回 |
| `patches/dsh-napcat-clock/` | 时区修正（作息/静默按 Asia/Shanghai 计算） |
| `patches/dsh-napcat-guard/` | 外发安全护栏（敏感路径拦截 + 泄露意图词表） |
| `docs/SYSTEM.md` | 整套体系设计 + 运维手册 |

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
DSH Usage

DeepSeek Harness 的用量面板：按项目看 Token、开发时间和预估费用，也能查已配置账户的余额与订阅额度。

简体中文 · English

DSH Usage 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的用量统计插件，支持桌面端和 Web。它读取 DSH 的会话记录，按项目、日期和模型整理 Token、开发时间和预估费用；无法确认价格的部分会标出来，不会硬猜。`(｡•̀ᴗ-)✧` 界面品牌叫 **DSH Usage**，安装包名仍是 **`@rongyi7/dsh-stats`**（沿用已安装 profile 的依赖名），两者是同一个插件。 > **和其它用量插件的关系**：本项目只在侧边栏底部加一个「用量」入口，面板是独立浮层，不占用会话输入区、不改动会话界面。已经装了会话级费用挂件的用户可以直接叠加：它们回答「这一轮花了多少」，这里回答「这个月在各项目上花了多少」。


浅色模式 · 桌面端真实数据，敏感信息已打码 · 点击查看完整总览

> 除账户余额页外，截图来自桌面端实拍；项目名、路径、会话标题、账户名和金额已打码为 xxxx。余额页仍使用隔离夹具的演示数据。截图不包含 API Key、Cookie、管理令牌或会话内容。费用按公开价格推算，最终以 Provider 账单为准。 ## 📦 安装 插件装进 DSH 的 profile。桌面端和 Web 是两个 profile（`desktop`、`web`），装到其中一个不会同时装到另一个。 ### 推荐：插件市场（DSH 0.2.1 及以上） 在「设置 → 插件市场」搜索 **`dsh-stats`**，一键安装。 市场列表来自 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)，本插件已收录，[条目页在此](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/)。如果市场里一时搜不到，通常是本地还没同步到最新索引（索引每天更新一次），用下面的命令行方式安装即可。 ### 命令行安装 两条命令里的 `-w` 是 pnpm 的 workspace 安装选项，不是文件路径。 #### 桌面端 用桌面应用自带的 CLI 安装（macOS 路径如下，其他系统用应用目录里对应的 `dsh`）： ```bash "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin \ --profile desktop add -w @rongyi7/dsh-stats ``` 装完完整退出 DSH（macOS 用 Cmd+Q，不是只关窗口），再重新打开。侧边栏底部的「用量」就是入口。 桌面 profile 由应用自己管理：用 npm 单独安装的 `dsh` 会直接拒绝操作 `desktop` profile。更多细节见[使用指南](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/usage-guide.md#11-桌面端)。 #### Web ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add -w @rongyi7/dsh-stats ``` 然后重启 Web 宿主（`dsh web`），刷新页面。只刷新浏览器不会重新加载宿主侧插件。 自定义 profile 把 `desktop` / `web` 换成实际名称即可。 ### 版本与要求 插件要求 Node.js 22 或更高；桌面端自带运行时，不需要另外安装 Node。 npm 上的稳定版是 `0.5.2`（2026-10-28 发布），桌面端和 Web 都可以直接安装，下面的界面说明按这个版本写。`0.5.2` 是价格目录更新的韧性补丁：界面、peer 范围和目录格式都不变，RPC 只新增几个可选字段；启动后的首次自动检查延后 15–25 秒，失败会按 5/15/30 分钟退避重试，诊断里能看到具体原因（DNS、超时、HTTP 状态或解析失败）。`0.4.3` 声明的 Harness peer 范围虽然也覆盖 `0.2.1-rc.2`（宿主检查允许预发布版本参与，因此会被加载），但验证只做到 `0.2.0-rc.2`；升级到 `0.5.2` 才是已验证的组合。 固定版本、本地 tarball、注册验证、升级卸载和 pnpm 排错，见[使用指南的安装部分](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/usage-guide.md#1-安装)。 ## 🖼️ 界面 面板有四个标签页，头部固定显示数据来源状态、刷新、导出、计价设置和关闭。面板标题「DSH 用量」本身是项目仓库入口，点击会在新窗口打开 GitHub。 键盘：`Tab` 在面板内循环，`Esc` 逐层关闭筛选、菜单和价格抽屉、最后关闭面板，表头按钮按 `Enter` 排序，展开按钮按 `Enter` 展开或收起。 ### 项目总览 按项目看用量和预估费用：表格可按任意列排序，展开项目查看轮/步、工具时长、首 token、tok/s 和会话明细；右上角可以搜索并隐藏项目，隐藏的项目不计入指标和趋势。项目每页 50 个、会话每页 100 条，翻页不改变顶部汇总。

### 开发时间线 按日视图把项目排成泳道，上方每根柱子是半小时的费用或 Token，点色条或柱子看这半小时的明细，展开泳道打开会话。全部模式是日历矩阵，每页 30 天，点格子进入当天。

### 用量趋势 范围可选近 7 / 30 / 90 天，指标可在费用和 Token 之间切换。上方摘要给出区间合计、日均和最常用模型，中间是每日柱图，下面是固定 26 周的活动热力图，末尾按当前指标列出模型占比。点柱子或热力格会跳到那天的总览。

### 账户余额 一屏列出所有已接入账户，按紧急程度排序：额度或余额快用完、凭证失效、快照过期的账户排在最前面。多账户时顶部按币种合计可用余额，并给出最紧的额度和需要关注的账户数。每个余额账户可以设一条提醒线，只保存在当前浏览器。

### 计价设置 头部的齿轮图标打开计价设置抽屉，固定三个分区：模型价格、自定义规则、更新与版本。模型价格里可以搜索模型、查看当前规则和历史规则；自定义规则填好后先「预览影响」再保存；更新与版本管理自动更新开关、固定版本和历史目录快照。

## 💰 数据与费用 - **费用是估算**。价格按每百万 Token 计算，界面和汇总统一用人民币；USD 原价按固定汇率快照 `1 USD = 6.7205 CNY`（`2026-08-26`，[Frankfurter](https://api.frankfurter.app/2026-08-26?from=USD&to=CNY)）换算，换算后的金额算作估算，不随实时汇率浮动。JSON 导出保留每条用量的原币金额和所用汇率，方便审计。 - **三种金额**：`¥12.34` 是已计价，`¥12.34*` 是部分用量未计价，没有可用规则时显示「待计价」。点费用旁的 ⓘ 看说明。 - **订阅不折算**。订阅和 Token Plan 用量不会变成 API 费用；未知模型、显式 relay/local 且没配费率、规则冲突的会话也不猜价，不计入主汇总。原因在会话详情里，导出保留 `costStatus`、`ruleId`、`pricingSource` 供定位。 - **标题状态点**跟着当前标签页：统计页描述统计数据从哪来（「已同步」「数据不完整」「快照已过期」「本地摘要 · 内置价格」），账户页描述这次账户查询的结果。 - **内容上方的横幅**用另一套文案：「快照已过期」对应「刷新失败，显示上次快照」，「本地摘要 · 内置价格」对应「回退数据，可能不完整」。有错误信息时才展开「数据诊断」；只有状态为过期或回退、且宿主仍提供对应 RPC 时才出现重试。 - **数据来源和单价是两件事**。状态点描述的是数据从哪来，金额本身另有一套 `exact` / `estimated` / `free` / `partial` / `unsupported` 状态。 - **凭证只在宿主侧使用**。账户查询由 DSH 宿主读取凭证并请求各 Provider 的官方接口，凭证不进入前端 bundle、RPC 日志或 CSV/JSON 导出。 - **导出范围**。项目总览、开发时间线和用量趋势支持 CSV/JSON，导出的是当前日期或区间选中的项目；账户余额是实时快照，不提供导出。 - **时区**。时间线、峰谷时段和计价规则的生效时间都用北京时间（UTC+8），不受宿主机时区影响。 计价状态、Provider 匹配规则、自定义规则与目录更新的完整说明见[使用指南的计价部分](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/usage-guide.md#3-计价与费用)；价格目录的采集和签名见[动态价格设计](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/pricing-updates.md)。 ## ❓ 常见问题
装完为什么侧边栏没有「用量」？ 先确认安装命令成功，再完整重启宿主（桌面端退出应用，Web 重启 `dsh web`），浏览器必要时硬刷新。DSH 会缓存客户端模块和 Typert 描述符。确认装的是目标 profile：装到 `web` 不会同时出现在 `desktop`。
为什么费用看起来不全？ 主费用汇总只包含能确认并换算成人民币的金额。订阅用量、未知模型、显式 relay/local、归档且无日志的 fork 都不猜价，因此被排除；原因在会话详情里，导出保留 `costStatus`、`ruleId` 和 `pricingSource`，可以逐条定位。
为什么账户页查不到某个账户？ 账户查询走各 Provider 的官方余额接口。没有公开接口的 Provider 会列在账户页的「未接入」组并说明原因，Token 统计不受影响；已配置接口但缺少凭证的账户会单独标出缺少的变量名。DeepSeek 的 `deepseek-account` 登录方式没有 API Key，查不到余额。凭证变量和覆盖方式见[使用指南的账户部分](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/usage-guide.md#4-账户与凭证)。
怎么更新？ 重新执行对应 profile 的安装命令并指定目标版本，然后按安装时的方式重启。价格目录是独立更新的：宿主启动时和之后每小时检查签名目录，不需要为调价重装插件。
## ⚠️ 已知限制 - 当前会话的 projection cache 可能滞后几秒，面板每 60 秒自动刷新。 - 普通归档会话会标注「已归档」；归档、无日志且只有继承 cache 的 fork 会从统计中排除。 - OpenRouter 使用带日期的模型目录快照，这类金额会标记为 `estimated`。 - 同一项目的并发会话在时间线中合并为墙钟区间，项目 LLM/工具时长仍是累计工作量指标。 ## 🛠️ 开发与文档 ```bash npm ci npm run build npm test ``` `lib/` 是发布产物，请修改 `src/` 后重新构建，不要手工编辑。`npm run verify:lib` 会重建并检查产物是否已提交；执行一次 `git config core.hooksPath .githooks` 后，`pre-push` 会在推送前跑同一项检查。架构、数据契约和性能权衡见 [DESIGN.md](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/DESIGN.md)，逐版本的模块契约、完整 Web 与浏览器夹具结果见[兼容性矩阵](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md)，`npm run smoke:browser` 使用隔离夹具检查桌面和手机界面。 文档索引： - [使用指南](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/usage-guide.md)（中文）· [Usage guide](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/usage-guide.en.md)（English） - [动态价格设计与维护](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/pricing-updates.md) - [兼容性矩阵](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md) - [0.5.2 发布说明](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/release-0.5.2.md) · [0.5.1 发布说明](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/release-0.5.1.md) · [0.5.0 发布说明](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/release-0.5.0.md) ## 🙌 参与与许可 欢迎在 [Issues](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/issues) 反馈问题，或提交 Pull Request。项目采用 [MIT License](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/LICENSE)。 `╰(*°▽°*)╯`

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Project Atlas — 可视化项目工作台

Project Atlas 是一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：把本机的 AI 项目、技能、Codex / DSH 会话、运行状态与产出，收进一个可缩放的项目工作台。它默认只读，不会替你改写项目；是否把项目交给 Agent，由你在项目页里明确操作。

版本变化请查看 [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md)。

- 四个场景：地球、工作室、图书馆、时间庭
- 项目总览、生命周期与本地备注
- SKILL.md 图谱、DSH / Codex 会话索引
- 运行状态、产物预览、磁盘与 AI 软件概览
- 本地优先：没有账号、没有云端同步、没有遥测

## 安装

### 从 DSH 插件市场安装

在 DSH 的插件市场搜索 **Project Atlas** 或 **项目工作台**，安装后按桌面端提示重启。

> 市场条目需要维护者合并并重建目录；如果暂时搜索不到，请使用下面的手动安装。仓库和 Release 已经可直接下载。

### 手动安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:ruide92/dsh-project-atlas
```

如果 `dsh` 不在 PATH 中，使用桌面端内置的完整 CLI 路径。然后在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中加入 `dsh-project-atlas`，重启桌面端。具体路径以你的 DSH 安装为准；也可以直接从 GitHub 仓库的 tarball 地址安装。

## 第一次使用

插件**不会**猜测你的硬盘、用户名或项目目录。首次打开是空状态，这是有意的安全默认值。

在下面任一位置创建配置：

1. 环境变量 `DSH_WORKBENCH_CONFIG` 指向的 JSON 文件（最高优先级）
2. 插件目录下的 `workbench.config.json`（开发时使用）
3. `~/.dsh/data/dsh-workbench/config.json`（推荐，升级插件不会丢）

最小示例：

```json
{
  "roots": [
    { "path": "D:/work", "depth": 4, "label": "Work" }
  ]
}
```

保存后回到工作台，点击“重新扫描”。

### 配置项

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `roots` | `[]` | 要扫描的根目录。每项可以是字符串，或 `{ path, depth, label }`。为空时不会扫描任何目录。 |
| `excludeGlobs` | 常见依赖/构建目录 | 扫描时排除的 glob。 |
| `workspaceNames` | `Projects` / `Workspace` / `Code` / `Dev` / `Repos` | 被视为“工作区容器”的目录名；容器本身不显示为项目，直接子项会被提升。 |
| `workspaceGroups` | `[]` | 可选的路径前缀分组，例如 `{ "prefix": "D:/work", "label": "Work" }`。 |
| `noisePatterns` | `[]` | 额外视为缓存/临时目录的路径片段。 |
| `assetContainerMarkers` | `[]` | 目录中出现这些文件名时，把该目录当作素材容器，其子目录作为项目。 |
| `skillRoots` | 常见 Agent 目录 | SKILL.md 扫描根。设为 `[]` 可完全关闭技能扫描。 |
| `dshHome` | `~/.dsh` | DSH 数据目录。 |
| `dshSessionsDir` | `<dshHome>/sessions` | DSH 会话目录。 |
| `codexDb` | 自动探测 `~/.codex/state_5.sqlite` | Codex 会话数据库；不存在时静默跳过。 |
| `openCodeDb` | 空 | OpenCode 数据库路径。 |
| `allowDelete` | `false` | 是否允许在界面里删除**已弃用**项目。默认关闭；开启后删除仍会走回收站并要求二次确认。 |
| `protectedPaths` | `[]` | 额外禁止删除的路径。插件自身、数据目录、用户主目录及常见个人目录始终受保护。 |

## 数据与隐私

- 项目内容只在本机读取；插件不发起上传，也不包含遥测。
- 运行数据写在 `~/.dsh/data/dsh-workbench/`：目录缓存、备注、交接记录、删除日志。它们不会被打进 npm 包或 Git 仓库。
- 删除默认关闭。即使开启，也只允许删除标记为“已弃用”的顶层项目，并且会拒绝符号链接、插件自身和数据目录。
- 仓库与发布包不包含任何真实项目、用户名、机器路径、会话 ID 或项目截图；内置地球纹理是 NASA 公共领域素材。

## 文档

- [配置参考](docs/CONFIGURATION.md)：完整字段、优先级、扫描与删除边界
- [架构与数据流](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)：模块、请求流程、数据目录
- [隐私与安全](docs/PRIVACY.md)：读取范围、写入范围、公开仓库清洁规则
- [开发与发布](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)：本地检查、临时安装、发布流程
- [开发场景](docs/scene-development.md)：源码级注册、共享项目数据和扩展边界
- [故障排查](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)：空状态、配置、会话、端口与双工作台冲突

## 开发

```bash
npm test        # 运行自动化测试
npm run check   # 语法检查
```

要求 Node.js >= 22.18（使用 `node:sqlite` 读取 Codex 会话）与 DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.1。

## 资产许可

地球纹理来自 NASA Earth Observatory / Visible Earth，属于 NASA 公共领域素材；详细来源、处理方式和校验和见 [ASSET-LICENSES.md](ASSET-LICENSES.md)。

## License

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

# dsh-superinput

dsh（DeepSeek Harness）**超级输入框套件**：一个插件，八个输入区模块，模块级失败隔离。

| 模块 | 功能 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| **cost** | 费用引擎：状态行费用 pill、官方用量旁的费用按钮+弹卡、月底预测、设置页统计/预算/导出、历史回填、官方价格同步、汇率自动刷新 | 原 dsh-cost |
| **picker** | 模型选择器接管 + 推理强度滑条 | 原 dsh-power-picker |
| **enhancer** | 提示词增强按钮 | 原 dsh-prompt-enhancer |
| **followup** | 回合尾跟进建议 chips | 原 dsh-followup |
| **voice** | 语音输入 | 原 dsh-siri-voice |
| **snippets** | 片段管理器：自动捕获窗口内复制 → 收藏/搜索/点击插入草稿 | 新模块 |
| **prompts** | 提示词模板库：手动保存常用模板，{{变量}} 占位符插入 | 新模块 |
| **hub** | 设置总览：各模块生效配置聚合展示 + 运行时调节 | 新模块 |

`dsh-compaction-control` 不在套件内（宿主配置补丁层 + /compact 命令桥，保持独立插件）。

## 架构

- 服务端 `index.js` 聚合六个模块的 Config（嵌套命名空间 `config.cost.*` 等）并逐模块 try/catch 调用；peer 注入取并集（`llm`、`tools`）。
- 客户端 `client.js` 是单 `__ModuleLoader__` 入口：六个工厂内联（由 `scripts/build-suite.mjs` 从上游各包机械生成），factory 与 apply 双层 try/catch。
- 跨模块协作保持原机制：调用来源分账走 `globalThis.__dshPluginCall` 5s 窗口；各模块调试日志维持原路径（`~/.dsh/cost-debug.log` 等）。

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <本目录绝对路径>
```

从五个独立插件迁移：先装套件、确认 bundles 里有 `dsh-superinput`、重启验证，再移除旧插件（避免同槽位双注册冲突）。装完完整重启 dsh。

## 上游更新

改了 `packages/dsh-*` 的源码后，在套件目录重跑 `node scripts/build-suite.mjs` 再生成 `modules/` 与 `client.js`（幂等）。

## License

MIT

[English](README.en.md) | **简体中文**
# dsh-cherry-bridge **把 DeepSeek Harness 桥接到 Cherry Studio 桌面端** — DSH 插件 在 DSH 会话里直接驱动局域网内 Cherry Studio 的 agent：配对、列设备/会话、读历史、 发消息并等待终态、应答审批与提问卡、取消执行；附一个同源设置页管理设备与工具启用范围。 ```mermaid flowchart TB T["DSH 会话
14 个 cherry_* 工具"] --> P W["设置页
设备 · 配对 · 启用范围"] --> P P["dsh-cherry-bridge
连接池 · 订阅缓存 · 作用域"] P <-->|"ws:// · Noise XX"| C["Cherry Studio 桌面端
二维码配对 · 审批"] ``` - 包名：`dsh-cherry-bridge`，插件 id：`cherry-remote` - 传输：默认 `ws://` + Noise XX（加密由 Noise 记录层提供）；桌面端位于 TLS 前置之后时拨 `wss://`，私有 CA 的信任由 `wsTls` 提供 - 工具面：14 个 `cherry_*` 工具，**按工作区**启用，默认**谁都没有**（见「启用范围」） - 设置页与 HTTP 面：宿主 Web 服务器上的同源前缀 `/cherry-remote/api` ## 安装 > **DSH 版本需求**：`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`（由 `package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 声明；不满足时 bundle 被跳过、设置页里该插件的行被禁用，确需在区间外使用可用 `dsh plugin allow-version` 精确豁免。0.3.0 需重新评估兼容性后再放开）。 > > **Cherry Studio 兼容范围**：桌面端 **2.1.4 – 2.1.10 已核对**——`v3` 自定义地址二维码需 **2.1.8+**，2.1.4–2.1.7 的 `v2` 二维码同样可用。2.1.9/2.1.10 与 2.1.8 在 remote-access 面上只差桌面端发送链的一处健壮性修复（PR #22593，不影响客户端），并在 2.1.10 真机上跑过「建会话 → 发送 → 等待 → 读取」冒烟。区间外未经验证：握手只协商协议版本 `[1]`，不兼容时会以 `unreachable` 明确失败，不会静默出错。协议包钉在 `0.7.0` / `0.2.5`，2.1.10 携带的还是同一对版本。 ```bash # 从 npm 安装（推荐，钉住版本） npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cherry-bridge@0.2.0 # 安装 npm 最新发布版 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cherry-bridge # 从 GitHub 源码安装（与 npm 发布同一提交） npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:SAXEM1997/dsh-cherry-bridge#v0.2.0 ``` 本包自带 `cordis.patch.yml`（`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向它）， dsh-plugin-manager 据此自动插入插件行。手工加行等价于： ```yaml - id: cherry-remote name: 'dsh-cherry-bridge' config: perSessionCacheBytes: 2097152 rateBudgetPerSecond: 32 ``` ### 首次配对 1. 在 Cherry Studio 桌面端打开 **remote access → 添加设备**：该界面显示**二维码**， 配对信息要点开扫码后的页面才看得到。 2. **扫这个二维码**（微信、浏览器等均可），复制页面上显示的配对信息。 3. 在 DSH 里调用 `cherry_pair`（设置页向导亦可），粘贴这段配对信息。 4. **双向核对 6 位验证码**：与桌面端显示的数字人工比对一致后再在桌面端批准。 5. 批准后设备档案写入数据目录（`devices.json`，`0600`），其 `desktopIdentity` 被 pin 住， 此后每次连接都校验 Noise 对端静态公钥与 pin 一致，防二维码被劫持后的中间人替换。 ## 快速上手 ```text cherry_pair → 粘贴扫码页的配对信息，核对 6 位验证码 cherry_devices → 看设备与连接状态（前缀即可选中，如 "dev-A"） cherry_agents → 列设备上的 agent，拿 agentId cherry_sessions → 列某 agent 的会话，拿 sessionId cherry_read → 读会话历史（默认取最新 100 条，从新到旧） cherry_send → 发消息并等待终态，返回助手文本 cherry_interactions → 看待答的提问/审批卡；cherry_respond 作答 ``` ## 配置 | 键 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `dataDir` | string | `$DSH_HOME/cherry-remote`（回退 `~/.dsh/cherry-remote`） | 插件数据目录，存放 `identity.key` 与 `devices.json`（均 `0600`）。 | | `perSessionCacheBytes` | number | `2097152`（2 MiB） | 每个会话的**本地**订阅事件缓存上限，超出按 LRU 丢弃最旧事件并 `warn`。 | | `rateBudgetPerSecond` | number | `32` | 每设备平滑请求预算（请求/秒）。桌面端共享额度在 ≤2.1.6 是 64 req/s、≥2.1.7 是 256 req/s，且只有新版本才把超限降级为单请求 `RATE_LIMITED`（旧版本直接 close `1011` 终止会话），故按更严格的一代取保守值。内容读取（`agent.content.read`）按 8:1 派生独立一档，且**封顶 512/s**（该额度两代一致）。 | | `wsTls` | object | — | 每次 `wss` 拨号的**扁平** `tls.connect` 选项（只接受 `rejectUnauthorized` / `ca`），供桌面端位于私有 CA 或自签 TLS 前置之后时由运维提供信任；配对与重连**两个拨号点**共用。**不写入设备档案、不写日志、不进诊断报告。** 整个对象要么按原样生效、要么整体忽略：未知键或不可用值按名 `warn` 后回退 Node 默认信任库（不部分应用）。 | > `wsTls.ca` 是 **PEM 内容**（证书文本本身），不是文件路径。 > ⚠️ `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config` 是**整体替换**，不与默认值合并。删掉一个键得到的是 > 插件默认值；键存在但值非法（`0`、负数、字符串）会按名 `warn` 后回落默认值。 ## 工具 | 工具 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `cherry_devices` | 列出已配对设备及连接状态（`connected`/`connecting`/`offline`/`disabled`/`identity-mismatch`）。`action: "forget"` 可遗忘指定地址（从拨号列表移除，且桌面再广播也不会被重新学习，直到 `remember` 或重新配对）；`action: "remember"` 撤销该标记（下次握手可重新学习）；两者都需要 `device` 与 `hosts`。 | | `cherry_agents` | 列出某设备上可用的 agent（分页）。被截断时必带 `truncated`+`truncationReason`（`limit` 或 `safety-bound`，后者是 1000 条内部上限）；停点可命名时还给出 `resumeCursor`——用同一 device 与过滤条件把它回传为 `cursor` 即可从停点继续（此时 `limit` 约束的是下一次回答）；跨工具/设备/过滤条件的令牌会被**本地拒绝**，不会转发给对端。 | | `cherry_workspaces` | 列出某 agent 的**已注册**工作区，以及是否存在系统工作区。被截断时必带 `truncated`+`truncationReason`；停点可命名时还给出 `resumeCursor`——用相同过滤条件回传为 `cursor` 即可续读。 | | `cherry_sessions` | 列出某 agent 的会话，可按工作区过滤。被截断时必带 `truncated`+`truncationReason`（`limit` 或 `safety-bound`），停点可命名时还给出 `resumeCursor`——用同一 device 与**相同过滤条件**把它回传为 `cursor` 即可从停点继续（此时 `limit` 约束的是下一次回答）；跨工具/设备/过滤条件的令牌会被**本地拒绝**。 | | `cherry_read` | 读会话消息历史快照，**从新到旧**返回（`limit` 丢掉的是**最旧**的消息）。失败消息在桌面端给出时附带 `failure: {reasonCode, retryable, message}`（对端分类、是否值得重试、对端自己的有界摘要；其 `source`/`context` 不投影到回答里）。附件 part 只回 `name`/`mediaType`/`byteLength`，`content` 为空——字节不取。这覆盖桌面端可能发来的两种形状：`file` part（`name` 即文件名，`byteLength` 取自它的 ref）；以及桌面端用于**未上传**附件的旧式 `data` part——`name: "file"`，元数据以 JSON 形式放在 `content.text` 里（`{"mediaType":…,"filename":…}`），同样字段被取出结构化，`filename: null` 则不报 `name`，且只有当该对象里的每个键都是这两个上报字段时才清空 `content`（带额外键时保留原始文本）。其他 `name` 的 `data` part（例如任务事件）不是附件，原样透传。被截断时 `truncated` + `truncationReason` 一定说明：`limit` 表示你设的条数到了，提高 `limit` 即可；`aggregate-bytes` 表示单次回答达到了**输出大小上限**——与 `limit` 无关，提高 `limit` 只会多付往返、仍停在同一预算。**被挡下的更旧消息用 `messagesResumeCursor` 续读**：把本次返回的 `messagesResumeCursor` 原样传给下一次调用的 `messagesResumeCursor` 参数即可从停点继续（`limit` 此时约束的是**从停点起**本次最多返回多少条），长历史分几次回答读完。停点不可命名时**没有**这个令牌（`truncated` 仍为 `true`，**缺失本身不代表历史已到底**；补救按 `truncationReason` 分：`limit` 可以提高 `limit`，`aggregate-bytes` 不行——被挡住的旧消息在这一回答里拿不到，详见[错误与限制](#错误与限制)）。两种令牌：`cursor:`（整窗读完后的 peer 分页位置）与 `after:`（停在窗内，续读从最新端扫到该消息、返回它更旧的那些）。不是本工具发出的令牌会被**本地拒绝**（不转发给桌面端——桌面端会静默回退到最新页）；`after:` 锚点在历史里找不到则**报错**，不会返回空结果。 | | `cherry_events` | 读取该会话缓冲区内比 `cursor` 更新的事件，并在投递后 ack。返回 `{events, nextCursor}`；把 `nextCursor` 作为下次的 `cursor` 传回即可续读。 | | `cherry_create` | 在 agent 工作区创建会话（工作区选择**必填**；创建后回读身份）。 | | `cherry_send` | 向会话发消息，默认等待运行到终态并返回助手文本；`wait: false` 立即返回命令回执。内容被截断时 `messagesTruncated`/`messagesTruncationReason` 说的是**消息**被截断（丢更旧的）；`deadline` 表示**回答自身的装配时限**到了（见下），已读到的内容照常返回。 | | `cherry_wait` | 只等待该会话在途执行收敛（不发送新消息）。 | | `cherry_interactions` | 列出该会话**待答**的交互卡（提问 / 审批）。被截断时必带 `truncated`+`truncationReason`；停点可命名时还给出 `resumeCursor`——用 `sessionId` 相同的调用回传为 `cursor` 即可续读（`limit` 计的是过滤**前**的对端条目）。 | | `cherry_respond` | 应答交互卡：提问必须全量作答，审批走 `decision`。 | | `cherry_cancel` | 取消会话在途执行（`expectedExecutionId` 必填）。 | | `cherry_pair` | 用「扫码后页面显示的配对信息」建立与桌面端的配对。 | | `cherry_unpair` | 解除配对：断开连接并从设备档案删除。 | `device` 参数接受**精确 `deviceId`**，或 **`deviceId` 前缀 / 显示名前缀**；多项命中返回 `ambiguous-device` + `candidates`，一个都没命中返回 `not-found` + `known`。 `cherry_send(wait: true)` / `cherry_wait` 的 `status` 有 **8 个取值**：四个协议终态 （`completed`/`failed`/`cancelled`/`interrupted`），加上 `awaiting-interaction`（出现待答 交互卡，运行仍活着）、`timeout`（窗口用尽，**不是失败**，随附部分内容，停点可命名时再带游标）、 `idle`（`cherry_wait` 遇到没有在途执行的会话，立即返回快照）、`subscription-lost` （事件订阅丢失且重建失败，运行结局**不可知**，随附修复指引）。 ## 错误与限制 - 读方法在重连后**单次**重放；桌面端 ≥2.1.7 的限流拒绝（`RATE_LIMITED` + `retryAfterMs`） 也在调用方预算内等待后**单次**重放。**命令永不重放**——写操作丢失应答时，携**原 `commandId`** 重试即可，桌面端的命令账本会回放原回执。命令被限流拒绝是另一回事：桌面端在**派发前**就拒绝， 命令根本没执行，错误文本会说明这一点、给出对端要求的等待时间（`retryAfterMs`，对端没给就不写）， 并提示该检查的 `rateBudgetPerSecond`（默认预算远到不了限流）。 - 单个外置内容上限 32 MiB，超过的 part 标 `unavailable`，不回无法校验的部分内容。 - **外置内容装配是进程级限流的**：同时最多 4 个 `{ref}` 在装配（官方客户端的读并发策略）。 单个 ref 的装配峰值约 3× 它的大小，所以**装配峰值**上界是 4×3×32 MiB = 384 MiB，日常远低于此 （4×3×声明大小）。它约束的是**正在装配**的内容，不是全部驻留：已经装配完、被各调用自己持有的内容 不在这个乘积里（每次并发读最多再带一整条消息，因为输出预算只在消息之间检查），parts 缓存另计。 等待槽位也计入等待类回答的时限：排到时限就放弃并把这一 part 标 `unavailable`。 - 历史走查被截断时一定说明（`truncationReason`，`limit` / `aggregate-bytes` / `deadline` 三种含义不同，见上）， 并在停点可命名时给出 `messagesResumeCursor` 续读令牌。**停点不可命名时就不给**：对端位置为空、 带首尾空白或任意控制字符、形如已停用的 v1 令牌、令牌会超过 4096 字符上限、或没有可当锚点的 消息 id——此时 `truncated` 仍为 `true`，**缺失本身不代表历史已到底**。补救按 `truncationReason` 分：`limit` 停点只有在调用方自己握着上限时才靠更宽的 `limit`（`cherry_read` 与四个列表工具）； **wait 类回答的 `limit` 是它自己的固定条数额度**，更旧的历史要用 `cherry_read` 去读。 `aggregate-bytes` 停点不行——预算是它停下的原因，更宽的 `limit` 只会多付往返，被挡住的旧消息 在这一回答里拿不到；`safety-bound` 停点是内部熔断，调用方动不了它；`deadline`（只出现在 wait 类回答）同样改用 `cherry_read` 续读，它没有时限。 **两个面是同一条规则**：消息面的 `messagesResumeCursor` 与四个列表工具的 `resumeCursor` 都只发出本工具会收回的令牌；位置内部的普通空格合法，不会因此被拒。 某条消息自身 parts 没读全时带 `incomplete: true`（wait 类回答里被时限截断的那条消息会带 `partsTruncated: "deadline"`）。 - **等待类回答有自己的装配时限**：`cherry_send(wait: true)` / `cherry_wait` 在窗口结束后仍要读一段历史 （消息页 + 每条消息的 parts + 每个外置 `{ref}` 内容），这一步现在是**有时限的**——截至「你的窗口 + 同样长度的时间」，下限 1 秒、上限 15 秒（即窗口 1 秒 → 最多再等 1 秒；窗口 20 秒 → 最多再等 15 秒）。 链路抖动时不会再有「每个请求各等 5 秒重连」把回答拖到几分钟之后；时限用尽就停走查， 已读到的内容照常返回并标 `messagesTruncationReason: "deadline"`，更旧的历史用 `cherry_read` 续读。 同一条时限也覆盖 **终态与超时回答**所读的会话快照：快照读不到时 回执降级（`aggregateError` + `guidance`），不会把已经确定的运行结局（`status` 与各 id）一起丢掉。 `cherry_wait` 判断「会话是否还有在途执行」的那次**前置快照**同样有时限（从工具入口起算「窗口 + 尾」）： 它在预算内读不到时直接**失败并给出修复指引**——此时还没有回答可降级，运行状态**不可知**，重试是恢复路径； 「500 毫秒窗口却先等 5–10 秒重连与重放」的旧形态因此消失（#51）。前置快照成功之后， idle 回答的历史走查仍从那一刻起算自己的预算（慢但成功的快照不会把走查挤成零）； 代价是两段预算**分开计**，病态调用可能把两段都花掉。 - **已知限制**：`cherry_respond` 让 DSH agent 可代替用户批准 Cherry 端审批卡（MVP 不加拦截层， 信任 DSH 自身的工具审批）；每设备仅申请 `agent` capability；传输默认 `ws://`， `wss://` 要求桌面端位于 TLS 前置之后（本插件不做 TLS 终止；私有 CA 的信任由 `wsTls` 提供）。 > 传输重放、32 MiB/≈3× 内存、空页与游标容忍、完整性语义等工程细节见 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)。 ## 设置页与启用范围 插件同时是 **web client bundle**（`package.json` 的 `dsh.client`，导出 `./client`），通过 `settings.section` 槽位注册 **`cherry-remote`**（导航标签「Cherry 互联」）页面： 设备卡片（启用/停用/删除）、配对向导（粘贴 → 6 位验证码 → 终态）、启用范围面板，以及经 `/cherry-remote/api/events` SSE 推送的实时状态。 14 个工具**按工作区**决定是否出现，机制是**隐藏而非拒绝**（不在范围的会话里不进工具表，省上下文）： - **默认谁都没有**：作用域文档不存在、损坏或读不出来，都按 `selected` + 空列表处理（fail-closed）。 - **`仅选定工作区`**：只有勾选的工作区里的会话才可能出现这些工具；没有工作区的会话始终没有。 - **`全局`**：所有工作区都可见，面板勾选不参与判定。 - **保存即时生效**：对所有 live agent 重装/释放限制层，**下一轮**即生效，无需重启或新建会话。 - **范围只管工具**：设置页与 `/cherry-remote/api` 不受范围影响，被排除的工作区也能自救。 - **不假装**：宿主能力 `pending` / `unsupported` 时面板如实说明，这些工具都**不注册**（fail-closed）。 开发时可单独跑 `npm run dev:ui`，前提是宿主已在 `http://127.0.0.1:23023` 运行； `CHERRY_DEV_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:` 可改端口。作用域文档在 `/scope.json` （`0600`、原子写入、`revision` 单调），HTTP 端点与错误码见 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)。 ## 开发 ```bash npm test # vitest 全量（含 tests/contract/） npm run typecheck # 服务端 + UI 两侧 npm run build # tsdown → dist/index.mjs + dist/index.d.mts npm run build:client # vite → lib/client.js npm run dev:ui # 设置页 dev server（需宿主在 127.0.0.1:23023 运行） npm run prepublishOnly # 发布前闸门：typecheck + test + build + build:client + npm pack --dry-run ``` `dist/` 与 `lib/` 是**随仓库提交**的产物：改完 `src/` 或 `ui/` 必须重跑 `npm run build && npm run build:client` 再提交。开发约定、构建事实、协议依据与设计决策见 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)；发布前请走完 [`docs/e2e-checklist.md`](docs/e2e-checklist.md) （配对 / 发送 / 交互应答 / 断连恢复 / 多设备并存需真机人工核验）。 ## License MIT

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# TreeCom — 对话树

> Tree-shaped conversation branching for DeepSeek Harness. Keep one visible conversation; manage its branches as a tree.
>
> 版本 **0.5.3** · MIT · DeepSeek Harness Web 插件

用一个对话窗口和一棵可平移的画布树管理它的分支；分支仍然是普通会话，会出现在左侧工作区：

- 画布上每个圆点是一个节点；根节点在顶部，分支向下展开，按叶序从左到右排开；
- 拖动空白画布即可上下左右平移；滚轮 / 触控板缩放，树可以无限延伸；画布左上角「回到当前」定位当前叶子，「居中」把树移回视野中心；
- **点击节点 = 选中并在右侧打开该轮详情**，不会跳转、也不会分叉；详情里的「回到这一轮」才会切换分支并定位；
- 生成状态按节点区分：只有真正在生成的那一轮叶子显示「生成中」，它的父节点显示「存在子节点正在生成中」；画布、悬停预览和右侧详情保持一致；「生成中」用浅蓝色标记，「你在这里」保持绿色；
- 右侧详情显示：上下文窗口占用（百分比 + 进度条 + 精确 token）、从该节点开始还能继续多少轮、可上下滚动的完整提问 / 回答，以及归档、重命名、分叉；
- 鼠标悬停节点会浮出可交互的详情预览：轮次、完整提问与回答、上下文占用、后续轮数；鼠标移进预览框不会消失，框本身是箭头；移到文字上变为工字光标，可直接拖拽选择并复制；可用滚轮在框内上下滚动查看完整对话；点击预览框底部的「点击查看详情」与点击节点效果相同；
- **没有分叉的连续轮次会折叠成一个带数字的节点**；点击该节点展开整段连续对话；展开后把鼠标移到链上的节点，预览框里会出现「折叠上方 N 轮」，只折叠该节点之上的部分，不会把整条链全部收起；
- 树数据按会话缓存，只在会话内容发生变化（新轮次、切换/新增对话、标题变化等）时更新；空闲时不轮询，生成中的会话会低频刷新；右上角刷新按钮可强制重新加载；
- 当前所在节点用主题绿色圆点；选中节点用主题强调色；「你在这里」保持绿色；
- 分支叶子节点仍与对话区会话标题同步：在对话区改名会同步到树的叶子；在树上重命名也会同步回会话标题；中间轮次节点的标签只影响树内展示；
- 从标题栏打开时，对话树出现在**右侧边栏**里，对话区保持可见；边栏的关闭、宽度调整由宿主提供；会话视图切换到「对话树」标签页时，输入框自动隐藏；
- 右侧详情的提问框 / 回答框设置最大高度：内容短时自动收缩，超过上限才在框内向下滚动；复制按钮固定在框上方；
- 右侧详情和悬停预览里的提问 / 回答都按 Markdown 渲染（标题、列表、代码块、表格、链接、强调等）；右侧提问 / 回答框上方有「复制」按钮，复制成功后短暂显示「已复制」；
- **两个入口**：
  - 标题栏右上角的「对话树」按钮：打开右侧边栏里的「对话树」标签页；边栏本身负责关闭和拖动宽度，对话区保持可见；
  - 会话视图里的「对话树」标签页：和「对话 / 轨迹 / 上下文」并排，全宽显示画布 + 右侧详情；此标签页激活时输入框隐藏，切回「对话」即可继续输入；对话区的宽度拖拽手柄在此标签页下也会停用，避免误出现横向缩放光标；
  - 没有第三个入口，也不再有任何浮动遮罩层；
- 重命名 / 归档 / 分叉按钮固定显示在右侧详情的标题下方，不再藏在长对话底部；
- 每次对话结束后的分叉统一使用宿主自带的「在新对话中分支」，插件不再额外加「分叉」按钮；树节点详情里的「分叉」用于从任意旧节点开分支；
- 新分支不再自动归档，会直接出现在左侧工作区；每个非根节点在详情里有「归档」；
- **归档同步**：已归档的分支不在树里显示；在左侧取消归档后，它会自动回到树里。

## 为什么底层是 fork

DSH 的会话日志是 append-only 的线性 surface，聊天区只渲染「追加」消息。
在一个物理会话里用 `surfaceOp: replace` 切分支，只会改变模型看到的内容，
不会改变聊天记录；要做到「界面也跟着切」，只能重写整套 Chat 渲染层。

DSH 官方支持的分支原语是 fork：把某一轮之前的完整事件前缀复制成子会话。
子会话的聊天区显示的就是「到该轮为止的同一段对话」，因此切分支看起来是
「回到那一轮」，不是打开一个新对话。TreeCom 把这个过程藏在一个树面板后面。

## 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness（Web UI），已启用本地插件/bundle。
- 插件是纯 JavaScript，无构建步骤；Host 半与 Client 半都在仓库里。

## 安装

`dsh plugin` 会把参数转发给 profile 目录里的 pnpm，因此 npm 包名、`github:`、`link:`、`file:` 等 pnpm 支持的 spec 都可以。

从 GitHub 直接安装（当前可用）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Serenity-2026/dsh-treecom
```

发布到 npm 后，也可以只写包名：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-treecom
```

本地开发时，克隆后把目录 link 进 profile：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Serenity-2026/dsh-treecom.git
dsh plugin --profile web add link:"$PWD/dsh-treecom"
```

安装或更新后刷新 DSH Web 页面（Host 半的 `/treecom` 路由需要重新加载）。

> 仓库名是 `dsh-treecom`，当前 npm 包名是 `treecom`；npm 上计划使用 `dsh-treecom`。在 npm 发布前，请使用上面的 `github:` spec。

## 使用

画布的缩放和位置会按会话树记住：从侧边栏切到「对话树」标签页、重新打开面板或切换分支再回来时，画布会回到上次的位置，而不是每次都跳回根节点。


1. 点标题栏右上角的「对话树」打开右侧边栏，或使用会话视图里的「对话树」标签页；
2. 拖动空白处平移画布；滚轮 / 触控板缩放，节点始终按树形展开；没有分叉的连续轮次会折叠成一个节点，点击展开；
3. 点任意节点，在右侧查看该轮详情；点「回到这一轮」才切换分支并定位到那一轮；
4. 悬停节点可快速看本轮提问、上下文占用和后续轮数；鼠标移进预览框后可继续滚轮查看完整对话；
5. 在详情里「分叉」开新分支，新分支会作为普通会话出现在左侧，但当前对话区仍然停在原分支；新节点会在约 0.6 秒内从父节点位置逐渐生长出来，不再瞬间出现；
6. 分叉创建后会显示「分支创建成功，正在刷新对话树…」的进度提示；刷新完成前树上的选择、拖动、缩放、详情操作和刷新按钮都会锁定，完成后提示「分支已创建，对话树已刷新」；
7. 分叉完成后，树的选中状态和视野会自动移到新分支；新分支详情里会显示「回到这一轮」，点击即可切到该分支并继续提问；
8. 在详情里「重命名」改名，对话区会话标题会同步；叶子节点也会同步显示会话标题；
9. 在详情里「归档」把分支移出树；在左侧取消归档即可恢复。

## 结构与数据

- `index.js`：Host 半。只读索引 `/treecom`，读 `sessionQuery` 的会话日志，
  把轮次按 `inheritedEventCount` 归一化，共享主干只画一次；标签写到
  `~/.dsh/storages/treecom/state.json`。不写任何会话日志。
- `plugin.client.js`：Client 半。可平移/缩放画布树、右侧详情面板、标题栏入口、
  会话视图「对话树」标签页；数据按会话缓存，会话变化时刷新；fork/切换走正常 Client 服务。
- `locale/`：中英文案；`icon.svg`：插件图标；`cordis.patch.yml`：bundle 挂载行。

所有数据都在本地：树索引读本地会话日志，标签写本地 sidecar 文件，只与本机 DSH 的 `/treecom` 路由通信，不发起外部网络请求。

## 已知边界

- 底层每个分支是一条 fork 会话，会正常出现在左侧工作区（标题带 (1)、(2) 后缀）。
- 点节点的「分叉」才会创建分支；如果随后不提问，会留下一个空分支，
  在树里显示为「新分支 · 等待提问」；它也会出现在侧栏，可在节点上归档，或在左侧取消归档恢复。
- 当前分支正在生成时，分叉按钮、树上的分叉动作和归档按钮会禁用；
- 刷新按钮会转圈，完成后弹出「刷新成功」提示；点击时会清掉该会话缓存并强制重新请求 `/treecom`，不会因为缓存而看起来没有变化；空闲时不会自动轮询，避免反复重绘；生成中的会话会低频刷新；
- 卸载插件后所有会话仍在；归档的分支可在 DSH 的归档列表里取消归档。

## License

MIT © 2026 Minchuan Deng

### Ask a blank branch from the tree

Select a newly forked “新分支 / 等待提问” node, type directly into the 提问 box in the right detail pane, and press Enter. The question is sent to that branch’s own session, the current branch switches to the new turn (the green dot moves), the 对话树 tab is reopened, and the answer streams into the same 回答 box. The child tree is prefetched before the switch so it appears instantly.

### Collapse parent subtrees

Select a node that has children and use 「收起子节点 / 展开子节点」 in its detail header. Collapsing hides the complete subtree; expanding restores the previous nested state — a child that was expanded before stays expanded.

### Promote a branch into a new tree

Long-press a non-root node on the canvas and drag it to the top drop banner (「拖到这里，设为新树根」). This creates a new tree view rooted at that node and keeps the original tree intact. The promoted root is stored per folder.

Use the header switcher to choose 「当前对话树」 (default) or 「全部对话树」. The all-trees view lists every root conversation tree in the same folder plus promoted roots; choosing another root opens that conversation. The all-trees list uses the new Host `forest` action, so restart the Host once after updating.

decision.reason: Held for versioned DSH compatibility. MIT and Git installation are documented. Versioned DSH support is unresolved. Session-file reading, branch UI and persisted tree state are native client/host capabilities. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-shelfry

在 DSH 左侧导航多一个入口，点开是整页的 [Shelfry](https://shelfry.app) 插件市场，看到合适的插件直接点「安装」。

## 它做什么

DSH 自带 profile 能力，但「装什么」一直靠手找。这个插件把 Shelfry 的插件市场搬进客户端：

- 侧栏新增一行「Shelfry 市场」，点击切到整页面板（不是设置项）
- 列表按综合分排序（星数、最近提交、简介完整度、安装方式加权），默认展示前 2000 条
- 搜索框按名称、作者、用途即时过滤；分类胶囊按插件 / Skill / 其他筛选
- 卡片尺寸统一，列数随容器自适应：设置弹窗里两列，侧栏整页三列
- 点「安装」先弹确认窗（描述、兼容性、安装命令），确认后交给宿主安装；装完显示「已安装」
- 新装插件传入 `enabled: false`，不会自动启用，是否启用仍由你在插件管理里决定
- 点「详情」跳到站点详情页，看完整评分与来源

插件只读市场数据，不读你的本地 profile、不改配置。安装动作走宿主自己的 `remote.pluginManager`；
壳没有暴露这个服务时，面板自动降级为「复制安装命令」，其余功能不受影响。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shelfry/dsh-shelfry
```

`--profile` 是必填参数；`web` / `tui` 是 DSH 自带模板，首次使用会自动初始化，也可以换成你自己的 profile 名。

## 数据

客户端打开面板时直连 `https://shelfry.app/data/market-top.json`（静态只读，站点已开放 CORS）。
数据每天随站点重建，不在本地落缓存。取不到数据时面板显示错误与「重试」，不影响 DSH 其他功能。

数据契约（`market-top.json`）：`schemaVersion` / `generatedAt` / `total` / `entries[]`，
每条只保留展示字段 `i`(owner/repo)、`n`(名称)、`d`(简介)、`s`(星数)、`sc`(综合分)、
`t`(类型)、`vr`(版本)、`g`(engines.dsh)、`cmd`(安装命令)。

## 结构

```
src/index.ts     宿主侧入口（空实现：面板完全在客户端）
client.js        客户端半区：ModuleLoader 包，注册 sidebar.panellist（导航行）+ main（整页）
cordis.patch.yml 挂载行（行名必须是包根名，壳靠它读取 dsh.client）
```

客户端半区不经过打包器：壳把它当作 ModuleLoader 包执行，`react` 由壳注入的 `require` 提供。
因此**改 `client.js` 不需要构建**。

宿主侧编译产物 `lib/` 已提交进仓库：这样 `github:` 安装时不需要跑任何构建脚本，
也就不会被 pnpm 的 `allowBuilds` 拦下。改 `src/index.ts` 后请重新 `npm run build` 并一并提交 `lib/`。

## 开发

```bash
npm install     # 只装 typescript
npm run build   # 编译宿主侧到 lib/（改 src/ 后必须跑）
npm test        # 客户端半区契约测试
npm pack --dry-run
```

宿主侧兼容性由 `engines.dsh` 决定（当前 `>=0.1.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`）。

## 许可

MIT

decision.reason: Static evidence chain reviewed. MIT, documented repository Git install and engines.dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 through below 0.3.0 agree. Fixed host/client and patch are captured. Client fetches shelfry.app market data, shows an install confirmation and hands a GitHub or upstream spec to manager.installBundle with enabled:false. No lifecycle hooks; the external mutable market/spec and host installer remain supply-chain trust boundaries. Reviewed covers this plugin identity, not the packages it lists. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

fullManifest.description: DSH × Blender 直连插件（v3.0.1，GUI 优先，无头备用）：15 个模型工具让 AI 直接驱动 Blender——视口/自定义视角、持久内核 Python、时间窗/帧序列观察、内环参数搜索、无头进程与热会话（see/watch/reset/preload/warmup）、作业层、事务回滚、配方库，以及 34 family / 228 op 的契约层（catalog / 判定 / 验收 / 造型 / 装配 / 白模 / 导出）。v3.0.0 为工程重构版（runtime TypeScript、addon zip）；v2.6.2 新增曲面算法包 surface_*（loft/sweep/patch → tessellate → validate → export，M0–M2/M4；M3 fit 与 M5 blend/offset 未实现）。P0–P2 能力：交互式无头（rt_do/rt_see session、plan session=auto）、参考图量具（img_digest/probe/measure/calib）、装配扫描/清单/合并/修复/门/导出（asm_*）、白模与 Seedance 参考包（blockout refsheet/turntable）、同机位 QC（visualreport_report）、无头轮廓拟合（shapesolve_solve）、缺陷注入评估（eval_run）、强制门（gate_/deliver_export require_gate）。默认先开 GUI；无头备用；装完必须重启 DSH；唯一验收判据 doctor kind=ok；blender-modeling skill 随包自动注册。详见 README 与 docs/操作教程.md。

# DSH × Blender

[简体中文](docs/zh/README.md)

DSH × Blender connects DeepSeek Harness to Blender so an agent can build, inspect, validate, and export 3D scenes in a real Blender session. The normal workflow is GUI-first: start Blender, connect the addon, and let the agent look, change, and verify. When no GUI is available, a persistent headless session provides the same interactive loop, including frames.

## Contents

- [Features](#features)
- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Tools](#tools)
- [Documentation](#documentation)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)
- [Development](#development)
- [Support](#support)
- [License](#license)

## Features

- **GUI-first interactive modeling.** The agent works against the Blender session you are looking at. It can inspect the scene, run Python in a persistent kernel, take a viewport or custom-angle frame, and iterate one step at a time.
- **Headless fallback with visual feedback.** If Blender has no GUI, start a persistent worker and the agent can still execute code and get Workbench frames. This is a fallback path, not the default; it exists so the agent is never blind.
- **Reference-image measurement.** Measure silhouettes, holes, symmetry, readable features, and scale from a reference image before modeling. If no scale is known, the tools return pixel units instead of inventing millimeters.
- **Parametric surfaces.** Build reproducible surface meshes from sections (loft), a profile swept along a rail, or a four-sided patch; run continuity, curvature, self-intersection, and thickness checks; then export GLB. The same spec yields the same `spec_hash` and vertices instead of hand-sculpted geometry.
- **Assembly audit and repair.** Validate an assembly manifest, classify clashes, hidden overlaps, contacts, gaps, floating parts, and contained parts, apply safe repairs, gate the result, and export GLB, FBX, or OBJ with a manifest and merge ledger.
- **Blockout and video-reference packs.** Build low-poly blockouts from declarative parts, render orthographic and perspective reference views, and produce a turntable MP4 for video models such as Seedance.
- **Visual acceptance and delivery gates.** Compare renders against references from the same camera, report defects with crops and measurements, run defect-injection evaluation, and block delivery when the gate is not pass.
- **Automation and long jobs.** Run one-shot headless scripts, long background jobs, parameter searches, and batch validation without occupying the GUI.
- **Native selection.** Select objects or collections in Blender and send them into the current DSH draft.
- **Works in dsh-TUI too.** In dsh-TUI, a Blender selection is attached to your next message as a context chip; the footer shows the Blender channel state (connected / AI paused / rendering / jobs); `@` mentions scene objects, materials, and collections; and `/blender status|doctor|jobs` checks the channel without going through the model. Each part needs the matching dsh-TUI seam and stays off when the seam is missing.

## Quick start

**Before anything else: install the bundled addon first.** Use the addon shipped in this repository: **addon/dsh_blender_bridge.zip**. It must be your only Blender-side *agent bridge*: do not install or run `MCP for Blender`, `blender_mcp`, or any other addon that serves Blender over its own socket, since they compete for 127.0.0.1:9876. Unrelated addons (modeling, materials, rendering, asset libraries) are fine and are neither checked nor blocked. Install and enable this addon in Blender before the other steps. If the installation below does not work, first check that this exact addon is installed, enabled, and connected.

### Requirements

- DSH (DeepSeek Harness) installed and working.
- Node.js 22.17 or newer is needed only for source builds; installing from npm uses the runtime bundled with DSH. Node.js 22.17 is the CI and test baseline.
- Blender 4.2 LTS is the tested version. Blender 4.x may work; Blender 5.x is not yet validated. GUI mode requires the bundled addon (install it first); headless mode only needs the Blender executable.
- Addon compatibility: the bundled addon is the only required addon and the only supported agent bridge. Other addons do not conflict; an old `MCP for Blender` / `blender_mcp` does (same 127.0.0.1:9876 port) — disable it, no need to uninstall.
- Optional: a DSH source checkout when rebuilding the host side; otherwise the build links against this repository's installed dependencies.

### Option A: install from npm

This is the supported installation path. It does not require `git clone`, `npm ci`, or `npm run build`.

1. **Install the bundled addon first.** Download `dsh_blender_bridge.zip` from the [latest GitHub Release](https://github.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin/releases/latest), then in Blender open `Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > Install`, select the zip, enable **DSH Blender Bridge**, open the `N` panel in the 3D view, and click **Connect**.

2. **Install the DSH plugin from npm.** Choose the path for your DSH host:

   - **DSH Web or DSH TUI:** install into the profile you actually run:

         dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-blender-plugin@3.0.1

     Then restart DSH in step 3.

   - **DSH Desktop:** open the Plugins page and install the bundle `dsh-blender-plugin@3.0.1`. DSH Desktop applies the bundle from the Plugins page and does not need a DSH restart.

3. **Restart DSH (DSH Web and DSH TUI only).** If you installed from the DSH Desktop Plugins page, skip this step.

4. **Verify the installation.** The only acceptance criterion for the GUI route is `doctor` returning `kind` equal to `ok`:

        curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:9877/doctor

   GUI route: `curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:9877/health` and `/doctor`; `doctor.kind` must be `ok`.

   Headless-only route (no addon): `blender_rt_worker(op="start")` followed by `op="see"` must return a frame.

The addon remains the only supported Blender-side agent bridge. Disable any other bridge addon that serves port 9876; ordinary modeling, material, rendering, and asset addons are unaffected.

### Option B: ask an AI agent

Copy this prompt into an agent that can run commands:

    First install and enable the bundled addon dsh_blender_bridge.zip
    from the latest GitHub Release. If a bridge addon is already enabled
    (MCP for Blender / blender_mcp, or anything else serving Blender on
    port 9876), disable it; do not uninstall the user's other addons and
    do not ask them to.
    Then install the DSH × Blender plugin from npm for my DSH profile:
    dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-blender-plugin@3.0.1
    Read docs/AI-安装提示词.md first, follow it exactly,
    and finish with the acceptance check: doctor must return kind=ok for the
    GUI route, or worker start + see must return a frame for the headless-only route.
    Do not skip the check and do not claim success without it.

Fetch the full install prompt locally:

    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin/main/docs/AI-安装提示词.md -o AI-安装提示词.md

Install the standalone modeling skill (only needed for hosts that do not load the plugin; DSH gets it bundled):

    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin/main/skills/blender-modeling/install.sh | bash

### Option C: build from source (developers)

1. **Install the bundled addon first.**

   Download **addon/dsh_blender_bridge.zip** from the addon/ folder of this repository. In Blender, open Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > Install, select that zip, enable DSH Blender Bridge, open the N panel in the 3D view, and click Connect. The addon listens on 127.0.0.1:9876. If you previously installed the single-file `dsh_blender_bridge.py`, disable and remove it first: v3.0 installs only the package zip.

   Keep this addon as your only agent bridge. If `MCP for Blender` / `blender_mcp` (or another addon that opens its own server on 9876) is enabled, turn it off — uninstalling is not required. Your other addons can stay. If the rest of the installation does not work, check this step first.

2. **Developer path:** clone the repository and build it. `lib/` is a build artifact and is not committed, so a fresh clone must build once before use. Unless you are developing the plugin, use the npm install above.

        git clone https://github.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin.git
        cd dsh-blender-plugin
        npm ci --legacy-peer-deps
        npm run build
        # Optional: DSH_CHECKOUT=/path/to/dsh-harness npm run build links DSH host packages

3. Add the package to your DSH profile as a bundle. Link the checkout into the profile, then add the dependency and bundle entry to the profile package.json.

        ln -s /absolute/path/to/dsh-blender-plugin <profile>/node_modules/dsh-blender-plugin

    Profile package.json:

        {
          "dependencies": {
            "dsh-blender-plugin": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-blender-plugin"
          },
          "dsh": {
            "profile": {
              "bundles": ["dsh-blender-plugin"]
            }
          }
        }

    Validate the profile and restart DSH:

        dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config

4. Verify the installation.

    GUI route:

        curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:9877/health
        curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:9877/doctor

    The only acceptance criterion for the GUI route is doctor returning kind equal to ok. If it does not, the plugin is not installed correctly.

    After DSH restarts, you can also use blender_viewport with op equal to launch. It starts Blender, enables the addon, and connects automatically.

    Headless-only route (no addon):

        blender_rt_worker(op="start", name="smoke")
        blender_rt_worker(op="see", name="smoke")

    A returned frame means the headless fallback is working. The doctor bpy round-trip is expected to be unreachable in this mode.

## Tools

The plugin exposes 15 tools. All planning, audit, assembly, export, and evaluation operations live under blender_rt_plan, so the tool list stays small.

### Interaction and control

| Tool | What it gives you |
|---|---|
| blender_rt_see | A frame of the current GUI viewport or a custom camera angle. |
| blender_rt_do | Runs Python in Blender with a persistent kernel; can return a frame with the result. |
| blender_rt_watch | Samples a time window or frame range and reports whether the image changed. |
| blender_rt_worker | A persistent headless session for interactive work when no GUI is available. |

### Planning and operations

| Tool | What it gives you |
|---|---|
| blender_rt_plan | The capability catalog and the execution surface for modeling, audit, assembly, delivery, and evaluation operations. Start here when you are unsure which operation to use. |
| blender_viewport | Channel health, doctor, launch, and write-lease operations for coordinating multiple sessions. |

### Automation and jobs

| Tool | What it gives you |
|---|---|
| blender_rt_headless | Runs a standalone Blender background process for batch work, validation, or rendering. |
| blender_rt_job | Starts long work in the background and collects the result by job id; a timeout does not lose the result. |
| blender_rt_loop | Runs a parameter search loop inside Blender and returns the best candidates. |

### Scene utilities

| Tool | What it gives you |
|---|---|
| blender_rt_txn | File-level snapshots and object-level marks for rollback. |
| blender_rt_preset | Saves, lists, applies, and exports reusable parameter presets. |
| blender_rt_perf | Diagnoses and applies render performance settings. |
| blender_rt_opt | Finds safe object merges to reduce scene overhead. |

### Addon access

| Tool | What it gives you |
|---|---|
| blender_rt_cmd | Calls any addon command directly. |
| blender_rt_commands | Lists available addon commands and integration states. |

## Documentation

- Surface algorithm: docs/曲面算法.md
- Step-by-step guide: docs/操作教程.md
- Configuration: docs/配置参考.md
- AI install prompt: docs/AI-安装提示词.md
- Deployment SOP: docs/部署SOP.md
- Third-party checklist: docs/给第三方的安装清单.md
- Architecture: docs/architecture.md
- Modeling skill: skills/blender-modeling/
- Release notes: GitHub Releases and CHANGELOG.md

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | What to do |
|---|---|
| doctor does not return kind equal to ok | Check that Blender is running and the addon is connected. For the GUI route this is the only valid acceptance check. |
| No GUI is available | Use the persistent worker fallback: start a worker, then run code and request a frame. |
| Another session is writing to the same scene | Take the write lease with blender_viewport, or use separate headless workers for parallel work. |
| An old MCP for Blender / blender_mcp addon is still enabled | Disable it (uninstalling is not required) and use the bundled DSH Blender Bridge addon; both compete for 127.0.0.1:9876. |
| Images are generated but not attached | Update to the latest build; the Windows path fix is included. If it persists, open the returned path directly. |
| Followed the steps and it still does not work | Check the bundled addon first: only addon/dsh_blender_bridge.zip is supported, and it must be enabled and connected. |

## Development

- Node.js **22.17** is the CI and test baseline; Node.js 20 is not tested.
- Python tests need a virtualenv with `pytest`. Point `PYTHON` at its interpreter
  (`PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8` and `PYTHONUTF8=1` on Windows); tests import the TypeScript sources directly.
- The canonical command table — install, build, typecheck, test, lint, pack — is
  [`AGENTS.md` §1](AGENTS.md#1-commands-single-source). `lib/` is rebuilt from `runtime/` and `src/`; never hand-edit it.
- Test layers, fixtures, and per-layer commands: [`tests/README.md`](tests/README.md).
- Contribution workflow: [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [`docs/zh/CONTRIBUTING.md`](docs/zh/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- Bundled skill source: `skills/blender-modeling/`.

## Support

If this project is useful to you, you can support its development on Afdian (爱发电): <https://afdian.com/a/sixtysevenlf>

## License

The plugin is BSD-3-Clause. The bundled modeling skill is MIT; see skills/blender-modeling/LICENSE and NOTICE.md. Blender is a trademark of the Blender Foundation.

# Compaction provenance guard

A standalone, additive DSH Bundle. Its single entry is
`skunpoj-compaction-provenance-guard`. It does not patch, disable, rename or
replace official DSH components. The repository root remains a deployment
reference; this subfolder is the plugin installation target.

## Purpose and limits

Before a completed compaction response reaches checkpoint adoption, check the
tested English claims that an assistant guide included opaque identifiers.
Identifiers appearing only in user text must not be credited to assistant
output. Unsupported or ambiguous attribution holds compaction and suppresses
recovery retry for that typed error. Ordinary chat bypasses the guard.

This is a bounded heuristic, not a general truth, recall, security or summary
quality verifier. It cannot guarantee detection across languages, paraphrases,
hidden/non-text content or identifiers outside its matcher. A hold can prevent
compaction until the conversation is reviewed. Existing summaries are not
rewritten. The existing compactor owns persistence; the plugin itself does not
read/write files, access credentials, run commands or make network requests.
It buffers up to 4 MiB of chunks and 262,144 text characters before releasing
successful compaction output. Source inspection is bounded at 32 MiB visible
text. Rejected candidate details exist only on the in-memory error object.

## Host requirements

Use the exact release matrix in [compatibility.json](compatibility.json).
Unlisted versions remain unknown. Node must satisfy `engines.node`.

| DSH version | Install | Native start / scoped guard | Uninstall | Rollback |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.2.1-rc.1 | Passed | Passed | Passed | Passed |
| 0.2.1-rc.2 | Passed | Passed | Passed | Passed |
| 0.2.1-rc.3 | Passed | Passed | Passed | Passed |

Tested on Windows with Node 24.18.1. Each case used a separate temporary home,
the actual DSH CLI/package manager and native profile loader. The real native
compactor adopted a supported synthetic checkpoint; explicit and coreference
misattributions were held without checkpoint replacement. Uninstall removed
the entry and restored unguarded synthetic stream behavior. The original
profile manifest was restored, newly created lock/workspace configuration
removed, and a disposable history sentinel remained unchanged. Official
module source hashes matched before and after. No real model calls, real
histories, browser application, Linux/macOS or live deployment were tested.

The package has no runtime dependencies. The host must
already provide both `llm` and `compaction`. No install/prepare lifecycle scripts
or model-provider keys are supplied. Do not install alongside another copy of
the deployment guard in the same profile.

## Install, start and uninstall

First pin the complete repository commit and inspect this subfolder and its
manifest. Use a **new disposable DSH_HOME**, never your current profile, for
initial acceptance. Replace the paths with your own absolute paths:

```sh
export DSH_HOME=/absolute/path/to/new-disposable-dsh-home
dsh plugin --profile guard-check add /absolute/path/to/dsh_setup/plugins/compaction-provenance-guard
dsh --profile guard-check --dump-config
# Start that disposable profile using your ordinary DSH launcher.
# The plugin must show active with its own entry ID.
dsh plugin --profile guard-check remove dsh-compaction-provenance-guard
dsh --profile guard-check --dump-config
```

The exact automated qualification procedure, its real host lifecycle and mock
stream boundary are documented in `test/qualify.mjs`. It never invokes a model
provider. CLI/profile installation and native plugin startup are separate
checks; passing them does not certify a browser application or real LLM summary.
Back up profile manifest, lockfile and patch before any non-disposable install.
Remove the bundle and restore the saved profile files for rollback. Do not
delete user histories or change upstream packages.

## Development

`npm test` runs bounded source/stream checks without a host or model.
`node --expose-internals test/qualify.mjs /absolute/path/to/isolated-host /absolute/path/to/new-output`
executes the isolated host lifecycle from the repository checkout. Keep personal configuration, secrets and
raw private deployment evidence outside this package.

For DSH Store monorepo discovery use manifest path
`plugins/compaction-provenance-guard/package.json` and install path
`plugins/compaction-provenance-guard`. Packaging and author tests do not imply
marketplace approval or independent security audit.

# Private AI Workspaces - Kubernetes and 1M Context

## Current GPU setup, measurements and administrator plan

[Current PDF report](docs/gpu-platform/GPU_PLATFORM_REVIEW.pdf) · [Graph and data](docs/gpu-platform/README.md) · [Three serving profiles](gpu-stack/profiles/README.md) · [Host-change and recovery runbook](gpu-stack/runbooks/gpu-peer-access.md)

DeepInfer + DSpark is a separate inference engine, not vLLM; the retained `vllm-*` Service name and humming library ownership do not identify the serving engine. The three references explicitly separate current DeepInfer/NCCL, retained SGLang rollback and the **unqualified proposed** DeepEP trial after host integrity checks. The public fork exists, but a known tokenizer difference and compiled-artifact provenance remain open. Public references do not claim the private Azure operational pipeline has completed its cutover.

Based on [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness); not a GitHub fork. Upstream releases are tracked by the auto-port workflow (`.github/workflows/upstream-auto-port.yml`).

**GPU serving today (30 Oct 2026):** DeepInfer + DSpark on 4× H100 NVL, 1M context; see [docs/deepseek-v41-h100](docs/deepseek-v41-h100/README.md#current-production-30-oct-2026-utc).


[English Fola video guide](docs/COURSE_GUIDE.md) · [Video and presentation index](docs/PRESENTATION_EDITION.md)
## Application links and learning materials

The [Main/Test application guide](docs/APP_LINKS_AND_STATUS.html) provides the deployment status, application login flow, slides and English video. Main application controls are separate from the controlled App5/App6 Test examples.

## Application sign-in and return

The [application login guide](docs/APP_SIGNIN_AND_RETURN.html) explains app-focused team login, the Test continuation flow, returning to the requested app, and Public access with separate destination authentication. RegChat, App5 and App6 are examples rather than hardcoded login paths.

## Managed provider login

Keep the team gateway login and native DSH authentication. Managed LiteLLM profiles hide the separate official DeepSeek account sign-in. See [the login guide](docs/MANAGED_PROVIDER_LOGIN.html) for user steps, configuration and hot reload.

## Three risk controls

Start with [the design and operating principles](docs/THREE_RISK_CONTROLS.md) or its [HTML guide](docs/THREE_RISK_CONTROLS.html): prevent external leakage, prevent damage or excessive access, and keep results within authorized users. GPU configuration and measurements belong in the technical references after the controls. [Risk-first course delivery](docs/COURSE_DELIVERY.md) explains authenticated video, captions, source snapshots and safe updates.

## AD / LDAP authentication

Start with the [user manual](docs/DSH_USER_MANUAL.md) or its [standalone HTML version](docs/DSH_USER_MANUAL.html) for sign-in, private environments, tools, application URLs and administrator controls. The [current-guide policy](docs/CURRENT_GUIDE.md) describes the single deployment guide and preserved archives.

Optional verified LDAPS sign-in supports private No Internet accounts with Internet access approved separately by an administrator. An AD username that conflicts with an existing local account is rejected with a clear instruction to contact an administrator to resolve the identity conflict; no account or history is automatically merged or deleted. Existing local recovery sign-in remains available. See [configuration, collision handling and tests](docs/LDAP_AUTHENTICATION.md).

## Authenticated application sharing

Owners can explicitly share an ordinary local web app with enabled DSH users while keeping JupyterLab, terminals, workspaces and histories private. Existing mappings remain owner-only. See the [sharing guide](docs/AUTHENTICATED_APP_SHARING.md) or its [HTML version](docs/AUTHENTICATED_APP_SHARING.html) for setup, isolation boundaries and application responsibilities.

## Public presentation and speaker guide

[Editable PowerPoint](docs/presentations/guarding-the-value-stream/Guarding_the_Value_Stream.pptx) · [Slide PDF](docs/presentations/guarding-the-value-stream/Guarding_the_Value_Stream.pdf) · [Detailed storytelling PDF](docs/presentations/guarding-the-value-stream/Guarding_the_Value_Stream_Story.pdf)

The 23-slide talk covers agent incidents, controls, governance, illustrative banking and insurance workflows, and DSH. Its final QR links to this repository. Research infographics are credited to **Thanatchon Chongmankhong** ([HarnessWatch](https://thanatchon36.github.io/harnesswatch/paper/) and [airmkit](https://thanatchon36.github.io/airmkit/paper/)). The examples are hypothetical and are not a claim of live business automation or certified compliance.

This public tree contains sanitized installation code and generic configuration for the approved core version. Site-specific configuration, identities, credentials and operational history remain in an access-controlled repository. See [publication boundaries](docs/PUBLICATION.md).

A configurable deployment of DeepSeek Harness, internal LiteLLM and a four-GPU
inference backend (DeepInfer + DSpark in production since 29 Oct 2026; SGLang kept as the fallback). The repository includes the GPU manifests, model-download job,
storage, context guard, scheduler overlays, private user environments and setup
instructions. No separate infrastructure repository is required.

This is a **fresh-install reference**, not an export of an existing organization
or a promise that any four-GPU machine will sustain 1M context. Model weights,
hardware, storage drivers, domain names, certificates and credentials are supplied
by the operator. The public examples contain no real deployment addresses,
personal accounts, operational transcripts or credential values.

## What it provides

- One private non-root runtime, workspace and history volume per user/environment.
- No Internet as the main login default; separate Internet dependency preparation.
- Protected local password records, owner-bound routing and an admin access log.
- Managed Claude Code and TrueForge configuration using model-only client keys.
- Four-GPU serving with DeepInfer + DSpark (DP-attention and expert parallelism over four ranks) or
  SGLang tensor parallelism as the fallback, 1,048,576 total-token capacity,
  chunked prefill and fail-closed scheduler compatibility checks.
- LiteLLM authentication, PostgreSQL-backed virtual keys and a loopback final-wire
  context guard. Text above 32K counted input plus reserved output uses bounded
  managed admission; shorter requests can remain concurrent. Input includes the
  complete conversation and tool context, not only the latest prompt. That is not two simultaneous full-1M requests or an SLA.
- Persistent storage and read-only approved packages. Persistence is not backup.

## Roadmap

Planned, not yet delivered. Each item is tested in a disposable profile or a test window before it reaches users.

- **Theme centre.** A small skin format (`dsh-themes`) and a picker (`@dsh-suite/themes`) so an operator can offer several reviewed themes beside the native Light/Dark/System appearance, instead of shipping one fixed theme package. It follows the optional `dsh-theme-custom-light` plugin and an operator's custom theme release (0.2.0: a separate colour row under the untouched native Appearance setting, plus brand slots). Installation stays pinned and hash-checked; an existing older copy is upgraded only from an exact, qualified version, with a rollback copy kept.
- **Prefix cache for DeepInfer.** DeepInfer has no cross-request prefix cache yet: a follow-up turn on a long conversation re-reads the whole prompt (first token about 38 s at 127K, 145 s at 498K and 301 s at 995K tokens). The host prefix-cache (hicache) module is not in the upstream tree; the plan is row K ("host prefix cache", in the configuration matrix of [DeepInfer#221](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepInfer/discussions/221)).
- **Host GPU peer-to-peer trial.** Saved cross-socket copy checks found destination-data mismatches. IOMMU translation/ACS are candidate factors, not an isolated cause. Start with administrator readback, then an approved, reversible host trial and byte-integrity gates before DeepEP. The conditional W1 one-request estimate and its assumptions are in the current report; no post-change speed or recovery result is claimed.
- **One canonical source for portable code.** This repository is to become the canonical home of the portable product code; a site deployment carries only that code plus its private overlay (site names, identities, branding, operations). Until then, the publication boundaries in [docs/PUBLICATION.md](docs/PUBLICATION.md) describe what stays private; the path-by-path mapping will be added there.

## Start here

1. Read [prerequisites and complete installation](docs/INSTALL.md).
2. Copy `config.example.yaml` to ignored `config.local.yaml`; supply your storage,
   domain and built runtime-image digest. Never put credentials in that file.
3. Render `generated/` with `python scripts/render_k8s.py --config config.local.yaml --output generated`.
4. Follow the ordered namespace/storage, Secret, model-download, platform and
   client-key steps in the guide. Do not apply everything before downloading weights.
5. Perform [acceptance tests](docs/ACCEPTANCE.md) before allowing real workloads.

The renderer refuses unresolved placeholders. It never reads a live cluster or
renders Secret values. Helpers create fresh Secrets through stdin, do not print
their values and refuse to overwrite existing credentials.

## Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  U[Authenticated user] --> G[Gateway and protected account store]
  G --> N[Private No Internet runtime]
  G --> I[Private Internet runtime]
  N --> P[Own workspace and history]
  I --> Q[Separate workspace and history]
  N --> L[Authenticated LiteLLM]
  I --> L
  L --> F[Loopback final-wire context guard]
  F --> M[DeepInfer v4 + DSpark on 4× H100 NVL, SGLang kept as fallback]
  L --> DB[Private PostgreSQL]
  I --> C[Private incoming packages]
  C --> O[Operator review and hash promotion]
  O --> A[Approved cache mounted read-only]
  A --> N
```

The browser does not select a backend host. The server binds each login to an
operator-provisioned user/environment mapping. Runtime pods have no account-store
mount or Kubernetes API token. No corporate identity provider or datalake is
implicitly configured. [Security boundaries](docs/SECURITY.md).

## Context and performance

The reference profile reserves up to 8,192 output tokens and 256 proxy tokens.
With that full output reservation, maximum counted input is 1,040,128 tokens.
DSH automatic compaction is configured near 917,504 estimated tokens, with exact
wire budgeting enforced separately. Long prefill can take minutes and reduce
short-request throughput. Use [the tuning guide](docs/CONTEXT_1M.md); qualify your
own memory margin, cancellation, tools and mixed load before increasing limits.

## Verification and maintenance

```sh
python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
python scripts/scan_public.py .
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_public_manifests.py'
node tests/test_password_store.js
node tests/test_workspace_policy.js
```

Pinned package/image compatibility checks fail closed on upstream changes. A
source or schema test is not proof of successful GPU inference. Keep local
configuration, generated manifests, keys, tickets, backups and results out of Git.
See [third-party notices](docs/THIRD_PARTY.md).

For custom automatic provisioning, see [signup capacity, pressure gating and automatic recovery](docs/SIGNUP_CAPACITY.md). The portable evaluator is supplied for integration; it does not install a collector or enable registration.

## Application access and proxy setup

Private local applications and explicitly approved HTTPS destinations can use owner-bound app URLs, with DSH sign-in required by default. See the [application proxy setup and regression checks](docs/APP_PROXY.md) for origin policies, DNS/TLS, optional Gradio compatibility and destination-authentication boundaries.

For existing installations that cannot restart immediately, the optional [managed-client compatibility layer](docs/LIVE_CLIENT_COMPATIBILITY.md) applies only to new launches. It preserves existing processes and history; permanent image adoption remains separate.

## DeepInfer on four H100 GPUs

**Current (30 Oct 2026):** DeepInfer v4 + DSpark serves production on 4× H100 NVL (SM90) with a 1M-token
context, 8 requests at once and least-loaded routing. SGLang + DSpark is kept switched off as the measured
baseline and rollback. Cross-socket GPU peer-to-peer drops writes on the reference host, so experts are
exchanged over an NCCL all-to-all fallback instead of DeepEP. Configuration, the matched DeepInfer-versus-SGLang
comparison and the open items (host P2P fix, prefix cache): [docs/deepseek-v41-h100](docs/deepseek-v41-h100/README.md#current-production-30-oct-2026-utc).

The SM90 engine tree (based on the community SM90 work in DeepInfer #92 and #200) will be published as a public
fork of `deepseek-ai/DeepInfer`; link to follow once it is published.

## Jupyter Start

Start safely reuses an already-enabled Jupyter service across Main DSH, DSH2 and DSH3.
[Administrator controls](docs/JUPYTER_START_CONTROLS.html) and the
[captioned walkthrough](docs/JUPYTER_DSH2_DSH3_WALKTHROUGH.html) explain Start, Stop and Restart.


### Application audiences and checkbox editing

The deployed Main-gateway update replaces typed usernames with a local-user checkbox picker and adds **Edit sharing / URL** for saved applications. New ordinary authenticated apps default to **All authenticated users (local and AD / LDAP)**; owners can choose all local users, all AD / LDAP users, selected local users or owner-only. Existing audiences stay unchanged until saved. JupyterLab and terminal remain owner-only.

Actual gateway tests cover local/directory identity enforcement, private routing and HTTP/WebSocket revocation; form-script tests cover checkbox editing and defaults. The update is deployed on Main DSH. The exact deployed source passed 158 tests in the running runtime image; existing accounts, app audiences, sessions and worker/history preservation were verified. Legacy DSH2/DSH3 entrypoints remain owner-only. See [audience choices, edit workflow and boundaries](docs/AUTHENTICATED_APP_SHARING.md).

## Jupyter automatic startup

Private workspaces seed managed Jupyter in both environments. Internet startup still requires admin-approved Internet access. Autostart recovers the saved desired state after replacement; Admin Stop stays disabled. Existing on-demand servers are left running until natural handover, preserving active notebooks. Saved files and settings remain in their private storage. See the [lifecycle guide](docs/JUPYTER_APP_LIFECYCLE.html) and [operator backfill procedure](docs/JUPYTER_AUTOSTART_BACKFILL.html).


Jupyter dashboard status distinguishes **Waiting for existing Jupyter**, **Internet approval pending**, **Account disabled** and **Recovery retry pending**. These labels do not change startup or access permissions. See the [status explanation](docs/JUPYTER_APP_LIFECYCLE.html) and [captioned walkthrough](docs/JUPYTER_DSH2_DSH3_WALKTHROUGH.html).

Jupyter status transitions are verified using disposable users: Internet approval clears the pending label, and exiting an existing server permits automatic handover to **Running**. Existing saved notebook/settings markers remained unchanged. See the [lifecycle guide](docs/JUPYTER_APP_LIFECYCLE.html) and [walkthrough](docs/JUPYTER_DSH2_DSH3_WALKTHROUGH.html).

## Three-site code and maintenance

The approved DSH application is 0.2.1-rc.5 with pi-ai 1.3.0; sites still running 0.2.1-rc.2 move to it when redeployed. Main DSH, DSH2 and DSH3 share the core build and inspected transport/supervisor code while retaining distinct authentication and environment policies. Use the managed LiteLLM model and choose the correct local or AD sign-in provider. New releases are ported automatically when no reviewed file changed: [automatic pin ports](docs/UPSTREAM_AUTO_PORT.md).

## User-managed credentials

[Credential management guide and Fola lesson](docs/USER_CREDENTIAL_MANAGEMENT.html): aliases instead of secrets in chat; owner/workspace/environment/action policy; lifecycle and audit controls. ## Optional persistent secondary registry

The [registry installation, CI and recovery guide](docs/SECONDARY_REGISTRY.md) includes a machine-only token service, isolated Test deployment renderer, same-image promotion and reproducible synthetic tests. The [Deep Agents and DSH CLI candidate](integrations/managed-agents/README.md) adds an opt-in image overlay and fixed-model launchers. It is source-tested, not built or deployed. # dsh-theme-custom-light

An optional DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that adds a **Custom Light** appearance beside the native Light, Dark and System themes. Native themes stay exactly as upstream DSH ships them; System continues to follow the device colour scheme. The plugin registers through the DSH theme service and the supported Appearance settings slot and does not modify built application assets.

Installation does not select Custom Light. Choosing it stores only a version marker, the selected state and the native fallback preference in browser-local storage, so the choice is per browser origin and profile, not synchronized between accounts or devices. Native choices keep their normal DSH settings transport. Removing the plugin restores the native Appearance row and preference.

## Structure

The layout follows [bugmaker2/dsh-plugin-template](https://github.com/bugmaker2/dsh-plugin-template), reduced to a client-only plugin with no runtime dependencies:

```text
package.json         # dsh.bundle + dsh.client manifests, scripts
cordis.patch.yml     # mounts the host row into a profile
dsh.plugin.json      # registry manifest
lib/index.js         # empty host entry (name/apply)
lib/client.js        # prebuilt Web client bundle (node build.mjs)
src/palette.mjs      # Custom Light token values
src/controller.mjs   # selection, fallback and persistence
src/client.mjs       # theme registration and Appearance slot
test/                # service tests against published DSH bundles
```

## Install

From a checkout containing this directory, into an explicitly selected profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add ./plugins/dsh-theme-custom-light
```

Restart that profile through its normal deployment process. Remove it with `dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> remove dsh-theme-custom-light`. Managed deployments install it with `scripts/install_native_theme_profile.cjs`, which accepts only the qualified `lib/client.js` hash; see [NATIVE_THEME_INTEGRATION.md](../../docs/NATIVE_THEME_INTEGRATION.md).

## Development

Rebuild the client bundle with `node build.mjs`, then update `CLIENT_SHA` in `scripts/install_native_theme_profile.cjs`. To run the service tests, install the pinned development dependencies and run `npm test`; the tests use the published DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 theme and slot services, with React rendering, the Cordis facade and the settings transport as test doubles.

The palette carries 32 aliases from the gateway login stylesheet `scripts/platform.css`. Broad element selectors, hashed class selectors and global `!important` declarations are not copied, so this preserves the palette, not pixel parity. Palettes from the dshbase theme gallery can replace `src/palette.mjs` after review; the gallery's Skin Center, which writes body theme attributes directly, is not installed by this package.

## Qualification

The service tests and the named-profile lifecycle checks (discovery, activation, disposal, removal and rollback) do not establish browser rendering or deployed behaviour. Before promotion, qualify all four choices, refresh, font changes, OS scheme changes, removal, chats and attachments against the exact profile and image.

## Jupyter Start

Start safely reuses an already-enabled Jupyter service across Main DSH, DSH2 and DSH3.
[Administrator controls](docs/JUPYTER_START_CONTROLS.html) and the
[captioned walkthrough](docs/JUPYTER_DSH2_DSH3_WALKTHROUGH.html) explain Start, Stop and Restart.


### Application audiences and checkbox editing

The deployed Main-gateway update replaces typed usernames with a local-user checkbox picker and adds **Edit sharing / URL** for saved applications. New ordinary authenticated apps default to **All authenticated users (local and AD / LDAP)**; owners can choose all local users, all AD / LDAP users, selected local users or owner-only. Existing audiences stay unchanged until saved. JupyterLab and terminal remain owner-only.

Actual gateway tests cover local/directory identity enforcement, private routing and HTTP/WebSocket revocation; form-script tests cover checkbox editing and defaults. The update is deployed on Main DSH. The exact deployed source passed 158 tests in the running runtime image; existing accounts, app audiences, sessions and worker/history preservation were verified. Legacy DSH2/DSH3 entrypoints remain owner-only. See [audience choices, edit workflow and boundaries](docs/AUTHENTICATED_APP_SHARING.md).

## Jupyter automatic startup

Private workspaces seed managed Jupyter in both environments. Internet startup still requires admin-approved Internet access. Autostart recovers the saved desired state after replacement; Admin Stop stays disabled. Existing on-demand servers are left running until natural handover, preserving active notebooks. Saved files and settings remain in their private storage. See the [lifecycle guide](docs/JUPYTER_APP_LIFECYCLE.html) and [operator backfill procedure](docs/JUPYTER_AUTOSTART_BACKFILL.html).


Jupyter dashboard status distinguishes **Waiting for existing Jupyter**, **Internet approval pending**, **Account disabled** and **Recovery retry pending**. These labels do not change startup or access permissions. See the [status explanation](docs/JUPYTER_APP_LIFECYCLE.html) and [captioned walkthrough](docs/JUPYTER_DSH2_DSH3_WALKTHROUGH.html).

Jupyter status transitions are verified using disposable users: Internet approval clears the pending label, and exiting an existing server permits automatic handover to **Running**. Existing saved notebook/settings markers remained unchanged. See the [lifecycle guide](docs/JUPYTER_APP_LIFECYCLE.html) and [walkthrough](docs/JUPYTER_DSH2_DSH3_WALKTHROUGH.html).

## Three-site code and maintenance

The approved DSH application is 0.2.1-rc.5 with pi-ai 1.3.0; sites still running 0.2.1-rc.2 move to it when redeployed. Main DSH, DSH2 and DSH3 share the core build and inspected transport/supervisor code while retaining distinct authentication and environment policies. Use the managed LiteLLM model and choose the correct local or AD sign-in provider. New releases are ported automatically when no reviewed file changed: [automatic pin ports](docs/UPSTREAM_AUTO_PORT.md).

## User-managed credentials

[Credential management guide and Fola lesson](docs/USER_CREDENTIAL_MANAGEMENT.html): aliases instead of secrets in chat; owner/workspace/environment/action policy; lifecycle and audit controls. Implemented for configured API-token/PAT connectors; OAuth consent and Kerberos acquisition are not included.

[OpenShell prerequisites](docs/OPENSHELL_RUNTIME_PREREQUISITES.md) separates the completed CPU-only preflight from its 25 unrun product gates. [OAuth/Kerberos explanation](docs/CREDENTIAL_OPERATIONS.md#why-oauth-and-kerberos-are-separate) describes these optional integrations and the configuration they need.

## Optional persistent secondary registry

The [registry installation, CI and recovery guide](docs/SECONDARY_REGISTRY.md) includes a machine-only token service, isolated Test deployment renderer, same-image promotion and reproducible synthetic tests. Primary registry defaults stay explicit; this package never deploys applications or enables automatic failover.


## Standalone compaction guard plugin

The [additive plugin bundle](plugins/compaction-provenance-guard/README.md) is independent of the deployment overlays. DSH 0.2.1-rc.1, rc.2 and rc.3 passed disposable-profile CLI install, native startup, uninstall and rollback on Windows/Node 24.18.1, with synthetic streams and native compaction. It owns one entry ID, has no runtime dependencies or install hooks, and does not replace official packages. Exact results and limitations are in the [compatibility matrix](plugins/compaction-provenance-guard/compatibility.json). This packaging release does not deploy the plugin or change live workspaces, histories or GPU settings. DSH Store review remains separate.

## Managed coding-agent integration candidate

The [Deep Agents and DSH CLI candidate](integrations/managed-agents/README.md) adds an opt-in image overlay and fixed-model launchers. It is source-tested, not built or deployed. Web Terminal runs the actual CLIs; DSH web chat does not automatically control their sessions. See the [public-source review scope](docs/PUBLIC_SOURCE_REVIEW.md) for publication checks and limitations.
