# dsh-task-board-team · Team collaboration provider for the DSH task board English | [中文](README.zh.md) An external provider extension for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) task board (`@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-task-board`). It connects this machine to a cloud `team-hub`: issues the hub assigns to a dsh-agents member bound here are claimed under a lease, executed as mirror cards on this Host, and settled back to the hub, while decision questions, comments and review rejections travel between the team and the session that is doing the work. The board's columns, ledger and execution rules are untouched, and the plugin mounts through `cordis.patch.yml` and profiles without any DSH source change. ## Features - **Member bindings, not a shared queue**: the settings entry names dsh-agents member ids; the member definition supplies the name the hub resolves mentions by, the agent preset and the team workspace. An issue assigned to any other agent is never claimed here, even when the hub lists it. - **Registration and heartbeat**: the Host registers at startup with its hostname, client version and agent definitions, then heartbeats every 15 s, which is the cadence the protocol fixes. A member name another Host already owns is skipped by the hub and reported as a visible problem instead of going missing silently. - **Lease-based claiming**: a claim returns a lease token and an execution attempt id; the mirror card stores both in this extension's own `integrations` payload, and the lease is renewed every 20 s while the card executes. - **Idempotent reconnect**: a reconnect re-registers, replays the channel from its last sequence number and re-claims with the attempt credentials the card still carries, which is only while the run executes here and the lease is held; a settled card releases both, so claiming that issue again is fresh and the hub mints the new attempt itself. - **Settlement write-back**: a settled execution becomes `succeeded` (the issue moves to `in_review`) only when automated acceptance passed; a failure or a cancellation becomes `failed` with the recorded reason, and the summary is clipped to the protocol's 4000-character cap. Every write-back names the attempt that ran. A refusal that can never change — 412 `LEASE_EXPIRED`, or any other deterministic 4xx (with four exceptions) — is final: the Host drops the pending settlement instead of retrying it, clears the attempt and lease only when the refusal names the ones the card holds, and records a visible error; reporting a new outcome requires starting the card again. Anything that may still pass — a transport failure, a 5xx, and four 4xx exceptions (401: the Host Token is unrecognized or revoked, and can still land once the operator provides the right token; 408 and 429; and a 4xx without the hub's error envelope: such errors come from a CDN or firewall in front of the hub rather than the hub's own gates) — stays on the card, and the next sweep retries it before claiming that card, because a claim would mint an attempt nothing runs and the retry would then die against it. - **Question routing**: a decision question asked through `ask_user_question` in a mirror card's session is reported to the hub and answered by the issue's reviewer; the answer, an expiry or a local cancellation ends the ask, and every other session on the machine keeps its own answerer. - **Comments both ways**: the `team_comment` tool posts an agent comment on the issue behind a card, and a comment that mentions a bound agent is delivered into that card's session as a follow-up message. - **Rework and retries**: a review rejection and a sweep share one claim per issue, and only a successful claim decides what runs — a pending rework re-runs the card in its existing session with the reviewer's instructions, and a card a human sent back with nothing running here is started again through the same entry a first claim uses. A refused claim starts nothing and records the refusal locally, and a fresh claim drops the settlement an earlier attempt left behind, because that attempt is gone and its retry can never land. - **The run starts through the board's host face**: the provider contract has no "run" member, so a claimed card is started through the `taskBoard` host service's `apply` — the same in-process action seat the remote bridge drives the board with, and every run gate still applies. - **Visible degradation**: follow-up delivery, rework and the execution trigger are probed at mount; a board revision that serves none of them loses that delivery, says so on the card and in the settings block, and keeps everything else working. - **Three browser seats**: a task-detail section (issue, hub status including `in_review`, assignee, reviewer, comment thread, activity stream and open questions), a hub-status badge on the card, and a configuration block inside the board's own settings card that stays reachable while the extension is switched off. - **One switch gates both halves**: turning the extension off stops the claim loop, the lease timers, the channel and the tool registration, drops the published summary and releases the rendering seats, without deleting a single card. ## Install Install this package into the profile and restart `dsh web`: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-task-board-team@latest ``` ### Local development ```sh pnpm install pnpm --filter @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-task-board-team build dsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/dsh-task-board-team ``` ## Configure Open the task board settings and find the **Team collaboration** block; it stores the hub URL and team id as this plugin's own volatile settings and sends a pasted Host Token to the host once. - The Host Token is held in the harness credential store under `hostTokenRef` (default `DSH_TEAM_HUB_TOKEN`) or, failing that, in the environment variable of that name; no snapshot, summary or tool result carries its value. - The member bindings are dsh-agents member ids (comma separated in the block). A binding that names a member the dsh-agents ledger no longer defines is reported in the block and skipped, and so is a member whose definition pins no agent preset: the hub requires a non-empty `preset_id`, and running such a member would silently fall back to the deployment default. ```yaml # profile patch equivalent hubUrl: https://hub.example.com teamId: team_01j7b5w8m4f9q2e3r6t1y8u4i5 hostTokenRef: DSH_TEAM_HUB_TOKEN agents: - memberId: mem_01j7b5w8m4f9q2e3r6t1y8u4i6 ``` ## Known limitations - **A board that cannot pin the draft targets is refused, not guessed at**: the member's preset, model and reasoning effort travel with the `tasks.create` draft, and the created card is read back to confirm they survived. A board revision that drops them produces a mirror card that is left UNSTARTED with a visible note in the settings block, because running it under the deployment's default preset would not be the member's run. - **Starting an execution needs the board's action seat**: the contract has no "run" capability, so the mount probes the board's in-process action applier and, when a deployment serves none, the claimed card is created for the operator to start instead. - **The activity stream is what this Host observed**: `GET /issues/:id/activity` exists but only a member session may read it, and this Host authenticates with a Host Token, so the detail section renders the events this Host received over the channel since it started; the complete stream is in the Whale App. - **Questions are reported one at a time**: a batch with several questions reports the first one and keeps the rest on this machine, because the hub's question schema stores a single question. - **A claimed question holds the ask for two minutes**: after that window the ask returns to the local answerer and the hub question is withdrawn, so a team that never answers cannot stall a session for the hub's 24-hour TTL. ## Security model - **The Host Token never reaches the browser twice**: it is written once from the settings block into the credential store, read only by the host half, and reported afterwards as "configured" plus its source. - **Tool permission approvals never enter the hub**: this provider subscribes to `user-questions/request` only; `approval/request` has no listener here, so a tool sandbox decision stays on this machine and never becomes a remote request. - **Remote text is content, not authority**: an issue title, body or comment becomes card text, a summary field or a session message, and never a permission, a workspace identity, an agent preset or a `promptPrefix`. - **Claims are bounded by the lease**: a claim that this machine cannot mirror or start is logged and left to expire, and the lease renews only while this Host still holds it. # dsh-web · DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI 插件与主题全家桶 中文 | [English](README.en.md) dsh-web 是面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web GUI、DeepSeek 网页版与官方桌面客户端（DeepSeek Desktop）的模块化插件生态与 AI 智能体开发工作台。全面支持 DeepSeek-V3 与 DeepSeek-R1 等前沿推理模型，为开发者与重度用户提供自主任务自动化看板（Cron 定时后台执行）、手机 App 远程访问、Web SSH 终端与 Linux 集群运维、Git 可视化提交图谱与多 Agent Worktree 隔离开发、全量会话检索与归档管理、Token 用量与成本监控（含 Token 银行），以及一站式主题皮肤与桌面宠物工坊。用户既可以通过官方 profile 机制将插件全家桶一键挂载至已有的 `dsh web` 实例，也可以直接在官方 DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端中开箱即用。

事务账本为权威持久化核心，真正实现了长程任务从拆解、分发、团队协作、对抗质检到外部成果闭环的全流程自动化： - **宿主权威后台驱动与 7x24 小时离线无人值守**：区别于传统仅在前端网页轮询的脆弱看板，所有卡片流转、调度触发与执行监控完全由 DSH 后端 Host 进程作为唯一权威驱动。浏览器仅为异步视图，关闭网页标签页、熄灭屏幕或断开网络，后台智能体会话照常并发执行与原子落盘结算。内置跨平台防休眠电源管理（macOS `caffeinate`、Windows `ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED`、带有 systemd-logind 的 Linux `systemd-inhibit`），允许显示器正常关闭的同时阻止整机因闲置休眠，确保夜间无人值守巡检与流水线准时打卡。 - **多 Agent 树状级联并发与原生 Agent Teams 团队编排**：复杂工程目标可自由拆解为多层树状子任务（支持 1~3 层深度，内置环路与深度护栏）。**级联执行模式**通过受控准入队列（runLaunchWidth）并发派生多个独立智能体会话，自动跳过已在完成列的子任务，任一子任务失败自适应收拢整树状态；**原生 Agent Teams 模式**深度对接官方团队服务，启动专属 Team Lead 会话并在其内部为每个子任务动态孵化专属 Teammate，协同工具跨智能体联动，实现真正意义上的多智能体团队协同作战。 - **对抗式双盲质量验收门禁（No False Completion）**：彻底终结 AI 编程中“自述已完成、实则未改动或改崩溃”的虚假交付顽疾。以 goal 形式执行的任务在 Agent 试图调用 `update_goal(complete)` 宣告完工的瞬间被 Host 强制拦截，必须由独立的裁判模型（可自选模型与思考档位）进行真实验收。验收机制沿用严苛的 Coding 质量判据、0.65 绝对通过阈值，每项判据双轮交换 A/B 位置打分消偏，并严格结合会话执行轨迹与宿主工作区真实磁盘文件的 Diff 行级变更审查。首轮未达标精准下发具象结构化问题引导 Agent 自我修复，两次仍不通过才判负，杜绝敷衍糊弄。 - **全自动 GitHub Issue-to-PR 闭环研发流**：搭配官方扩展（`dsh-client-ui-task-board-github`），实现任务看板与 GitHub Issues / PR 状态的实时双向深度同步。远端 Issue 自动进入看板流水线驱动 Agent 读取需求、定位代码、修复 Bug 并运行测试，验收交付后全自动创建 GitHub Pull Request 并绑定 Issue 关联，PR 合并后自动关闭 Issue，打造全天候无人值守的开源与企业 Issue 自动化修复交付管线。 - **长程目标驱动、会话持久化与冻结交接包（Freeze Handover）**：任务支持武装内置 `/goal` 引擎进行多轮自主续跑；周期性任务可开启会话复用，保留完整上下文记忆；支持通过 `<< Agent 预设”中选用。梁神模式（`dsh-liangshen`）是专为追求**极致推理效率、超低静态上下文开销与严苛工程执行纪律**而深度重构的杀手级预设与运行时插件。针对主流大模型在长程编程任务中容易出现的系统提示词冗长膨胀、工具 Schema 挤占上下文、思维链无效空转（如“流水账推理”）以及多轮遗忘退化等痛点，梁神模式通过原生极简提示词、程序化代码工具调用（PTC）、MCP 温和分页与关键事实局部就近投射，提供纯粹而强悍的编程作战体验： - **极简 Persona 与严苛行动导向纪律（Zero Prompt Waste）**：彻底剥离官方 Standard 预设中冗长繁琐的系统级条文，将提示词极致收敛为单行 Persona 与经过实战千锤百炼的高效工程纪律。内置反思熔断（同一假设推演不超过两轮，缺少事实立即闭合思考并调用原生工具探测，杜绝凭空揣测）、行动导向（思考过程仅用于决定下一步具体操作，严禁在思考中预演完整代码）、并发探索（单轮内并发派发多个独立检测或搜索工具）、YAGNI 与 PDCA 循环（单步验证单一假设，不写冗余注水注释）、以及有界收敛纪律（前置检查最多 2-3 轮即刻收敛，迅速转入实际作答或编辑）。大幅降低静态 Token 占用，让模型注意力百分之百倾注于业务与代码本身。 - **程序化工具调用传输（PTC · Programmatic Tool Calling）**：彻底终结在每次请求中平铺上百个 JSON Schema 工具参数的低效模式。默认将网络线协议（wire）极致收拢为唯一的 `run_code`（运行 TypeScript 脚本），其余所有工具均通过自动生成的强类型 SDK 在独立的沙箱线程中以代码形式调用。无论系统注册了多少复杂工具，静态传输面始终保持极小体积；模型可原生利用 `Promise.all` 编写并发工具调用，并在程序内预先过滤、聚合、提取关键数据，只将精炼结论回传至对话上下文，从根本上解决大文本输出打爆 Token 的问题。对于习惯原生工具面的场景，亦可在插件设置中一键无缝切换为组装好的原生工具清单（Native）。 - **MCP 工具温和分页与 LRU 动态激活（Gentle Tool Paging）**：针对海量 MCP 工具或第三方插件扩展，出厂默认启用温和分页（默认匹配 `mcp__*`）。外部工具在初始状态下仅以命名空间摘要形式登记在目录消息中，既不占 wire 协议也不进 SDK 声明；当大模型判定需要使用对应工具时，可自主调用 `tool_activate({ namespace })` 按需挂载。内置 LRU 策略（上限 3 个活跃命名空间），自动淘汰最久未用的命名空间，激活状态在会话压缩与恢复后完整重建，兼具海量工具接入能力与极致小巧的静态 Schema 面。 - **关键事实登记簿与就近状态投射（Fact Register & Working Context）**：长程多轮对话中大模型极易遗忘早期的关键业务约束或踩过的坑。插件向模型提供专属 `fact_register` 工具，可将用户硬性约束、已确认的架构决策或失败路径登记为单行事实（每条不超过 160 字符，最多保留 12 条）。关键事实随 `[Working Context: ...]` 状态行在每一轮交互中就近投射至最新消息尾部的局部注意力窗口内，从物理机制上彻底解决长上下文“中间遗忘”与重复踩坑顽疾。 - **原生调度者架构与敏捷访谈纪律（Dispatcher Identity & Triage）**：预设出厂深度集成调度者（Dispatcher）架构规范，赋能模型以团队指挥官身份统领工程任务。内置复杂度分诊机制（L0/L1 单点任务直接敏捷执行，L2 复杂任务严格遵循“澄清访谈 -> 架构规划 -> 并发子代理派发 -> 双层严格验收”标准流）；设定严格的提问预算控制（单轮最多 4 问、总计最多 3 轮、影响面排序、假设先行），杜绝无效拉扯；任务状态权威沉淀于 `todo_write`，杜绝浮躁的敷衍式交付。 - **新建会话老虎机拨杆与炫酷中奖特效（Composer Slot Lever）**：在新建会话输入框工具行、模型选择器左侧，精心打造了一台复古老虎机拨杆控件。下拉拨杆（支持鼠标拖拽、单击或键盘快捷操作）即可一键为当前新建会话装配梁神模式，拉下命中即触发绚丽的中奖粒子特效（闪光、冲击环、火花粒子与专属彩蛋横幅）；上推即可平滑切回默认模式。拨杆自适应全局主题色彩，且在会话开始后自动隐藏，丝滑灵动，极具极客趣味。 详细机制、评测数据与高级配置参数见 [dsh-liangshen README](packages/dsh-liangshen/README.zh.md)。 ### 手机 App 远程访问（Mobile Remote · 原生手机 App 接入） 在 profile 中安装 `@linxin666/dsh-remote-bridge` 插件并重启服务后，点击侧边栏底部的二维码图标（aria-label 为「配对手机（协议 v1）」）打开配对面板。使用手机 App 扫码即可直接开始使用。 配对面板具备本地安全保护，令牌路由（`/remote-bridge/pair/token`）带有回环门控，仅允许在本机浏览器中访问（非本机访问返回 403）。面板生成的配对码为一次性凭据，有效期为 30 秒，点击「重新取码」将作废上一张配对码。二维码编码包含服务地址与令牌的文档（URL 形如 `wss:///ios/v1?token=...`），手机 App 扫码后即可同时获取服务地址与鉴权令牌。 网络接入协议面仅暴露 `/ios/v1` 一个 WebSocket 端点，隧道与局域网转发均指向仅放行该路径的入站闸门，公网无法直接访问 Web GUI 路由。服务地址按实时状态（中继租约或运行中的隧道）、环境变量 `DSH_REMOTE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` 以及局域网转发器实际监听地址的顺序解析。默认配置下公网可用（中继默认开启、隧道默认关闭、局域网转发默认关闭）；若需在局域网内直连，需在插件配置中开启局域网转发。原浏览器远程控制插件 `dsh-remote-web-ui` 已退役，接入栈能力已迁入本包。 ### 远程连接（SSH Ops · Web 终端、SFTP 传输与集群运维） 通过侧边栏“SSH”入口打开远程运维面板。支持密钥与密码认证，可一键导入本地 `~/.ssh/config` 主机列表；配置数据安全保存在 `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json` 中。面板提供以下操作能力： - **Web 终端**：基于 xterm.js 的完整远程交互终端，支持实时输出与窗口自适应； - **文件传输**：集成 SFTP 上传与下载功能，提供进度提示并支持可视化浏览远程目录； - **端口转发**：支持建立本地到远程内部服务的加密隧道（如内网数据库、后端 API），默认仅监听 127.0.0.1 安全地址； - **集群并发执行**：支持多主机批量命令执行，并可通过别名、运行环境或标签进行过滤； - **Agent 直连调用**：智能体与面板共享主机配置，在会话中发出指令即可委派 Agent 执行远程巡检与运维命令。 ### 使用统计（Usage Statistics · Token 消耗追踪、余额预警与 Token 银行） 在“设置 > 使用统计”中集中查看 token 消耗数据、供应商余额以及编程套餐额度，支持自动定时刷新与手动即时查询。 - **用量明细**：查看每日输入、输出与缓存用量，按不同供应商与模型细分展示，并提供最近 30 天消费趋势；支持的供应商提供账户余额查询，针对 DeepSeek 官方路由还提供峰谷分时计费与账单估算。 - **个人套餐追踪**：实时展示 Kimi、GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode Go、Codex / ChatGPT 等平台编程套餐的使用比例与重置周期。 - **Token 银行**：所有 provider 每消耗 100 万 tokens 铸造 1 鲸元，以“鲸元券”形式展示台账周期内的累计 token 与调用指标，支持保存票券卡片与系统级分享。 - **桌面宠物联动**：安装宠物插件后，可通过桌面悬浮挂件的气泡提示直接查看当前会话供应商的额度、余额或今日消耗。 统计自插件首次启用起计，不回填历史数据；鲸元券统计台账窗口内所有 provider 的 tokens（消费行仍只来自 DeepSeek 官方余额观测）。支持的供应商列表与配置细节见 [dsh-usage README](packages/dsh-usage/README.zh.md)。 ![DeepSeek Token 用量统计与 Token 银行 — API 消耗追踪与账单估算](docs/screenshots/35-usage-token-bank.webp) ### Git 图谱（Git Graph · 分支可视化与 Worktree 会话隔离） 在对话输入框上方集成 Git **安全批量操作**：支持跨筛选结果的多选批量归档、批量恢复以及级联物理删除。执行物理删除时系统将明确提示受影响的后代会话数与预计释放空间，大批量删除需二次确认；当前处于运行中或带有运行中子代理的会话受到严格保护，防止误删； - **自动化生命周期策略**：提供两个默认关闭的自动化策略：根据最后活跃时间自动归档、根据归档时间自动清理超期数据，支持在启用前进行结果预览与单次手动执行。 删除操作不可逆，所有管理路由严格限制本机回环访问。详细机制见 [dsh-session-archive README](packages/dsh-session-archive/README.zh.md)。 ### 更多插件（More Plugins） - **Skill 中心**（`dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer`）：按来源集中查看与管理已加载的 agent `dsh web` 可正常启动。 - npm 安装方式无需额外环境；若从源码仓库构建，需要 Node.js >= 22 与 pnpm 环境。 ### 三步上手（npm 安装，推荐） - **DSH Web CLI（现有浏览器服务）**： 1. 先完成三项构建脚本审批（见“安装排障”），再安装聚合包：`dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-web-all@latest` 2. 重启 `dsh web` 服务，侧边栏将自动呈现各插件入口 3. 打开“设置 > 插件配置”按需开关插件，或在皮肤面板选用主题 - **官方桌面客户端（DeepSeek Harness Desktop）**： 1. 打开官方桌面客户端，进入“设置 → 插件”页面 2. 在插件安装框中输入 `@linxin666/dsh-web-all` 并确认安装 3. 重启客户端，即可在侧边栏与“设置”中使用各插件功能 > 若仅需要皮肤功能，可单独安装 `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center`。若因包管理器门禁安装到旧版本，请参阅后文“安装排障”。 ### 从 GitHub 仓库直接安装 仓库根目录声明了标准 `dsh.bundle` npm 安装聚合包效果等价，二者择其一即可。请勿同时通过两种方式安装，以免出现 entry id 冲突。 ### 从仓库安装（开发调试） 如需二次开发或调试插件，可按以下步骤从源码构建（要求 Node.js >= 22 与 pnpm）： ```sh # 1. 克隆源码仓库 git clone https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web.git cd dsh web 服务 dsh web ``` > 提示：profile 目录未配置为 pnpm workspace，聚合包内部的 `workspace:*` 依赖在解析时会尝试回退拉取 npm 线上版本。若线上包存在版本差异，请先运行 `node scripts/link-profile.mjs` 确保全部子包均指向本地构建产物。 ### 单独安装某个插件 > **pnpm 严格依赖隔离导致模块找不到**：pnpm 的 isolated 模式默认仅将聚合包放置在顶层，部分子包可能被嵌套收敛，导致 `dsh web` 启动时报错 `Cannot find package '@linxin666/dsh-...'`。若遇到此情况，可在 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中添加配置 `nodeLinker: hoisted`（或 `public-hoist-pattern: ['@linxin666/*']`）后重新安装。 > **构建脚本被拦截 (ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS)**：这三项审批必须在首次 add 之前就位。正确顺序是重置 profile（官方 `--from-default-profile web`）或换新 profile，在 `/pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里把三项写成映射，再执行 add： > > ```yaml > allowBuilds: > cloudflared: true > cpu-features: true > ssh2: true > ``` > > 必须写成上面的映射形式：列表形式会被 pnpm 改写成 `'0': cloudflared` 之类的占位条目，重跑时还会回退已解析的包（`Packages: -10`）。装失败后补审批重跑会 e

# dsh-task-board · Autonomous Task Board & Cron Scheduling for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) English | [中文](README.zh.md)

   

Autonomous Kanban Task Board & Cron Scheduling for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
Host-Authoritative Ledger · Parent-Card Subtask Dispatch · Double-Blind Verification · Sleep Inhibition · GitHub Issue-to-PR

A hot-pluggable DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI and official desktop client task automation plugin with a Host-authoritative task ledger, real DSH agent session execution, cron background scheduling, cross-platform idle-sleep protection, parent-card subtask dispatch, and automated verification quality gates. It executes unattended background workflows including automated code reviews, routine health checks, and scheduled pipelines without requiring an open browser window. It mounts cleanly via `cordis.patch.yml` and profiles without modifying DSH core code. - Host-authoritative architecture and offline background execution: The browser is merely an asynchronous view; closing tabs or dropping connections will not interrupt Host scheduling, session execution, or atomic ledger settlement. Built-in cross-platform sleep inhibition (macOS, Windows, Linux) allows screens to power down while preventing system idle sleep for reliable unattended automation. - Parent-card dispatch over subtask trees: a task can carry subtasks, one to three levels deep as the deployment allows. Running a card opens one session, that card's own: the Host opens nothing for its subtasks, and that session reads them with `task_board_get`, dispatches them with `subagent` in dependency order, and writes their conclusions back with `task_board_manage` before it finishes. A card whose subtasks are still unfinished runs under the liangshen dispatcher preset. - Double-blind adversarial judge quality gates (No False Completion): Intercepts false agent completion claims; requires verification by an independent Judge Model using strict coding criteria, a 0.65 threshold, two-round A/B position swapping, and validation against real workspace filesystem diffs, returning actionable diagnostics for self-repair. - Automated GitHub loop, freeze handover, and agent tool surface: Real-time bidirectional GitHub Issues sync automates agent bug fixing and PR creation; supports `<<>>FREEZE` block from a session; it parses into a goal/progress/next snapshot persisted with the task (ledger v3). Cards carry a frozen badge, the detail view shows the full snapshot and freeze time, search covers snapshot text, and archive/restore matches plain tasks. The snapshot reuses the freeze security gate at the protocol layer: sensitive patterns become `[REDACTED]` with a marker, slash-prefixed command lines reject the whole snapshot, and each field is capped at 8 KiB. - **Handover bundles and the permission confirmation gate**: a continuation card may attach a handover bundle — the pinned execution triplet (workspace / agent preset / permission) plus doc/script references. The bundle's triplet overrides the plain pin fields at execution, and the references ride the prompt as a handover preamble. A binding whose effective permission is above the deployment's permission baseline — the Host's own default permission preset unless the profile pins `sessionDefaultPermission` — is unconfirmed: manual run refuses, cron skips the card and rolls to the next occurrence, and the confirm button in the task detail resolves the binding; any later permission or bundle change re-arms the gate. - **Claim provenance wrap and source audit**: executing a continuation card (a card with a frozen snapshot) mandatorily wraps the task instruction in a source-declaration template — freeze instant, source session, and an unreviewed-content warning — composed after the handover preamble so the picking-up agent stays wary of stored prompt injection in card text. The session issuing a create/update action is stamped into the snapshot (frozenBy, re-stamped when the snapshot is replaced), and the session issuing a run/rerun lands on the execution record (initiatedBy) together with a captured copy of the freeze provenance; both are visible in the task detail. The initiator is client-asserted audit metadata, not a trust boundary. - **Task tags (issue #1521)**: a task may carry up to eight labels. A label renders as a colour-toned badge on the card — the tone is hashed from the name, so one label always paints the same way and no colour is stored — the board header gains a multi-select tag filter built from every label in use (including archived tasks), and search also matches label names. A label with an "execution hint" is injected ahead of the execution prompt on every run as a `标签提示` block; a label without one is display and filter only, so an untagged task's prompt is byte-for-byte what it was before the feature. Labels stay editable after the first run: they classify the task and shape the next run, they are not the record of what already ran. A **Manage labels** action on the filter row opens the label manager: every label in use with the number of tasks carrying it, a rename that rewrites the label on every card (merging into an existing label of that name and keeping that label's execution hint), and a delete that removes it from every task including archived ones. Both are ledger-wide Host transactions, so several windows looking at one board stay consistent. - **Label cleanup**: a **Cleanup** row in the label manager takes a threshold (5 by default, 1 to 99) and removes the labels the board has stopped using. A label is a candidate when fewer than that many tasks carry it and every one of those tasks is already done or failed; archived cards count on the same terms, so an archived card that settled lets its label go while a card that is archived and still unfinished keeps it. Cleanup works out its candidates before it writes anything: with none it only says so and leaves the ledger alone, and with some it opens the confirm dialog listing each label with its task count, after which each of them goes through the same ledger-wide delete the manager's own delete button uses. The label leaves every card including archived ones, its execution hint goes with it, and no task is otherwise touched; the removal cannot be undone. - **Subtasks and parent-card dispatch**: a task can be given subtasks, either by creating one from its detail view (the form starts from the parent's workspace, preset, permission, and model, and each stays overridable) or by linking an existing task that has no parent yet; a subtask can be detached again once it is not running. The lineage gate lives in the Host: the parent must exist and be on board, a task can never be attached under one of its own descendants, and a tree may not exceed the configured `maxSubtaskDepth` (1 by default, 3 maximum). Running a card opens one session for that card and none for its subtasks, and running a subtask directly is the same operation: that card is the root of the run even when it carries a parent and subtasks of its own, and nothing under it is expanded. A subtask already in the done column is outside the run's dispatch set, so finishing subtasks one by one and then running the parent costs one session instead of a repeat of the tree; move it back to the todo column to have it dispatched again. The board marks parent and subtask cards, the detail view lists the direct subtasks and says what one run will do, and the header offers a one-click hide-subtasks filter. - **Parent-card dispatch and subtask accounting**: clicking a card that carries unfinished subtasks opens that card's own session and nothing else. The run is forced under the `liangshen` dispatcher preset shipped by `packages/dsh-liangshen`, the card's stored agent preset is never rewritten, and session reuse is skipped so the run mints a fresh session; a deployment that registers no `liangshen` preset fails the run closed, with that missing preset as the reason on the card. The prompt names every unfinished subtask with its title, task id, and status, states that no session is opened for them, and asks the session to read each card with `task_board_get`, dispatch it with `subagent` in dependency order (independent ones may run together), and write each conclusion back with `task_board_manage({action:'record-external-outcome'})` before it finishes. A conclusion the session never wrote back is supplied by the Host when the card's own run ends: every still-unrecorded unfinished subtask inherits that verdict as an external record whose initiator reads `parent-run:` and whose reason says the card ran no session of its own and inherited the parent run's conclusion. The backfill is idempotent, and a cancelled parent writes nothing. A card with no unfinished subtask is unaffected. - **Project partition (issue #1536)**: the board header offers a project row built from the deployment's DSH workspaces — "all projects" plus one entry per registered project. Selecting a project narrows the columns to the tasks pinned to it, and tasks with no pinned workspace stay visible under "all projects". Opening the new-task form while a project is open preselects that project as the task's workspace, and "new project…" registers a host directory through the same runtime call the GUI's own add-project uses. A root task created without a project choice — from the form or through the board's agent tool — inherits the workspace of the session that created it, and a card that still pins nothing runs in the deployment's most recently used workspace instead of the Host's own working directory. - **AI parse of pasted text (issue #1540)**: the new-task form takes text copied from anywhere and has a model turn it into the title, description, and run prompt. The model is one of the deployment's configured models (the same list the task's model pin uses, first entry preselected), and the call runs on the Host behind the board's usual loopback and same-origin fence, with a 45 s budget and a cancel affordance. The draft only fills the form: nothing is created until the task is submitted, and a failed parse leaves what you already typed untouched. - **Collapsible task form**: the create/duplicate/subtask dialog groups its configuration into collapsible regions — task content open by default, then labels, execution settings, run mode, handover, and scheduled runs — and every collapsed region keeps a one-line summary of the values it holds, so the dialog fits without a scrollbar (its body keeps an overflow fallback for very short windows). The agent-preset field is named "Agent preset" and lists the deployment's built-in presets under localized names plus any user preset, with an inherit default that names the preset a run without a pin actually uses. - **Card attachments (issue #1979)**: a card may carry up to eight files and images. The create and edit forms accept them three ways — drag and drop, paste, and the file picker — and a picked file stays a LOCAL preview until the card is saved: the upload happens on save, so a card the user abandons leaves no stored object behind. The drop area is focusable and keyboard-operable, and the removal controls are disabled while a save is in flight. An image is stored as a raster image and travels with the execution as an image part of the prompt, placed after the text part; any other file is stored verbatim and reaches the execution session as a readable host path in a read-only attachment section of its own, separate from the handover references. The card keeps METADATA only — the kind, the stored identifier, the name, the size, the media type, the digest of the exact stored bytes, and the pixel size of an image — never the bytes, never base64, never a data URL. The display name is always one canonical line without any path part, so it can neither break the prompt nor point at a directory. Before the ledger commits an attachment, the Host proves the claim against the official attachment storage: an image is read back and compared, a file is streamed and its digest recomputed, and a reference the storage cannot prove refuses the whole action, so a spoofed client claim never becomes a stored fact. Every execution resolves the attachments afresh, and a route that declares it cannot read images refuses the run before the prompt is queued. The board's limits are eight attachments per card, 10 MiB per attachment and 32 MiB per card; a deployment whose own attachment storage is stricter — including its per-message image budget — lowers the published limit, and the Host enforces that budget both when it writes the card and when the execution resolves it. One stored object is claimed once: the same content never appears twice on a card. - **Host-authoritative ledger**: tasks, schedules, and execution records live in `$DSH_HOME/task-board/ledger-v2.json`; browser actions become confirmed Host transactions. - **Bounded execution history**: each task keeps the most recent 20 execution records; the oldest runs are trimmed when a new run starts, so ledger size and write cost stay bounded regardless of how often a task has run. - **Real execution**: manual and scheduled runs use the same Host runner, which by default creates a fresh session, renames it, applies the agent preset and `/permission `, then queues the task prompt. - **Goal-driven runs (opt-in per card, on top of the global switch)**: the GLOBAL native `/goal` switch (below, off by default) is the master control; with it on, and only when a card opts in through its detail-view checkbox (the new-task dialog starts unchecked), the runner queues the task prompt and then arms dsh's built-in `/goal` with that same composed prompt as the objective. dsh's goal-round driver keeps starting continuation rounds in the session until the agent marks the goal complete, and the board keeps the execution in `running` until the goal leaves its active phase: a completed goal settles the run as succeeded, a blocked one fails it with the goal's own reason. The option is per task (`goalRun`, absent means off, so a card that never touched it runs one plain turn) and is available to `task_board_create`/`task_board_update` too. The checkbox is always operable: the master switch decides whether the preference takes effect, never whether it can be stated, and it never rewrites the stored value. - **Goal acceptance (on by default)**: a task executed in goal form must pass ONE acceptance before `update_goal(action: complete)` may take effect, because the board gates that call on the official tool pre-execute lifecycle instead of trusting the agent's own report. Acceptance runs the default final acceptance of the installed `dsh-llm-verifier` (MIT): the three coding criteria (Specification Adherence, Output Match, Error Signal Detection), a 0.65 threshold applied to the total AND to every criterion, two judge rounds per criterion with the A/B slots swapped and averaged, the task's real trajectory (tool calls, their output, assistant prose) judged against the empty-work baseline, the work must beat that baseline, and — when the deployment records workspace changes — the HOST's own record of what the run changed on disk (file list with added/deleted counts and bounded per-file comparisons) is attached as the prompt's reference context so a described-but-unapplied patch cannot pass. A veto is booked as a quality verdict only when it can be LOCATED: every criterion that makes the run fail must arrive with a structured finding naming the requirement it imposes, the observation that falls short, the difference, and a verbatim citation of the task, the work's own trajectory or the host's workspace record. A rejecting answer with no finding, a generic or empty finding, a citation that does not occur in the reviewed evidence, a citation of the empty-work baseline, and a criterion failed without its own evidence are recorded as an INVALID acceptance instead: they spend no quality budget, do not fail the card, and are bounded separately (two), after which the board stops calling the judge and holds the card for a human. A run whose only records are invalid ends for lack of a matching pass, but with its own terminal reason that states the acceptance was unusable and explicitly denies being an evidence-backed quality veto. A judge that could not see the output because the trace was truncated is treated the same way, because insufficient evidence is not a failure of the work. One execution may accept twice: the first failure returns the total, the per-criterion scores and the located findings to the fixing agent, the second failure ends that execution as failed. Once an execution PASSES and settles, the acceptance-only detail (its findings and structured citations) is removed automatically and only a lightweight audit credential remains — verdict, scores, time, judge route, evidence hash and a one-line problem summary. Nothing outside that execution's own acceptance record is touched, a failed or invalid execution keeps everything a repair or a review needs, the removal is idempotent, and a cleanup that fails is recorded and retried on the next Host start without ever revoking the pass. The budget lives on the execution record, so a repeated completion call, a new goal round, a plugin reload and a Host restart all reuse the same cycle, while a rerun or a scheduled occurrence is a new execution with its own budget. An anomaly (timeout, authentication failure, unparseable judge answer, unresolvable judge route) is recorded separately from a quality verdict and never consumes the quality budget. Exhausting the anomaly budget does NOT fail the card: a judge route that cannot answer is the environment failing, not the work, so the cycle is held open with no further judge call until a user clears the recorded anomalies through `task_board_manage(action: reset-verification)`. An attempt that the acceptance time budget ends before any verdict is recorded as its own stage, spends no budget at all and also fails nothing. Both ceilings are settings (`goalVerificationCallTimeoutSeconds`, `goalVerificationBudgetSeconds`), read live, and a judge call is never opened when the time left cannot hold it. The running column shows executing / verifying / fixing, and each execution's row carries its verdict, judge model and level, count, scores with thresholds, findings, evidence scope and token usage. Forced acceptance also keeps the old fallback paths honest: a paused goal, an unreadable projection, a completed turn and a manual settle can no longer settle a goal execution as succeeded without a matching pass record. A failure carrying acceptance records means the judge answered and the work did not pass, while a failure with no acceptance record at all is reported as its own reason: the gate never opened because the session never called `update_goal(action: complete)` — often a session that narrated completion in prose — so nothing was ever judged and the delivery was never rejected. **A single card can opt out of the gate**: the new-task form and the task detail both carry a Skip acceptance checkbox (off by default, a card-level option like Continue in the same conversation and Start with /goal), and a checked card no longer intercepts its completion claim in goal form. The execution records `applicability: skipped` and the report says the CARD skipped acceptance, which is a different fact from the board-wide switch being off and is reported as such. It applies only to executions started afterwards, so flipping it mid-run never rewrites the rule judging a run already in flight. - **Task reasoning effort**: the task model picker exposes a reasoning-effort selector when the selected model declares supported levels in the Host model catalog. Leaving it blank inherits the model/Host default; only that model's declared levels are offered. The task stores its choice and applies it when selecting the execution model, including a reused session. This setting is separate from the acceptance judge's reasoning effort. - **Optional session reuse**: a task can opt into continuing in its previous execution's session (issue #1419). Reuse happens only when that session is idle and still present in the runtime roster — the Host then re-applies the pinned permission and model on it and queues the prompt, keeping the conversation title and history; otherwise the run mints a fresh session as before, so an unknown roster or a busy session never blocks a scheduled run. The roster read is taken for the launch itself, so a board that has been idle reuses a session that has been idle all along instead of refusing it. - **Idle-aware session polling (issue #1821)**: the Host reads the DSH session roster only while the board has something that roster can decide — an execution to inspect, or a card parked in the running column whose verdict may arrive from a settle this process never saw. An empty board with no running card, no open execution and no enabled schedule polls nothing at all, so an idle Host no longer rebuilds every persisted session row (string conversion, object allocation, one stat per record) on a fixed heartbeat. The cadence that governs a busy board is the `sessionPollSeconds` setting, and a roster read that fails or stays unknown backs off on a doubling delay up to one minute, so a session tree that is down is not hammered at the poll interval. - **Fail-closed pins**: a missing workspace, missing or broken preset, or rejected permission command fails before the task prompt is sent. - **Host scheduler**: 5-field cron supports `*`, `*/n`, ranges, comma lists, and Sunday `0/7`. Each rule carries its own IANA time zone (the Host's zone by default), and day-of-month/day-of-week follow Vixie semantics: both fields restricted means OR, any other combination means AND. Wall-clock gaps at a daylight-saving transition are skipped, and an ambiguous repeated time fires once, at the earlier instant. A rule is either a recurring cron rule — optionally capped by a run limit (unlimited, 1, 2, or any positive whole number) — or a one-shot pinned to a single future instant; the Host counts the executions it actually opens, and a rule that reaches its cap or fires its one-shot stops itself in the ledger rather than waiting for the executed work to disarm it. - **Deterministic recovery**: a running execution with a recorded session is observed after restart; an interrupted start without a session id is cancelled and is not resent. - **Live synchronization**: mutations return a full revisioned snapshot; SSE announces revision, scheduler, and power changes. The mirror has five re-read entry points: change frames (revision advancing), connection establishment or re-establishment (`EventSource.onopen`), page visibility recovery, stream errors (`EventSource.onerror`, throttled by `STREAM_ERROR_NOTIFY_MS`), and a bounded verification read while the mirror still has unsettled executions (`src/client/pending-verify.ts`, `PENDING_VERIFICATION_MS` 15 seconds, stopped as soon as the last execution settles). A connection can stay open yet stop delivering, in which case there is neither an `onerror` nor a frame, so frames cannot be verified from the browser side. An idle board with no unsettled executions performs zero reads. - **Optional idle-sleep protection**: off by default; when enabled it covers every running DSH session, enabled non-archived task-board schedules, and unknown session state. - **System-prompt injection**: the Host registers a `plugin:task-board` section (order 200) through `SystemPrompt.section`, and the task-board settings can disable the announcement without disabling the board. The guidance also reminds agents to close any visible `todo_write` plan before the final answer. - **Agent tools**: every session gets eight model-facing tools (`task_board_list`, `task_board_get`, `task_board_create`, `task_board_update`, `task_board_set_parent`, `task_board_run`, `task_board_manage`, `task_board_schedule`) that drive the same Host ledger the browser drives, so an agent can list the board, create subtasks, link or detach them, start a run, move a card to any column (declaring it done, failed, or in progress without a run), archive/restore/delete it, settle a card the board can no longer observe, and arm its cron schedule from the conversation. - **External outcomes (issue #1826)**: work that is not executed by this Host — an agent outside DSH such as Codex or Claude Code, running its own model — can be recorded as a real run rather than a bare column edit. `task_board_manage(action: 'record-external-outcome', result: 'succeeded'|'failed', initiatedBy: )` appends an execution record carrying the verdict, the caller and an optional summary, and the terminal column is derived from that same record by the same rule a Host settlement

# dsh-update · Plugin Ecosystem Version Check & Update Notifier for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) English | [中文](README.zh.md)

   

Plugin Ecosystem Version Check & Update Notifier for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
Sidebar Footer Trigger · npm Auto-Detection · Release Notes Integration · Verified Update Pipeline

> In-GUI auto-update extension for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) family: a download trigger alongside the settings button in the sidebar footer that checks npm for newer `@linxin666/dsh-web-*` versions and runs a verified `pnpm update --latest` inside the active profile. > **The family aggregate does not include this package.** `@linxin666/dsh-web-all` mounts no update row and does not depend on `@linxin666/dsh-update`; install this package on its own in the profile that should offer self-update. The aggregate keeps only the `update` tombstone subpath, so a profile that still records `@linxin666/dsh-web-all/update` resolves the export and mounts nothing. This package is an external plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), structured as a cordis bundle: the host half mounts the `/api/update` route family while the browser half renders the sidebar trigger and update modal. The feature is deliberately structured as an **independent plugin row** (row id `update`) rather than sharing a seat with `dsh-remote-web-ui`: disabling remote access must never remove the update path, and the row belongs to this package alone. ## What it does - **Sidebar trigger**: a download control in the official `sidebar.footer.action` seat beside the settings trigger. It marks the button with a text badge when a newer release exists, checks the registry on open, and lets the user confirm the update from the result view. - **Web pages only**: the trigger mounts on pages a web transport delivered — the loopback GUI in a browser, a LAN or tunnel deployment. The official DSH Desktop shell serves its page from `dsh-app://app/` and owns its own updater, so the seat is not mounted there at all; that page's seat keeps the phone-remote trigger alone. - **Verified install**: the run endpoint executes `pnpm update --latest` in the profile the web GUI was booted from, then re-reads the installed versions. The pnpm 11/12 `minimumReleaseAge` gate can silently keep same-day releases, so a green exit alone is not reported as success. - **Release notes**: the panel fetches the matching GitHub release notes and lists the component versions it moved. - **Restart hint**: a successful update asks the user to restart `dsh web`, which is when the new package versions load. ## Requirements - DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.3`. - The profile must own the family packages through npm: the aggregate `@linxin666/dsh-web-all`, or the family packages installed directly. A profile whose family is installed with local `link:` specs is reported as **local development mode** and the update is refused (sync the checkout instead). ## Install ```sh # Recommended: install directly from npm dsh plugin --profile add @linxin666/dsh-update # Or from a checkout (development loop) dsh plugin --profile add link:/packages/dsh-update ``` Installing the package mounts the row. Uninstall it, or disable the row in the plugin manager, so a profile stops offering self-update. ## Configuration The plugin ships no settings namespace of its own: a profile either mounts the row or not, and the plugin manager's per-row switch is the only control. The host surface is fixed — the two loopback routes below — and the sidebar trigger always registers into the official `sidebar.footer.action` seat. ## Use 1. Open the dsh web GUI and look at the sidebar foot: the download trigger sits beside the settings trigger (a 36px circle in the collapsed rail, a pill in the wide column). 2. Click it. The panel probes the registry and shows either "up to date" or the newer release with its notes. 3. Confirm with **Update now**. The panel shows the pnpm run, then the outcome and the component versions. 4. Restart `dsh web` for the new packages to load. ## Routes Both routes are exact matches on the host web server and answer only to the local machine: | Route | Method | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `/api/update/status` | GET | Registry probe: install mode, owning profile, per-package current/latest, release notes | | `/api/update/run` | POST | Runs the verified `pnpm update --latest` in the owning profile | A paired remote desktop reaches them through the `dsh-remote-web-ui` gated `/remote/api` channel, which is why that plugin's channel rules keep `/api/update/` on the paired path. ## Security model - **The run endpoint executes a real install on this machine.** It is fenced to the loopback authority and refuses cross-site browser markers, so a LAN or tunnel origin can never trigger it directly. - **The update target is the host process's own module graph.** The anchor manifest is resolved from the running host (`@linxin666/dsh-web-all` first, falling back to this package), so the update always writes the profile that serves the page — never a path supplied by the client. - **Local links are refused**, not rewritten: a `link:` spec cannot be updated from the registry, and silently replacing it would detach the user's checkout. - The panel prints the captured pnpm output, which can contain local paths. No credentials are read from or written to the profile by this plugin. ## Known limitations - The desktop shell (`dsh-app://` pages) has no update seat by design: use the desktop application's own updater there, or open the GUI in a browser to drive the family update. - A profile whose family packages are installed with local `link:` specs reports local development mode and cannot self-update; sync the checkout instead. - `pnpm` must be resolvable on the host (`pnpm`, `corepack`, or `npx`); the panel names the candidate that failed when none works. - The pnpm 11/12 `minimumReleaseAge` gate can hold back same-day releases. The update command overrides it per run with `--config.minimum-release-age=0`; the key is kebab-case because pnpm 12 ignores `--config.minimumReleaseAge=0` without a warning, while pnpm 11 accepts both spellings (#1897). When the installed versions did not move, the panel explains that key change and the `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` / `minimumReleaseAge: 0` remedy. - The captured pnpm output is shown verbatim and can contain local paths. - The wide sidebar row that puts the footer actions beside the settings trigger is declared by `dsh-remote-web-ui`. With that plugin disabled the update trigger falls back to the shell's own stacked foot: it still renders and works, only the shared-row layout is lost. ## Development ```sh pnpm --filter @linxin666/dsh-update typecheck pnpm --filter @linxin666/dsh-update test pnpm --filter @linxin666/dsh-update build ``` ## Checks Focused gates: `pnpm --filter @linxin666/dsh-update test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test:standards`, and `pnpm libs:check` after the aggregate is rebuilt. ## Telemetry One anonymous install heartbeat per browser per UTC day (package name only, silent failure), following `docs/telemetry.md`. 自动化流水线） 通过侧边栏“任务看板”进入。任务看板不仅仅是一个可视化卡片界面，更是 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Web GUI 与桌面客户端中的**宿主权威后台长程执行与多 Agent 自动化调度引擎**。任务按“待规划、待办、进行中、已完成、已失败”五列进行全生命周期管理，以 Schema v6 事务账本为权威持久化核心，真正实现了长程任务从拆解、分发、团队协作、对抗质检到外部成果闭环的全流程自动化： - **宿主权威后台驱动与 7x24 小时离线无人值守**：区别于传统仅在前端网页轮询的脆弱看板，所有卡片流转、调度触发与执行监控完全由 DSH 后端 Host 进程作为唯一权威驱动。浏览器仅为异步视图，关闭网页标签页、熄灭屏幕或断开网络，后台智能体会话照常并发执行与原子落盘结算。内置跨平台防休眠电源管理（macOS `caffeinate`、Windows `ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED`、带有 systemd-logind 的 Linux `systemd-inhibit`），允许显示器正常关闭的同时阻止整机因闲置休眠，确保夜间无人值守巡检与流水线准时打卡。 - **多 Agent 树状级联并发与原生 Agent Teams 团队编排**：复杂工程目标可自由拆解为多层树状子任务（支持 1~3 层深度，内置环路与深度护栏）。**级联执行模式**通过受控准入队列（runLaunchWidth）并发派生多个独立智能体会话，自动跳过已在完成列的子任务，任一子任务失败自适应收拢整树状态；**原生 Agent Teams 模式**深度对接官方团队服务，启动专属 Team Lead 会话并在其内部为每个子任务动态孵化专属 Teammate，协同工具跨智能体联动，实现真正意义上的多智能体团队协同作战。 - **对抗式双盲质量验收门禁（No False Completion）**：彻底终结 AI 编程中“自述已完成、实则未改动或改崩溃”的虚假交付顽疾。以 goal 形式执行的任务在 Agent 试图调用 `update_goal(complete)` 宣告完工的瞬间被 Host 强制拦截，必须由独立的裁判模型（可自选模型与思考档位）进行真实验收。验收机制沿用严苛的 Coding 质量判据、0.65 绝对通过阈值，每项判据双轮交换 A/B 位置打分消偏，并严格结合会话执行轨迹与宿主工作区真实磁盘文件的 Diff 行级变更审查。首轮未达标精准下发具象结构化问题引导 Agent 自我修复，两次仍不通过才判负，杜绝敷衍糊弄。 - **全自动 GitHub Issue-to-PR 闭环研发流**：搭配官方扩展（`dsh-client-ui-task-board-github`），实现任务看板与 GitHub Issues / PR 状态的实时双向深度同步。远端 Issue 自动进入看板流水线驱动 Agent 读取需求、定位代码、修复 Bug 并运行测试，验收交付后全自动创建 GitHub Pull Request 并绑定 Issue 关联，PR 合并后自动关闭 Issue，打造全天候无人值守的开源与企业 Issue 自动化修复交付管线。 - **长程目标驱动、会话持久化与冻结交接包（Freeze Handover）**：任务支持武装内置 `/goal` 引擎进行多轮自主续跑；周期性任务可开启会话复用，保留完整上下文记忆；支持通过 `<< Agent 预设”中选用。梁神模式（`dsh-liangshen`）是专为追求**极致推理效率、超低静态上下文开销与严苛工程执行纪律**而深度重构的杀手级预设与运行时插件。针对主流大模型在长程编程任务中容易出现的系统提示词冗长膨胀、工具 Schema 挤占上下文、思维链无效空转（如“流水账推理”）以及多轮遗忘退化等痛点，梁神模式通过原生极简提示词、程序化代码工具调用（PTC）、MCP 温和分页与关键事实局部就近投射，提供纯粹而强悍的编程作战体验： - **极简 Persona 与严苛行动导向纪律（Zero Prompt Waste）**：彻底剥离官方 Standard 预设中冗长繁琐的系统级条文，将提示词极致收敛为单行 Persona 与经过实战千锤百炼的高效工程纪律。内置反思熔断（同一假设推演不超过两轮，缺少事实立即闭合思考并调用原生工具探测，杜绝凭空揣测）、行动导向（思考过程仅用于决定下一步具体操作，严禁在思考中预演完整代码）、并发探索（单轮内并发派发多个独立检测或搜索工具）、YAGNI 与 PDCA 循环（单步验证单一假设，不写冗余注水注释）、以及有界收敛纪律（前置检查最多 2-3 轮即刻收敛，迅速转入实际作答或编辑）。大幅降低静态 Token 占用，让模型注意力百分之百倾注于业务与代码本身。 - **程序化工具调用传输（PTC · Programmatic Tool Calling）**：彻底终结在每次请求中平铺上百个 JSON Schema 工具参数的低效模式。默认将网络线协议（wire）极致收拢为唯一的 `run_code`（运行 TypeScript 脚本），其余所有工具均通过自动生成的强类型 SDK 在独立的沙箱线程中以代码形式调用。无论系统注册了多少复杂工具，静态传输面始终保持极小体积；模型可原生利用 `Promise.all` 编写并发工具调用，并在程序内预先过滤、聚合、提取关键数据，只将精炼结论回传至对话上下文，从根本上解决大文本输出打爆 Token 的问题。对于习惯原生工具面的场景，亦可在插件设置中一键无缝切换为组装好的原生工具清单（Native）。 - **MCP 工具温和分页与 LRU 动态激活（Gentle Tool Paging）**：针对海量 MCP 工具或第三方插件扩展，出厂默认启用温和分页（默认匹配 `mcp__*`）。外部工具在初始状态下仅以命名空间摘要形式登记在目录消息中，既不占 wire 协议也不进 SDK 声明；当大模型判定需要使用对应工具时，可自主调用 `tool_activate({ namespace })` 按需挂载。内置 LRU 策略（上限 3 个活跃命名空间），自动淘汰最久未用的命名空间，激活状态在会话压缩与恢复后完整重建，兼具海量工具接入能力与极致小巧的静态 Schema 面。 - **关键事实登记簿与就近状态投射（Fact Register & Working Context）**：长程多轮对话中大模型极易遗忘早期的关键业务约束或踩过的坑。插件向模型提供专属 `fact_register` 工具，可将用户硬性约束、已确认的架构决策或失败路径登记为单行事实（每条不超过 160 字符，最多保留 12 条）。关键事实随 `[Working Context: ...]` 状态行在每一轮交互中就近投射至最新消息尾部的局部注意力窗口内，从物理机制上彻底解决长上下文“中间遗忘”与重复踩坑顽疾。 - **原生调度者架构与敏捷访谈纪律（Dispatcher Identity & Triage）**：预设出厂深度集成调度者（Dispatcher）架构规范，赋能模型以团队指挥官身份统领工程任务。内置复杂度分诊机制（L0/L1 单点任务直接敏捷执行，L2 复杂任务严格遵循“澄清访谈 -> 架构规划 -> 并发子代理派发 -> 双层严格验收”标准流）；设定严格的提问预算控制（单轮最多 4 问、总计最多 3 轮、影响面排序、假设先行），杜绝无效拉扯；任务状态权威沉淀于 `todo_write`，杜绝浮躁的敷衍式交付。 - **新建会话老虎机拨杆与炫酷中奖特效（Composer Slot Lever）**：在新建会话输入框工具行、模型选择器左侧，精心打造了一台复古老虎机拨杆控件。下拉拨杆（支持鼠标拖拽、单击或键盘快捷操作）即可一键为当前新建会话装配梁神模式，拉下命中即触发绚丽的中奖粒子特效（闪光、冲击环、火花粒子与专属彩蛋横幅）；上推即可平滑切回默认模式。拨杆自适应全局主题色彩，且在会话开始后自动隐藏，丝滑灵动，极具极客趣味。 详细机制、评测数据与高级配置参数见 [dsh-liangshen README](packages/dsh-liangshen/README.zh.md)。 ### 手机 App 远程访问（Mobile Remote · 原生手机 App 接入） 在 profile 中安装 `@linxin666/dsh-remote-bridge` 插件并重启服务后，点击侧边栏底部的二维码图标（aria-label 为「配对手机（协议 v1）」）打开配对面板。使用手机 App 扫码即可直接开始使用。 配对面板具备本地安全保护，令牌路由（`/remote-bridge/pair/token`）带有回环门控，仅允许在本机浏览器中访问（非本机访问返回 403）。面板生成的配对码为一次性凭据，有效期为 30 秒，点击「重新取码」将作废上一张配对码。二维码编码包含服务地址与令牌的文档（URL 形如 `wss:///ios/v1?token=...`），手机 App 扫码后即可同时获取服务地址与鉴权令牌。 网络接入协议面仅暴露 `/ios/v1` 一个 WebSocket 端点，隧道与局域网转发均指向仅放行该路径的入站闸门，公网无法直接访问 Web GUI 路由。服务地址按实时状态（中继租约或运行中的隧道）、环境变量 `DSH_REMOTE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` 以及局域网转发器实际监听地址的顺序解析。默认配置下公网可用（中继默认开启、隧道默认关闭、局域网转发默认关闭）；若需在局域网内直连，需在插件配置中开启局域网转发。原浏览器远程控制插件 `dsh-remote-web-ui` 已退役，接入栈能力已迁入本包。 ### 远程连接（SSH Ops · Web 终端、SFTP 传输与集群运维） 通过侧边栏“SSH”入口打开远程运维面板。支持密钥与密码认证，可一键导入本地 `~/.ssh/config` 主机列表；配置数据安全保存在 `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json` 中。面板提供以下操作能力： - **Web 终端**：基于 xterm.js 的完整远程交互终端，支持实时输出与窗口自适应； - **文件传输**：集成 SFTP 上传与下载功能，提供进度提示并支持可视化浏览远程目录； - **端口转发**：支持建立本地到远程内部服务的加密隧道（如内网数据库、后端 API），默认仅监听 127.0.0.1 安全地址； - **集群并发执行**：支持多主机批量命令执行，并可通过别名、运行环境或标签进行过滤； - **Agent 直连调用**：智能体与面板共享主机配置，在会话中发出指令即可委派 Agent 执行远程巡检与运维命令。 ### 使用统计（Usage Statistics · Token 消耗追踪、余额预警与 Token 银行） 在“设置 > 使用统计”中集中查看 token 消耗数据、供应商余额以及编程套餐额度，支持自动定时刷新与手动即时查询。 - **用量明细**：查看每日输入、输出与缓存用量，按不同供应商与模型细分展示，并提供最近 30 天消费趋势；支持的供应商提供账户余额查询，针对 DeepSeek 官方路由还提供峰谷分时计费与账单估算。 - **个人套餐追踪**：实时展示 Kimi、GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode Go、Codex / ChatGPT 等平台编程套餐的使用比例与重置周期。 - **Token 银行**：所有 provider 每消耗 100 万 tokens 铸造 1 鲸元，以“鲸元券”形式展示台账周期内的累计 token 与调用指标，支持保存票券卡片与系统级分享。 - **桌面宠物联动**：安装宠物插件后，可通过桌面悬浮挂件的气泡提示直接查看当前会话供应商的额度、余额或今日消耗。 统计自插件首次启用起计，不回填历史数据；鲸元券统计台账窗口内所有 provider 的 tokens（消费行仍只来自 DeepSeek 官方余额观测）。支持的供应商列表与配置细节见 [dsh-usage README](packages/dsh-usage/README.zh.md)。 ![DeepSeek Token 用量统计与 Token 银行 — API 消耗追踪与账单估算](docs/screenshots/35-usage-token-bank.webp) ### Git 图谱（Git Graph · 分支可视化与 Worktree 会话隔离） 在对话输入框上方集成 Git **安全批量操作**：支持跨筛选结果的多选批量归档、批量恢复以及级联物理删除。执行物理删除时系统将明确提示受影响的后代会话数与预计释放空间，大批量删除需二次确认；当前处于运行中或带有运行中子代理的会话受到严格保护，防止误删； - **自动化生命周期策略**：提供两个默认关闭的自动化策略：根据最后活跃时间自动归档、根据归档时间自动清理超期数据，支持在启用前进行结果预览与单次手动执行。 删除操作不可逆，所有管理路由严格限制本机回环访问。详细机制见 [dsh-session-archive README](packages/dsh-session-archive/README.zh.md)。 ### 更多插件（More Plugins） - **Skill 中心**（`dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer`）：按来源集中查看与管理已加载的 agent `dsh web` 可正常启动。 - npm 安装方式无需额外环境；若从源码仓库构建，需要 Node.js >= 22 与 pnpm 环境。 ### 三步上手（npm 安装，推荐） - **DSH Web CLI（现有浏览器服务）**： 1. 先完成三项构建脚本审批（见“安装排障”），再安装聚合包：`dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-web-all@latest` 2. 重启 `dsh web` 服务，侧边栏将自动呈现各插件入口 3. 打开“设置 > 插件配置”按需开关插件，或在皮肤面板选用主题 - **官方桌面客户端（DeepSeek Harness Desktop）**： 1. 打开官方桌面客户端，进入“设置 → 插件”页面 2. 在插件安装框中输入 `@linxin666/dsh-web-all` 并确认安装 3. 重启客户端，即可在侧边栏与“设置”中使用各插件功能 > 若仅需要皮肤功能，可单独安装 `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center`。若因包管理器门禁安装到旧版本，请参阅后文“安装排障”。 ### 从 GitHub 仓库直接安装 仓库根目录声明了标准 `dsh.bundle` 装配清单，支持直接通过仓库地址安装，无需手动克隆代码与构建： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhu1090093659/dsh-web # 或使用完整 git 地址：dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web.git ``` 该方式与直接从 npm 安装聚合包效果等价，二者择其一即可。请勿同时通过两种方式安装，以免出现 entry id 冲突。 ### 从仓库安装（开发调试） 如需二次开发或调试插件，可按以下步骤从源码构建（要求 Node.js >= 22 与 pnpm）： ```sh # 1. 克隆源码仓库 git clone https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web.git cd dsh web 服务 dsh web ``` > 提示：profile 目录未配置为 pnpm workspace，聚合包内部的 `workspace:*` 依赖在解析时会尝试回退拉取 npm 线上版本。若线上包存在版本差异，请先运行 `node scripts/link-profile.mjs` 确保全部子包均指向本地构建产物。 ### 单独安装某个插件 > **pnpm 严格依赖隔离导致模块找不到**：pnpm 的 isolated 模式默认仅将聚合包放置在顶层，部分子包可能被嵌套收敛，导致 `dsh web` 启动时报错 `Cannot find package '@linxin666/dsh-...'`。若遇到此情况，可在 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中添加配置 `nodeLinker: hoisted`（或 `public-hoist-pattern: ['@linxin666/*']`）后重新安装。 > **构建脚本被拦截 (ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS)**：这三项审批必须在首次 add 之前就位。正确顺序是重置 profile（官方 `--from-default-profile web`）或换新 profile，在 `/pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里把三项写成映射，再执行 add： > > ```yaml > allowBuilds: > cloudflared: true > cpu-features: true > ssh2: true > ``` > > 必须写成上面的映射形式：列表形式会被 pnpm 改写成 `'0': cloudflared` 之类的占位条目，重跑时还会回退已解析的包（`Packages: -10`）。装失败后补审批重跑会 exit 0，但 `dsh.profile.bundles` 仍无该行：静默半挂载，重跑修不回来，需要先 remove 再 add。已带审批的存量 profile 升级不受影响。 > **pnpm 11 发布时间门禁问题**：在包版本发布后的短时间内，pnpm 11 的默认安全策略（`minimumReleaseAge`）可能会尝试回退拉取旧版本。建议在 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中排除相关命名空间以确保获取最新版本： > > ```yaml > minimumReleaseAgeExclude: > - '@linxin666/*' > ```
## 兼容性与运行环境 dsh-web 针对主流操作系统、现代化浏览器及网络拓扑进行了深度工程调优与兼容性保障： | 维度 | 支持范围与技术规格 | | --- | --- | | 宿主运行环境 | DeepSeek Harness CLI (`dsh web`)、官方桌面客户端（DeepSeek Harness Desktop） | | 操作系统 | macOS (Apple Silicon M 系列 & Intel 芯片)、Windows 10/11 (含 WSL2)、Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Arch, CentOS 等) | | 浏览器与设备 | 桌面浏览器 (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox)；移动端现代浏览器 (iOS Safari, Android Chrome 等) | | 网络连接架构 | 本机环回访问 (127.0.0.1)、局域网多设备互联 (LAN)、公网隧道安全穿透 (Cloudflare Tunnel, Tailscale, FRP, Nginx 反向代理) | | 模型供应商覆盖 | DeepSeek 官方通道与满血模型、OpenAI (GPT-4o 等)、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini、Kimi (Moonshot)、GLM (智谱

# dsh-usage · Token Usage Breakdown, API Balance & Cost Monitor for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) English | [中文](README.zh.md)

   

Token Usage Breakdown, Multi-Provider Balance & Cost Monitor for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
Daily Token Analytics · Provider API Balance · Subscription Quotas · Peak/Off-Peak Costing · Token Bank

A dedicated token usage and cost monitoring plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI and official desktop client: multi-provider balances, coding subscription quota tracking, live token accounting ledgers, and a compact quick-glance card above settings in the sidebar. ## What it does The plugin runs a host-side service and a Usage page under Settings → Web Extensions (or a standalone first-level 使用统计 section when that parent is absent): - **Usage tab (用量)**: today's token totals per bucket (input / output / cache read / cache write, disjoint as the provider reports them) with per-provider and per-model breakdown, the last 30 days as a horizontal provider/model bar chart, and the balance of every configured provider (one row per adapter family: a dormant catalog alias shadowed by the family's live route no longer renders its own balance row). A **day picker** switches that card to any retained day that recorded usage (today first, then the other days newest first) and the card then shows that day's own totals, provider rows, and estimated spend; the peak/off-peak line stays on today because it describes the pricing window now. The ledger folds live `session/event` streams (`request/header` route attribution plus `assistant/message` usage) into `$DSH_HOME/dsh-usage/usage-ledger.json` with day-based retention, so past days survive restarts; counting starts when the plugin is first enabled. For the official DeepSeek family the tab also shows the current peak/off-peak pricing period (Beijing weekdays 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 are peak, billed at double) and today's estimated spend in CNY; that line is toned by the current clock — red while peak, green while off-peak — and always carries the word plus a dot, so colour is never the only signal. - **Plans tab (个人套餐)**: coding-plan quota windows for every configured provider that exposes one — used percent and reset time per window (Kimi For Coding 5h/week, GLM Coding Plan 5h/week/month, OpenCode Go rolling/weekly/monthly, MiniMax 5h/week, Codex / ChatGPT subscription 5h/week). Providers without a real plan or subscription (DeepSeek, ZenMux, Moonshot, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow) never appear on this tab; their balance shows on the usage tab instead. - **Token Bank tab (Token 银行)**: the whale-yuan voucher (鲸元券) minted from every provider's ledger usage at an anti-inflation exchange rate of 1,000,000 tokens per whale yuan: the DeepSeek official family (the `deepseek` catalog alias, the live `deepseek-official` route and the signed-in `deepseek-account` route) counts its tokens and calls beside every subscription and relay route. The tab sums those retained-ledger totals, stamps the minted face value onto the banknote artwork with a serial line carrying the minting window, and offers a save-image button plus a native share button when the browser supports sharing files. The spend line stays official-family only: it shows the real CNY total observed from the official balance once available — balance decreases accrue as spend, top-ups never count — and falls back to the fold-time estimate before the first observation, because subscription and relay routes ship no price book. The minted total prefers the host's whole-ledger aggregate and falls back to the last 30 days on an older host; with no usage at all the tab shows its empty state. A day picker mints the note from one picked day instead of the whole retention window (the observed-spend line, which accrues from the first balance reading, is whole-window only and falls back to that day's fold-time estimate on a single day). The on-note text is locale-neutral (digits, latin captions, ISO dates) and the export is rendered locally in the browser. - **Sidebar foot card**: a compact glance seated above the sidebar's Settings row — today's estimated spend as the headline (today's tokens when nothing priced is recorded yet), the tokens/calls line, and up to two configured-provider balances with a +N overflow. The whole card is one button that opens the usage settings section, so detail stays in one place, and the corner chevron folds it into a one-line strip (the spending provider's name, the peak marker, the label, and the headline value), a choice persisted across reloads. When today's spend runs on the official DeepSeek route the card marks the pricing clock for the current date and hour (weekends and Chinese public holidays are off-peak for the whole day, so the red state only ever appears inside a weekday peak window): a red dot with 高峰 (peak) or a green dot with 空闲 (off-peak), plus a line naming when the current period ends or when peak returns in the expanded state; a card for any other provider never carries the marker. It polls at a relaxed 30 s cadence while the tab is visible, hides in the collapsed 56 px rail, and disappears while the plugin is disabled. - Probes run entirely host-side on a poll cycle (default 60 s, manual refresh button); API keys are resolved through the harness credential seam (`llm-pi-ai` records, `apiKeyEnv` references) and never reach the browser. Supported balance endpoints: DeepSeek (the official live route `deepseek-official` and the catalog alias `deepseek` both resolve), Moonshot (CN/international), OpenRouter, SiliconFlow (CN/international), ZenMux. Supported plan endpoints: Kimi For Coding, GLM Coding Plan (CN via open.bigmodel.cn, international via api.z.ai — the `zai` route the pi-ai catalog registers, plus the `zai-coding` / `zai-coding-cn` aliases; 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, token-metered and credit-metered plans), OpenCode Go, MiniMax, Codex / ChatGPT subscription (OAuth access token from the pi-ai grant; a stale token shows an error until the harness next refreshes it). Providers without a programmatic endpoint (Qwen token plans, OpenCode Zen PAYG, Anthropic, OpenAI) are listed without facts. ### Spend estimate scope Today's spend is an estimate priced at fold time from the published DeepSeek peak/off-peak price book (CNY per million tokens; peak = the windows above, off-peak half of peak). The rows in force are `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) and `deepseek-v4-pro`: the retired flash ids (`deepseek-v4-flash`, `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) bill the flash row, and `deepseek-v4-pro` moves to that row once DeepSeek routes the id to V4.1-Flash on 2026-09-14 12:00 Beijing. It covers the official DeepSeek routes only — relay traffic billed elsewhere (ZenMux, SiliconFlow, ...) stays unpriced — and unknown DeepSeek model ids take the flash-class row. Buckets recorded before a price change keep the old pricing, so a price-book update is reflected from the moment it ships, not retroactively. The published rule bills a Chinese public holiday entirely off-peak even on a Monday-Friday, and bills an adjusted workday falling on a Saturday or Sunday off-peak too. Weekends are therefore already off-peak by construction, and this package ships the State Council holiday table (`src/core/holidays.ts`, 2020 through 2026, taken from the MIT-licensed [chinese-holidays-node](https://github.com/bastengao/chinese-holidays-node) yearly data with only its `holiday` entries), so a public-holiday weekday is estimated at the off-peak row instead of reading up to about twice the real spend. A year the table does not cover (later than 2026) falls back to the published windows, which reads high rather than low — the safer direction to be wrong in. ## Install Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 or later: the plugin is developed against the 0.2.1-rc.3 DSH cohort (its settings page is the Host-generated page of the plugin's own Config schema) and its `@deepseek-ai/*` runtime imports are provided by the host itself. In your profile (e.g. `~/.dsh/profiles/web`): ```bash pnpm add @linxin666/dsh-usage ``` and insert into `cordis.patch.yml` (or use the bundle patch): ```yaml - insert: - id: usage name: '@linxin666/dsh-usage' ``` Restart `dsh web` for the host half; the client half applies on refresh. A full family install opens `Settings -> Web Extensions -> Usage`; a standalone install keeps `Settings -> Usage Statistics`. ## Configuration | Key | Default | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; off = no listeners, no probes, no routes | | `pollIntervalSec` | `60` | Provider probe cycle (30-3600 s; a change reloads the plugin row) | | `retainDays` | `180` | Ledger retention in local days (7-730) | ## Known limitations - Usage counting starts when the plugin is first enabled; historical sessions are not backfilled. - OAuth-based routes (for example qwen OAuth grants) are detected as such but not probed; the plugin does not spend third-party OAuth budgets. - A failed probe keeps the previous fact visible and reports the error line; providers may rate-limit aggressive polling. - The voucher's face value covers the ledger's retention window (`retainDays`): pruned days drop out of both the trend chart and the note. - The day pickers list only days the ledger recorded usage on: a day without usage is never offered, and a day pruned by retention leaves an empty or zeroed card rather than a different one. - The real-spend watch starts at the first official balance observation: earlier consumption is not backfilled, and only observed balance decreases accrue (a balance rise is a top-up and never counts). # dsh-web · DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI 插件与主题全家桶 中文 | [English](README.en.md) dsh-web 是面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web GUI、DeepSeek 网页版与官方桌面客户端（DeepSeek Desktop）的模块化插件生态与 AI 智能体开发工作台。全面支持 DeepSeek-V3 与 DeepSeek-R1 等前沿推理模型，为开发者与重度用户提供自主任务自动化看板（Cron 定时后台执行）、手机 App 远程访问、Web SSH 终端与 Linux 集群运维、Git 可视化提交图谱与多 Agent Worktree 隔离开发、全量会话检索与归档管理、Token 用量与成本监控（含 Token 银行），以及一站式主题皮肤与桌面宠物工坊。用户既可以通过官方 profile 机制将插件全家桶一键挂载至已有的 `dsh web` 实例，也可以直接在官方 DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端中开箱即用。

               

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 插件生态 · 模块化智能体工作台
全功能 Web UI · 任务自动化看板 · 手机 App 远程访问 · Web SSH 运维 · Git 图谱与 Worktree · Token 成本统计 · 视觉工坊

## 是什么 原生 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供了核心的对话交互与工具调用能力，但在多任务并发调度、长程后台执行、移动端协同以及工程化开发运维方面仍有扩展空间。 dsh-web 通过官方 profile 机制挂载到 `dsh web`，零修改侵入官方源码，为用户提供完整的模块化扩展体系： - **工程运维与协同插件**：涵盖长程自动化任务看板（多 Agent 级联/Teams 编排、对抗验收质检与定时调度）、梁神模式（极简 Persona、PTC 代码运行传输与敏捷调度纪律）、手机 App 远程访问、SSH 终端传输、Git 图谱与 worktree 隔离、全量会话归档管理以及模型能力声明编辑器； - **视觉主题与资产解耦**：功能插件与样式资产完全分离。皮肤插件负责底层渲染，多样化的主题皮肤（含样式、贴图与动态特效）以及桌面宠物可通过 [DSH 创意工坊](#创意工坊dsh-marketcom)自由安装； - **全家桶聚合与按需组合**：既支持通过 `@linxin666/dsh-web-all` 聚合包一键安装完整功能，也支持按需单独安装特定插件。聚合包预集成家族全部功能插件，详见[插件全家桶使用指南](packages/dsh-web-all/README.zh.md)。 ![DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 配合 实行应用内专管（外部 CLI 会限制对 `desktop` profile 的修改），安装本插件全家桶时请直接在桌面客户端内进行： 1. 打开官方桌面客户端，进入“设置”中的“插件”页面（或左侧导航栏的插件入口）； 2. 在插件管理界面的安装输入框中，输入插件全家桶包名 `@linxin666/dsh-web-all`（或 `@linxin666/dsh-web-all@latest`），点击安装； 3. 安装完成后重启客户端，即可在客户端中使用任务看板、主题皮肤、远程控制等全套插件能力。 ## 创意工坊（dsh-market.com） [创意工坊](https://dsh-market.com) 是 DSH 生态的一站式资产分发平台，统一提供主题皮肤、桌面宠物、功能插件与社区 Agent 预设”中用于新建会话。 ![DeepSeek Harness 创意工坊 dsh-market.com — 主题皮肤、桌面宠物与社区插件市场](docs/screenshots/31-market-home.png) 创意工坊站点为本仓库的组成部分：前端为纯静态构建，由构建脚本 `scripts/market-build` 依据 `skin.json`、`pet.json` 与 `community.json` 等数据源自动生成；点赞等动态能力由 Cloudflare Workers 边缘函数与 D1 数据库提供支持（遵循单设备单票限制），代码合入 `main` 分支后自动触发持续集成部署。 创意工坊旨在建立开放透明的社区生态，方便开发者分享作品并让用户自由选择所需扩展。 ## 功能插件 ### 任务看板（Task Board · 企业级后台长程执行引擎与多 Agent 自动化流水线） 通过侧边栏“任务看板”进入。任务看板不仅仅是一个可视化卡片界面，更是 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Web GUI 与桌面客户端中的**宿主权威后台长程执行与多 Agent 自动化调度引擎**。任务按“待规划、待办、进行中、已完成、已失败”五列进行全生命周期管理，以 Schema v6 事务账本为权威持久化核心，真正实现了长程任务从拆解、分发、团队协作、对抗质检到外部成果闭环的全流程自动化： - **宿主权威后台驱动与 7x24 小时离线无人值守**：区别于传统仅在前端网页轮询的脆弱看板，所有卡片流转、调度触发与执行监控完全由 DSH 后端 Host 进程作为唯一权威驱动。浏览器仅为异步视图，关闭网页标签页、熄灭屏幕或断开网络，后台智能体会话照常并发执行与原子落盘结算。内置跨平台防休眠电源管理（macOS `caffeinate`、Windows `ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED`、带有 systemd-logind 的 Linux `systemd-inhibit`），允许显示器正常关闭的同时阻止整机因闲置休眠，确保夜间无人值守巡检与流水线准时打卡。 - **多 Agent 树状级联并发与原生 Agent Teams 团队编排**：复杂工程目标可自由拆解为多层树状子任务（支持 1~3 层深度，内置环路与深度护栏）。**级联执行模式**通过受控准入队列（runLaunchWidth）并发派生多个独立智能体会话，自动跳过已在完成列的子任务，任一子任务失败自适应收拢整树状态；**原生 Agent Teams 模式**深度对接官方团队服务，启动专属 Team Lead 会话并在其内部为每个子任务动态孵化专属 Teammate，协同工具跨智能体联动，实现真正意义上的多智能体团队协同作战。 - **对抗式双盲质量验收门禁（No False Completion）**：彻底终结 AI 编程中“自述已完成、实则未改动或改崩溃”的虚假交付顽疾。以 goal 形式执行的任务在 Agent 试图调用 `update_goal(complete)` 宣告完工的瞬间被 Host 强制拦截，必须由独立的裁判模型（可自选模型与思考档位）进行真实验收。验收机制沿用严苛的 Coding 质量判据、0.65 绝对通过阈值，每项判据双轮交换 A/B 位置打分消偏，并严格结合会话执行轨迹与宿主工作区真实磁盘文件的 Diff 行级变更审查。首轮未达标精准下发具象结构化问题引导 Agent 自我修复，两次仍不通过才判负，杜绝敷衍糊弄。 - **全自动 GitHub Issue-to-PR 闭环研发流**：搭配官方扩展（`dsh-client-ui-task-board-github`），实现任务看板与 GitHub Issues / PR 状态的实时双向深度同步。远端 Issue 自动进入看板流水线驱动 Agent 读取需求、定位代码、修复 Bug 并运行测试，验收交付后全自动创建 GitHub Pull Request 并绑定 Issue 关联，PR 合并后自动关闭 Issue，打造全天候无人值守的开源与企业 Issue 自动化修复交付管线。 - **长程目标驱动、会话持久化与冻结交接包（Freeze Handover）**：任务支持武装内置 `/goal` 引擎进行多轮自主续跑；周期性任务可开启会话复用，保留完整上下文记忆；支持通过 `<< Agent 预设”中选用。梁神模式（`dsh-liangshen`）是专为追求**极致推理效率、超低静态上下文开销与严苛工程执行纪律**而深度重构的杀手级预设与运行时插件。针对主流大模型在长程编程任务中容易出现的系统提示词冗长膨胀、工具 Schema 挤占上下文、思维链无效空转（如“流水账推理”）以及多轮遗忘退化等痛点，梁神模式通过原生极简提示词、程序化代码工具调用（PTC）、MCP 温和分页与关键事实局部就近投射，提供纯粹而强悍的编程作战体验： - **极简 Persona 与严苛行动导向纪律（Zero Prompt Waste）**：彻底剥离官方 Standard 预设中冗长繁琐的系统级条文，将提示词极致收敛为单行 Persona 与经过实战千锤百炼的高效工程纪律。内置反思熔断（同一假设推演不超过两轮，缺少事实立即闭合思考并调用原生工具探测，杜绝凭空揣测）、行动导向（思考过程仅用于决定下一步具体操作，严禁在思考中预演完整代码）、并发探索（单轮内并发派发多个独立检测或搜索工具）、YAGNI 与 PDCA 循环（单步验证单一假设，不写冗余注水注释）、以及有界收敛纪律（前置检查最多 2-3 轮即刻收敛，迅速转入实际作答或编辑）。大幅降低静态 Token 占用，让模型注意力百分之百倾注于业务与代码本身。 - **程序化工具调用传输（PTC · Programmatic Tool Calling）**：彻底终结在每次请求中平铺上百个 JSON Schema 工具参数的低效模式。默认将网络线协议（wire）极致收拢为唯一的 `run_code`（运行 TypeScript 脚本），其余所有工具均通过自动生成的强类型 SDK 在独立的沙箱线程中以代码形式调用。无论系统注册了多少复杂工具，静态传输面始终保持极小体积；模型可原生利用 `Promise.all` 编写并发工具调用，并在程序内预先过滤、聚合、提取关键数据，只将精炼结论回传至对话上下文，从根本上解决大文本输出打爆 Token 的问题。对于习惯原生工具面的场景，亦可在插件设置中一键无缝切换为组装好的原生工具清单（Native）。 - **MCP 工具温和分页与 LRU 动态激活（Gentle Tool Paging）**：针对海量 MCP 工具或第三方插件扩展，出厂默认启用温和分页（默认匹配 `mcp__*`）。外部工具在初始状态下仅以命名空间摘要形式登记在目录消息中，既不占 wire 协议也不进 SDK 声明；当大模型判定需要使用对应工具时，可自主调用 `tool_activate({ namespace })` 按需挂载。内置 LRU 策略（上限 3 个活跃命名空间），自动淘汰最久未用的命名空间，激活状态在会话压缩与恢复后完整重建，兼具海量工具接入能力与极致小巧的静态 Schema 面。 - **关键事实登记簿与就近状态投射（Fact Register & Working Context）**：长程多轮对话中大模型极易遗忘早期的关键业务约束或踩过的坑。插件向模型提供专属 `fact_register` 工具，可将用户硬性约束、已确认的架构决策或失败路径登记为单行事实（每条不超过 160 字符，最多保留 12 条）。关键事实随 `[Working Context: ...]` 状态行在每一轮交互中就近投射至最新消息尾部的局部注意力窗口内，从物理机制上彻底解决长上下文“中间遗忘”与重复踩坑顽疾。 - **原生调度者架构与敏捷访谈纪律（Dispatcher Identity & Triage）**：预设出厂深度集成调度者（Dispatcher）架构规范，赋能模型以团队指挥官身份统领工程任务。内置复杂度分诊机制（L0/L1 单点任务直接敏捷执行，L2 复杂任务严格遵循“澄清访谈 -> 架构规划 -> 并发子代理派发 -> 双层严格验收”标准流）；设定严格的提问预算控制（单轮最多 4 问、总计最多 3 轮、影响面排序、假设先行），杜绝无效拉扯；任务状态权威沉淀于 `todo_write`，杜绝浮躁的敷衍式交付。 - **新建会话老虎机拨杆与炫酷中奖特效（Composer Slot Lever）**：在新建会话输入框工具行、模型选择器左侧，精心打造了一台复古老虎机拨杆控件。下拉拨杆（支持鼠标拖拽、单击或键盘快捷操作）即可一键为当前新建会话装配梁神模式，拉下命中即触发绚丽的中奖粒子特效（闪光、冲击环、火花粒子与专属彩蛋横幅）；上推即可平滑切回默认模式。拨杆自适应全局主题色彩，且在会话开始后自动隐藏，丝滑灵动，极具极客趣味。 详细机制、评测数据与高级配置参数见 [dsh-liangshen README](packages/dsh-liangshen/README.zh.md)。 ### 手机 App 远程访问（Mobile Remote · 原生手机 App 接入） 在 profile 中安装 `@linxin666/dsh-remote-bridge` 插件并重启服务后，点击侧边栏底部的二维码图标（aria-label 为「配对手机（协议 v1）」）打开配对面板。使用手机 App 扫码即可直接开始使用。 配对面板具备本地安全保护，令牌路由（`/remote-bridge/pair/token`）带有回环门控，仅允许在本机浏览器中访问（非本机访问返回 403）。面板生成的配对码为一次性凭据，有效期为 30 秒，点击「重新取码」将作废上一张配对码。二维码编码包含服务地址与令牌的文档（URL 形如 `wss:///ios/v1?token=...`），手机 App 扫码后即可同时获取服务地址与鉴权令牌。 网络接入协议面仅暴露 `/ios/v1` 一个 WebSocket 端点，隧道与局域网转发均指向仅放行该路径的入站闸门，公网无法直接访问 Web GUI 路由。服务地址按实时状态（中继租约或运行中的隧道）、环境变量 `DSH_REMOTE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` 以及局域网转发器实际监听地址的顺序解析。默认配置下公网可用（中继默认开启、隧道默认关闭、局域网转发默认关闭）；若需在局域网内直连，需在插件配置中开启局域网转发。原浏览器远程控制插件 `dsh-remote-web-ui` 已退役，接入栈能力已迁入本包。 ### 远程连接（SSH Ops · Web 终端、SFTP 传输与集群运维） 通过侧边栏“SSH”入口打开远程运维面板。支持密钥与密码认证，可一键导入本地 `~/.ssh/config` 主机列表；配置数据安全保存在 `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json` 中。面板提供以下操作能力： - **Web 终端**：基于 xterm.js 的完整远程交互终端，支持实时输出与窗口自适应； - **文件传输**：集成 SFTP 上传与下载功能，提供进度提示并支持可视化浏览远程目录； - **端口转发**：支持建立本地到远程内部服务的加密隧道（如内网数据库、后端 API），默认仅监听 127.0.0.1 安全地址； - **集群并发执行**：支持多主机批量命令执行，并可通过别名、运行环境或标签进行过滤； - **Agent 直连调用**：智能体与面板共享主机配置，在会话中发出指令即可委派 Agent 执行远程巡检与运维命令。 ### 使用统计（Usage Statistics · Token 消耗追踪、余额预警与 Token 银行） 在“设置 > 使用统计”中集中查看 token 消耗数据、供应商余额以及编程套餐额度，支持自动定时刷新与手动即时查询。 - **用量明细**：查看每日输入、输出与缓存用量，按不同供应商与模型细分展示，并提供最近 30 天消费趋势；支持的供应商提供账户余额查询，针对 DeepSeek 官方路由还提供峰谷分时计费与账单估算。 - **个人套餐追踪**：实时展示 Kimi、GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode Go、Codex / ChatGPT 等平台编程套餐的使用比例与重置周期。 - **Token 银行**：所有 provider 每消耗 100 万 tokens 铸造 1 鲸元，以“鲸元券”形式展示台账周期内的累计 token 与调用指标，支持保存票券卡片与系统级分享。 - **桌面宠物联动**：安装宠物插件后，可通过桌面悬浮挂件的气泡提示直接查看当前会话供应商的额度、余额或今日消耗。 统计自插件首次启用起计，不回填历史数据；鲸元券统计台账窗口内所有 provider 的 tokens（消费行仍只来自 DeepSeek 官方余额观测）。支持的供应商列表与配置细节见 [dsh-usage README](packages/dsh-usage/README.zh.md)。 ![DeepSeek Token 用量统计与 Token 银行 — API 消耗追踪与账单估算](docs/screenshots/35-usage-token-bank.webp) ### Git 图谱（Git Graph · 分支可视化与 Worktree 会话隔离） 在对话输入框上方集成 Git 操作栏与可视化提交历史图谱： - **分支与提交图谱**：直观展示分支分叉与合并泳道，便于在大中型项目中快速追溯代码演进与切换分支。 - **Git Worktree 隔离会话**：多 Agent 并发处理任务时，直接在主分支修改容易导致文件冲突与分支污染。插件支持在 `$DSH_HOME/worktrees/` 目录下为新会话建立完全独立的 worktree 检出与隔离分支（命名形如 `wt/<名称>`），主检出文件保持干净；通过“管理 worktree”面板可集中查看与清理临时检出。 - **自动化策略与 Agent 集成**：提供“自动隔离”选项，为进入 Git 仓库的新会话自动分配专属 worktree；同时向智能体暴露 `git_worktree` 工具，允许 Agent 自主创建与管理隔离开发环境。 | Git 图谱 | Git worktree 并行会话 | | --- | --- | | ![DeepSeek Harness Git 图谱 — 分支合并与提交历史可视化](docs/screenshots/04-git-graph.png) | ![DeepSeek 多 Agent 并行会话 — Git Worktree 工作区独立隔离](docs/screenshots/34-git-worktree.png) | ### 会话归档管理（Session Archive Manager · 全文检索与生命周期策略） 会话归档管理（`dsh-session-archive`）是专为解决大量长短期会话堆积而设计的集中管理模块，随全家桶安装生效： - **集中检索与状态筛选**：统一呈现活跃会话、已归档会话、空白会话、子代理派生会话以及无工作区会话，支持按标题、工作区、状态及会话 ID 进行关键词搜索与多维排序； - **安全批量操作**：支持跨筛选结果的多选批量归档、批量恢复以及级联物理删除。执行物理删除时系统将明确提示受影响的后代会话数与预计释放空间，大批量删除需二次确认；当前处于运行中或带有运行中子代理的会话受到严格保护，防止误删； - **自动化生命周期策略**：提供两个默认关闭的自动化策略：根据最后活跃时间自动归档、根据归档时间自动清理超期数据，支持在启用前进行结果预览与单次手动执行。 删除操作不可逆，所有管理路由严格限制本机回环访问。详细机制见 [dsh-session-archive README](packages/dsh-session-archive/README.zh.md)。 ### 更多插件（More Plugins） - **Skill 中心**（`dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer`）：按来源集中查看与管理已加载的 agent skills，支持按名称与功能描述实时搜索过滤，多工作区独立呈现，支持一键启停与删除。 - **插件管理器**（`dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager`）：基于官方 host 接口从 npm 或 git 仓库直接安装插件，可视化管理插件运行状态与自定义配置。 - **插件自更新**（`dsh-update`，全家桶不含，需单独安装）：自动检测 npm 官方更新并在 Web GUI 侧边栏/设置中提供更新日志与一键平滑升级。 - **任务看板 GitHub 同步**（`dsh-client-ui-task-board-github`）：为任务看板无缝接入 GitHub Issues 与 PR 状态双向同步，自动化驱动 AI Agent 修复与提 PR。 - **会话 ID 辅助**（`dsh-client-ui-session-id`）：侧边栏底部提供当前会话全量 ID 的一键复制与快速检索定位。 - **国际化语言包**（`dsh-i18n`）：提供俄语本地化定义与全家族插件命名空间统一多语言字典支持。 ### 皮肤 经典的 Blue Fantasy 蓝色幻想是随皮肤插件内置的默认主题：深邃的靛蓝色调贯穿全局，搭配半透明毛玻璃面板与定制鲸鱼插画，在暗色模式下具有优秀的视觉沉浸感。其他精美皮肤与 Wallpaper Engine 动态壁纸由皮肤插件统一管理，可直接在[创意工坊](https://dsh-market.com)在线预览、试穿与一键安装。 ![DeepSeek Harness 主题皮肤 — Blue Fantasy 暗黑沉浸风格预览](docs/screenshots/17-skin-blue-fantasy-dark.png) ## 快速上手 ### 系统要求 - 已安装 DeepSeek Harness 且 `dsh web` 可正常启动。 - npm 安装方式无需额外环境；若从源码仓库构建，需要 Node.js >= 22 与 pnpm 环境。 ### 三步上手（npm 安装，推荐） - **DSH Web CLI（现有浏览器服务）**： 1. 先完成三项构建脚本审批（见“安装排障”），再安装聚合包：`dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-web-all@latest` 2. 重启 `dsh web` 服务，侧边栏将自动呈现各插件入口 3. 打开“设置 > 插件配置”按需开关插件，或在皮肤面板选用主题 - **官方桌面客户端（DeepSeek Harness Desktop）**： 1. 打开官方桌面客户端，进入“设置 → 插件”页面 2. 在插件安装框中输入 `@linxin666/dsh-web-all` 并确认安装 3. 重启客户端，即可在侧边栏与“设置”中使用各插件功能 > 若仅需要皮肤功能，可单独安装 `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center`。若因包管理器门禁安装到旧版本，请参阅后文“安装排障”。 ### 从 GitHub 仓库直接安装 仓库根目录声明了标准 `dsh.bundle` 装配清单，支持直接通过仓库地址安装，无需手动克隆代码与构建： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhu1090093659/dsh-web # 或使用完整 git 地址：dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web.git ``` 该方式与直接从 npm 安装聚合包效果等价，二者择其一即可。请勿同时通过两种方式安装，以免出现 entry id 冲突。 ### 从仓库安装（开发调试） 如需二次开发或调试插件，可按以下步骤从源码构建（要求 Node.js >= 22 与 pnpm）： ```sh # 1. 克隆源码仓库 git clone https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web.git cd dsh-web # 2. 安装项目依赖并构建全包 pnpm install pnpm -r build # 3. 将本地包软链挂载至 web profile（建议先链接所有子包再注册聚合包） node scripts/link-profile.mjs dsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/dsh-web-all # 4. 重新启动 dsh web 服务 dsh web ``` > 提示：profile 目录未配置为 pnpm workspace，聚合包内部的 `workspace:*` 依赖在解析时会尝试回退拉取 npm 线上版本。若线上包存在版本差异，请先运行 `node scripts/link-profile.mjs` 确保全部子包均指向本地构建产物。 ### 单独安装某个插件 如果不需要安装全家桶，可根据实际需求单独安装各个功能模块： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-task-board@latest # 任务看板 dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-liangshen@latest # 梁神模式（极简预设与 PTC 传输） dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-task-board-github@latest # 任务看板 GitHub Issues 同步扩展 dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-ssh@latest # 远程连接（SSH） dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-usage@latest # 使用统计 dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-pet@latest # 桌面悬浮宠物 dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-session-archive@latest # 会话归档管理 dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-update@latest # 插件自更新（全家桶不含） dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-session-id@latest # 会话 ID 复制 dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer@latest # Skill 中心 dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-i18n@latest # 国际化语言包 ```

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
OpenCode 用量面板

在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏，随时看清 OpenCode 的额度、花费和趋势。

安装 · 界面 · 账户形态 · 开发与原理

> [!NOTE] > 这是 DeepSeek Harness 的第三方插件，数据来自 OpenCode 官方。

侧栏卡片（浅色主题，示意数据）：用量 · 额度 · 预测 · 趋势 · 模型
## 为什么用它 OpenCode 的额度、花费和用量分散在几个接口里：Go 订阅的滚动 / 周 / 月窗口，Console 的花费与 token。这个插件把它们收进一张侧栏卡片，不用打开网页控制台，也不用自己算。 - **Go 和按量账户都能用**：有 Go 订阅时显示额度窗口；只有 Console 用量时保留花费、趋势和模型。 - **知道今天花了多少**：今日花费、请求数、tokens，以及本周 / 本月汇总。 - **看见趋势**：7 天 / 24 小时，花费 / tokens / 请求数随时切换。 - **提前知道会不会用完**：有月度额度时，按当前计费周期的花费速度外推，标出 50% / 100% 的预计日期。 - **知道钱花在哪个模型**：按花费排序的模型条形图。 - **多账户不打架**：同一组织的 Key 合并成一张卡，不同组织分开；可切换账户，花费可按服务账号筛选。 - **高度可配置**：分块显示/隐藏与排序、色条、四档阈值、趋势指标、刷新间隔都能改。 - **不打扰**：跟随 DSH 主题、中英双语、无外部 CDN，偏好只存在本机。 ## 界面 下面按侧栏卡片的五个分块、设置页的三个面板分别说明。截图使用固定样例数据（`acme` / `org_acme` 等账户名与组织 id 均为虚构），实际数字随账户变化。 ### 侧栏卡片 卡片放在侧栏设置按钮上方；侧栏收起时退化为一个百分比/金额小方块，展开后按偏好顺序显示分块，默认只开「用量」和「额度重置时间」，其余在设置里随时打开。卡片右上角还有收起按钮，收起后只剩一行「OpenCode + 最紧一档」，再点一下展开。卡片顶部有一条拖拽热区（悬停露出一小条横线），上下拖动直接调卡片限高，拖到内容放满、不再需要滚动时会自动关掉限高。卡片顶部是账户入口：点账户名可切换组织和服务账号，右侧是刷新、设置与收起按钮。 #### 用量

- 今日花费、请求数、tokens； - Tokens 列默认显示紧凑值，悬停或键盘聚焦可看精确到个位的数字； - 有月度额度时，顶部油表显示本月剩余百分比； - 下方并排汇总今日、本周、本月，不用来回切页面。 #### 额度

- 滚动 5 小时、本周、本月三个窗口； - 进度条按四档分级变色，右侧显示已用百分比； - 每行带重置倒计时；没有 Go 订阅时整块隐藏。 #### 预测
